chapters.title: Chapter 4701: A storm is coming
paragraphs: After Baili Haojie found out about Ling Han’s strength, he was depressed for a whole three days.
He was the son of a Great Emperor, and should have been invincible among his peers, yet in the end, he had encountered a super freak, who suppressed him completely.
How was he supposed to compete?
This gap was not just a little bit, but was completely one-sided.
It could be said that even if all the Great Emperors in history were summoned, it was guaranteed that no one would be a match for Ling Han in a battle of equal cultivation levels.
It must be because of the treasure passed down by Empress Qingzhu!

It should be known that Empress Qingzhu had foreseen that there would be great dangers in this era, and made arrangements, leaving behind a trump card that could eliminate great chaos. That was why Ling Han was so freakish, right?

—He had guessed half right. However, even without the Seed of the Holy Flame, the Saint that Ling Han would become would still be incredibly powerful. He would only be slightly inferior to the present him.
Baili Haojie was extremely jealous. As the son of a Great Emperor, such a great opportunity actually didn’t fall into his hands!
The heavens were really unjust.
But what could be done? Time could not be reversed.
Even if Ling Han made all kinds of demands that went too far, the two great Imperial Clans could only swallow their grievances.
It could not be helped. Ling Han was too strong.
Right now, they could still rely on the Imperial Weapon and Imperial Formation to resist. However, what would happen when Ling Han became a Nine-Star Saint, or even a Pseudo-Emperor?
He would probably be able to channel the Imperial Weapon endlessly, and by then, aside from the true Great Emperor, who would be able to match him?

En, a Pseudo-Emperor bearing an Imperial Weapon should work as well, but whether it was Buddha Doga, Ge Qianqiu or Qian Yanghao, they were all on Ling Han’s side. Just the thought of it was enough to make one lose hope.
Ling Han left in satisfaction. He had practically squeezed the two great Imperial Clans dry.

In desperate times, desperate measures were naturally necessary. Moreover, he had already formed a great enmity with the Ziwei Imperial Clan. He was already being merciful by not razing them to the ground.

Ling Han went to a few more Imperial Clans, and directly showed his cultivation level as a One Star Saint. If anyone was dissatisfied, he further demonstrated thirty Eight Star Regulations, and immediately, there were no objections. They expressed their willingness to form an alliance with the Nine Suns Holy Land, and they would advance and retreat together.
The alliance was established, but how could real-time communication be achieved?

Even if the Saint’s speed was fast, the journey between two locations would take four to five days, at the very least. This Skeleton Saint Tool was pressing down on them en masse, and it was very possible that a battle would be over in less than half a day’s time, so what meaning was there to it?
Thus, they definitely had to establish a real-time communication network. Then, they also had to greatly shorten the time of travel.
Ling Han began to study formation techniques.
In any case, he was already at the peak stage of One Star Saint, and it was impossible for him to break through just by cultivating diligently. Thus, he had free time to do as he liked.
The method he thought of was naturally formations, but this was still limited.
Finally, he thought of the life plaque.
In the Imperial Clan, every important clansman had a life plaque. Once they died, their life plaque would immediately shatter.
Ling Han’s plan was to rear some pigs and dogs, and create life plaques for them. If anything happened, they could be killed, and the various great Imperial Clans would be immediately informed.

Similarly, the various Imperial Clans could also do the same. This dog corresponded to the Nine Suns Holy Land, and that pig would correspond to another Imperial Clan. Once slaughtered, its life plaque shattered, they would immediately be notified.

This solved the problem of communication. However, Ling Han still needed to think of some way to get the Saint-level reinforcements to arrive quickly. At present, the Transfer Formation was not as fast as a Saint making the journey personally.
However, this method of communication was met with opposition from the large black dog and the perverted pig.
Killing dogs and slaughtering pigs, wasn’t that just mocking them?
"If I don’t kill dogs and pigs, I’ll kill flies and mosquitoes, all right?" Ling Han could only compromise.

He had agreed on some details with the Imperial Clans. For example, what level of danger killing flies represented, and what level of danger killing mosquitoes represented. In fact, killing different flies and mosquitoes could also be combined into a complex message, transmitting more specific information.
However, how to get the Saint-level reinforcements to arrive quickly was still a dilemma that could not be solved.
There was really no other way, so he could only use the stupidest method.
Surveillance.

A dozen or so Saints were dispatched to keep an eye on the Skeleton Saint Tool. If there were any signs that they were going to attack any clan, they would immediately send a message and arrive in advance.
After such arrangements, Ling Han finally felt slightly more at ease.

The Skeleton Saint Tool was really too terrifying. It was mainly because there were too many of them. An abundance of ants could bite an elephant to death, and they were completely like lions. Only the Pseudo-Emperor could match them.
Even if Ling Han was so extraordinary, he could only fight one or two of them alone. Once there were too many of them, he would still be beaten to death.
Though the Netherworld did not launch another attack, the atmosphere was incredibly tense.

Ling Han believed that the Netherworld wouldn’t give him time to grow. The twelve Great Emperors had schemed for so many years, so how could they watch as he became a Great Emperor and destroyed everything?
Hence, this was a sign that a storm was about to come, and what would follow would definitely be an incredibly cruel battle.
Most importantly, Ling Han could run, and the large black dog, the empress, and the others could also run, but what about the Four Origin Planet?
There were too many living beings on it.
However, right at this moment, Ling Han suddenly discovered that he was about to break through.

He immediately went into seclusion. Right now, what was most reliable was his own strength. If he could become a Nine-Star Saint... no, as long as he became a Five-Star Saint, that would be enough. That would be enough to force the Skeleton Saint Tool into the ground.
This time, the breakthrough took a long time. A whole three months later, Ling Han finally managed to silently destroy another part of his body, and could thus accommodate even more Regulations.
A Two Star Saint!
His strength immediately soared, and the number of Regulations he had grasped increased from 25 to 30, but the power of belief could only boost Regulations by five times.

Ordinary Saints would only be able to accommodate an additional Regulation after advancing a single level. Those like the Imperial Son would only be able to accommodate an additional two Regulations. Furthermore, it could not be guaranteed that he would be able to reach this number every time he broke through. Only if he was the son of a Great Emperor, would he be able to reach the level of gaining three eight-star Regulations.
But what about Ling Han?
Five flashes!
This was very, very shocking.
However, Ling Han wasn’t overjoyed. Although his battle prowess had increased, it was still insufficient against the Skeleton Saint Tool.
"Now, it’s definitely no problem for me to fight three Skeleton Saint Tools alone, but..."
The number of Skeleton Saint Tools was in the hundreds. If they were all mobilized to attack Four Origin Planet, what could Ling Han do?
If he fought with all his might, he would definitely die, and if he abandoned it and fled, how could Ling Han bear to do so?
However, whatever he feared would come true.

On the third day after Ling Han came out of seclusion, he received news that the Skeleton Saint Tools had moved out, and were charging towards Four Origin Planet, and their numbers were... all at once!
This was a message that had been transmitted by the Saints at the front lines through the method of killing flies and mosquitoes.
At the same time, this news also spread to the other Imperial Clans.

The Saints from the various clans had all come. However, they all advised Ling Han not to clash head-on with the army of Skeleton Saint Tools. Instead, it was best for him to sacrifice his pawns to protect the chariot. Otherwise, he would only die with the Four Origin Planet.

No one agreed to defend the Four Origin Planet with their lives. There were far too many Skeleton Saint Tools, and the Imperial Weapons would only awaken for a limited amount of time. Thus, how long could they defend for?
Thus, retreating immediately was the best course of action.

chapters.title: Chapter 4702: Enemy arrives
paragraphs: None of the Imperial Clans agreed to stay on the Four Origin Planet to fight against the Yin souls.
This was clearly a suicidal action.
The Imperial Weapons could indeed delay them for a while, but could it last forever?

Moreover, there were 12 Ancestral Kings in the Twelve Lands of Death, so there were naturally 12 Imperial Weapons as well. If they really came to blows, they might not be at a disadvantage in terms of Great Emperor-level power.
Thus, the best course of action was to resolutely give up and leave the Four Origin Planet.
Ling Han pondered for a moment, then said, "If these Skeleton Saint Tools were attacking your ancestral grounds, what would you choose?"
These words instantly silenced everyone.
Could they bear to abandon the ancestral grounds and flee with only a limited number of people?
Don’t do unto others what you don’t want.

Ling Han swept an eye over the Saints, and continued, "It is impossible for the invasion of the Netherworld to stop. If we flee the moment they attack, there will eventually come a day when we will have no foothold!"
"Everyone, can the speed at which you push the ancestral grounds to leave compare to the speed at which the Skeleton Saint Tools attack?"
The Saints were even more silent, their expressions grim.

The Netherworld’s battle line was indeed not advancing very quickly. This was limited by the suppression of heaven and earth. However, the Skeleton Saint Tool could attack on its own, and with about a hundred of them arriving at the same time, what Imperial Clan would be able to withstand it?
Now, it was Four Origin Planet. What if it was Ziwei Imperial Clan, Donglin Imperial Clan or the Peacock Imperial Clan next?

The attacks of a few Imperial Weapons would definitely be able to blast open the imperial formation. At that time, the Skeleton Saint Tool would be able to penetrate deeply, and wouldn’t the people be massacred?
"Thus, we must have the courage to fight to the death!" Ling Han said.
"Let’s battle!" Brother Monkey raised the metal rod, divine light shooting from his eyes. His fighting spirit was already blazing.
"Let’s battle!" the young Imperial Sons said respectively.

Though the veteran Saints still had some hesitation in their hearts, they were all on the edge of death now. If Four Origin Planet was destroyed, then perhaps it would be their own ancestral planet’s turn next.
Moreover, if they didn’t help Ling Han, how could Ling Han possibly help them?
"All right, let’s battle!" The Saints all nodded.
There was really no way out for them. They were irreconcilable with the Netherworld, and there was absolutely no way that they could compromise and coexist. Thus, their only option was to battle.
Since they had made up their minds, the Saints also calmed down, and waited quietly.
In the upcoming great battle, it was possible that Saints would fall like rain.
But in the face of this kind of Interrealm War, how could the deaths of Saints be avoided?
No one could possibly stay out of it.
One day, two days, three days. All of a sudden, the air became incredibly oppressive.
Shua!
An attack suddenly blasted over. This was a flash of sword light, as long as 5,000 km. It was entwined with eight-star Regulations, and slashed over.
"Humph!"
Brother Monkey attacked, brandishing his staff to parry the sword light.
Peng! With a single strike, the sword light was instantly obliterated.
"Who are you, little brat!" Brother Monkey’s expression was filled with violence, as he slung the staff over his shoulder.
"Descendant of the Battle Saint Emperor." In space, a person walked out, extremely casual, as if he was walking in his own backyard.
This was a young man, his white robes fluttering, exuding an otherworldly air.
"And who are you?" Brother Monkey asked.
"The son of the Three Purity Great Emperor, Li Dangping," this young man said calmly. He was clearly showing off his strength, yet seemed to have no anger at all, which was a very conflicting scene.
The Three Purity Great Emperor!
Beneath them, the Saints all heard clearly that another identity of the Lords of Death had come to light.

However, it didn’t matter whether they knew their identities or not. In any case, these twelve people were definitely Great Emperors who had suppressed an era. Each of them had once been an invincible emperor.
When they thought of this, all the Saints trembled. How were they supposed to block this kind of enemy? Would they have any chance of winning?
"Come battle!" Brother Monkey brandished his staff and charged towards Li Dangping.
The current Brother Monkey had already successfully advanced into Three Stars. With a wave of his staff, there was a monstrous vicious might.
Boom!
Li Dangping swept out with his sword, and when Brother Monkey’s attack was blocked, he counterattacked aggressively. In just a few moves, he had the complete upper hand.

"Monkey, you’re not the son of a Great Emperor, so how can your aptitude compare to mine?" Li Dangping said calmly. He had also suppressed his cultivation level to three stars, but his battle prowess was enough to suppress Brother Monkey by three levels.
It could not be helped. This was the son of a Great Emperor!
However, Brother Monkey was completely unconcerned. So what if your battle prowess is stronger than mine? I still want to hit you!
Boom, an air of endless violence exuded from Brother Monkey’s body. This was fighting spirit. It actually forcibly increased his battle prowess, and gradually turned the tables on his opponent.
This!
Ling Han looked on with a frown.

The line of the Battle Saint Emperor were indeed natural battle maniacs. However, though Brother Monkey was presently domineering, he had sacrificed his life force as a price. This meant that Brother Monkey’s lifespan would be far from reaching the theoretical one million years of a Saint.

Even for those like the Battle Saint Emperor, who had battled all their lives, they had expended too much energy, and were completely unable to live a second life. They had long since gone to the edge of the universe.
This kind of bloodlust was already branded into the depths of their bodies, and could not be changed at all.
However, Ling Han didn’t stop him.
This was Brother Monkey’s choice. If he forcefully stopped him, that would be disrespectful to Brother Monkey.
Thinking of this, he couldn’t help but feel angered.
If it was not for the invasion of the Netherworld, would Brother Monkey have been forced into such a bloody battle?
Xiu, xiu, xiu! In space, multiple powerful auras appeared. Those were the Imperial Sons of the Twelve Lands of Death.
Shi Gang, Di Wuji, Zhang Yu, Lu Xun, and so on. All of them stood proudly in spaced, exuding an air of dominance.
The son of a Great Emperor was naturally extraordinary.
Ling Han was currently filled with anger. He immediately let out a battle cry, and charged over alone.
"Ling Han, you are too arrogant, aren’t you!" Di Wuji said coldly. He shot out a punch, which turned into a black wolf that was thirty thousand meters long, that pounced to bite at Ling Han.
"Scram!" Ling Han shouted loudly. Peng, this silver wolf was forcibly shattered.
What!
Di Wuji paled in shock. Was Ling Han really as strong as the legends said, to the extent that he could only look up to him in admiration?
How was this possible?
Boom, Ling Han had already charged over with his iron fists, bringing with him his nameless fury.
Peng!

Yang Yihuan, He Luo, Tong Ming, and the other Imperial Sons all summoned their Saint Tools at the same time. They joined forces to parry Ling Han’s attacks. However, with a single punch, these Imperial Sons were all sent flying, as if they were flowers scattered by a celestial maiden.

This caused all the Imperial Sons to feel chills all over their bodies. In the past, they had all been supreme king tiers that could shake the heavens and earth. Their natural talent could almost match that of their father. If it was not for the fact that only one person was allowed to become Emperor in an era, it may not be impossible for them to become Emperor.

Now that they had traversed countless years, wanting to become Emperor this era, they also thought that their strength was enough to sweep aside any so-called king tier. However, with more than ten of them joining forces, they were actually no match for a single punch from Ling Han!
"What a terrifying opponent!" a young man in black said with a faint smile. "I’m the third son of the Four Directions Great Emperor, Chang Tingjian."
Though the Chang Clan Clan had hold of the Galaxy Network, they themselves were very mysterious. To this day, no one knew where their ancestral grounds were.
Ling Han stared at Chang Tingjian, and frowned, "Eight-star Saint!"

It was not that he was wary of the other’s strength, but rather that his cultivation level was too high, and was close to the peak stage of Saint-level. Then, what if the other managed to become Emperor before him?
Instantly, his killing intent soared.

Those were the Imperial Sons of the Twelve Lands of Death.
Shi Gang, Di Wuji, Zhang Yu, Lu Xun, and so on.
All of them stood proudly in spaced, exuding an air of dominance.
The son of a Great Emperor was naturally extraordinary.
Ling Han was currently filled with anger.
He immediately let out a battle cry, and charged over alone.
"Ling Han, you are too arrogant, aren’t you!" Di Wuji said coldly.
He shot out a punch, which turned into a black wolf that was thirty thousand meters long, that pounced to bite at Ling Han.
"Scram!" Ling Han shouted loudly.
Peng, this silver wolf was forcibly shattered.
What!
Di Wuji paled in shock.
Was Ling Han really as strong as the legends said, to the extent that he could only look up to him in admiration?
How was this possible?
Boom, Ling Han had already charged over with his iron fists, bringing with him his nameless fury.
Peng!
Yang Yihuan, He Luo, Tong Ming, and the other Imperial Sons all summoned their Saint Tools at the same time.
They joined forces to parry Ling Han’s attacks.
However, with a single punch, these Imperial Sons were all sent flying, as if they were flowers scattered by a celestial maiden.
This caused all the Imperial Sons to feel chills all over their bodies.
In the past, they had all been supreme king tiers that could shake the heavens and earth.
Their natural talent could almost match that of their father.
If it was not for the fact that only one person was allowed to become Emperor in an era, it may not be impossible for them to become Emperor.
Now that they had traversed countless years, wanting to become Emperor this era, they also thought that their strength was enough to sweep aside any so-called king tier.
However, with more than ten of them joining forces, they were actually no match for a single punch from Ling Han!
"What a terrifying opponent!" a young man in black said with a faint smile.
"I’m the third son of the Four Directions Great Emperor, Chang Tingjian."
Though the Chang Clan Clan had hold of the Galaxy Network, they themselves were very mysterious.
To this day, no one knew where their ancestral grounds were.
Ling Han stared at Chang Tingjian, and frowned, "Eight-star Saint!"
It was not that he was wary of the other’s strength, but rather that his cultivation level was too high, and was close to the peak stage of Saint-level.
Then, what if the other managed to become Emperor before him?
Instantly, his killing intent soared.

chapters.title: Chapter 4703: Fight with your backs against the wall
paragraphs: The Living Realm’s only hope was for a new Great Emperor to appear and eradicate the darkness all by himself.
However, if this Great Emperor was born from the Twelve Lands of Death... then everything would be over.

A Great Emperor ruled over an era. Those Pseudo-Emperors, Imperial Weapons and Imperial Formations and whatsover, in front of a true Great Emperor, were all trash. The difference between them lay in how many moves they would be able to block from the hands of a Great Emperor.
In the past, those descendants of the Great Emperors had never participated in the competition for the throne. Thus, the heaven and earth would allow them to become Emperor in this era.
With their aptitude... it was very possible.
Thus, Chang Tingjian was actually an eight-star Saint, and his lead was considerably large. This caused Ling Han’s killing intent to rise, and he wanted to kill him.

For example, Yang Yihuan, He Luo, Feng Miaoling, these Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters from the Twelve Lands of Death who had appeared the earliest, were only three-star or four-star Saints. This was far from enough to pose a threat to becoming Emperor.
Ling Han stared at Chang Tingjian, his aura completely locked onto this person.
If he moved, it would definitely be a swift strike.
Chang Tingjian smiled faintly, "Ling Han, or rather Number One in the Galaxy, I have long wanted to spar with you."
Number One in the Galaxy?
What, Ling Han was Number One in the Galaxy?

To say nothing of the people on the Four Origin Planet, even Imperial Sons like Di Wuji and the others were greatly shocked. As it turned out, the person who had broken records time and time again on the Galaxy Network, and suppressed Heaven Crushing and Origin, was actually Ling Han!

When Ling Han had called himself Number One in the Galaxy, who knew how many people had teased him? Even when Ling Han had broken records time and time again, but there was still no one who truly admitted that he was Number One in the Galaxy.
Because on the long path of cultivation, it was very likely that Ling Han would encounter an accident, and die young.
But now?
Number One in the Galaxy really lived up to his name.
Others could not possibly know this kind of secret, but the Chang Clan had hold of Galaxy Network, so how could they not know?
Ling Han looked at Chang Tingjian coldly, "What is it? Are you dissatisfied?"
"Indeed." Chang Tingjian nodded. He drew out a staff, and laid it out in front of him. Weng, instantly, the staff glowed, multiple seals lighting up, exuding a terrifying saintly might.
This was a Saint Tool!
Ling Han was displeased. He actually dared to use the same weapon as Brother Monkey?

"Ling Han, without the treasure that Empress Qingzhu obtained from the Primitive Abyss, how could you have possibly become so strong?" Chang Tingjian’s expression was filled with defiance. If the Four Directions Great Emperor had also been able to obtain a supreme treasure in the past, then he would definitely be stronger than Ling Han.
Because he was the son of a Great Emperor!
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "My strength comes from myself. Everything else is only icing on the cake!"
"Don’t act like you’re innocent when you have obtained an unfair advantage!" Chang Tingjian charged over, his staff sweeping out.
Boom! The might of his Eight Star Saint physique was on full display, and 24 streaks of Eight Star Regulations shone brilliantly.
Ling Han smiled faintly. When he had been a One Star Saint, he had more than just this bit of strength, all right?
"Scram!" He didn’t need the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and directly greeted this attack with his fists.
Peng! With this strike, Chang Tingjian was instantly sent flying. The web between his thumb and forefinger split open, and blood flowed profusely.
His eyes widened, completely unable to accept this.
He, an eight-star Saint, was actually no match for a single punch from Ling Han?
How was this possible?
He was the son of a Great Emperor!
Hiss, what kind of treasure had this guy obtained from the Primitive Abyss? His battle prowess was actually freakish to this extent?
"Trash!" Ling Han said disdainfully. His figure charged out. He was going to kill this Imperial Son in a single go.
He used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and his speed was astonishingly fast.
Chang Tingjian was shocked, and hurriedly brandished his staff to parry.
This time, he had activated the power of belief, and blasted out as many as 27 Regulations.
However, in front of Ling Han, what was the use?
Peng!
With a single punch, Chang Tingjian was once again sent flying, and what terrified him was the fact that the staff in his hand had clearly bent.
This was Saintly Material!
Inferior only to Origin Gold, the hardest material in the world, it was actually bent by a single punch. How could this be believed?
Are you a Pseudo-Emperor?
Without the word ’Emperor’, how could you be so powerful?
However, Ling Han didn’t give him any time to catch his breath. With a quick stride, he caught up to him and threw another punch.
In this strike, he was going to completely destroy this Imperial Son.
Boom! The iron fist arrived, and just as it was about to strike Chang Tingjian, a large hand suddenly stretched out, blocking between the two of them.
Ling Han’s fist arrived, yet it landed on this large hand, causing the light of this large hand to flicker madly. Yet, it actually did not shatter.
Because this was the Skeleton Saint Tool!
The Netherworld’s most terrifying weapon had finally arrived!

Ling Han’s heart clenched. Even if he was freakish, he still had to be careful when encountering this deadly weapon. If he was besieged and attacked by over a hundred Skeleton Saint Tools, even he would die.

Weng, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower floated above his head. He channeled Destructive Energy, and the holy flame was also ready to be unleashed at any time, unleashing his most terrifying destructive power.
"Haha, Brother Ling, let us help you!" A heroic laugh rang out, and Ding Shu and the Genesis World’s rulers all appeared.
Previously, they had been cultivating in seclusion. He had not thought that they would actually appear at this most crucial moment.
Ling Han nodded, and laughed loudly, "All right, we will fight side by side."
Xiu, xiu, xiu! More Saints appeared in space, facing the Skeleton Saint Tools head-on.
They had to fight this battle head-on.
They could not retreat, and could not lose.
"Die!"
There was nothing else to say; the only thing left was to fight.
Instantly, an intense battle broke out.
These were all people with Saint-level power, so how terrifying was it?
Thankfully, there were no more planets here. Though the Void had cracked and collapsed from the impact, it had not implicated the bystanders.
"Ling Han, die!" Tong Ming shouted loudly. He pointed a finger, and 30 Skeleton Saint Tools appeared, charging towards Ling Han.
They had gathered their strongest troops this time round, and their purpose was to kill Ling Han.
They had no choice but to kill him. Otherwise, if this guy became Emperor, that would really be too dangerous.
How could the plans of the Great Emperors be ruined in his hands?
Thus, they would kill him at all costs!
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The 30 Skeleton Saint Tools charged over, and no one could block them at all.
This was far too terrifying. This was equivalent to several thousand Saint Tools attacking at the same time. Who could block this?
Ling Han couldn’t do it either. He used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to forcefully break out of the siege.
Then, he immediately charged back.
The Skeleton Saint Tool was far too terrifying. He had to stall as many of them as possible.
Boom! He resolutely unleashed the holy flame.
At the same time, he transmitted his divine sense to Ding Shu and the others. That was the complete Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy.
Now that things had come to this, he could no longer keep his skills to himself. He had to make everyone stronger as much as possible.
And only the Genesis World’s Masters could channel the Destructive Energy. Combined with the holy flame, it could even pose a threat to the Skeleton Saint Tools.
In the face of such a great matter, Ling Han was not allowed to keep any secrets.
For the Genesis World’s rulers, grasping Destructive Energy was close to an instinctive ability. As long as they had the corresponding Spirit Diagram, they would be able to quickly learn it.
Die! Die! Die!
Ling Han went berserk, and pushed his battle prowess to the extreme.

chapters.title: Chapter 4704: The Great Emperor makes his move
paragraphs: It had to be admitted that the power of the Netherworld far surpassed that of the Living Realm.
There were hundreds of Skeleton Saint Tools. Even if Ling Han held back 30 of them, there were still close to 70 of them. How could they be blocked?
The merging of the babies could only block one of them. Ding Shu and the other Genesis World rulers used their full strength and used the holy flame, but they could only block one each.

The remaining ones could only be temporarily suppressed by the might of the Imperial Weapon. However, the Imperial Weapon couldn’t be maintained in an endless state of recovery, and it would eventually dim.
What could they do? What could they do?

Ling Han looked at the Four Origin Planet in the distance. In the midst of the great battle, everyone had deliberately drawn out the distance, to prevent the battle from affecting the Four Origin Planet.

At first, he had thought that by stimulating the fighting spirit of the Saints, and fighting to the death, they would be able to block this wave of attack from the Netherworld. But from the look of things now, that was still not possible.
True, the 12 Great Emperors had schemed and planned for so many years, so how could they possibly allow Ling Han to resolve the situation so easily?
If things went on like this, they were definitely going to lose. If they fought to the death here, then there would really be no hope at all.
But... giving up on Four Origin Planet?
Ling Han was unwilling to give up. All of a sudden, his thoughts flew, wanting to think of a way out.
All of a sudden, a thought flashed through his mind.
Since he could release the people of Genesis World, could he take them in again?
He would give it a try. At present, he could only put everything on the line as a last resort.
Ling Han channeled the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight and flew toward Four Origin Planet. Behind him, the 30 Skeleton Saint Tools chased after him.
Weng!
Ling Han unleashed a murderous aura attack, but it wasn’t targeted at the pursuers behind him. Instead, it was targeted at Four Origin Planet.

He strictly controlled the intensity of the murderous aura. In fact, he even used a different intensity on different living beings. When the murderous aura surged past Four Origin Planet, all the living beings on it had passed out.

It wasn’t that he hadn’t possessed a Spatial Spirit Tool that could store living beings before. The Spirit Tool needed the recipient to have no mental resistance against it. Otherwise, the recipient could only be brought in after knocking them unconscious.
There were countless living beings on the Four Origin Planet, so could Ling Han notify them one by one not to resist?
There was too little time, and now it was Yin souls that were pressing down on their territory. Everyone was anxious, and the rate of execution of commands would decrease by a considerable amount.
Thus, it would be better to just knock them all out.
Ling Han unleashed his divine sense and wrapped it around Four Origin Planet.
It definitely had to work!
Shua, a scene that caused one’s eyes to pop out appeared. The massive Four Origin Planet suddenly disappeared from the universe.
’Holy f*ck!’

All of a sudden, the battles in space stopped. Of course, the Skeleton Saint Tool had no emotions, nor did it have intelligence. It only knew to carry out commands, so they continued to attack without the slightest pause.
However, even Lu Xun and the other sons of Great Emperors were dumbfounded.
What was going on?
How could a planet disappear just like that?

They could accept that Ling Han’s punch, or even a single thought from Ling Han was capable of destroying Four Origin Planet. However, they couldn’t accept the fact that a planet had disappeared so soundlessly.
Could a Great Emperor do the same?
Only Ding Shu and the other Genesis World elites could guess that Ling Han had most likely absorbed the Four Origin Planet into his body.
The problem was, this was a planet from a great world, so how colossal was it?
"Wa!" Ling Han threw up blood madly. After storing a planet into his body, he felt like his whole person was about to explode.
This was really too forceful. The pain was indescribable.
"Retreat!" he shouted loudly. In this state, he would not be able to last much longer.
Only now did the Saints come to their senses as if they had just woken up from a dream. There was actually such a thing?
Are you trying to defy the heavens?
However, the Skeleton Saint Tool was far too powerful, so much so that they couldn’t block it at all. If they didn’t leave now, when would they?
Furthermore, Ling Han had the means to take away a planet like this. Then, in future, when the Yin souls attacked their ancestral grounds, Ling Han could also help them like this.
With this in mind, they were naturally reassured.
Regardless of how Ling Han did it, the most important thing was that this solved a huge problem.
All of a sudden, the Saints began to retreat. As long as they managed to throw off their opponents, they would immediately tear a rip into space and leave.
Ling Han also unleashed his full battle prowess to cover everyone.
His speed was the fastest, and when the time came, he could directly use Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to break out of the siege.
Boom!
Right at this moment, a large hand that was as black as ink suddenly tore open the Void and stretched out, grabbing out at Ling Han.
It was as if this strike had been destined by the heavens, and was moving with the great trends. It could not be blocked at all, and could not be blocked.
A terrifying Imperial Might spread out, enshrouding space.
This, this was the action of a Great Emperor!
Heavens!
All of a sudden, everyone felt a strong sense of despair.
Emperor, the strongest in the world, who could stop him?
Oh no, they were done for.

All the Saints had always thought that the Lords of Death were capable of "immortality", and must have been restricted by some kind of powerful restriction from the heaven and earth, which was why they could not make a move, and had to rely on the hands of the Skeleton Saint Tools to sweep through the universe.
This was also where hope lay. Otherwise, with the arrival of the Great Emperor, any resistance would be futile.
But now... the Great Emperor had made his move.
Aside from despair, what other ideas could they have?
Boom, the large hand grabbed out. There was nowhere to dodge, and he was no match for it.
Ling Han definitely wouldn’t give up. He activated the Imperial Weapon and charged forward.
The large hand collided with the Clear Bamboo Sword, and instantly, Imperial Might diffused into the surroundings. Even Saints felt suffocated.
That large hand... had been blocked!

This wasn’t strange. With the awakening of the Imperial Weapon, it was equivalent to a Great Emperor moving, so it was only natural that he would be able to defeat another Great Emperor. However, this was also because the Great Emperor that had moved hadn’t truly appeared. He had only stretched out a hand through the boundless universe.
Boom, this large hand paused, and grabbed out again, its might even more frightening.

Ling Han tried to block it again, but the Clear Bamboo Sword could block it, and he only sustained a tiny bit of the shockwave, but it was enough to make him throw up blood madly. All the skin on his body had exploded, and he had become a figure of blood.
At this rate, in three or four moves at most, he would definitely die.
That large hand was merciless, and blasted towards him for the third time.
This was the power of the Great Emperor. With a flip of his hand, he could summon clouds, and with a flip of his hand, he could summon rain. He was invincible in this world.
"Pu!" Ling Han spat out another mouthful of blood. He felt as if at least half of the bones in his body had been shattered, and he was in extreme pain.
So what if he was the strongest Saint? In front of the Great Emperor, he was nothing but trash.

Boom, the large hand struck again. This time, Ling Han could no longer resist, and even if he still had power to burst out, his body had already reached the critical point. With this strike, he would definitely be crushed into pieces.
He was done for.

This was the strongest prodigy of all eternity. If he could become a Great Emperor, he would definitely be the strongest Ancestral King in history. Unfortunately, the Great Emperor had moved now, and directly erased him, not giving him any room for growth at all.

Everyone believed that the Lords of Death would definitely have to pay a huge price for their actions. However, the Great Emperor was too decisive. Even if he had to sacrifice himself, he had to completely eliminate the unstable factors.
Sigh!
The giant hand grabbed out, enshrouded in the paramount Nine Star Regulations, causing even the heavens to pale.
Peng!
A terrifying soundwave rang out. Even if this was space, so what? The booming sound spread far and wide.
When the light of energy dissipated completely, everyone shockingly discovered that Ling Han actually hadn’t died!
How was this possible? Had he managed to block an attack from the Great Emperor?
No.
An old man was shockingly standing beside Ling Han.
Ge Qianqiu!

Could a Great Emperor do the same?
Only Ding Shu and the other Genesis World elites could guess that Ling Han had most likely absorbed the Four Origin Planet into his body.
The problem was, this was a planet from a great world, so how colossal was it?
"Wa!" Ling Han threw up blood madly.
After storing a planet into his body, he felt like his whole person was about to explode.
This was really too forceful.
The pain was indescribable.
"Retreat!" he shouted loudly.
In this state, he would not be able to last much longer.
Only now did the Saints come to their senses as if they had just woken up from a dream.
There was actually such a thing?
Are you trying to defy the heavens?
However, the Skeleton Saint Tool was far too powerful, so much so that they couldn’t block it at all.
If they didn’t leave now, when would they?
Furthermore, Ling Han had the means to take away a planet like this.
Then, in future, when the Yin souls attacked their ancestral grounds, Ling Han could also help them like this.
With this in mind, they were naturally reassured.
Regardless of how Ling Han did it, the most important thing was that this solved a huge problem.
All of a sudden, the Saints began to retreat.
As long as they managed to throw off their opponents, they would immediately tear a rip into space and leave.
Ling Han also unleashed his full battle prowess to cover everyone.
His speed was the fastest, and when the time came, he could directly use Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to break out of the siege.
Boom!
Right at this moment, a large hand that was as black as ink suddenly tore open the Void and stretched out, grabbing out at Ling Han.
It was as if this strike had been destined by the heavens, and was moving with the great trends.
It could not be blocked at all, and could not be blocked.
A terrifying Imperial Might spread out, enshrouding space.
This, this was the action of a Great Emperor!
Heavens!
All of a sudden, everyone felt a strong sense of despair.
Emperor, the strongest in the world, who could stop him?
Oh no, they were done for.

All the Saints had always thought that the Lords of Death were capable of "immortality", and must have been restricted by some kind of powerful restriction from the heaven and earth, which was why they could not make a move, and had to rely on the hands of the Skeleton Saint Tools to sweep through the universe.
This was also where hope lay.
Otherwise, with the arrival of the Great Emperor, any resistance would be futile.
But now... the Great Emperor had made his move.
Aside from despair, what other ideas could they have?
Boom, the large hand grabbed out.
There was nowhere to dodge, and he was no match for it.
Ling Han definitely wouldn’t give up.
He activated the Imperial Weapon and charged forward.
The large hand collided with the Clear Bamboo Sword, and instantly, Imperial Might diffused into the surroundings.
Even Saints felt suffocated.
That large hand... had been blocked!
This wasn’t strange.
With the awakening of the Imperial Weapon, it was equivalent to a Great Emperor moving, so it was only natural that he would be able to defeat another Great Emperor.
However, this was also because the Great Emperor that had moved hadn’t truly appeared.
He had only stretched out a hand through the boundless universe.
Boom, this large hand paused, and grabbed out again, its might even more frightening.
Ling Han tried to block it again, but the Clear Bamboo Sword could block it, and he only sustained a tiny bit of the shockwave, but it was enough to make him throw up blood madly.
All the skin on his body had exploded, and he had become a figure of blood.
At this rate, in three or four moves at most, he would definitely die.
That large hand was merciless, and blasted towards him for the third time.
This was the power of the Great Emperor.
With a flip of his hand, he could summon clouds, and with a flip of his hand, he could summon rain.
He was invincible in this world.
"Pu!" Ling Han spat out another mouthful of blood.
He felt as if at least half of the bones in his body had been shattered, and he was in extreme pain.
So what if he was the strongest Saint?
In front of the Great Emperor, he was nothing but trash.
Boom, the large hand struck again.
This time, Ling Han could no longer resist, and even if he still had power to burst out, his body had already reached the critical point.
With this strike, he would definitely be crushed into pieces.
He was done for.
This was the strongest prodigy of all eternity.
If he could become a Great Emperor, he would definitely be the strongest Ancestral King in history.
Unfortunately, the Great Emperor had moved now, and directly erased him, not giving him any room for growth at all.
Everyone believed that the Lords of Death would definitely have to pay a huge price for their actions.
However, the Great Emperor was too decisive.
Even if he had to sacrifice himself, he had to completely eliminate the unstable factors.
Sigh!
The giant hand grabbed out, enshrouded in the paramount Nine Star Regulations, causing even the heavens to pale.
Peng!
A terrifying soundwave rang out.
Even if this was space, so what?
The booming sound spread far and wide.
When the light of energy dissipated completely, everyone shockingly discovered that Ling Han actually hadn’t died!
How was this possible?
Had he managed to block an attack from the Great Emperor?
No.
An old man was shockingly standing beside Ling Han.
Ge Qianqiu!

chapters.title: Chapter 4705: Fighting the Great Emperor
paragraphs: Ge Qianqiu, Pseudo-Emperor!
The Pseudo-Emperor moved, blocking the deadly attack of the Lord of Death, saving Ling Han.
"Ge Qianqiu, you are seeking your own death." An incredibly cold voice rang out in space. It was emotionless, as if all other living beings were nothing but stray dogs.
This was definitely the Great Emperor who had attacked. It was just that they didn’t know who he was.
Ge Qianqiu’s face was slightly flushed. After all, he had blocked the attack of a Great Emperor. Even if he was a Pseudo-Emperor, so what? How could it possibly be easy?
"What joy is there in life? What bitterness would death hold?" He laughed loudly, "You Great Emperors should have died long ago, yet have used evil techniques to live to this day!"

"Mere mortals, what do you know!" This Great Emperor said calmly, "Taking into account the fact that you have cultivated to the level of Pseudo-Emperor with much difficulty, I will give you a chance. Leave immediately, and I will spare your life!"
"Hahaha!" Ge Qianqiu laughed loudly. "You’re only afraid of fighting me, which would force you to use your full power, and cause you to injure yourself!"

The Lord of Death definitely couldn’t attack casually, or else there wouldn’t be anyone else’s business at all. Thus, now that the Lord of Death had forcefully attacked, he would definitely cause damage to himself, and if he wanted to fight a Pseudo-Emperor, the price he had to pay would definitely be even greater.

Before this, several Lords of Death of Death had been "successfully persuaded" by Buddha Doga, Ge Qianqiu and Qian Yanghao respectively, and the reason was precisely because they didn’t want to sacrifice themselves.
That Great Emperor paused for a moment, then said, "Since you are so determined to seek death, I shall oblige you!"
Boom, this Great Emperor moved again. He stretched out a palm, and grabbed out in the direction of Ling Han.
"Senior!" Ling Han handed over the Clear Bamboo Sword. Using his divine sense, he transmitted the technique to control the Imperial Weapon to Ge Qianqiu.
The latter had already blocked the attack of the Great Emperor for him, so what need was there for him to keep this a secret?
Ge Qianqiu caught the Clear Bamboo Sword, and slashed at the large hand that was attacking him.
In this instant, it was naturally impossible for him to grasp the control of the Clear Bamboo Sword, but the combination of Pseudo-Emperor and Origin Gold was still very powerful.
Peng!
With this strike, the large hand was turned back in defeat. However, Ge Qianqiu wasn’t much better off either. He retreated rapidly, his face alternating between red and white.
No one felt disdain because of this.
The opponent was a Great Emperor. Being able to survive was a symbol of strength.
But what was despairing was that the Great Emperor had not appeared at all. He had only moved from a boundless distance away, and his might was already so terrifying.
The Emperor was invincible in the world, and these were really not just empty words.
"Go!" A voice rang out in Ling Han’s mind. This was Ge Qianqiu transmitting a message to his divine sense.
"But senior—" How could Ling Han watch helplessly as Ge Qianqiu battled the Great Emperor alone?
So what if he was a Pseudo-Emperor? Once the Great Emperor became serious, his only fate would definitely be death.

"You are the only hope for the future!" Ge Qianqiu’s voice continued to ring out, "You are very special. There is a power in your body that has blocked destiny. Even the Great Emperor would not be able to predict your whereabouts."
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. Was this because he was the Genesis World’s ruler, or because he had fused with the Seed of the Holy Flame?
"Go quickly. If this Great Emperor unleashes his full strength, I won’t be able to stop him even if I wield the Imperial Weapon," Ge Qianqiu said in a slightly hurried voice.
Ling Han did not hesitate any longer. He stretched out a hand, wanting to tear a rip into space, and leave this place.
Once he left, Ge Qianqiu naturally wouldn’t need to stay here any longer. He could leave as he liked.
If he cleared the path with the Imperial Weapon, there was still a very high chance that he could escape from the hands of the Great Emperor.
After all, the Lord of Death also had his reservations, and it was very unlikely that he would attack with his full strength.
But right at this moment, boom, another large hand stretched out from the Void.
Unlike the large hand that was as black as ink previously, this hand was burning with raging flames, illuminating this part of the sky.
The Golden Crow Great Emperor!

This name suddenly flashed through Ling Han’s mind. This was because this large hand was different from ordinary human hands. It actually looked a little like a claw, and was of the fire element. The possibility that it was the Golden Crow Great Emperor’s hand that had moved was very high.
This!
A second Great Emperor had actually made his move.
Heavens, a Great Emperor was capable of suppressing an entire era, and was absolutely invincible. And now, there was actually a second Great Emperor. How was he supposed to block this?

Ge Qianqiu gave a loud shout, and the Clear Bamboo Sword suddenly exploded with a terrifying might, slashing towards the first Great Emperor. Then, he charged towards that giant hand of fire, the aura all over his body rising endlessly.
At this moment, it was as if he wasn’t a Pseudo-Emperor, but a true Great Emperor.
Peng! With a single strike, the giant hand of flames was instantly sent flying.
Ge Qianqiu stood proudly in space, his hand holding onto the Clear Bamboo Sword. Imperial might spread out, and it was unclear whether it was exuding from him or the Clear Bamboo Sword.

"Ge Qianqiu, you only have that little bit of Imperial Source, and now it’s burning, allowing you to temporarily possess Great Emperor-level battle prowess. How long can you last?" The Golden Crow Great Emperor’s cold voice rang out, "Once the Imperial Source is burnt to nothing, you will die. Is it worth it?"
Ling Han was shocked. As it turned out, Ge Qianqiu had to pay such a heavy price!
"Old man!" he hurriedly said.

Ge Qianqiu shook his head, and said, "I know very well whether it’s worth it or not! Ling Han, when you become Emperor and eradicate the chaos, remember to toast a cup of wine in front of my grave and share it with me."
All of a sudden, Ling Han felt as if something was stuck in his throat, and could not say a single word.
However, the two Great Emperors wouldn’t give them any time to catch their breath. Boom! The two giant hands slammed down from the sky again.
"Go!" Ge Qianqiu shouted loudly, battling two Great Emperors alone.
Ling Han gritted his teeth, and suppressed all his emotions. He stretched out a hand and tore a rip into space.

He entered into the Void, and turned around to take a look. He saw that Ge Qianqiu was exuding an endless might, fighting the two Great Emperors head-on. However, the two Great Emperors also seemed to be truly angered, and wanted even more to detain Ling Han, their battle prowess increased endlessly.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
So what if he had the Imperial Weapon? So what if he had ignited his Imperial Source? In front of a true Great Emperor, he would not even be able to withstand a single blow.
In just a few moves, Ge Qianqiu was blown up, while the Clear Bamboo Sword were sent flying, shooting into the depths of the universe.
Boom! The hands of the two Great Emperors mercilessly grabbed over.
"Senior!" Ling Han turned around with tears in his eyes, and entered into the Void.
Hong long long, the hand of the Great Emperor sent the Void splitting apart. Imperial might spread out, and set off in pursuit of Ling Han.
Ling Han unleashed the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to block the oncoming Imperial Might. Phoenix Wings Divine Flight activated, and he sped through the Void.
Behind them, the Imperial Might receded like floodwaters, and the attack from the two Great Emperors was finally dispersed.

"Wa!" Ling Han rushed out of the Void, immediately throwing up blood madly. Furthermore, he could no longer control himself. Four Origin Planet appeared from within his body, floating in the pitch-black universe.
"Senior!" There were tears in his eyes, and his hands were tightly clenched into fists.
Ge Qianqiu had died to save him.
As a dignified Pseudo-Emperor, as long as he was willing to protect himself wisely, even the Lord of Death would not deliberately target him.
However, he could clearly transcend the rest of the world, yet would rather fight to the death.
"I definitely won’t let Senior sacrifice for nothing!" Ling Han wiped away his tears, his expression determined.

chapters.title: Chapter 4706: Summoned by Buddha Doga
paragraphs: Before this, Ling Han had heard of countless legends of Great Emperors.
The Emperor was invincible.
This was only a vague explanation. He had no idea what kind of invincibility it was.
But now, Ling Han knew.

Even for someone as strong as a Pseudo-Emperor, who had ignited the Imperial Source, who could be considered a Great Emperor for a short period of time, with the Imperial Weapon in hand, he was still blasted into smithereens in a few moves.
To fight a Great Emperor head-on, anyone would only be seeking death.

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel fortunate. When he had been in Buddhist Land, Ah Han had only activated the Imperial Weapon to kill him. He hadn’t moved to kill him himself. Otherwise, how could he have survived until now?
This was truly a power that could drive one to despair. So what if he was the strongest Saint in all eternity? In front of Imperial Might, he could not even withstand a single blow.
Ling Han took a deep breath, regaining his confidence.

It was very normal that he was no match for the Great Emperor at present. He was only a Two Star Saint. If he could withstand the attack of the Great Emperor, then the invincibility of the Great Emperor would be a joke.
However, if he became a Pseudo-Emperor, he should be able to match a Lord of Death who would not dare use their full power.
With a thought, he channelled the secret technique, summoning the Clear Bamboo Sword.
Xiu, in a short while, the Void split open, and the Clear Bamboo Sword shot out, caught in his hand.

Now, the empress, Brother Monkey, and the others had all torn a rip into the Void to escape. Without the means to contact through Galaxy Network, wanting to reunite everyone was naturally not an easy task.
However, Saints roamed the world, so as long as they weren’t personally targeted by the Great Emperor, they should have no problem protecting themselves.
Ling Han believed that the Lords of Death probably wouldn’t waste their energy on Brother Monkey and the others. After all, they would definitely have to pay a huge price each time they attacked.
As for him, Ge Qianqiu said that there was a special power to conceal destiny, and even the Great Emperor could not predict his whereabouts.
Thus, he should be safe for the moment.
Ling Han returned to Four Origin Planet, and continued to push this planet towards the edge of the universe.
He began to recall how it felt to hold a planet in his body.
At the beginning, that had only been an act of desperation as there was nothing else he could do. He hadn’t thought that he would really succeed.
He could actually hold a planet. However, compared to the millions and millions of dimensions inside his body, this burden was indescribably heavy.
Was it because the living beings on the planet were too powerful?
Or was it because the planet itself was a colossal source of energy?
Ling Han set this problem aside first. If he encountered the assault of the Netherworld again, he could take Four Origin Planet into his body and flee, and it would no longer become a visible target.
Then, he communicated with the various Imperial Clans through killing mosquitoes and flies.
Thankfully, the Saints had all returned to their respective ancestral planets. At present, there were no attacks from the Skeleton Saint Tools, so it was still considered safe.
In Ling Han’s eyes, it was most likely the Lords of Death didn’t give a toss about them.
Even if there were these Imperial Clans, so what? They would not be able to affect their grand plans at all.

Only Ling Han was a variable. Once he became Emperor, or it was possible that as long as he became a Pseudo-Emperor, it would cause damage to the plans that the Lords of Death had planned for countless years.
Now, Ling Han didn’t dare to reveal his location. What if the Lords of Death charged over again?
Have Buddha Doga or Qian Yanghao tep out and make another sacrifice?
He could only hope that Brother Monkey and the others would first go to the various Imperial Clans and get in touch with him. Then, he would bring them back to the Four Origin Planet.

As expected, Brother Monkey, the empress, and the others shared the same thoughts as Ling Han. If they couldn’t find Ling Han, they would find the Imperial Clans first. Very quickly, Ling Han brought everyone back to the Four Origin Planet.
When they found out that Ge Qianqiu had died in order to save Ling Han, everyone was both grateful, furious and grieved.
This was a Pseudo-Emperor!
"The old man definitely won’t have sacrificed himself for nothing," the large black dog said solemnly. It was rare for him to become serious.
Ling Han nodded approvingly. When they became Emperor, he would have these Lords of Death beheaded, one after another.
So what if they had once been Great Emperors? They were definitely not allowed to trample over the universe so despicably.

Ling Han frowned. Time waited for no man. He had to improve his cultivation level as soon as possible. However, at his height, it was already very, very difficult to speed up his cultivation, unless there waas that kind of rare Great Herb.
The problem was, since it was so rare, how could it possibly be obtained?

The majority of territory in the Living Realm had already been transformed into the Netherworld, and the Celestial medicines had naturally all died out. Thus, this kind of rare Great Herb was even harder to find.
If he had to cultivate step by step, how long would he need to reach the level of a nine-star Saint?
Even if Ling Han’s natural talent was astonishing, he would definitely need a very, very long time.
"Now, there is only one place that I could possibly obtain such a Great Herb," Ling Han murmured.
’Where?’
The Primitive Abyss.

That was where the entire universe had been born. He was sure that the Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy, the Divine Stone, and the babies had all come from there, and the Seed of the Holy Flame was also incredibly awesome.
Thus, if he could find Great Herbs there, it would definitely help Ling Han increase his cultivation level extremely quickly.
However, there were two dilemmas.
Firstly, how was he supposed to get there?

It was too far away. Previously, Ling Han and Brother Monkey had already made a trip, but the distance was still very far. Even if Ling Han’s current speed had soared to another level, he believed that it would still need an extremely long time.

Secondly, his strength was enough to sweep aside all Saints, but the Primitive Abyss was something that even the Great Emperors dared not enter lightly. The majority of them would only enter and take a gamble in their later years.
Thus, even if he could enter the Primitive Abyss now, it was possible that he wouldn’t be able to obtain the Great Herb and would lose his life first.
"However, time waits for no man. If I don’t enter the Primitive Abyss and take a gamble, it’s extremely likely that I won’t have another chance."
However, even if he was willing to take the risk, what could he do when he couldn’t even go there?
Time passed quietly, and another few days later, Ling Han suddenly received news that Buddha Doga had gone to the Donglin Imperial Clan and wanted to see him.
’Buddha Doga?’
Ling Han didn’t immediately move, because he didn’t know if this was a trap.
His whereabouts could not be deduced, but the Twelve Lands of Death could think of some way to draw him out.
What if... the Donglin Imperial Clan was suddenly conquered, and they were forced to send a false message to Ling Han?
There was no Galaxy Network now, so they could only send a message through the shattering of life plaques. In theory, this was completely feasible.
However, he still had to go.

Ling Han brought the Imperial Weapon with him. He first arrived in the area of space near the Donglin Imperial Clan. Then, he quietly entered, and only appeared after confirming that there was no danger.
This wasn’t a trap. Indeed, Buddha Doga was waiting for him there.

This Pseudo-Emperor who had achieved Dao through killing stood with his hands clasped behind his back, standing in front of a plum blossom tree. He looked so peaceful as if there wasn’t the slightest bit of temper in him.
"Do you want to rapidly increase your cultivation level?" Buddha Doga asked. However, he didn’t turn around.
"Yes!" Ling Han nodded.
"You should have some understanding of the Primitive Abyss, right?" Buddha Doga asked.
"Yes." Ling Han nodded.

Only then did Buddha Doga turn around and say, "Every Great Emperor has entered the Primitive Abyss before. If they want to live a second life, they can only obtain supremely valuable medicines from there."

"There, there is a substance called Genesis, which contains the secret of the formation of the universe.The Great Herb that absorbs this substance to grow has effects that surpass all Celestial medicines."
"If you obtain it, you can rush to the pinnacle of Saint Tier in the shortest time possible."

He had no idea what kind of invincibility it was.
But now, Ling Han knew.

Even for someone as strong as a Pseudo-Emperor, who had ignited the Imperial Source, who could be considered a Great Emperor for a short period of time, with the Imperial Weapon in hand, he was still blasted into smithereens in a few moves.
To fight a Great Emperor head-on, anyone would only be seeking death.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel fortunate.
When he had been in Buddhist Land, Ah Han had only activated the Imperial Weapon to kill him.
He hadn’t moved to kill him himself.
Otherwise, how could he have survived until now?
This was truly a power that could drive one to despair.
So what if he was the strongest Saint in all eternity?
In front of Imperial Might, he could not even withstand a single blow.
Ling Han took a deep breath, regaining his confidence.
It was very normal that he was no match for the Great Emperor at present.
He was only a Two Star Saint.
If he could withstand the attack of the Great Emperor, then the invincibility of the Great Emperor would be a joke.
However, if he became a Pseudo-Emperor, he should be able to match a Lord of Death who would not dare use their full power.
With a thought, he channelled the secret technique, summoning the Clear Bamboo Sword.
Xiu, in a short while, the Void split open, and the Clear Bamboo Sword shot out, caught in his hand.
Now, the empress, Brother Monkey, and the others had all torn a rip into the Void to escape.
Without the means to contact through Galaxy Network, wanting to reunite everyone was naturally not an easy task.
However, Saints roamed the world, so as long as they weren’t personally targeted by the Great Emperor, they should have no problem protecting themselves.
Ling Han believed that the Lords of Death probably wouldn’t waste their energy on Brother Monkey and the others.
After all, they would definitely have to pay a huge price each time they attacked.
As for him, Ge Qianqiu said that there was a special power to conceal destiny, and even the Great Emperor could not predict his whereabouts.
Thus, he should be safe for the moment.
Ling Han returned to Four Origin Planet, and continued to push this planet towards the edge of the universe.
He began to recall how it felt to hold a planet in his body.
At the beginning, that had only been an act of desperation as there was nothing else he could do.
He hadn’t thought that he would really succeed.
He could actually hold a planet.
However, compared to the millions and millions of dimensions inside his body, this burden was indescribably heavy.
Was it because the living beings on the planet were too powerful?
Or was it because the planet itself was a colossal source of energy?
Ling Han set this problem aside first.
If he encountered the assault of the Netherworld again, he could take Four Origin Planet into his body and flee, and it would no longer become a visible target.
Then, he communicated with the various Imperial Clans through killing mosquitoes and flies.
Thankfully, the Saints had all returned to their respective ancestral planets.
At present, there were no attacks from the Skeleton Saint Tools, so it was still considered safe.
In Ling Han’s eyes, it was most likely the Lords of Death didn’t give a toss about them.
Even if there were these Imperial Clans, so what?
They would not be able to affect their grand plans at all.
Only Ling Han was a variable.
Once he became Emperor, or it was possible that as long as he became a Pseudo-Emperor, it would cause damage to the plans that the Lords of Death had planned for countless years.
Now, Ling Han didn’t dare to reveal his location.
What if the Lords of Death charged over again?
Have Buddha Doga or Qian Yanghao tep out and make another sacrifice?
He could only hope that Brother Monkey and the others would first go to the various Imperial Clans and get in touch with him.
Then, he would bring them back to the Four Origin Planet.
As expected, Brother Monkey, the empress, and the others shared the same thoughts as Ling Han.
If they couldn’t find Ling Han, they would find the Imperial Clans first.
Very quickly, Ling Han brought everyone back to the Four Origin Planet.
When they found out that Ge Qianqiu had died in order to save Ling Han, everyone was both grateful, furious and grieved.
This was a Pseudo-Emperor!
"The old man definitely won’t have sacrificed himself for nothing," the large black dog said solemnly.
It was rare for him to become serious.
Ling Han nodded approvingly.
When they became Emperor, he would have these Lords of Death beheaded, one after another.
So what if they had once been Great Emperors?
They were definitely not allowed to trample over the universe so despicably.
Ling Han frowned.
Time waited for no man.
He had to improve his cultivation level as soon as possible.
However, at his height, it was already very, very difficult to speed up his cultivation, unless there waas that kind of rare Great Herb.
The problem was, since it was so rare, how could it possibly be obtained?
The majority of territory in the Living Realm had already been transformed into the Netherworld, and the Celestial medicines had naturally all died out.
Thus, this kind of rare Great Herb was even harder to find.
If he had to cultivate step by step, how long would he need to reach the level of a nine-star Saint?
Even if Ling Han’s natural talent was astonishing, he would definitely need a very, very long time.
"Now, there is only one place that I could possibly obtain such a Great Herb," Ling Han murmured.
’Where?’
The Primitive Abyss.
That was where the entire universe had been born.
He was sure that the Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy, the Divine Stone, and the babies had all come from there, and the Seed of the Holy Flame was also incredibly awesome.
Thus, if he could find Great Herbs there, it would definitely help Ling Han increase his cultivation level extremely quickly.
However, there were two dilemmas.
Firstly, how was he supposed to get there?
It was too far away.
Previously, Ling Han and Brother Monkey had already made a trip, but the distance was still very far.
Even if Ling Han’s current speed had soared to another level, he believed that it would still need an extremely long time.
Secondly, his strength was enough to sweep aside all Saints, but the Primitive Abyss was something that even the Great Emperors dared not enter lightly.
The majority of them would only enter and take a gamble in their later years.
Thus, even if he could enter the Primitive Abyss now, it was possible that he wouldn’t be able to obtain the Great Herb and would lose his life first.
"However, time waits for no man.
If I don’t enter the Primitive Abyss and take a gamble, it’s extremely likely that I won’t have another chance."
However, even if he was willing to take the risk, what could he do when he couldn’t even go there?
Time passed quietly, and another few days later, Ling Han suddenly received news that Buddha Doga had gone to the Donglin Imperial Clan and wanted to see him.
’Buddha Doga?’
Ling Han didn’t immediately move, because he didn’t know if this was a trap.
His whereabouts could not be deduced, but the Twelve Lands of Death could think of some way to draw him out.
What if... the Donglin Imperial Clan was suddenly conquered, and they were forced to send a false message to Ling Han?
There was no Galaxy Network now, so they could only send a message through the shattering of life plaques.
In theory, this was completely feasible.
However, he still had to go.
Ling Han brought the Imperial Weapon with him.
He first arrived in the area of space near the Donglin Imperial Clan.
Then, he quietly entered, and only appeared after confirming that there was no danger.
This wasn’t a trap.
Indeed, Buddha Doga was waiting for him there.
This Pseudo-Emperor who had achieved Dao through killing stood with his hands clasped behind his back, standing in front of a plum blossom tree.
He looked so peaceful as if there wasn’t the slightest bit of temper in him.
"Do you want to rapidly increase your cultivation level?" Buddha Doga asked.
However, he didn’t turn around.
"Yes!" Ling Han nodded.
"You should have some understanding of the Primitive Abyss, right?" Buddha Doga asked.
"Yes." Ling Han nodded.
Only then did Buddha Doga turn around and say, "Every Great Emperor has entered the Primitive Abyss before.
If they want to live a second life, they can only obtain supremely valuable medicines from there."

"There, there is a substance called Genesis, which contains the secret of the formation of the universe.The Great Herb that absorbs this substance to grow has effects that surpass all Celestial medicines."
"If you obtain it, you can rush to the pinnacle of Saint Tier in the shortest time possible."

chapters.title: Chapter 4707: Primitive Abyss
paragraphs: Buddha Doga paused for a moment before turning to Ling Han and asking, "Do you dare to take this trip?"

Ling Han couldn’t help but chuckle. He was just worrying about being unable to quickly increase his cultivation level, and wanted to go to the Primitive Abyss. However, he was only a Saint, so it would take him an unknown amount of time to get there.
Hence, he could only think about it.
By the looks of it, Buddha Doga was intending to send him there?
"I dare, but I don’t know how to go," Ling Han said.
Buddha Doga nodded and said, "I can send you there."
"All right." Ling Han nodded. When talking to top-notch elites, it was best to be concise and comprehensive. No one could afford to waste their time.
Boom! A powerful aura suddenly erupted from the body of Buddha Doga. Flames of light blazed, and it was as if a Great Emperor had descended into the world.

Ling Han was greatly astonished. He had sensed this kind of aura from Ge Qianqiu. That was the aura that came from burning Imperial Source, which allowed him to temporarily reach the height of Great Emperor.
However, this was an act of putting his life on the line.
"Senior!" he exclaimed in astonishment.
"We don’t have much time," Buddha Doga said calmly. "We can’t leave slowly."

He stretched out a hand to grab Ling Han, and a golden path instantly spread out beneath his feet, heading directly into the boundless distance. He took another step, and in an instant, had already disappeared without a trace.

At this time, the people of Donglin Imperial Clan all rushed over. Naturally, they couldn’t see anything at all, which made them feel surprised. What exactly happened? Why was there suddenly imperial might pervading the air, making them think that something big was about to happen.
Light and shadow flashed before Ling Han’s eyes, and he could no longer see clearly.
But at this moment, he could only feel touched.

In order to help him reach the Primitive Abyss as soon as possible, Buddha Doga did not hesitate to burn his Imperial Source. This could possibly cause him to fall out of the level of Pseudo-Emperor, or even die.
Everything was for the greater good of the world.
Ge Qianqiu buried himself and revived over ten million years. He was strong enough to become Pseudo-Emperor, yet he died in battle.

Buddha Doga was a mighty figure from hundreds of millions of years ago, one of the two prodigies of the Buddhist Race. He had lived a second life in this era, and was also a Pseudo-Emperor, yet he was also silently making sacrifices.
In the world, there were formidable characters like the Lords of Death, as well as heroes like Old Man Ge and Buddha Doga.
Ling Han’s heart became even more resolute. He definitely had to become Emperor, and pacify the darkness, even if it meant paying the price of death.
For him, this was also a massive change.
Even though Ling Han had repeatedly reached the pinnacle of the world, his initial goal was actually very simple, and that was to gain enough strength, so he did not need to be bullied by anyone.
He did not have any ambitions to become the overlord of heaven and earth, and rule over countless people.
What he wanted was very simple. To have his lovers by his side, and his children and grandchildren gathered around him.
However, after witnessing the sacrifice of Ge Qianqiu and Buddha Doga, his mindset suffered a huge blow, and he had a different opinion.
After burning the Imperial Source, the speed of Buddha Doga was astonishingly fast. The great golden path spread out, and with a single thought, it could reach the various planets in the universe.
However, the empty space in the universe was even larger, and the Primitive Abyss was boundlessly far.
It should be known that even with Ling Han’s vision, he was still unable to capture the exact details of the scenery. He could only see darkness flying by.
Thankfully, there were no more planets here, and only darkness was left. There was no need to feel dizzy and blurred vision anymore.
A whole day later, Buddha Doga finally stopped. His aura fluctuated wildly, and was extremely unstable.
"Senior!" Ling Han hurriedly exclaimed. His expression was filled with worry.
Buddha Doga waved his hand and said, "It’s fine. I won’t die yet. However, I can only send you to this point. U need to rest."
His words were very simple. He said he was just going to rest for a while, but Ling Han knew that Buddha Doga had paid an unimaginable price to send him here.
"Senior, I definitely won’t disappoint you!" Ling Han said in the most solemn tone.

Buddha Doga smiled, "Go on! From now on, you can only depend on yourself. However, I have exaggerated a little previously. There are Genesis-level Celestial medicines in the periphery of the abyss, but they are very rare. You can search there. Don’t go too deep. Even Great Emperors could possibly die there."
After saying this, he sent another divine sense message to Ling Han. This contained his understanding of the Primitive Abyss.

Billions of years ago, Buddha Doga had come here before. It was also because of that he had obtained a great fated opportunity that allowed him to traverse millions and millions of years and live a second life.
—He was different from Ge Qianqiu. Old Man Ge had only sealed himself with the Primordial Source Clay.
Ling Han nodded and looked ahead.
With his and Buddha Doga’s personality, what need was there for them to be pretentious?
All he could do was become stronger as soon as possible. Only then would he be worthy of Old Man Ge and Buddha Doga’s sacrifices.
Ahead of them lay a massive fissure, as if heaven and earth had been sliced open by a Divine Sword. Just how wide and how long was it? Even with Ling Han’s vision, he could not see the end.
He used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and with a flap of his fiery wings, he arrived above this massive fissure.
The Primitive Abyss.
The entity of heaven and earth was born here, and within it, there was hidden the secret of how the entity of heaven and earth had formed, as well as incredibly precious Genesis Substance.

Ling Han could clearly see that the abyss wasn’t completely dark. Instead, there was a faint flickering of light. However, this light was different from any other light of the universe. It was as if it belonged to another world.
He did not hesitate, and immediately leaped in.
When he had completely entered into the abyss, he discovered that he had lost all contact with the outside world.
This was reflected in the fact that he could no longer sense the Regulations of heaven and earth.
However, Saints could absorb Regulations, so even if they lost their connection with heaven and earth, they could still use Saint-level power.
And in Ling Han’s case, he was even more different.
This was because the power of belief in his body originated from the dimensions in his body, and it was self-contained. Even after entering this place, he could still use it.
Thus, his battle prowess wasn’t weakened in the slightest.
As he ventured deeper and deeper, this abyss did not seem to be much different from the outside world. It was just a dark space, with occasional spots of light flickering.
Ling Han went over to capture it, and discovered that these were actually floating particles. However, he couldn’t tell what kind of material they were. They were burning and emitting light.
Boom!
However, he shockingly discovered that a particle in the distance had suddenly exploded, turning into a terrifying shockwave.
Even at such a far distance, Ling Han could still sense that powerful energy fluctuation.
This was enough to insta-kill a nine-star Saint.
Ling Han gritted his teeth, and hurriedly distanced himself from that glowing particle.
His strength was strong, and this shockwave was not enough to injure him. However, if it suddenly exploded at close quarters, he would probably be injured as well.
Eye technique activated, and Ling Han carefully observed the particle. After a long time, he came to a conclusion.
This was actually a star core!

No, it should be said that this was a star that had been compressed into the size of a grain of rice. Furthermore, it was a Sun-level star. Thus, once it exploded, it could even insta-kill a Nine Star Saint.
Ling Han swept his gaze over the surroundings, and couldn’t help but inhale sharply, because there were innumerable such particles of light.
No wonder it was said that the whole universe had spurted out from this abyss.
Just look, just a single particle was equivalent to a super-large star.
It should be the unique environment of the abyss that had caused it to become the size of a grain of rice.
That’s not right!
This was originally the size of a grain of rice, but after it was shot out of the abyss, it expanded endlessly, turning into the multiple stars that he was familiar with.
The Primitive Abyss, the beginning of everything.
