chapters.title: Chapter 4708: Discovery
paragraphs: Yi!
Ling Han suddenly realized that this was similar to his situation.
There were dimensions in his body, and these dimensions contained countless planets. These planets nurtured all matter.
In terms of difference, the scale of this place was much larger. It was extremely difficult for him to even accommodate a single star.
Hold on, if he became Emperor, then wouldn’t he be able to do it?
Ling Han had already been suspicious before, and now, he was practically certain.
The so-called Divine Stones came from the Primitive Abyss.
However, added with Ding Shu and the others, there were a total of seven Divine Stones.
Yi, this was the same thing as the Calabash Brothers?
"We have a close relationship with Xuan Taiyu."
"Xuan Taiyu has come to the Primitive Abyss before, and the Divine Stones clearly came from here."
"Xuan Taiyu definitely couldn’t have thrown the Divine Stones away rashly, so the Divine Stones only dispersed to every corner of the universe after Xuan Taiyu died."
"At that time, there was clearly no opportunity for immortality, but the Lords of Death appeared. What are they fighting over?"
"The Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy, or... the so-called Divine Stones?"
The Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy could allow one to channel ten stars of high-level energy. Furthermore, aside from them, the Genesis World’s rulers, no one else could cultivate it.
However, what about the Great Emperor?
Which Great Emperor would be able to grasp this kind of high-level energy? If they could, even among Great Emperors, they could be considered extremely awesome, right?
Right, why had Xuan Taiyu been able to match the twelve Lords of Death at that time?

One of the reasons was that those ancient Great Emperors were unable to unleash their full power, but the other was probably because Xuan Taiyu had mastered Destructive Energy, which was why he was able to intimidate those ancient Great Emperors.

However, Emperors were too strong, and in a battle of twelve against one, even if Xuan Taiyu had heaven-defying luck and obtained the Divine Stones and Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy, he had only just become Emperor, after all, and his battle prowess hadn’t reached its peak yet, so he was heavily injured. Even if he temporarily suppressed the Twelve Lands of Death, he still died not long after.
This made sense, but as for the specific details... Xuan Taiyu was already dead, and only the Lords of Death would know.

Ling Han continued onwards, but this path seemed to have no end. All the while, he could only see the particles that were dancing and glowing. Occasionally, they would explode, creating a terrifying shockwave that would insta-kill Saints.
In the divine sense message that Buddha Doga had transmitted to him, there was not a single detail.
After travelling for a whole seventeen days, he finally uncovered something different.
Ahead of him, an expanse of Primal Chaos appeared. He could vaguely see that it contained all things, but could not see anything clearly.

This area of Primal Chaos was astonishingly huge. He could not see the end of it with a single glance, and outside this area, there was another ring-shaped area that surrounded this area of Primal Chaos.

Ling Han knew that this ring-shaped area was the outer circle of the Primitive Abyss. Meanwhile, that area of Primal Chaos was the real Primitive Abyss . It was so dangerous that it could even kill a Great Emperor.
At present, he could only search for Genesis-level Celestial medicines in the outer regions. He only had to obtain one, and his cultivation level would soar.
Why?

The Genesis Substance was the cornerstone of that great world outside. All Regulations were formed from the Genesis Substance, so if he refined the Genesis Substance, how could his cultivation level not soar?

If he could go to the Primal Chaos area, his gains would definitely be astonishing. For example, the Seed of the Holy Flame had come from there. However, if Ling Han had barged in now, he would definitely not be able to return.
Thus, he had best just obediently try his luck in the outer circle.
He leaped up, and entered into that ring-shaped area.
This was still astonishingly huge.
This was really an "earth" zone. There was solid ground here, and it was not a boundless space.
However, Ling Han had just neared, when he felt an astonishing suction force assault him, causing him to crash towards the ground.
He hurriedly used his power to resist, but his figure was still falling. It was just that his speed had decreased slightly.

Ling Han shouted lightly, and pushed his power to the extreme. Finally, he steadied his footing. Furthermore, he could also increase the height he was at, leaving the ground far behind him. However, his speed was frighteningly slow, and furthermore, he had expended too much power, causing sweat to instantly form on his forehead.
This felt like he was standing off against a supreme elite.
Ling Han’s eyes lit up. If he could cultivate his physique and physical power here, he would be able to obtain a terrifying increase.
Next, he did not resist this kind of suction force any longer, and landed on this piece of land.
Peng, he landed heavily. Under the acceleration of such a terrifying suction force, just how astonishing was his speed?
However, when he landed on the ground, he shockingly discovered that there wasn’t even a hole in the ground, what more shattering it.
This!

Ling Han was stunned. It should be known that his high-speed crash was completely not inferior to a casual strike from a Saint, but he actually did not manage to create a hole. Instead, it caused his feet to go slightly numb.
Just how freakish was the sturdiness of this land?

Ling Han dug at the dirt on the ground, but it was as if this was a Saintly Material. He spent a great deal of effort to break a bit off. Then, he shockingly discovered that it was as if he was holding up several hundred stars.
No wonder it was so hard.
How could it not be extremely heavy and hard, with several hundred stars compressed to such a small size?
If there was a battle here, to say nothing of the fact that it would be very difficult for Saints to cause damage, there would probably only be a limited number of Great Emperors that could.
As expected of the beginning of the universe.
He no longer focused his attention on this land. Even if there were treasures hidden underneath, with his power, it was practically impossible to pry them out.
He walked with great difficulty on this piece of land.

The gravity fields were far too powerful, so much so that his progress was extremely slow. To say nothing of the fact that his speed could not match the speed of a Saint, even a mere cultivator of Foundation Building Tier would be much faster than him.
Ling Han viewed this as a kind of tempering, and this kind of opportunity was really too hard to come by.
Did others have the chance to come here?

Aside from the Great Emperor, it was extremely likely that even a nine-star Saint would be killed by the specks of stars during their previous advance. And when they reached this place, to say nothing of advancing, they would be sprawled out on the ground, unable to move even a single finger.
Then... they would just have to wait for death.
Ling Han also gritted his teeth. Buddha Doga was truly confident in him. Wasn’t he afraid that he wouldn’t be able to withstand this kind of extreme gravity?
This place was completely desolate. To say nothing of the fact that there was no one here, there wasn’t even a blade of grass.
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. In this place, even a Nine-Star Saint could possibly be crushed into mush, what more plants.
However, if there were really plants growing, it would definitely be supremely valuable medicines.
He looked forward to it, but was not in a rush.
Walking here was also a rare opportunity to cultivate.

In the blink of an eye, seven days had passed. Ling Han didn’t gain anything, and was still advancing with great difficulty. However, if one compared him with seven days ago, they would discover that his speed was actually slightly faster.
Though it was only a little bit, he had indeed sped up.
This meant that Ling Han was slowly adapting to such a terrifying gravity field.
Others might not know, but Ling Han knew very well that the organs in his body, as well as his mind, were all reborn.
Of course, this was a very long process, and would not be reflected in the short term.
Another month passed, and Ling Han’s speed became slightly faster. In fact, he could even occasionally jump a few times.

Ling Han suddenly realized that this was similar to his situation.
There were dimensions in his body, and these dimensions contained countless planets.
These planets nurtured all matter.
In terms of difference, the scale of this place was much larger.
It was extremely difficult for him to even accommodate a single star.
Hold on, if he became Emperor, then wouldn’t he be able to do it?
Ling Han had already been suspicious before, and now, he was practically certain.
The so-called Divine Stones came from the Primitive Abyss.
However, added with Ding Shu and the others, there were a total of seven Divine Stones.
Yi, this was the same thing as the Calabash Brothers?
"We have a close relationship with Xuan Taiyu."
"Xuan Taiyu has come to the Primitive Abyss before, and the Divine Stones clearly came from here."
"Xuan Taiyu definitely couldn’t have thrown the Divine Stones away rashly, so the Divine Stones only dispersed to every corner of the universe after Xuan Taiyu died."
"At that time, there was clearly no opportunity for immortality, but the Lords of Death appeared.
What are they fighting over?"
"The Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy, or... the so-called Divine Stones?"
The Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy could allow one to channel ten stars of high-level energy.
Furthermore, aside from them, the Genesis World’s rulers, no one else could cultivate it.
However, what about the Great Emperor?
Which Great Emperor would be able to grasp this kind of high-level energy?
If they could, even among Great Emperors, they could be considered extremely awesome, right?
Right, why had Xuan Taiyu been able to match the twelve Lords of Death at that time?

One of the reasons was that those ancient Great Emperors were unable to unleash their full power, but the other was probably because Xuan Taiyu had mastered Destructive Energy, which was why he was able to intimidate those ancient Great Emperors.

However, Emperors were too strong, and in a battle of twelve against one, even if Xuan Taiyu had heaven-defying luck and obtained the Divine Stones and Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy, he had only just become Emperor, after all, and his battle prowess hadn’t reached its peak yet, so he was heavily injured.

This made sense, but as for the specific details...
Xuan Taiyu was already dead, and only the Lords of Death would know.

Why?
The Genesis Substance was the cornerstone of that great world outside.

chapters.title: Chapter 4709: Genesis-level Great Herb
paragraphs: Unknowingly, Ling Han had already been here for a year.
However, Ling Han was still not the slightest bit anxious.
Because here, the flow of time was different.
The gravity fields here were far too powerful, so much so that they actually affected the flow of time.
According to the calculations of Buddha Doga, time passed much faster here, at least a hundred times faster than in the outside world.
Thus, even if he stayed here for a hundred years, only about a year would have passed outside.
A year had passed, and Ling Han’s adaptability had greatly improved.

In the first place, he had already cultivated the True Dragon’s Body Art, and his physique was incredibly tough. However, it could not be denied that this secret technique was tailor-made for the True Dragon, after all. He could learn it, but it was destined that he could not reach the peak stage.
It should be known that even if he used a higher level of energy to temper his body, the toughness of his body was only equal to that of the little azure dragon.

However, he was tempering his body here, and under the incomparably high-intensity resistance, Ling Han was modifying this Body Art that only belonged to the line of True Dragons, so it was more suitable for him.
He was already a Saint by now, and was only a step away from the peak stage of power of the world. Thus, he was qualified to make modifications.
In this one year, his improvement was astonishing.

Firstly, it was indeed because he had spent a long time and his body had gotten used to it, but no matter how much he had gotten used to it, there was still a limit, and the fact that he could keep improving was the result of him modifying the True Dragon Body Art.
"At this rate, when I leave, my Body Art alone would probably be enough to suppress a Nine-Star Saint."
"Even if I stand still and allow the nine-star Saint to attack me, would they be able to penetrate my physique?"
This was definitely shocking, but Ling Han wouldn’t be proud because of this.
That was because his opponent... was the ancient Great Emperors!
Even if there were 10,000 Saints added together, they would still be no match for a single finger of a Great Emperor.
However, even if he hadn’t left, the benefits were still very obvious.
Ling Han’s speed was now comparable to when he had been in the Foundation Building Tier.
This naturally greatly increased the speed of his exploration. However, after a whole year, he still did not find any Genesis-level Great Herb.
It should be said that he had not discovered any living matter at all.
This was difficult to find in the first place.

Even in the area of the Primal Chaos, the Genesis-level Great Herb was extremely rare, what more in the outer circle. Furthermore, Ling Han’s speed was so slow, so the area he could search in a year was also limited. It was not strange that he did not find anything.
In any case, time passed quickly here, so it was fine.
However, he wanted to make use of the fast flow of time here to complete the "rapid" improvement of his cultivation level?
This was impossible.
That was because there were no Regulations of heaven and earth here at all, so how could he cultivate here?
In this place, Ling Han’s cultivation level was stagnant.
Thus, he could only place his hopes on the Genesis-level Great Herb.
Two years, three years, ten years... Time slowly passed, and Ling Han still didn’t gain anything.

Of course, his speed had also increased again, and could be compared to when he had been in the Cauldron Forging Tier. However, this was also his limit. It was not that the strength of his physique could no longer be improved, but rather the gravity here was too terrifying after all.
As his physique improved, his speed could still increase, but it would definitely be extremely minor.

Twenty years, fifty years, a hundred years... Ling Han had already been here for a very, very long time. His physique had finally reached the limit of his current level. Unless he broke through to Emperor Tier, there would be no further improvement.
Previously, he had been training his physique, and even if he did not gain anything, he at least had a goal. However, now that his physique had reached its limit, he became bored.
This place was really too desolate.

Thankfully, he had millions and millions of dimensions in his body, as well as beautiful wives like Shui Yanyu. He could communicate with them at all times, so he did not go crazy from being too lonely.
After a long time, he was still a little numb. He walked expressionlessly, spreading out his divine sense to search for a special fluctuation.
According to Buddha Doga, Genesis Substance had a special fluctuation. Once one approached it, it would be very easy to discover.
—The Genesis-level Great Herb was only a manifestation of the Genesis Substance. Actually, it could still exist in other objects, such as Origin Gold.
However, comparatively speaking, there were more Celestial medicines.
Walk, walk, walk. Ling Han was like a walking corpse. In this place, he could not cultivate. Aside from walking and exploring, there was nothing else he could do.
’Hmm?’
He suddenly stopped in his tracks, an expression of delight appearing on his face.
He had sensed it, he had sensed a special fluctuation!
Genesis Substance!
He hurriedly turned around, and after walking for a while, he saw that a purple-red plant was shockingly growing ahead of him.
This plant was very peculiar. It had a stem and no leaves, and its stem was like a beautiful jade. It was translucent, and just looking at it gave one a pleasing and incredibly comfortable feeling.
A Genesis-level Great Herb!
Ling Han laughed loudly. It had been more than a hundred years, and he had finally reaped some rewards.
It had been too long.
—If Buddha Doga knew about this, he would definitely complain endlessly.

That was because he had entered into the zone of Primal Chaos all those years ago, but it had still taken him more than a thousand years to find the Genesis-level Great Herb, which allowed him to lay out his plans, and appear in this era.
Of course, though they were both Genesis-level Great Herbs, the amount of Genesis Substance they contained was completely different.
The one Ling Han found contained far too little.
However, Ling Han was only a Two Star Saint, and it wasn’t as if he were going to live a second life. In terms of merely increasing his cultivation level, this was already astonishing enough.
Moreover, he had only spent over a hundred years in the outer circle, and he had already gained something. Was that not enough?
The Great Herb was found, but digging out this Celestial medicine took Ling Han a whole nine months’ time.
It couldn’t be helped. He couldn’t directly pull it out, or the Great Herb would definitely break, and the Genesis Substance would be lost.
He could only dig it out bit by bit.
However, just how hard was this ground?
To dig out the Great Herb in one piece was definitely a massive test.
Nine months was not a long time.
"I’ve finally dug it out!" Ling Han revealed an overjoyed expression. Then, he stuffed the Great Herb into his mouth and swallowed it whole. He didn’t even chew, and directly swallowed it.
Then, he immediately began to refine it.
In just a short while, a special substance circulated in Ling Han’s body, giving him an ancient feeling, as if he had seen the origins of everything.
Genesis Substance, the cornerstone of heaven and earth.
Weng! A beam of light burst from his forehead. This was none other than the Dao of Heaven and Earth.

This was the source of heaven and earth, yet did not belong to the heaven and earth. There was no Dao or Regulations here. However, when the Genesis Substance was refined, the Dao of Heaven and Earth actually appeared.
These were not Regulations, but rather superior to Regulations.
What were Regulations?
It served the Dao of Heaven and Earth.
You see, the power of belief could also transform into Regulations, and someone as strong as the Saint could even create an absolute zone, and change the Regulations within this zone.
Thus, Regulations could be changed, but great dao would never change.
This was the true cornerstone of the heaven and earth, so how could it possibly be changed?

All of a sudden, enlightenment rose up in Ling Han’s mind. It was as if he was about to grasp the core of everything, and penetrate the secrets of heaven and earth, but at the same time, it was as if there was a film, so he could not truly touch it, which made him feel extremely uncomfortable.
He hurriedly suppressed these emotions, because this was the internal demon in his heart!
His enlightenment was real, and the internal demon was also real. If he pursued that secret of heaven and earth at all costs, it would only make him lose his way.
That was because his present cultivation level was still insufficient.

chapters.title: Chapter 4710: Sandstorm
paragraphs: Ling Han grasped the Dao of Heaven and Earth that had appeared in this short amount of time, and began to appreciate it.
The Dao of Heaven and Earth, superior to Regulations.

The Regulations had its limitations. For example, there were no Regulations here at all. One could not cultivate here, and could not extract them. Once the Regulations contained in one’s body was exhausted, battle prowess would immediately decline.
However, the great dao was different. This was the foundation of the universe, the essence.
No wonder the Genesis Substance could increase one’s cultivation level. One had skipped over Regulations and headed straight for the core. How could it not be awesome?
Furthermore, Ling Han also discovered that while he was accommodating the Regulations, his body was not silently destroyed.
It should be known that only by assimilating with the heaven and earth, could one accommodate more Regulations. This was the path of advancement for Saints.
A Saint would experience Silent Destruction nine times. This was his limit, and that was becoming a nine-star Saint.

However, different Saints had different natural talents. Some could accommodate one Regulation when they experienced Silent Destruction once, while others could accommodate two or even three Regulations, and freaks like Ling Han could accommodate five Regulations at a time!
But no matter what, this still required one’s body to experience Silent Destruction, to walk in the direction of being assimilated by heaven and earth.
However, Ling Han’s body clearly accommodated more Regulations, but there was no Silent Destruction of his body.
Then could he be considered to have broken through?
Even Ling Han himself didn’t know this.
If he continued to do this, would he be able to accommodate all the Regulations after absorbing going through Silent Destruction twice?
Then, as a Two Star Saint, would he be able to directly break through to Emperor Tier?
Ling Han was slightly confused. This was something that had never happened before.
What Saint could come here to cultivate?
Even a Nine-Star Saint was also about to be crushed to the ground, and had no option but to wait until the day his lifespan dried up.
Hence, he should be the only Saint that was cultivating here. Otherwise, only those Pseudo-Emperors could enter into this space.
Ling Han thought for a moment, and felt that his understanding of the Silent Destruction Tier was wrong. In fact, everyone in the Silent Destruction Tier was wrong.

Silent Destruction Tier elites didn’t need to annihilate their bodies nine times. Instead, nine times was the limit, and they couldn’t annihilate their bodies anymore. After nine times, their bodies would more or less be assimilated with heaven and earth. If they annihilated their bodies again, they would become one with heaven and earth.
—No matter how strong a Saint was, how could he be stronger than heaven and earth?
Thus, once one was completely assimilated with the heaven and earth, that was equivalent to having died.
Thus, the Silent Destruction Tier was actually trying to accommodate as many Regulations as possible before completely assimilating with heaven and earth.
"If possible, accommodating all eight-star Regulations in a single go is the proper way to go."
This was because stepping into Emperor Tier meant that one had to become independent. This was the complete opposite of having one’s body transform into heaven and earth.
Thus, if the number of times elites experienced Silent Destruction when they were at the level of Saint decreased, it would be even easier for them to break through to Emperor Tier.
Ling Han focused on cultivating and appreciation. Three days later, the essence was exhausted, and the great dao disappeared. His cultivation progress stopped there.
The number of Regulations in his body had reached as many as 35.

Theoretically speaking, he should have broken through to become a Three Star Saint, because every time he broke through, he would be able to accommodate five more Regulations. This was his previous experience.
Forget it. Regardless of how many stars of Saint Tier he was, the most important thing was how many Regulations he could use.

According to his experience, the maximum number of Regulations should be 99. Thus, when the number of Regulations he could accommodate in his body reached 99, he would be able to begin breaking through to the level of Pseudo-Emperor.

Ling Han set out again. After his cultivation level increased, he naturally felt a little more relaxed, but it was not obvious. He was afraid that if he did not become Emperor, he would not be able to relax here no matter what.
All of a sudden, another two years had passed, and Ling Han still did not make any progress.
This was very normal. Genesis Substance was so precious, so how could it be so easily found?
To say nothing of two years, it wouldn’t be strange even if he didn’t gain anything in two hundred or two thousand years.

As he walked, a change took place in the ground. It was no longer flat ground, but multiple stone pillars that were protruding from the ground. The tallest were three thousand meters tall, and the shortest was only about a foot tall. They were all greyish white in colour.
Ling Han walked closer, and pressed down with a finger. This pillar was indeed extraordinarily hard. This push did not cause the slightest bit of damage.
It seemed that the structure here was all the same. Even dirt the size of a grain of rice could turn into a star.
He walked into the forest of stone pillars and began his search.
Seven years had passed, and Ling Han was already accustomed to the boundless loneliness. He only had one thought, and that was to find the Genesis Substance.
Suddenly, his eyes widened.
He sensed a terrifying commotion.
Could it be?
He climbed up an extremely tall stone pillar, and looked into the distance. He saw that a sandstorm had appeared very far away.
Instantly, his expression changed drastically.
If this was the outside world, then what was a sandstorm worth?
But in this place, every single particle was as heavy as a star. Furthermore, it was only so small. What kind of concept was it to be hit by them?
This was no weaker than being blasted by a nine-star Saint, right?
And at the same time, there were several thousand, tens of thousands of grains of sand surging up at the same time. Who could bear that?
Even the Great Emperor would frown at this. He wouldn’t dare to treat this lightly, would he?

Ling Han learned about this kind of sandstorm from the information given to him by Buddha Doga. It was indeed extremely terrifying. Even a Pseudo-Emperor like Buddha Doga didn’t dare to face it head-on. It was one of the most terrifying dangers in the outer circle.
However, Ling Han had entered this place for more than a hundred years, and had never encountered it before. This was really good luck.
Faced with this kind of sandstorm, it was impossible to run.
The gravity field was too strong, and his speed was restricted. He couldn’t outrun the speed of the sandstorm at all.
Thus, he could only immediately seek cover to avoid this terrifying storm.
Ling Han searched for thick stone pillars, then leaned back, waiting for the storm to arrive.
So fast!
It wasn’t long before the sandstorm arrived, sweeping past Ling Han.
Thankfully, his back was leaning against the stone pillar, and this had blocked the majority of the impact for him. However, there were still some "sand particles" that blew over and landed on him.
’Holy f*ck!’
Even with Ling Han’s powerful physique, he still gritted his teeth in pain. This was far too terrifying. It was as if stars were crashing toward him, causing him incredible pain.

And this was thanks to the fact that the present him had already reached the limits of Saint-level in Body Art. Otherwise, this would not be a matter of pain, but he would rather be smashed through and destroyed.
If he didn’t have the protection of the stone pillar, and confronted them head-onâ¦ he would definitely be dead.

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel relieved that he hadn’t encountered the sandstorm in the previously flat and unobstructed desolate plain. Otherwise, even if he revived the Imperial Weapon, how long would it be able to last?
Hiding inside the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower?
Under the impact of the shockwave, it would still be shattered into pieces.

After a whole hour, the sandstorm finally passed. Ling Han looked at his body. His clothes had all turned into pieces, and disappeared with the sandstorm. Now, his naked body was covered with red dots.
This had been created by the "sand". It was too terrifying, and he still had some protection from the sandstorm.

"I haven’t encountered any dangers for over a hundred years, so I was a little careless. I almost forgot that this is the most terrifying place under heaven and earth. Even the Great Emperor could possibly die with resentment here." Ling Han gritted his teeth.
The sandstorm passed, and Ling Han continued to advance.
This stone forest was astonishingly huge, and Ling Han’s luck seemed to have become bad. He began to encounter frequent sandstorms, causing his search progress to be extremely slow.
In the blink of an eye, another 600 years had passed.
Yi, Ling Han’s dazed expression suddenly changed.
He had sensed a special fluctuation again!

chapters.title: Chapter 4711: Visitor
paragraphs: Good!
Ling Han’s spirits were lifted, and he immediately followed the fluctuation.
It was still a Celestial medicine, completely emerald green in colour, pleasing to the eye.

Ling Han immediately began to dig. Similarly, it was extremely difficult to dig. The ground was too hard, and the Celestial medicine itself was very fragile. If he was not careful, he would damage it.

This excavation took a long time, and quickly, half a year had passed, but Ling Han was still unable to complete digging it out. He was still a little bit away from extracting it fully. No matter what, he had to work for another month or so.
But right at this moment, he sensed another wave.
A unique fluctuation!
Yi?
Ling Han was astonished. Had another Genesis-level Great Herb suddenly grown in this space?
However, that wasn’t right. He could sense that this fluctuation was actually approaching.
Would the Celestial medicine run away on its own?
Er, there were indeed such medicines in the outside world. The Celestial medicine had developed a spirit, and to say nothing of fleeing, it could even spit at you.
However, was it the same here?
This fluctuation was getting closer and closer, heading straight for him.
Ling Han turned around. In an instant, he saw someone walking over from ahead of him.
What!
He was shocked. He could actually see another person here?
How was this possible?
It should be known that the gravity field here was astonishingly strong. Even if a nine-star Saint came, he would still be suppressed to the ground, unless he was as awesome as he was.
Aside from that, it was either a Pseudo-Emperor or a Great Emperor, and there was no fourth possibility.
If the other was also a Saint, then that would definitely be a super great enemy of his, and if it was a Pseudo-Emperor or even a Great Emperor in fact... the consequences would be unimaginable.
He focused his gaze, and saw that it was a young man. His whole body was covered with a silver Battle Armor, and it was this Battle Armor that was releasing a special wave.
Saint.
Ling Han could clearly see with his eye technique that there was a green-colored holy flame flickering inside this young man’s body.
In other words, he was a six-star Saint.
Hiss, a six-star Saint was able to come here. In fact, it was as if he was walking on flat ground, even more relaxed than he had been. This was definitely a strong opponent.
He was shocked, and the young man opposite him was even more shocked than he was. His mouth involuntarily gaped, his eyes wide, as if he had seen a ghost.
What was going on?
Which side was he from?
Why wasn’t he wearing a Battle Armor?
Someone without a Battle Armor could actually walk around here?
Are you a f****** monster?
All of a sudden, his mind was filled with questions, shaking him to the point that he could not think at all.
"Hello." Ling Han waved a hand. He was also very curious about the origins of this young man.
Hearing his voice, the young man finally calmed down. His eyes turned towards that green Celestial medicine, and was just about to speak, when he heard Ling Han speak up first, "This is mine!"
Er!
He couldn’t help but grimace. ’Your reaction is a little too fast, isn’t it? I haven’t even spoken yet.’
Furthermore, how do you know that I want this Celestial medicine?
—Why didn’t he think about who Ling Han usually hung out with?
It was the large black dog, and it was well-known to be stingy!
Thus, wasn’t it a joke to want to take advantage of Ling Han?
This was completely the gulf between an ancestor and a grand-disciple.
The young man turned his eyes to Ling Han, and frowned, "Which Great Emperor are you under?"
Ling Han’s heart instantly jolted.
Which Great Emperor was he under?
A Great Emperor!
In this instant, countless thoughts streaked through Ling Han’s mind.

As far as he knew, there was at least the Battle Saint Emperor, the Canopy Demon Emperor and the Ancestral King Lingtian who had entered the Primitive Abyss. From then onwards, there was no news of them.
However, even after countless years had passed, a great many forces were still wary that these Ancestral Kings were still alive, especially the Battle Saint Emperor and the Canopy Demon Emperor.
Thus, Brother Monkey was only suppressed, and the pervert pig’s cultivation level was also sealed.
Perhaps, there were other Great Emperors that had also come here, though they were not recorded in historical records.
If these Great Emperors had really managed to attain immortality, and had for some reason stayed in the Primitive Abyss, then his words were very significant.
—These Great Emperors were spreading their roots here, and they had successors and descendants?
Though it was only a single sentence, there was really too much information contained within.
Thoughts streaked through Ling Han’s mind, but his expression remained unchanged. He decided to extort some information.
"I am a disciple of the Battle Saint Emperor."
Boom!

Unexpectedly, when these words fell, the young man immediately moved, and shot out a punch at Ling Han. There were clearly only 12 flashes of Regulations flickering, yet they had been imbued with some kind of special power, causing their might to far surpass 12 stars.
Where had he revealed a weakness?

Could it be that it was because Brother Monkey’s ancestor was too bellicose, offending even the Great Emperors here? Thus, the moment he announced the name of the Battle Saint Emperor, he was immediately targeted?
However, his attention was immediately drawn by the other’s attack.
There were only twelve Regulations activated, but their might had reached the height of twenty stars!
What was going on here?
Could it be that this person also possessed a deadly weapon like the Destructive Energy?
Additionally, there was clearly no Regulations here, so where had this guy cultivated these Regulations from?
Genesis Substance!
Or... had he been to the outside world before?
It should be known that though the Primitive Abyss was dangerous, the danger was referring to entering it, and not coming out of it.
Moreover, his battle prowess had reached twenty stars in a single strike?
For a six-star Saint, this was very, very shocking. In fact, it had even surpassed the son of a Great Emperor, and was perhaps only slightly inferior to Ding Shu and the others.

Judging from his tone, it seemed like he was also a disciple of a Great Emperor. Then that was strange. The disciple of a Great Emperor was even more naturally talented than the son of a Great Emperor?
Or was it because the environment here was unique, and a person that had cultivated to become a Saint here was even more awesome?
Ling Han became more and more confused. In this moment of distraction, even parrying was full of flaws.
"You are courting death!" The young man smirked coldly. Faced with his attack, you actually dare to be so careless. Wasn’t that just courting death?
Peng!
He leaned over and threw a punch at Ling Han’s chest.
Ling Han instantly stumbled back in retreat.
’F*ck!’
That young man was clearly the one who had the upper hand, but now, he was so terrified that his scalp was numb, and his whole body was covered in cold sweat.
He had unleashed at least 80% of his battle prowess in this strike, and it had landed solidly on Ling Han, but actually only caused him to retreat seven steps back.
Then, there was no ’then’!
’Holy f*ck!’
What kind of monster was this?
Hiss, this couldn’t be a Great Emperor in disguise, right?
"You, who exactly are you?" Even his voice was trembling.

Only then did Ling Han come back to his senses. Though the other’s strength was extraordinary, he was stronger. Furthermore, he had been here for almost a thousand years, so just how strong was his physique?
The True Dragon’s Imperial Technique, added with being tempered by Nine Stars Energy, as well as the terrifying gravity fields here made Ling Han’s physique incredibly tough.

It could be said that even Saintly Material was not as sturdy as Ling Han’s body. If he could advance into the level of Pseudo-Emperor, his physique might soar to match the toughness at the level of Origin Gold even.
Then... he would also be able to take a few blows from a Great Emperor’s attacks head-on. In fact, he would be able to take even more blows than that.
’You’re a six-star Saint, yet you’ve only unleashed a battle prowess of around 20 stars. It’s already impressive enough that you were able to strike me to the point of retreat, okay?’
"You’re very strong," Ling Han praised.
F***, do you have no shame?
The young man’s expression instantly became dark. ’Oh, I’m so strong, yet you only took seven steps back after taking a punch from me head-on. Just how strong are you?’
How could anyone be so shameless as to praise themselves?
"Who exactly are you?" he asked again.
This was definitely not a Great Emperor. There was no Great Emperor that was as shameless as this.

chapters.title: Chapter 4712: Genesis Battle Armor
paragraphs: Thankfully, Ling Han did not know what this young man was thinking. Otherwise, he would definitely be defiant. What right did he have to say that he was shameless?
Ling Han cracked a smile, and said, "Didn’t I already tell you? I’m a disciple of the Battle Saint Emperor, and who are you?"
The young man scoffed. ’Do you take me for an idiot?!’
"I am Wang Zhe," he said, but did not mention which Great Emperor he was under.
Ling Han shook his head, rolled up his sleeves, and muttered, "Looks like I have to beat him up first. If I beat him into submission, he’ll definitely behave."
His muttering was not soft, and Wang Zhe immediately looked furious.
What arrogance!
"Don’t think that just because your physique is tough, you can ignore my existence!" he protested.
"Come!" Ling Han beckoned with his hand, "You’ll be obedient later."
"Impudence!" Wang Zhe roared loudly, and charged towards Ling Han.
His attacks were exceptionally simple, and there was nothing fancy about them. There were only twelve eight-star Regulations, but their might was explosively powerful.
Ling Han could only sigh in emotion. This was the Primitive Abyss, and thi was as expected of the beginning of the universe. Any random person that came out was already so awesome.
However, compared to him, there was still too much of a gap.
Ling Han charged forwards, and did not use Regulations. He merely used the power that he had cultivated through Body Art.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

Now that they were actually exchanging blows, Ling Han was completely certain that the other party indeed only had twelve flashes of Regulations. However, this person’s strength had reached twenty stars.
Where had this additional battle prowess come from?
It was not his Body Art. Power was indeed a part of battle prowess, but it was far from being so exaggerated.

However, Ling Han was only using pure power, so no matter how strong he was, it was still limited. Even for someone like him, his battle prowess would only be around 10 stars. He was far from being Wang Zhe’s match.
However, his physique was too tough. Though Wang Zhe’s battle prowess was "more" than his, it was absolutely impossible for him to defeat and injure Ling Han.
"Humph, I thought you were very strong, but as it turned out, you have nothing but Body Art!" Wang Zhe said coldly, showing a hint of disdain.
No matter how strong your physique is, what use is it if you don’t have powerful battle prowess?
"When I capture you, and search your soul, your identity can no longer be concealed!" His offensive became even fiercer.
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile, "Where do you get such confidence from?"

"In the face of reality, are you still not prepared?" Wang Zhe scoffed. Boom, he shot out another punch. There were clearly only twelve flashes of Regulations, but with the boost of some mysterious energy, he could unleash a battle prowess of twenty stars.
Strange.
Precisely because of his curiosity, Ling Han chose to content with him, and did not use the power of Regulations.

Of course, the other consideration was that if he used them in the Primitive Abyss, the Regulations in his body would decrease with each use, and he could only rely on the Genesis Substance to replenish them.
To be able to use the precious Genesis Substance to replenish Regulations instead of to increase one’s cultivation level, just how great of a waste was that?
He was observing Wang Zhe. The latter’s battle system was something that he had never seen before, which made him want to study it.
After several hundred exchanges, Ling Han finally made some discoveries.
Actually, Wang Zhe himself was not very strong.
He was indeed a six-star Saint, but his natural talent was definitely no higher than the son of a Great Emperor. Instead... that mysterious energy came from the Battle Armor on his body.
Ling Han couldn’t help but think. Previously, he had sensed a special wave, and it had also come from the Battle Armor on Wang Zhe’s body.
En!
He suddenly strengthened his offensive, and finally used the power of Regulations, instantly boosting his battle prowess to a terrifying level.
Peng!
With a single punch, he had directly thrown Wang Zhe onto the ground.

"Yo, I used too much force, that I knocked him unconscious." Ling Han gritted his teeth. He hadn’t fought with anyone for a long time, and his strength had increased too quickly, so it was inevitable that he couldn’t control himself.
He took off Wang Zhe’s Battle Armor. However, it was really not easy to take it off. It stuck firmly onto Wang Zhe’s body, as if it was a part of his body.
However, in front of Ling Han’s brute force, resistance was only temporary.
"Yi?"
When he took off the Battle Armor, he saw that Wang Zhe had actually been directly flattened, instantly turned into dust, and died.
This!
Ling Han couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat. He had never planned to kill Wang Zhe. Even if he wanted to, he would wait until he had clarified the situation.
But now, this guy had died.
Why?

It was very simple. He had been forcefully crushed into smithereens by the extreme weight of the gravity fields here, and even his spirit had been instantly shattered. Naturally, he had died immediately, and there was no doubt about it.

He looked at the Battle Armor in his hand, and enlightenment rose up in his heart. Previously, the reason why the other had been able to come and go more easily than him was because of this Battle Armor.
It could counter gravity?
Now that the Battle Armor had been removed, this guy had died.
Sigh, he really had no intention of killing anyone.
"In this place, you can’t even be a ghost, so you can only blame your bad luck," Ling Han murmured.

He began to study this Battle Armor. He discovered that the material used to forge this Battle Armor was a type of metal, and Genesis Substance was contained within. This should have had a related effect, turning what was ordinary into something amazing.
Then, he put on the Battle Armor. Instantly, he felt as light as a swallow.
Er, there was still gravity, but compared to before, it was so light that there was practically no comparison.
Right now, Ling Han could unleash the speed of Venerate Tier.
"Furthermore, the defenses of this thing is also very high."
Being able to resist the gravity fields here, how could it not be extremely hard?
Even Saintly Material would find it difficult to compare, right?

Of course, the most important thing was still the Genesis Substance. With its existence, the Battle Armor was equipped with special effects. Otherwise, one could just dig out some of the ground directly to make one, and wouldn’t it also be extremely hard?
But if that was the case, he would be the first to be crushed to the ground.

"This guy... does he come from the zone of Primal Chaos?" Ling Han looked into the distance. Under the enshrouding of Primal Chaos, all things could not be seen clearly, and could only be vaguely seen.
"Are the Great Emperors that entered this place all still alive?"
"More importantly, just how many Great Emperors have entered this place?"
"If they can all appear, the Twelve Lands of Death will no longer be a threat in an instant."
Who would be weaker than the other among those who could become Emperors?
Thus, if there were also twelve Great Emperors here, they would naturally be able to easily resolve the threat posed by the Twelve Lands of Death.
"Should I explore inside?"

In the past, Ling Han definitely wouldn’t dare to act so recklessly. However, now that he had a Battle Armor, his speed increased explosively, and his defense also increased greatly. He was now qualified to take risks.
"However, I’ll still circle around the outer area first, and try my best to find Genesis Substance. The stronger my strength, the safer it would be to enter."
Ling Han continued to dig for medicine, and after another twenty plus days, he finally dug out this Great Herb, and then immediately refined it.
Boom, the pillar of light of great dao once again rushed out of his head.
He comprehended it carefully, thinking that if he could grasp the great dao itself, who in this world would be able to match him?

The Great Emperor had only grasped the Nine Star Regulations, but the Regulations had all evolved from the great dao, and if he grasped the great dao, it was equivalent to having grasped the source of everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 4713: Light of great dao
paragraphs: However, to grasp the great dao, this was completely unrealistic.
This was too majestic and vast, and could not be understood at all. For example, how a person who had never learnt how to read be able to cultivate it even if he was given a supreme treasured book?
Ling Han was just about to give up, when he suddenly discovered that his body had actually resonated with the great dao!
No, no, no. He immediately discovered that it wasn’t the great dao, but Genesis Substance.
Why hadn’t he done so before?
Was it because this was the second time that there was already a remnant of Genesis Substance in his body?
But in the next instant, he discovered that something was off, because there was a terrifying energy bubbling all over his body.
Destructive Energy!
Then, the holy flame also shook violently, as if it had received some kind of stimulation.
This!
Ling Han knew that whether it was Destructive Energy or Seed of the Holy Flame, they all came from the Primitive Abyss, but they actually resonated with great dao?
What in the world was going on?
Yi!
He suddenly discovered that the Battle Armor on his body had also resonated. The Genesis Substance was being extracted and fused into the light of great dao.

Hey, hey, hey. Ling Han hurriedly tried to stop it. He still had great use for this Battle Armor. He wanted to use it to enter into the territory of Primal Chaos. If the Genesis Substance was extracted, it would be a pile of scrap metal.
However, he couldn’t stop it. Genesis Substance was continuously being extracted, burning like flames.
Ling Han had no choice but to cultivate faster. Otherwise, his losses would be even greater.
Four days later, the light of great dao on his body disappeared.
Now, how many stars of Saint-level was he considered?
The color of the holy flame was still red. This meant that he was a Two Star Saint, but in truth, the Regulations that he could accomodate in his body had already reached as many as 38.
This was because the Genesis Substance had allowed him not to experience the Silent Destruction of his body, so he could accommodate even more Regulations.
Yi, going by that theory, Wang Zhe, a six-star Saint, was really too weak.

You see, as long as one had obtained the Genesis Substance, they would be able to accommodate even more Regulations without Silent Destruction of their body. And even if Wang Zhe had experienced Silent Destruction of his body six times, he was only able to accommodate twelve eight-star Regulations.
This meant that his talent was actually inferior to that of the Golden Generation.
Just look at how many times he had used Genesis Substance. The more he used, the worse his natural talent naturally was.

After all, this was the largest danger zone in the universe. It was already inconceivable that there were living beings here, but the population was definitely small. This large premise determined that it was impossible for too many prodigies to appear in this place.
Oh, so heavy!
Ling Han suddenly discovered that he was still wearing the Battle Armor. Right now, the Genesis Substance inside it had already been expended, and it instantly became extremely heavy.
This belated realization was because Ling Han’s physique was too tough. Even if there were millions of stars hanging from his body, he was actually able to withstand it.
"Now that Wang Zhe has died, and the Battle Armor has been destroyed, how am I supposed to enter the Primitive Abyss?"
It was definitely impossible for him to barge in forcefully. No matter how strong he was, he was only a Saint, and had only grasped 38 eight-star Regulations.
"I can only continue to search in the outer circle."
"Yi?"
He looked into his mind, and saw that there was actually a beam of light in the midst of the burning holy flame.
The Dao of Heaven and Earth!
Ling Han was dumbfounded. A Dao of Heaven and Earth had actually appeared in his mind!

No, it wasn’t that exaggerated. This still couldn’t be called the Dao of Heaven and Earth, but only the light of great dao, just like the light of great dao that had absorbed the Genesis Substance and shot out from his body.
However, it was still incredibly awesome.
If he used the light of great dao, just how powerful would his battle prowess become?
Let’s give it a try.
He threw a punch, which landed on the ground. Peng, the ground did not even tremble, because with the sturdiness of the ground, it was completely comparable to a Saint Tool.
In this punch, Ling Han had only used Body Art.
He then used all the Regulations, and added with the power of belief, he blasted out a total of 43 flashes.
Peng, when this punch landed, the ground was still the same, and not even a trace was left behind.
"I’m about to get serious."
Ling Han channelled the light of great dao from the holy flame, and shot out his fist for the third time.
Peng, this time, a hole shockingly appeared in the ground, as deep as a foot.
Heavens!
This destructive power was too terrifying, and this was completely because the light of great dao had been infused into the attack.
It was only a single beam, and it was extremely weak.
Genesis Substance!
It must be because of Genesis Substance. However, it wasn’t completely because of Genesis Substance.
Ling Han felt that he himself was also very useful. The Destructive Energy and the holy flame were both responding, and even his body was part of it.
"If the Divine Stones originate from the Primitive Abyss, then it wouldn’t be strange for me to resonate with this place."
Ling Han murmured to himself. Then, he suddenly had an idea. What would happen if he used the light of the great dao and the Destructive Energy together?
Moreover, his holy flame was different from others. What if he used it as well?
Though the more the holy flame was used, the less there would be left, he could still bear the expense of a single strike.

Ling Han channeled three types of unique energies at the same time: the light of the great dao, the Destructive Energy and the holy flame. Boom! He threw another punch, and instantly, a pit that was three feet in diameter and three feet deep appeared on the ground.
In the outside world, this kind of attack would only be Meridian Opening Tier-level, but in this place, it was too terrifying.
If he were to face the Skeleton Saint Tool again at this moment, he would probably be able to blast this kind of existence to bits.
At the very least, a single punch would be enough to break the legs and arms of the Skeleton Saint Tool.
"I’ll continue to search for Genesis Substance. As long as I can become a Pseudo-Emperor, then even against a Great Emperor, I would be qualified to render some resistance."
Ling Han’s confidence soared, and he began to search again.
However, without the Battle Armor, the gravity field he suffered was extraordinarily strong, so his speed still couldn’t increase.
One day after another, year after year passed, and Ling Han returned to his extremely lonely and boring life. His daily routine was to search for Genesis Substance, and sense that unique fluctuation.
With this search, another seven hundred years passed.
Calculating, it had already been more than 1600 years since Ling Han entered into this space. In the outside world, it had also been around 16 years.
Ling Han strolled slowly. He was already used to being alone.

He had come from the Genesis World, and in the Genesis World, a period of seclusion would easily take tens of thousands or even millions of years. Thus, though the process of searching was extremely boring, it did not bring him much negative effects.
In the meantime, he experienced several more sandstorms, but he still hadn’t walked out of this vast stone forest. Thus, he didn’t encounter any other dangers.
’Hmm?’
He faltered slightly, because he suddenly sensed a special fluctuation, and it was approaching him.
Could it be that another person like Wang Zhe had come?
Ling Han was filled with anticipation as he turned around to look.
In a short while, two figures shot out.

Similar to Wang Zhe, they were also wearing Battle Armors. However, unlike Wang Zhe’s silver armor, their Battle Armor was bronze in color. Moreover, it wasn’t metal, but stone. The Genesis Substance’s waves were clearly weaker than Wang Zhe’s.

chapters.title: Chapter 4714: The First Generation Divine Beast
paragraphs: These two people were also exuding Saint-level fluctuations, and added with the air from Genesis Substance, they formed a special pressure.
After discovering Ling Han, the two of them also acted like Wang Zhe, revealing incredibly stunned expressions.
There was actually someone who could move around here without wearing a Battle Armor?
"Hey, hey, hey, what’s with the look in your eyes?" Ling Han was displeased. "I’m only not wearing Battle Armor, but it’s not like I’m completely naked!"
The two of them were still astounded. Not wearing Battle Armors was much more shocking than not wearing clothes.
What kind of freak are you?
Hold on!
They hurriedly shook their heads. The two of them had come out to find disciples of the Great Emperors, not to show off their shock.
"Who are you?" one of them asked. His name was Luo Qi, and the other was Chu Tang.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "I am a disciple of a Great Emperor, and who are you people?"
Luo Qi and Chu Tang wore strange expressions. ’How the f*ck can you be a disciple of a Great Emperor?’
What disciple of a Great Emperor would be as poor as you, not even having a Battle Armor?
"There must be something strange about this person!" Luo Qi said to Chu Tang.
Chu Tang nodded, "The disappearance of the Nine Kings may be related to this person."
"Capture him!"
"All right!"
Ling Han sighed, "Though you guys are whispering to each other, I still heard very clearly."
"So what?" Chu Tang smirked coldly, "We are wearing bronze Saintly Armor, so how could we not be able to suppress you?"
Yi, the battle prowess contest here is a comparison of Battle Armor?

Ling Han couldn’t help but complain, saying, "The Battle Armor that you’re wearing is clearly made of stone. Don’t think that just because it exudes a bronze luster, you can call it Bronze Battle Armor. Are you trying to take advantage of the fact that I’m not educated?"
At this point, Luo Qi and Chu Tang really wanted to complain. What kind of guy was this person in front of them?
"Ignore him. Capture him first and then interrogate him."
"All right!"

Luo Qi and Chu Tang shook their hands at the same time, and instantly, a long spear appeared in their hands. It was also made of stone, but exuding an air of vitality, they instantly exerted a strong sense of danger.
In this place, Genesis Substance wasn’t just used to cultivate. It had a wide variety of uses, and at least, it could be used to forge Battle Armor and weapons.
Doubt arose in Ling Han’s heart. Just how many people were there in this Primitive Abyss?
He hadn’t heard about it from Buddha Doga.
Could it be that this kind of change was something that had happened after the departure of Buddha Doga?
Right at this moment, Luo Qi and Chu Tang had already charged over. They extended their long spears, and stabbed at his left and right shoulders respectively, intending to nail him to the spot.
Er, you guys are thinking too much.

Ling Han had only seen the Battle Armor that had been forged from Genesis Substance before, but he had never seen the might of a weapon before. Thus, he was naturally very intrigued, and allowed the two of them to stab at him.
Peng!

The two long spears struck Ling Han’s shoulder at the same time. However, not only did they not manage to pierce through Ling Han’s shoulder, but under the massive impact, the web between the thumb and forefinger of Luo Qi and Chu Tang’s hands became numb, and they almost lost their grip on their spears.
What kind of monster was this!

The two of them were transfixed with shock. Just how sharp were the weapons forged by Genesis Substance? Aside from the Battle Armor that was also forged by Genesis Substance, what could it not pierce or slice through?

Ling Han lowered his head to take a look. The clothes on his shoulders had turned into pieces. Being crushed by the terrifying gravity fields, so what if this was woven from high-level material? It instantly turned into ashes.
He shook his head, "If you damage my clothes, you will have to pay compensation."
Luo Qi and Chu Tang exchanged a glance before turning around to flee.
This was practically a monster, and was definitely not someone that they could stand against. They had best flee quickly.
They would go back and ask for help.

"Don’t be anxious!" Ling Han unleashed his power. Peng! He caught up to the two of them, but it was a little difficult. After all, he would be affected by the super gravity, while the gravity on Luo Qi and Chu Tang would be offset by the Battle Armor.
Thankfully, the speed of these two people had not soared, and he had directly caught up to them.
Ling Han stretched out his hands and placed them on their shoulders. Instantly, the two of them were rendered immobile.
"What is it? You don’t want to pay?" Ling Han asked with a smile.
"We will, we will!" Luo Qi and Chu Tang hurriedly said. Right now, their only wish was to escape. This man was far too mysterious and strange. He was not someone they could oppose at all.
Ling Han smiled, "Come, tell me about your origins."
Luo Qi and Chu Tang were both a little stunned. What did he mean by ’our origins’? At this moment, they didn’t know how to respond.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before asking again, "Which Great Emperor subordinate are you?"
Luo Qi and Chu Tang exchanged looks, and both came to a realization. "You’re from the outside world!" they exclaimed.
Otherwise, he would definitely not have asked such a question.
Ling Han frowned and said, "I don’t like to repeat a question."
"We are Lord True Dragon’s subordinates," Luo Qi hurriedly said.
’What?’
Ling Han faltered upon hearing this. True Dragon?
Hadn’t the True Dragon died long ago?
In this instant, Ling Han truly wished that the little azure dragon had come with him. Who knew what expression he would have when he found out that his old man had come back to life.
His first reaction was that these two people were lying.
When he had entered into the True Dragon Abyss, the True Dragon had entrusted his son into his guardianship, and that was how he had obtained the True Dragon’s Body Art.
Now, he was told that the True Dragon hadn’t died?
How was this possible!
"Hehe, compared to repeating questions, I hate it even more when others lie to me!" Ling Han shot out a punch, and Luo Qi was instantly blasted into smithereens.

This caused Chu Tang to shiver in fear. When he saw Ling Han turn his gaze over, he hurriedly said, "We are really the subordinates of Lord True Dragon, and there is definitely nothing false about it."
Ling Han frowned upon hearing this. He had already killed one person, so why was this person still replying in this manner?
Could it be that what he said was true?
How was this possible?
The True Dragon was definitely dead.
’Little azure dragon, how does it feel to suddenly have a father?’
But looking at how the other was breaking out in a cold sweat from shock, it did not seem like he was lying.
Moreover, was the character they were subordinate to some great secret that they had to protect with their lives?
Ling Han asked again, and Chu Tang answered honestly.

As far as Chu Tang knew, there were a total of 36 Great Emperors in the Primitive Abyss. Each of them was suppressing an area, forbidding any outsider from entering into the depths of the Primitive Abyss.
36 Great Emperors?

Aside from the True Dragon, there was also the True Phoenix, the Black Tortoise, the Vermillion Bird and so on. They were all Ancient Beasts, and were the first living beings to appear when heaven and earth was first born, and it was only at that time that Great Emperors could coexist.
Of course, there were also the Lords of Death, but none of them could make a move easily. This must be the restriction of heaven and earth.
Now, he was told that the first generation Divine Beasts had not died, and all of them were in the Primitive Abyss. How could he believe this?
Furthermore, countless billions of years had passed, so shouldn’t they have died of old age long ago?
What in the world was going on?
Hold on, Buddha Doga had entered into the Primitive Abyss before. Then, if there were thirty-six Divine Beasts at that time, would Buddha Doga not have told him?
Thus, this had only happened after the first life of Buddha Doga.
Ling Han was completely baffled. Thirty-six Divine Beasts had appeared all of a sudden, and they were all the earliest Ancestral Kings, so he did not know what kind of expression he should have.
In his eyes, this was completely unrealistic, but this Chu Tang did not look like he was lying at all.
Then what was going on here?
Ling Han felt that it was necessary to meet with Buddha Doga, so that the latter would also know about this.

chapters.title: Chapter 4715: Going deep
paragraphs: After putting on a "Bronze" Battle Armor, Ling Han brought Chu Tang with him and left the Primitive Abyss.
With this Battle Armor, his speed instantly soared.
This wasn’t as impressive as the Silver Battle Armor, but it still allowed Ling Han to display the speed that he had when he was a Sect Master.
However, when he was in the level of Sect Master, his speed was comparable to the level of Venerate Tier. Thus, his speed was really very fast.
This Battle Armor was resistant to gravity, so Ling Han was able to easily break free from the gravitational pull of this land. He flew back into the abyss and returned the way he had come.
After exiting the abyss, Ling Han released his divine sense, which instantly spread out like an ocean, as far as the eye could see.
It wasn’t long before he located Buddha Doga.
This Pseudo-Emperor was presently sitting cross-legged in space, the aura on his body fluctuating. Obviously, he had expended a great amount of Imperial Source previously, and had not recovered yet.

Similar to using the holy flame, the Imperial Source would decrease with each use, and was considered a consumable item. Thus, Buddha Doga wasn’t trying to heal the Imperial Source, but rather trying to recover from the damage caused by burning Imperial Source.
A Pseudo-Emperor was a Pseudo-Emperor. Even under in such a state, he sill immediately detected Ling Han’s divine sense. With a single step, he had already appeared in front of Ling Han.
Yi?
When he saw how Ling Han was wearing a strange suit of armor, and there was even a person in Ling Han’s grip, even this mighty figure from the ancient times was astonished.
What the hell?
If it had to be said that Ling Han had made a Battle Armor for himself out of boredom — though it was made of stone and was extremely trashy, why would there suddenly be another person?
He could tell with a single glance that this was a Saint.
What was going on here? There were actually other Saints in the Primitive Abyss?
However... that was impossible. How could a Saint possibly resist the dangers of the Primitive Abyss? Merely that gravity field was enough to crush a Saint into dust.
Only a freak like Ling Han could barely move around there. Don’t tell him that this kind of monster had appeared again!
Hold on!
Buddha Doga stared at the Battle Armor in disbelief. Although it was pitifully rubbish, it radiated with a unique aura.
Genesis Substance!
He revealed a shocked expression. This Battle Armor was actually forged from Genesis Substance?
Ling Han looked at Buddha Doga’s expression in satisfaction. After all, he couldn’t be the only one who was stunned.
Chu Tang was also stunned when he saw Buddha Doga. This was because he could sense a faint imperial might radiating from Buddha Doga’s body.
This was a Great Emperor.
This was far too terrifying. This was a Great Emperor!
"This person... comes from the Primitive Abyss?" Buddha Doga asked.
Ling Han nodded, and related all the information that he had found out from Chu Tang.
The first reaction of Buddha Doga was disbelief. However, looking at the Battle Armor on Ling Han’s body, as well as Chu Tang, he couldn’t help but feel doubt.
"The Divine Beasts from the ancient era are all still alive?" Even this Pseudo-Emperor was shocked. This news was really too shocking.
Ling Han shook his head, "I don’t know about other things, but in the case of the True Dragon, it has definitely died."
"My Lord True Dragon is still alive and well!" Chu Tang couldn’t help but interrupt. You guys can’t treat him like a dead man.
Emperors were invincible in the world, and their majesty was naturally deeply ingrained in everyone’s hearts.
"We can only enter there and get to the bottom of this," Buddha Doga said. His voice was resolute, and it was clear that he had made up his mind.
If such a mighty figure made up his mind, there was definitely no one that could change his mind.
Ling Han nodded. He knocked Chu Tang unconscious with a tap of his finger, then removed the Battle Armor from his body, handing it over to Buddha Doga.
Even if Buddha Doga was a Pseudo-Emperor, wearing this Battle Armor would still be somewhat helpful, even if the assistance it could provide was extremely minuscule.
After all, the Primitive Abyss could even kill the Great Emperor.
This also led to a problem. The Primitive Abyss was obviously so dangerous, but now, not only were there thirty-six Divine Beasts keeping watch, they had even established their own forces?
Extremely strange!
They entered the Primitive Abyss and headed towards the area of chaos.

When they passed through the Primal Chaos, it was as if they were walking in mud. It was incredibly difficult, and this was still because the Battle Armor on them had helped, dispelling a portion of the resistance. Otherwise, it would be even more difficult.
It didn’t matter to Buddha Doga, but it was extremely likely that Ling Han wouldn’t be able to pass through it.
After the two of them entered, they saw that this was actually very similar to the outer area. It was just an empty land, and there was nothing here.
"Let’s go."
The two of them advanced, heading into the depths.

They had not walked too far, when an ocean appeared ahead of them, but when Ling Han and Buddha Doga came closer, they saw that the ocean had actually dried up in an instant. A tall mountain broke out of the ground, and lay there.
However, it was only an instant, and the tall mountain crumbled, turning into hills, and then into a plain, nurturing all life.
It was still an instant, and everything was destroyed, turning into a barren land.
"What’s this?" Ling Han wore a stunned expression as he looked at Buddha Doga.
Buddha Doga nodded and said, "In this unique region, time flows indescribably fast. If we enter, we’ll be turned into bones before we can even walk out."
Yet Ling Han’s eyes lit up, "Then from here, can I cultivate Regulations of Time?"

This was too awesome. Even if it was the Great Emperor, so what? There was a limit to his lifespan. With a single strike from the Regulations of Time, time would instantly accelerate millions and millions of times, and it was guaranteed that the Great Emperor would also die.

Buddha Doga couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, saying, "Theoretically, yes. However, even if you have mastered it, it can’t possibly take effect on Pseudo-Emperor or Great Emperor, because people like us can already resist the abnormal flow of time."
The Saint’s body could absorb Regulations, while the Great Emperor’s body was self-contained. Thus, it was impossible to use Regulations on the Great Emperor.
Only the Dao of Heaven and Earth could suppress the Great Emperor, allowing the Great Emperor to age normally.

However, this place was the Primitive Abyss. There was no Regulations, but it was the birthplace of the Dao of Heaven and Earth. Thus, even if Buddha Doga entered into the area ahead of them, it was guaranteed that he would immediately age, die, and turn into a skeleton.
The Primitive Abyss was a land of death that could kill even Great Emperors.
For the so-called Twelve Lands of Death, the true danger lay in the Great Emperors inside.

The two of them circled around, but this area was very big. Furthermore, there were times when it was expanding, and there were times when it was shrinking. That would be even more dangerous. They had to stay far away, to avoid being suddenly dragged in. If that really happened, they would not even know how they died.
This detour was naturally time-consuming, and in this place, even the speed of a Pseudo-Emperor would not be much faster.
After half a year, they finally circled around this area, and the area ahead of them was finally considered safe.
However, they had not advanced for too long, when they saw endless flames surging, turning into a storm that surged madly in their direction.
Buddha Doga’s expression changed drastically. He immediately grabbed Ling Han and turned around to leave.
Hiss!
Ling Han also gritted his teeth. This storm of flames was too terrifying. He had a feeling that if he was swept up in it, it was guaranteed that his only fate would be death.
He looked closely with his eye technique, and saw that there was clearly not the sligthest bit of Regulations in these flames, yet they were extremely strong.
Why were these flames so terrifying?
