Thus, it was impossible to use Regulations on the Great Emperor.
Only the Dao of Heaven and Earth could suppress the Great Emperor, allowing the Great Emperor to age normally.
However, this place was the Primitive Abyss.
There was no Regulations, but it was the birthplace of the Dao of Heaven and Earth.
Thus, even if Buddha Doga entered into the area ahead of them, it was guaranteed that he would immediately age, die, and turn into a skeleton.
The Primitive Abyss was a land of death that could kill even Great Emperors.
For the so-called Twelve Lands of Death, the true danger lay in the Great Emperors inside.
The two of them circled around, but this area was very big.
Furthermore, there were times when it was expanding, and there were times when it was shrinking.
That would be even more dangerous.
They had to stay far away, to avoid being suddenly dragged in.
If that really happened, they would not even know how they died.
This detour was naturally time-consuming, and in this place, even the speed of a Pseudo-Emperor would not be much faster.
After half a year, they finally circled around this area, and the area ahead of them was finally considered safe.
However, they had not advanced for too long, when they saw endless flames surging, turning into a storm that surged madly in their direction.
Buddha Doga’s expression changed drastically.
He immediately grabbed Ling Han and turned around to leave.
Hiss!
Ling Han also gritted his teeth.
This storm of flames was too terrifying.
He had a feeling that if he was swept up in it, it was guaranteed that his only fate would be death.
He looked closely with his eye technique, and saw that there was clearly not the sligthest bit of Regulations in these flames, yet they were extremely strong.
Why were these flames so terrifying?

chapters.title: Chapter 4716: The True Dragon Emperor?
paragraphs: He brought Ling Han along with him as he ran madly, and this run actually lasted as long as half a year. Only then did Buddha Doga finally stop.
In the distance, the speed of the firestorm finally slowed down, and it slowly dissipated.
Hiss, Ling Han gritted his teeth.
With the speed of a Pseudo-Emperor, he still had to run madly for half a year. Just how terrifying was this place?
"What flames are these?" Ling Han asked. There was clearly not the slightest bit of Regulations, yet they were still chillingly strong.
Buddha Doga pondered for a moment, then said, "This is the Source Power of heaven and earth. I’m not sure either."
"Then what about now?" Ling Han didn’t linger on this matter. At present, he wasn’t even qualified to grasp Nine Star Regulations, what more Source Power?
Cultivation was a gradual process.
"Let’s continue forward."

The two of them continued forward. After the storm of flames swept over, peace returned. Because the ground had been shrunk countless times over, every grain of sand was the weight of a planet. Thus, even if this kind of flame burned over, it would only leave behind a charred spot, and did not cause too much damage.
Yet Ling Han frowned. That was because when he had walked here for the first time, he had not seen the charred ground.
He looked at Buddha Doga, and Buddha Doga nodded, and said, "There’s not only firestorms here. There are also other natural disasters."
Thus, passing through this area was not only time-consuming, but also dependent on luck.
If one was unlucky, they might have to circle around for a few hundred years.
True enough, merely two months later, Ling Han and Buddha Doga hadn’t even reached the finishing line they had the last time, when they saw meteorites raining down from the skies.
Peng, peng, peng! This was too terrifying. Every single one of them crashed down, and grooves appeared in the ground. They were as wide as thirty meters.

Ling Han was astonished upon seeing this. One had to realize that even if he unleashed his full strength, he could only create a three-meter-wide crater with each punch. Just what kind of concept was a 30-meter-wide crater?
Was it destructive power on the level of Pseudo-Emperor? Or even Great Emperor-level in fact?
This meteorite rain was also sweeping towards them from ahead. Thus, there was nothing else that could be done. Ling Han and Buddha Doga could only retreat.
Fortunately, the meteorite rain wasn’t advancing at a fast speed, allowing them to calmly retreat.
The problem was that this was too slow.
If it was not for the fact that time passed quickly here, and when a hundred years had passed, only a year would have passed outside, Ling Han would really die of anxiety.
This retreat actually lasted as long as three years.
The meteorite rain finally stopped, and Ling Han and Buddha Doga advanced again.
Faced with the might of heaven and earth, Ling Han didn’t even consider using the Clear Bamboo Sword or the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to block it.
It should be known that even a Great Emperor could possibly die here, so the Imperial Weapon was really not all that impressive.
They advanced. Two months, half a year, eight months, and this time, their luck actually improved. They did not encounter any more natural storms.
After walking for another two years, a city shockingly appeared ahead of them.
From afar, it looked like a dragon’s head, exuding a powerful dominance.
This!
It really couldn’t be the True Dragon Great Emperor, right?
Ling Han was also slightly moved, but he had clearly confirmed that the True Dragon was really dead.
Buddha Doga didn’t advance rashly. Instead, he released his divine sense towards the city.
Boom!
In just an instant, an imposing and domineering aura arrived with a bang. It was extremely cold and emotionless.
"Who are you, little brat?" A thought exploded in the minds of Ling Han and Buddha Doga.

Ling Han instantly spat out blood from all his apertures, and almost fainted. Thankfully, there was still a beam of light of great dao in his mind, which allowed him to just barely maintain consciousness.
Meanwhile, Buddha Doga’s expression wasn’t any better. His face was as white as a sheet.
Boom!
Right at this moment, a claw suddenly stretched out from the city ahead of them.
Five claws, golden.
This was... a dragon’s claw!
Ling Han and the little azure dragon had accompanied each other for so long, so he naturally knew what the claws of the Dragon Race were like.
True Dragon?
Hey, hey, hey, is this for real?
However, there was no time for him to mull over this. Buddha Doga grabbed him, turned around, and fled.
Fighting with a Great Emperor?
Hehe.
Boom! It was clear that the Great Emperor of the Dragon Race hadn’t appeared. However, when he extended his claw, it was as if it were a boundless realm that was drawing closer and closer.
"Here!" Ling Han took out the Clear Bamboo Sword and handed it over to Buddha Doga.
Buddha Doga caught the sword, and directly slashed out with his sword.

He was presently unable to awaken the Clear Bamboo Sword. However, Pseudo-Emperor was extremely strong in the first place, and added with the might of the Origin Gold, he could still just barely manage to match a Great Emperor.
Shua, this strike landed on the dragon claw, and instantly, a thin mark was left behind. However, Buddha Doga was directly sent flying, throwing up blood continuously.
It was not just him. Even Ling Han was throwing up blood madly. He had only been touched a little by the Imperial Might, but the Imperial Might was really too strong.

It was not that he had not taken a blow froma Great Emperor before. Though that was under the prerequisite of having awakened the Clear Bamboo Sword, he had a feeling that the might of this attack from the dragon claw was superior to the Lord of Death.
Was that possible?
To become a Great Emperor, who would be weaker than the other?
Unless... the Lord of Death hadn’t unleashed his full strength at that time.
True, against a mere Saint like him, was there any need for him to unleash his full strength?
Buddha Doga didn’t stop at all, continuing to run madly with Ling Han in tow.
Behind them, Imperial Might spread out, and an azure dragon dashed out of the city. Travelling on clouds and mists, it was presently rapidly chasing after them.
It was too fast; this was a genuine Great Emperor!
F***, the True Dragon really didn’t die?

The Imperial Clans could not produce a Great Emperor. This was like a curse from heaven and earth. Thus, Ling Han definitely did not think that this was any child of the True Dragon, but the True Dragon itself.
He was a little confused. This had completely disturbed his cognition.

Buddha Doga quickly familiarized himself with the Clear Bamboo Sword’s usage. He struck again, and this time, its might was terrifying. Imperial might spread out, as if that supreme empress had come back to life.
Boom!
The True Dragon moved, but was blocked. However, with how powerful the Great Emperor was, he immediately pursued again.

Meanwhile, Buddha Doga continued to charge forward as he slashed his sword. Relying on the might of the Imperial Weapon, he could still hold on for the time being. However, he definitely couldn’t hold on for too long.
The Imperial Weapon was only a weapon forged by a Great Emperor, so how could it possibly compare to a true Great Emperor?
What could they do?
They were being hunted down by a Great Emperor, a living Great Emperor!

Ling Han also activated the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to dissipate a portion of the aftermath of the Imperial Might. After all, this was also Origin Gold, and he was the most powerful Saint, so dissipating a portion of the aftermath shouldn’t be a problem.
This run took three days.
Boom!

A wave of water suddenly gushed out from the ground, and it was as wide as could be. Then, it separated into front and back, which just happened to separate the True Dragon Emperor, Buddha Doga, and Ling Han.
This... was life-saving!
This place was incredibly dangerous, and even a Great Emperor had to be extremely careful. Otherwise, it was extremely likely that he would be buried here.
The wave crashed down, and the True Dragon Emperor was also forced to stop. He then turned around and left.
"Humph!" The Great Emperor’s will surged, but they did not feel any dissatisfaction.
A mere Pseudo-Emperor and Saint, so what if he couldn’t kill them? The next time he encountered them, he would still be able to easily kill them.
Ling Han and Buddha Doga ran madly. As they ran, another half year’s time passed, and only then did the waves behind them calm down. What was originally a desolate plain had turned into a great sea.
This was truly a strange place.
"Let’s leave first," Buddha Doga said.

chapters.title: Chapter 4717: Return
paragraphs: Buddha Doga brought Ling Han away from the Primitive Abyss.
This place was no longer safe. A Great Emperor had targeted them, so aside from running, was there any other option?
"Inside the Primitive Abyss, there really is a secret to immortality!" Ling Han said. That True Dragon Emperor was clearly the first generation True Dragon.
However, he was also a little puzzled. Compared to the True Dragon’s divine sense that he had come into contact with, this True Dragon Great Emperor seemed to be slightly different.
"I don’t know if there’s a secret to immortality, but there something very strange about that Great Emperor," Buddha Doga said after a moment of thought.
In this aspect, Buddha Doga had a very strong say, because not only was he a Pseudo-Emperor, he even had a fellow disciple that had become a Great Emperor.
"Oh?" Ling Han was curious.
"It’s very strange," Buddha Doga continued. "It clearly possesses the Imperial Might, yet it seems to be a little lacking. Compared to a true Great Emperor... it’s weaker!"
Yi, what kind of existence was that?
Pseudo-Emperor?
Impossible, Buddha Doga was a Pseudo-Emperor, but in front of the True Dragon Great Emperor, he couldn’t fight back at all.
Thus, that being was definitely a Great Emperor.
However, this was indeed strange.
When Buddha Doga entered the Primitive Abyss for the first time, it was still completely desolate and lifeless. Now, however, a city had actually been built, with a Great Emperor standing guard.
Thus, this city must have been built after the first life of Buddha Doga.
But the crux of the matter lay here.
What era did the True Dragon belong to?
The primitive time when the heaven and earth first formed was indescribably far away.
Why had an existence that should have died countless years before Buddha Doga appeared after the latter?
A second life after so many eras?
Impossible!
A Great Emperor who had obtained a fortuitous encounter in the Primitive Abyss could live a third life, but this must be continuous.
The Great Emperor was too strong. No Regulations or treasures could suppress him. This also included the lifespan of a Great Emperor and his soul.
Thus, there was no possibility that he would be sealed for how many years, and then live a second life.
Could it be that it, like the Lords of Death, had relied on some kind of secret technique to live for countless years, and then appeared again in recent times?
This was indeed possible.
However, unlike the Lords of Death, the True Dragon Emperor could clearly attack without any reservations.
Moreover, according to Chu Tang and Luo Qi, the 36 Divine Beasts guarded the passage to the core of the Primitive Abyss, not allowing anyone to pass. Why was that?
Ling Han and Buddha Doga exchanged looks. They discussed endlessly, but the more they discussed, the more troubled they became.
This didn’t make sense. This didn’t make sense at all.
The more they knew, the more confused they became.
"This is truly a chaotic world!" Buddha Doga said with a deep frown.
The Twelve Lands of Death were already troublesome enough, and now there were thirty-six ancient Divine Beasts?
Though none of them had appeared yet, once they left the Primitive Abyss, just how colossal would the effects be?
Because of this, the structure of the world would be changed and reforged.

What they knew now was that in the Primitive Abyss, there was definitely the Great Emperor of the Dragon Race, the first generation True Dragon. However, it was slightly different from the first generation True Dragon. Furthermore, in terms of battle prowess, the former was considerably weaker.
Was this the key?

Buddha Doga decided to bring Ling Han back with him. This was because the Primitive Abyss was far too dangerous at this moment, so much so that they had attracted the attention of a Great Emperor. That being the case, how could they still dare to search for Genesis Substance inside peacefully?
It should be known that the outer circle was relatively safe, so wasn’t it even safer for the Great Emperor?
Without terrifying calamities such as firestorms, meteorites, and so on, how could they block the attack of a Great Emperor?
Thus, they could only leave now. No matter what, they had to avoid the limelight.

It should be known that one year in the outside world was equivalent to a hundred years in the Primitive Abyss. Thus, if they came back after a few hundred years, that True Dragon Great Emperor probably wouldn’t keep them constantly in his mind.
After all, in the eyes of the Great Emperor, they were all ants.
The two of them returned. This time, Buddha Doga didn’t burn the Imperial Source, because there was no need to rush.
A Pseudo-Emperor’s speed was fast, but it still took them 200 years to finally return to the part of the universe that Ling Han was familiar with.
Buddha Doga immediately left. He was going to contact a few people and inform them about the unforeseen event that had happened to the Primitive Abyss.
Ling Han knew that Qian Haoyang was definitely one, but Buddha Doga didn’t say "one".
Could it be that there were other Pseudo-Emperors?
However, Buddha Doga left in a hurry, not giving Ling Han time to ask questions. Ling Han could only suppress his doubts first, and begin to locate the Four Origin Planet.

Previously, he had set up formations on the Four Origin Planet, which could cut off destiny to a limited extent. If the Great Emperor made a prediction, it would definitely not be difficult, but he would have to pay a certain price.
Under normal circumstances, a Great Emperor would not be concerned at all, but for the Lords of Death, they would have to consider carefully.
As the master of the formation, it just happened to be the other way around, so it was even easier for him to sense it.
It wasn’t long before he located it. He then tore open space and traveled through the Void for a while. When he rushed out again, Four Origin Planet was already within sight.
His appearance instantly caused the empress and the others to sigh in relief.
They did indeed know that Ling Han had gone to the Donglin Planet. However, there was suddenly no news from the two of them. Moreover, it had been a whole 200 years, so how could they not be worried?
Ling Han gathered everyone over, and related his experiences over the past 200 years.

In truth, he had spent 200 years on his return. The true time he had spent in the Primitive Abyss was only 16 years. However, the flow of time was different, and he had spent more than 1600 years there.
Hearing Ling Han’s words, everyone was dumbfounded.
This!
The Lords of Death appeared out of nowhere and suppressed the universe, unmatched. This big problem was still yet to be resolved, and now there were 36 Divine Beasts?
No wonder Empress Qingzhu had foreseen such a terrifying future— 48 Great Emperors!
"My father... is actually in the Primitive Abyss?" The little azure dragon was so shocked that it couldn’t even close its mouth.
"Impossible!" He could not believe it, "My father has already died!"

Though he too hoped that the True Dragon was still alive, this was something that he had sensed from inside his egg shell. It was a connection through their bloodline, so it was even more impossible that it could be a deception.
Thus, he definitely couldn’t tolerate someone impersonating the True Dragon.

Ling Han also frowned, and said, "That is indeed a Great Emperor. Even Buddha Doga is completely no match for him. Furthermore, for someone who can become a Great Emperor, is there any need to impersonate another?"
Emperor meant the strongest in the world, so what was the significance of impersonating someone else?

"No, my father has definitely died," the little azure dragon said in agitation. "The bloodline connection definitely can’t be faked. Even if I’m not born yet, I can still clearly sense that my father’s bloodline has dried up and has assimilated with heaven and earth."
This guy didn’t even use "Grandpa Dragon" anymore, which showed how excited he was.

Indeed, having someone else impersonating his old man, anyone would be stomping their feet in fury, what more when it was a True Dragon. That had been the strongest Divine Beast in the past, and that could be a source of pride for the little azure dragon.
Then, what exactly was going on?
Ling Han suddenly recalled that Buddha Doga had said that the True Dragon Great Emperor was relatively weak, and was clearly inferior to Buddha Ah Han.
What did this mean?

This time, Buddha Doga didn’t burn the Imperial Source, because there was no need to rush.
A Pseudo-Emperor’s speed was fast, but it still took them 200 years to finally return to the part of the universe that Ling Han was familiar with.
Buddha Doga immediately left.
He was going to contact a few people and inform them about the unforeseen event that had happened to the Primitive Abyss.
Ling Han knew that Qian Haoyang was definitely one, but Buddha Doga didn’t say "one".
Could it be that there were other Pseudo-Emperors?
However, Buddha Doga left in a hurry, not giving Ling Han time to ask questions.
Ling Han could only suppress his doubts first, and begin to locate the Four Origin Planet.
Previously, he had set up formations on the Four Origin Planet, which could cut off destiny to a limited extent.
If the Great Emperor made a prediction, it would definitely not be difficult, but he would have to pay a certain price.
Under normal circumstances, a Great Emperor would not be concerned at all, but for the Lords of Death, they would have to consider carefully.
As the master of the formation, it just happened to be the other way around, so it was even easier for him to sense it.
It wasn’t long before he located it.
He then tore open space and traveled through the Void for a while.
When he rushed out again, Four Origin Planet was already within sight.
His appearance instantly caused the empress and the others to sigh in relief.
They did indeed know that Ling Han had gone to the Donglin Planet.
However, there was suddenly no news from the two of them.
Moreover, it had been a whole 200 years, so how could they not be worried?
Ling Han gathered everyone over, and related his experiences over the past 200 years.
In truth, he had spent 200 years on his return.
The true time he had spent in the Primitive Abyss was only 16 years.
However, the flow of time was different, and he had spent more than 1600 years there.
Hearing Ling Han’s words, everyone was dumbfounded.
This!
The Lords of Death appeared out of nowhere and suppressed the universe, unmatched.
This big problem was still yet to be resolved, and now there were 36 Divine Beasts?
No wonder Empress Qingzhu had foreseen such a terrifying future— 48 Great Emperors!
"My father... is actually in the Primitive Abyss?" The little azure dragon was so shocked that it couldn’t even close its mouth.
"Impossible!" He could not believe it, "My father has already died!"
Though he too hoped that the True Dragon was still alive, this was something that he had sensed from inside his egg shell.
It was a connection through their bloodline, so it was even more impossible that it could be a deception.
Thus, he definitely couldn’t tolerate someone impersonating the True Dragon.
Ling Han also frowned, and said, "That is indeed a Great Emperor.
Even Buddha Doga is completely no match for him.
Furthermore, for someone who can become a Great Emperor, is there any need to impersonate another?"
Emperor meant the strongest in the world, so what was the significance of impersonating someone else?
"No, my father has definitely died," the little azure dragon said in agitation.
"The bloodline connection definitely can’t be faked.
Even if I’m not born yet, I can still clearly sense that my father’s bloodline has dried up and has assimilated with heaven and earth."
This guy didn’t even use "Grandpa Dragon" anymore, which showed how excited he was.
Indeed, having someone else impersonating his old man, anyone would be stomping their feet in fury, what more when it was a True Dragon.
That had been the strongest Divine Beast in the past, and that could be a source of pride for the little azure dragon.
Then, what exactly was going on?
Ling Han suddenly recalled that Buddha Doga had said that the True Dragon Great Emperor was relatively weak, and was clearly inferior to Buddha Ah Han.
What did this mean?

chapters.title: Chapter 4718: Vicious reputation
paragraphs: Ling Han returned. For the moment, he couldn’t go to the Primitive Abyss anymore. What was the point?

He needed to increase his cultivation level and reach the limit of Silent Destruction Tier. Then, he would break through to the level of Pseudo-Emperor and later, become a Great Emperor to calm the darkness.
However, without the Genesis Substance, he could only rely on the supremely valuable medicine to speed up his cultivation. This was too slow.

Ling Han first concocted alchemical pills on the Four Origin Planet. He had squeezed out a great many treasures from the various Imperial Clans. Though they were ineffective on him, they could be used on others.
As a large number of alchemical pills were concocted, the cultivation levels of Lin Luo, Zhou Heng and the others were all rapidly improving.
To them, their natural talent was not too bad. They were only missing out on a bit of fated opportunity.
After all, they weren’t the masters of Genesis World.

Especially Lin Luo. His natural talent in cultivation was extremely shocking, and he had long since cultivated to the peak stage of Venerate Tier a good few years ago. After obtaining Ling Han’s alchemical pills, he had completely stabilized his cultivation level, and began seclusion, attempting to break through to Saint Tier.
Next, the Four Origin Planet would welcome a wave of breakthroughs.
Zhou Heng, Chu Hao, and the others had all reached the peak stage of Fourth Extreme. They were now qualified to attempt breaking through to the Saint Tier.

Ling Han didn’t know how many of them could ignite the holy flame with their own power, but for the moment, it was impossible to count on the power of belief. Four Origin Planet only had so many living beings, and it wasn’t enough to support any one of them to ignite the holy flame.
However, though it was difficult to become a Saint now, once he succeeded, his battle prowess would also be considerably stronger than the average Saint.

Ling Han was filled with anticipation. By now, though Saints no longer had much effect on the overall situation of heaven and earth, now that they had become Saints, they would at least have the ability to protect themselves.
After enjoying tender intimacy for a few years with the empress, Chi Menghan, and the others, Ling Han couldn’t sit still any longer.
Actually, an ordinary life was what he yearned for, but for this kind of ordinary life, he had to run around and put his life on the line first.
How could he rapidly increase his cultivation level?
This was ultimately a huge dilemma that hung above Ling Han’s head.

The responsibility on his shoulders was too heavy. To say nothing else, merely for the sake of Old Man Ge’s sacrifice, he too wanted to become a Great Emperor as soon as possible, and suppress the world.
However, where could he go now?
The various Imperial Clans?
He had already gone to those that he could find, and there were still some that had not exposed the location of the ancestral planets all this while. Now, it was even more impossible to find them.
Then, should he go to the Netherworld?
Ling Han guessed that there might also be great opportunities there.

Though the Netherworld had no life force, and was the complete opposite of the Living Realm, things would definitely go the other way when they reached the extreme. For example, wasn’t it theoretically impossible for any living creature to survive in the Primitive Abyss? However, there were Genesis-level Great Herbs there.
Perhaps the Netherworld didn’t possess such Great Herbs, but he was only a Saint, so he didn’t necessarily need such a precious Celestial medicine.

’Fine, I’ll go to the Netherworld and kill some Yin souls while I’m at it. I’ve been away for 200 years, so the Skeleton Saint Tool should be arrogant and domineering again. No one can stop it, right?’
Ling Han didn’t bring the empress and the others with him. After all, who knew if another Lord of Death would appear?
Though his present strength had soared greatly, it was still far from enough against a Great Emperor.

Right now, the Yin souls had already occupied about 30% of the planets in the universe. Their main purpose was to transform the territories that they occupied into the Netherworld. This would take too long. Otherwise, with the battle prowess of the Skeleton Saint Tool, it would be invincible.
Ling Han casually arrived at a planet that had been taken over. The aura of life emanating from his entire body was surging, and it was as dazzling as the sun.
Yin souls instantly surged over. To them, Ling Han’s blood and flesh was a supreme delicacy.

The flesh and blood of living spirits from the Ling Han were their instinctive desires, and ordinary Yin souls didn’t have intelligence. Driven by their instincts, they didn’t even consider Ling Han’s abilities as they pounced over.
All of them scrambled over one another, as if those who were a step slower would not be able to snatch Ling Han’s flesh and blood.
With a thought from Ling Han, weng, a shockwave immediately swept through the entire planet, and all the Yin souls were instantly turned into dust.
Then, he arrived at the second planet, and still, with a single thought, he had instantly dealt with all the Yin souls.
It wasn’t long before he cleared a galaxy and revived the sun.
After doing all this, he smiled slightly.
This was what a Saint was.
Previously, he had encountered opponents that were too strong. They were either the Skeleton Saint Tool, the Lord of Death or an ancient Divine Beast, which made him feel very lacking in confidence.

It should be known that if time was reversed by a few hundred years, a Saint would be an existence at the pinnacle of this world, and Ling Han was the strongest Saint in history. He should be invincible.
Sigh, who asked him to be born in such a chaotic world?
With a flash, he headed to the next galaxy.
But this time, he had just conquered three galaxies, when he sensed that the Void had been torn open, and a powerful aura was spreading out.
Saints had come. En, there was more than one.
Ling Han looked over, and there were a total of three Yin Saints coming out of the Void.

However, when these three Yin Saints saw Ling Han, their expressions instantly changed drastically. Even if they were only in the form of souls, a drastic change in expression could still be seen from them.
How could they not be shocked?
This was Ling Han.
The number one Saint of all eternity!
They hurriedly turned around and fled, once again tearing a rip into space, and threw themselves in.
At this, they finally breathed a sigh of relief. Thankfully, they had escaped from the hands of this bringer of misfortune.
"Hehe, leaving right after arriving, aren’t you giving me too little face?" Ling Han’s voice rang out by their ears.
What!
The three Yin Saints were all astonished. When had Ling Han caught up to them?
What kind of speed was this?
It should be known that they too were Saints.
The number one Saint of all eternity, this was the strongest Saint in history.
Ling Han stretched out a hand to grab them, and the three Yin Saints were immediately forcibly pulled back.
"You, what do you want to do?" the three Yin Saints asked in trembling voices. Of course, they were all communicating through divine sense.

At such a close distance, they could clearly feel Ling Han’s aura of life that was as majestic as the sun. There was no need for him to make a move at all. Merely this aura of life was enough to destroy their spirits.
Yin and Yang were opposites. This was inherent and fundamental.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and with a tremor of his divine sense, the three Yin Saints all fainted.
He didn’t kill them, not because he was benevolent, but because he wanted to leave the Yin Saints to the empress and the others.

—His strength was too strong. With the same rewards from heaven and earth, what he received would be useless, but if it was obtained by the empress and the others, the effects would be completely different.
Thus, in Ling Han’s eyes, this was equivalent to Great Herbs beneficial for cultivation, so he naturally couldn’t waste it.
Using his divine sense as a lock, he strung the three Yin Saints together, dragging them behind him. Then, he continued to head to other planets.
Light the sun, and once again illuminate these dark galaxies.
After another while, a spatial fluctuation spread out. This time, nine Yin Saints had come.
"Not good, it’s that bringer of misfortune, Ling Han!"
"Run!"
But this time, they had not even torn open space, when they were knocked unconscious by a single thought from Ling Han.
"Invigorating, this is what an elite should be like," Ling Han said with a smile. Then, he continued onto his own business.

He was going to wait for those Imperial Sons from the Lands of Death to arrive, and then take advantage of the opening to harvest another batch. Of course, the Skeleton Saint Tool was his main target. As long as he could get rid of the Skeleton Saint Tool, the invasion of the Netherworld would be greatly slowed down.

chapters.title: Chapter 4719: String of Yin Saints
paragraphs: Another half a day later, the third batch of Yin Saints arrived.
"Ling Han!"
"Run!"
Their reaction was the same. When they saw Ling Han, they immediately paled in shock. Then, they turned around and ran quickly.
Of course, they definitely wouldn’t be able to escape. They could only be suppressed by Ling Han.
However, this also made Ling Han very displeased.
Was his reputation really that bad?
Sigh, he was very unaccustomed to having no one by his side to answer him. Otherwise, the large black dog would point out righteously, "Yes, you are that kind of person!"
"If you want to show off, it’s still better to have Old Black here. He can deliver the greatest blow to your opponent."

Ling Han murmured to himself. With his continuous efforts, the surrounding galaxies had already lit up, area by area. The sun had revived, and was exuding sunlight that had not been seen for a long time.
After 10 days, Ling Han had already "captured" close to 100 Yin Saints. They were all strung together like kites by his power of belief, floating behind him.

"En, there are a little too many of them. Let’s go back first." Ling Han thought for a moment, then tore a rip into space. Taking these Yin Saints with him, he first returned to the Four Origin Planet, where he converted them into cultivation resources for the empress and the others.
Xiu, he sank into the Void. Space closed, creating a slight ripple.
When these ripples were about to disperse completely, it was visible that in the space not too far away, space had suddenly torn open, and a considerable number of figures had walked out.
—If Ling Han was here, he would discover that these were not Yin Saints, but rather living people.
The Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters of the Lands of Death.

Their improvement was impressive, and even the weakest had reached Five Stars, but their battle prowess naturally far surpassed Five Star Saints. With a dozen over of them together, they formed a terrifying suppression.
"He just left," Li Dangping said. He sensed for a while, and the ripples caused by the shattering of space had already passed. He couldn’t get any more information.
"Is it Ding Shu, or Origin?"
"Or Heaven Crushing, or Jing Haoran!"
These Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters of the Lands of Death were all guessing. By now, the only ones who truly had the ability to resist were Ding Shu and the other Genesis World rulers.

Ling Han selflessly taught the Destructive Energy to them, allowing their ability to resist Yin souls to reach its strongest. As long as they moved, no Yin Saint would be able to withstand a single strike. They could only rely on the Skeleton Saint Tool to suppress them.
However, if a Saint wanted to flee, how could he be stopped?
Of course, this was unless they had long since set up an inescapable net, and waited for them to enter the trap before killing them.
Even so, it was still unknown whether they could be killed or not.
Thus, Saints were extremely difficult to kill.
None of them suspected Ling Han, because Ling Han had already disappeared for too long, as if he had disappeared from this world.
"Summon Yin souls to come and reoccupy these planets."
"Let’s go and extinguish the sun again."
These Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters began to assign missions, turning the Living Realm into Netherworld. This concerned the great plans of the Lords of Death.
Meanwhile, Ling Han was far too powerful. He had arrived on the Four Origin Planet in just half a day’s time.
Boom, saintly might spread out.

Even if the abilities of the Yin Saints were much weaker, Saints were still Saints. Moreover, there were over a hundred Yin Saints here. Even if they were unconscious, there would still be a sliver of saintly might seeping out, so how terrifying would all of them be together?
Instantly, Brother Monkey and the others rushed out, but when they saw a large number of Yin Saints being skewered by Ling Han like candied hawthorn, their expressions became strange.
This... was indeed very shocking.
"Come, let’s share," Ling Han said with a smile. Killing Yin souls could obtain rewards from heaven and earth, and the rewards obtained from killing Yin Saints were even greater.
They could even be divided like this?
Everyone was gritting their teeth. Only Ling Han would have such extravagance, capturing a bunch of Yin Saints to give them the rewards of heaven and earth.
However, this was really a good thing. The rewards from heaven and earth were different from any Celestial medicine, safe and without side effects, so it was worth it.
After everyone had shared the spoils, they began to slaughter the Yin souls.
So what if it was Yin Saints? They were being suppressed by Ling Han, and could not resist at all.

With such a large amount of nutrition, Saints like Brother Monkey, the empress and the others did not have any obvious improvement, but for those below Saint-level, every single one of them had improved greatly.
It could be foreseen that not too long after, the Four Origin Planet would welcome a wave of breakthroughs of Saints.
"Little Han, we’re going too."
"That’s right, let’s fight together."
The large black dog, little azure dragon and the others were all howling. They constantly stayed on the Four Origin Planet to cultivate, and were very bored.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then nodded, "All right."

They were all Saints, so they could flee if they couldn’t defeat the enemy. If they truly came across a Great Emperor, he could activate the Imperial Weapon to resist and at that time, he could also provide cover for their retreat.
There were crises, but they mostly could be resolved. Furthermore, with this kind of pressure, cultivation would become faster.
"Let’s go!"
Ling Han tore a rip into space, and led everyone on their way.
Not too long later, they appeared out of thin air, and arrived in a dark galaxy.
Oh, the sun had been extinguished again.
If the sun could speak, it would definitely be complaining endlessly.
—You guys extinguish me one moment, and ignite me the next. Do you really think I’m a candle?
Boom! They were all Saints, so their saintly might naturally spread into the surroundings.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Immediately, multiple figures appeared. They were all Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters from the Lands of Death.
"Little Han, it’s time to show off," the large black dog immediately said.
Sure enough, the large black dog knew him best.
They practically... had the same tastes.
With a thought from Ling Han, his appearance immediately changed.
"Humph, so it’s you guys!" Lu Xun said coldly, "I really don’t know where you got your courage from, to actually dare to come over!"

With how weak the Living Realm was, they could only snipe once and then change locations. Thus, for the people of the line of Nine Suns Holy Land still dared to come over, this made him very confused.
"We have big d*cks, so we have nothing to fear!" the large black dog said.
"We’re not as thin as earthworms like you!" the little azure dragon also immediately said.
Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng!
However, without waiting for Lu Xun to make a move, these two bad-mouthed guys were immediately thrashed by Hu Niu and Chi Menghan.
This!
Lu Xun’s expression was livid. He was the dignified Imperial Son of the ancient times, and had once commanded an era. Yet now, he was actually being toyed with like a monkey?
"You guys have gone too far!" he said in a baleful voice.
"B@stard son, come fight me if you’re dissatisfied!" the large black dog provoked.

"You’re seeking death!" Lu Xun strode out. He was completely unafraid of the large black dog and the other Saints. Only Brother Monkey could make him feel slight wariness. When the line of the Battle Saint Emperor fought, he was a maniac, but the more he fought, the stronger he became, and the more crazy he became.
Thus, if the large black dog and the others were were willing to battle, he would naturally be more than happy to oblige. This would give him a chance to massacre them.
"That um... Little Han, I’ll give you a chance. Go, kill this guy for Grandpa Dog," the large black dog pointed at Ling Han and said very casually.
"Yes, Grandpa Dog," Ling Han said respectfully. He and the large black dog were the best partners.
Seeing that the large black dog didn’t dare to fight, Lu Xun couldn’t help but humph. However, when his eyes swept over Ling Han, he revealed a hint of surprise.
A red holy flame, a Two Star Saint.
Strange, when did a Two Star Saint appear from the Four Origin Planet?

By now, the only ones who truly had the ability to resist were Ding Shu and the other Genesis World rulers.
Ling Han selflessly taught the Destructive Energy to them, allowing their ability to resist Yin souls to reach its strongest.
As long as they moved, no Yin Saint would be able to withstand a single strike.
They could only rely on the Skeleton Saint Tool to suppress them.
However, if a Saint wanted to flee, how could he be stopped?
Of course, this was unless they had long since set up an inescapable net, and waited for them to enter the trap before killing them.
Even so, it was still unknown whether they could be killed or not.
Thus, Saints were extremely difficult to kill.
None of them suspected Ling Han, because Ling Han had already disappeared for too long, as if he had disappeared from this world.
"Summon Yin souls to come and reoccupy these planets."
"Let’s go and extinguish the sun again."
These Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters began to assign missions, turning the Living Realm into Netherworld.
This concerned the great plans of the Lords of Death.
Meanwhile, Ling Han was far too powerful.
He had arrived on the Four Origin Planet in just half a day’s time.
Boom, saintly might spread out.
Even if the abilities of the Yin Saints were much weaker, Saints were still Saints.
Moreover, there were over a hundred Yin Saints here.
Even if they were unconscious, there would still be a sliver of saintly might seeping out, so how terrifying would all of them be together?
Instantly, Brother Monkey and the others rushed out, but when they saw a large number of Yin Saints being skewered by Ling Han like candied hawthorn, their expressions became strange.
This... was indeed very shocking.
"Come, let’s share," Ling Han said with a smile.
Killing Yin souls could obtain rewards from heaven and earth, and the rewards obtained from killing Yin Saints were even greater.
They could even be divided like this?
Everyone was gritting their teeth.
Only Ling Han would have such extravagance, capturing a bunch of Yin Saints to give them the rewards of heaven and earth.
However, this was really a good thing.
The rewards from heaven and earth were different from any Celestial medicine, safe and without side effects, so it was worth it.
After everyone had shared the spoils, they began to slaughter the Yin souls.
So what if it was Yin Saints?
They were being suppressed by Ling Han, and could not resist at all.

With such a large amount of nutrition, Saints like Brother Monkey, the empress and the others did not have any obvious improvement, but for those below Saint-level, every single one of them had improved greatly.
It could be foreseen that not too long after, the Four Origin Planet would welcome a wave of breakthroughs of Saints.
"Little Han, we’re going too."
"That’s right, let’s fight together."
The large black dog, little azure dragon and the others were all howling.
They constantly stayed on the Four Origin Planet to cultivate, and were very bored.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then nodded, "All right."
They were all Saints, so they could flee if they couldn’t defeat the enemy.
If they truly came across a Great Emperor, he could activate the Imperial Weapon to resist and at that time, he could also provide cover for their retreat.
There were crises, but they mostly could be resolved.
Furthermore, with this kind of pressure, cultivation would become faster.
"Let’s go!"
Ling Han tore a rip into space, and led everyone on their way.
Not too long later, they appeared out of thin air, and arrived in a dark galaxy.
Oh, the sun had been extinguished again.
If the sun could speak, it would definitely be complaining endlessly.
—You guys extinguish me one moment, and ignite me the next.
Do you really think I’m a candle?
Boom!
They were all Saints, so their saintly might naturally spread into the surroundings.
Xiu, xiu, xiu!
Immediately, multiple figures appeared.
They were all Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters from the Lands of Death.
"Little Han, it’s time to show off," the large black dog immediately said.
Sure enough, the large black dog knew him best.
They practically... had the same tastes.
With a thought from Ling Han, his appearance immediately changed.
"Humph, so it’s you guys!" Lu Xun said coldly, "I really don’t know where you got your courage from, to actually dare to come over!"
With how weak the Living Realm was, they could only snipe once and then change locations.
Thus, for the people of the line of Nine Suns Holy Land still dared to come over, this made him very confused.
"We have big d*cks, so we have nothing to fear!" the large black dog said.
"We’re not as thin as earthworms like you!" the little azure dragon also immediately said.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
However, without waiting for Lu Xun to make a move, these two bad-mouthed guys were immediately thrashed by Hu Niu and Chi Menghan.
This!
Lu Xun’s expression was livid.
He was the dignified Imperial Son of the ancient times, and had once commanded an era.
Yet now, he was actually being toyed with like a monkey?
"You guys have gone too far!" he said in a baleful voice.
"B@stard son, come fight me if you’re dissatisfied!" the large black dog provoked.
"You’re seeking death!" Lu Xun strode out.
He was completely unafraid of the large black dog and the other Saints.
Only Brother Monkey could make him feel slight wariness.
When the line of the Battle Saint Emperor fought, he was a maniac, but the more he fought, the stronger he became, and the more crazy he became.
Thus, if the large black dog and the others were were willing to battle, he would naturally be more than happy to oblige.
This would give him a chance to massacre them.
"That um...
Little Han, I’ll give you a chance.
Go, kill this guy for Grandpa Dog," the large black dog pointed at Ling Han and said very casually.
"Yes, Grandpa Dog," Ling Han said respectfully.
He and the large black dog were the best partners.
Seeing that the large black dog didn’t dare to fight, Lu Xun couldn’t help but humph.
However, when his eyes swept over Ling Han, he revealed a hint of surprise.
A red holy flame, a Two Star Saint.
Strange, when did a Two Star Saint appear from the Four Origin Planet?

chapters.title: Chapter 4720: Might of the Battle Armor
paragraphs: In this era, only Saints could be active on the world stage. The others were all mediocre, and could only be blasted into dust.
However, even if a large number of Yin souls could help one rapidly increase his cultivation level, becoming a Saint was still not a simple matter.

By now, the power of belief could no longer be gathered. He could only rely on his own comprehension of the Regulations of heaven and earth to ignite the holy flame. This was really, really too difficult. There were really not many people that could do it.
Thus, the sudden appearance of a Two Star Saint from the Nine Suns Holy Land made Lu Xun feel very curious.
Could it be Ling Han?
This thought flashed through his mind, but he immediately shook his head.
Firstly, Ling Han had already disappeared for more than two hundred years, so how could he suddenly appear?
Secondly, with how freakish Ling Han was, how could he not have improved after so many years, and still be stuck at the level of Two Star Saint?
Although he didn’t want to praise Ling Han, he had to admit that Ling Han’s talent was too terrifying. 200 years was enough time for him to advance to the next level.
Thus, this person was definitely not Ling Han.
The red-colored holy flame could be seen with a single glance.

However, he had only seen one part of it, and not the other part. That was because if Ling Han’s holy flame was released from his mind, it would be even larger than a house. At that time, he would definitely change his mind.
"Who are you?" Lu Xun asked calmly.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then said, "My surname is Tu, and others call me Imperial Son."
Slaughtering Imperial <anno data-annotation-id="07a52705-b759-4711-8789-79b6fc87f34e" data-title="Son">Son1</anno>?
Hiss, do you take me for an idiot?

"You’re seeking death!" He immediately charged over. However, before Ling Han could make a move, he saw the staff sweep out, and Brother Monkey had already stood in front of Ling Han, launching an attack at Lu Xun.
In these two hundred plus years, Brother Monkey had been battling with Yin souls, and had obtained countless rewards from heaven and earth. By now, he was already a Four-Star Saint.
The staff struck out, its might terrifying.
Ling Han was rendered speechless. Sigh, Brother Monkey was really too bellicose.
However, since Brother Monkey had made a move, it would not be proper for him to interfere either. He could only step back slightly.
Er, he had not succeeded in showing off.

On the other side, Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters from the Lands of Death, such as Tong Ming,Wu Xingtong and the others were in no rush to make a move. As they saw it, Brother Monkey was the strongest Saint of Four Origin Planet. They only had to defeat Brother Monkey, and these people’s fighting spirit would collapse. They would not be able to withstand a single blow.
Of course, even if they attacked now, those people on the other side would still be unable to withstand a single blow.
Fight, fight, fight. In terms of cultivation level, Brother Monkey was inferior to Lu Xun, and his natural talent was also inferior. Logically speaking, he should have lost very soon.

However, the members of the line of the Battle Saint Emperor became stronger and crazier as they fought. Brother Monkey’s viciousness boiled, turning into blazing fighting spirit, and his battle prowess actually increased inconceivably.
He fought Lu Xun to a tie.
"As expected of the line of the Battle Saint Emperor."

"In the past, when the Battle Saint Emperor hadn’t become Emperor yet, his natural talent wasn’t the strongest. However, he forcibly defeated all the Saints of that era, and became a Pseudo-Emperor, and finally attaining Dao."
"This belief that the more you fight, the stronger you become is engraved in the bones of the line of the Battle Saint Emperor."
"However, this monkey should also be one of the strongest. He really has the domineering aura of the Battle Saint Emperor from years ago."
The Imperial Sons discussed spiritedly, but were not moved.

Brother Monkey’s strength was forcefully released by activating his life force. Furthermore, it seemed like only the line of the Battle Saint Emperor could do this in this world. However, this kind of strength ultimately could not be maintained for long.
In a prolonged battle, Lu Xun would definitely win.
"Brother Monkey, wear this Battle Armor." Ling Han tossed the bronze Battle Armor over to Brother Monkey.
The gulf between their cultivation levels was far too great. In the first place, this wasn’t a fair battle, so Ling Han had no option but to help Brother Monkey cheat.
Brother Monkey didn’t act coy and accepted the Battle Armor.
Pu!
Seeing the Battle Armor made of stone, Lu Xun and the others all looked disdainful.
’Just how poor are you people?’
Although a large number of planets had fallen, causing precious materials to be difficult to obtain, it wasn’t to the extent that they would use rocks to forge Battle Armors, right?
This was definitely rock, and every Imperial Son could guarantee this with their heads.
"Pu!"
"Hahaha!"
On the side of the Lands of Death, the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters all laughed loudly, unable to control themselves no matter what.
This was too hilarious. Just how poor were you people, to take out this kind of Battle Armor?
Was that Two Star Saint a joker?
"I wish Brother Monkey victory!" The large black dog immediately applauded.
The little azure dragon replied, "Brother Monkey, beat that guy up!"
"Humph, humph." The perverted pig snorted in response. For some reason, it was born displeased with Brother Monkey. It kept feeling as if it had been bullied by this monkey in its last life.
The little red bird placed a hand on her forehead. These unreliable guys. She was clearly so beautiful and dignified, so why had she gotten together with them?
Brother Monkey put on the Battle Armor, then waved the staff and placed it on his shoulder. Then, he cocked his head and said, "Don’t say that Old Sun is bullying you. I won’t use the staff!"
His strongest technique was released through using the staff. Now that he would not use the staff, it was equivalent to severing his own arms.
Lu Xun couldn’t help but laugh in anger. Where did you get such courage from?
’Do you really think that you’re invincible just because you’re wearing a stone armor?’
How naive was this?

"Humph, then let this Imperial Son wake you up from your dreams!" Lu Xun waved his hands, and instantly, endless flaming arrows flew out, shooting towards Brother Monkey. Every feather arrow was wrapped with eight stars Regulations, and their destructive power was incredibly terrifying.
Brother Monkey was unafraid, and directly faced the arrows head-on, charging towards Lu Xun.
"How preposterous!" Lu Xun sneered. In his eyes, this was completely suicide.
However, the following scene caused his eyes to pop out of his head.
Brother Monkey advanced fiercely all the way. Whatever feather arrow shot over, it was immediately sent flying.
What!
Not only him, but Yang Yihuan and the others were also the same. They all stuck out their tongues, their mouths big enough to fit a few eggs.
This, this, this, this!
Heavens, could it be that what they saw was an illusion?
At this time, Brother Monkey had already charged over. With Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, how fast was his speed?
He threw a punch at Lu Xun.
Though Lu Xun paled in shock, as the son of a Great Emperor, just how astonishing was his battle instincts?
Boom, he also replied with a punch of his own.

He was still very domineering. Whether it was in terms of cultivation level or natural talent in cultivation, he was completely superior to Brother Monkey. Thus, in this attack, Brother Monkey was only asking for trouble.

The two fists crashed into one another, instantly causing a stormy wave. The might of Saint Tier was too frightening. Light exploded, and Regulations surged into the skies, greatly affecting visibility.
Then, a figure fell out of the brilliance.
It was... Lu Xun!
Yang Yihuan and the others were all astounded. How was this possible?

Though Lu Xun was not the strongest elite among them, as a Five Star Saint, he would have fifteen stars of battle prowess under normal conditions, and if he used any more ultimate moves, his battle prowess could completely charge up to eighteen stars.

On the other hand, Brother Monkey was only a Four-Star Saint, and his conventional battle prowess was only eight stars. Even if the line of the Battle Saint Emperor could release a super-strong battle prowess, it shouldn’t be exaggerated to this extent, right?
How could it be!
They turned to look at the Battle Armor on Brother Monkey. Was it because of this?
B-but that really was made of stone, though it was exuding a bronze-coloured light.
<annotations style="display: none;">’Tu’ means slaughtering in Chinese.</annotations>

chapters.title: Chapter 4721: Terrifying physique
paragraphs: Ling Han laughed loudly, "Do you guys really want to complain? It’s fine. If you want to complain, go ahead."
Yang Yihuan and the others really wanted to complain, but they were even more stunned now. If it really was this Battle Armor that was taking effect, then this was too amazing, wasn’t it?
How could there be such an amazing Battle Armor in this world?
Brother Monkey didn’t care. With a sharp shout, he chased after Lu Xun.

Although the Bronze Battle Armor couldn’t compare to the Silver Battle Armor, it was similarly made from the compressed rocks of the Primitive Abyss. One grain of sand was comparable to a star, so how hard would this Battle Armor be?
What kind of attack could penetrate it?
Of course, if that was all, the shockwave would still be able to injure Brother Monkey. However, there was also Genesis Substance in the Battle Armor, and this was what truly had a decisive effect.
With the boost from this Battle Armor, Brother Monkey’s defense was invincible, and his battle prowess was greatly boosted again. It was truly terrifying.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
It was only Brother Monkey that was attacking madly. Lu Xun did not have the ability to fight back at all — even if he did, it was useless. He could not break through the Battle Armor at all.
This stunned Yang Yihuan and the others. What kind of Battle Armor was this? That was too terrifying, wasn’t it?
Who would have thought that the Four Origin Planet would actually possess such a treasure?
Hiss, even if the Skeleton Saint Tool attacked, could it break through the defenses?
These Imperial Sons were all doubtful, and did not have the slightest bit of confidence.

The large black dog and little azure dragon felt that it was a pity. There was only one such Battle Armor—the other was in the hands of Buddha Doga. Otherwise, they would also be able to show off now.
If a dog (dragon) didn’t show off in life, what difference did it have with a salted fish?

"Tsk, those trash over there, does anyone dare to battle Grandpa Dog’s lackey?" The large black dog could only find another way to show off. He placed his arm around Ling Han’s shoulder, "If anyone can take ten moves from Grandpa Dog’s lackey, Grandpa Dog will take him as my grandson."
These words!
Yang Yihuan and the others were all furious. This dog’s mouth was really too despicable.
How strange. Being able to become a Saint, how could he not have any bit of culture?
Is it because you are the most despicable character and so became a Saint?
"I’m going to kill this mutt. We’ll all have a dog meat feast later!" Tong Ming walked over in a dignified manner.
"All right," the Imperial Sons all replied with a smile. The flesh and blood of Saint-level Demonic Beasts were extremely nutritious, and would also be of some help to them.
"F***, they want to eat Grandpa Dog’s meat? Little Han, er, Ah Tu, beat them to death for Grandpa Dog!" The large black dog flew into a thunderous rage, and swatted out a paw at Ling Han.
"You won’t do it yourself?" Ling Han turned around and asked. Furthermore, what exactly should my name be?

"Shouldn’t lackeys be working for their Big Brother at this time?" The large black dog naturally wouldn’t participate in the battle. Firstly, his cultivation level was lower, and secondly, the opponent was an ancient Imperial Son, whose natural talent in martial arts overwhelmed him.
Thus, it was naturally best to munch on sunflower seeds, clap and watch the show.
Ling Han shook his head, then looked towards Tong Ming, "You are too weak. Go and call a few more people over."
"Haha, how boastful of you!" Tong Ming sneered. "Do you think you’re Ling Han?"
Now, Ling Han had already stabilized his position as the strongest Saint in all eternity. Even the ancient Imperial Sons had to admit that this guy was more freakishly awesome.
Er, should he be happy or displeased now?
Would this become a joke in the future?
Ling Han pinched his nose and said, "Fine, you go ahead then."
"You’re all brimming with confidence!" Tong Ming said as he launched an attack at Ling Han.
Pa!
Ling Han casually delivered a palm strike, and Tong Ming instantly collapsed, his body floating in the pitch-black space.
’F*ck!’
In this instant, all the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters wanted to curse madly. That was Tong Ming, and he had actually been knocked unconscious with a single palm strike?
Who could believe this?
"You, you are Ling Han!" All the Imperial Sons exclaimed in trembling voices.
Aside from Ling Han, no one else could be so freakish.
Ling Han sighed. At first, he had wanted to pretend to be a pig to eat a tiger, and pretend for a while longer, but now? His identity was immediately exposed.
It seemed that no matter how he changed his appearance and identity, his persona would soon collapse.
What was off?

—If those Imperial Sons of the Lands of Death knew what he was thinking, they would definitely complain madly, ’Your battle prowess! Aside from you, who else would possess this kind of battle prowess? Don’t you have the slightest idea?’
Ling Han shook his head resolutely, "I am not Ling Han. You have mistaken me for someone else!"
His alias couldn’t collapse so quickly!
All the Imperial Sons were speechless. The proof was so obvious, and you actually still want to deny it?

"Ling Han, you have finally returned!" Li Dangping said calmly. Though Ling Han was indeed very strong, he was still a Two Star Saint, after all. He seemed to be stuck on this threshold, and had not improved in the slightest.
Thus, if they, the great Imperial Sons, joined forces, it would not be difficult for them to match Ling Han.
"Where did you get this Battle Armor from?"
In comparison, he was even more curious about this.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, "If you defeat me, I’ll tell you."
The Imperial Sons all exchanged a glance before stepping forward.

In a one-on-one battle, any one of them had to admit that they were definitely no match for Ling Han. Thus, the dignified ancient Imperial Sons actually had to join forces to face the enemy, yet this was a move that they had no choice but to make.
Ling Han stood, arms crossed behind his back. In theory, he was a Two Star Saint, but in truth, he had grasped 38 Regulations, which was who knew how much more than a Nine-Star Saint.

Thus, even against the Skeleton Saint Tool, he could still put up a fight. Moreover, this was under the condition that he didn’t use the light of the great dao, the Seed of the Holy Flame, or the Destructive Energy.
As for the Imperial Sons? Heh, they could only be a snack for him.

"How arrogant!" The Imperial Sons of the Lands of Death all gritted their teeth, their expressions filled with displeasure. Only Feng Miaoling showed an expression of admiration. This was the man that she had her eye on. He was so dominating.
Unfortunately, they were on opposite sites, so what could she do to get Ling Han over to her side?
It was unknown who was the first to move, but the Imperial Sons of the Lands of Death all charged over. They all drew their Saint Tools, and attacked Ling Han madly.
They were completely outmatched in a one-on-one battle, so they could only place their hopes on overwhelming Ling Han with numbers.

There were over a dozen Imperial Sons here, and even the weakest among them was a Five-Star Saint. Add to that the Saint Tool, and there was no way that they would not be able to stand against that greatest freak of all eternity.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
A dozen over attacks landed on Ling Han almost at the same time, but Ling Han still had his hands behind his back. He had absolutely no intention of fighting back or even actually parrying.
This!
All the Imperial Sons smirked coldly. This was too arrogant, to actually dare to take their attacks head-on.

It should be known that if they unleashed their full power, even the weakest of them would have battle prowess of eighteen stars, and the strongest of them had even surpassed twenty stars. With so many attacks attacking him at the same time, even if he did not die, he would be crippled, what more when he was facing these attacks head-on?
’Die!’
Soon, the brilliance dispersed, and Ling Han was seen standing proudly, as straight as a spear. Aside from the fact that his clothes were slightly torn, what injury did he have in the slightest?
This!
What kind of physique do you have, freak!
"This bullsh*t, Grandpa Dog will give you nine points. I’m afraid that you’ll be too proud if I give you an extra point," the large black dog said from the sidelines.
"Grandpa Dragon gives you 10 points. I’m not afraid that you will become arrogant from it," the little azure dragon giggled.
Meanwhile, the Imperial Sons were all dumbfounded with shock, completely rendered speechless.
This was f*cking hopeless.

It’s fine.
If you want to complain, go ahead."
Yang Yihuan and the others really wanted to complain, but they were even more stunned now.
If it really was this Battle Armor that was taking effect, then this was too amazing, wasn’t it?
How could there be such an amazing Battle Armor in this world?
Brother Monkey didn’t care.
With a sharp shout, he chased after Lu Xun.
Although the Bronze Battle Armor couldn’t compare to the Silver Battle Armor, it was similarly made from the compressed rocks of the Primitive Abyss.
One grain of sand was comparable to a star, so how hard would this Battle Armor be?
What kind of attack could penetrate it?
Of course, if that was all, the shockwave would still be able to injure Brother Monkey.
However, there was also Genesis Substance in the Battle Armor, and this was what truly had a decisive effect.
With the boost from this Battle Armor, Brother Monkey’s defense was invincible, and his battle prowess was greatly boosted again.
It was truly terrifying.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
It was only Brother Monkey that was attacking madly.
Lu Xun did not have the ability to fight back at all — even if he did, it was useless.
He could not break through the Battle Armor at all.
This stunned Yang Yihuan and the others.
What kind of Battle Armor was this?
That was too terrifying, wasn’t it?
Who would have thought that the Four Origin Planet would actually possess such a treasure?
Hiss, even if the Skeleton Saint Tool attacked, could it break through the defenses?
These Imperial Sons were all doubtful, and did not have the slightest bit of confidence.
The large black dog and little azure dragon felt that it was a pity.
There was only one such Battle Armor—the other was in the hands of Buddha Doga.
Otherwise, they would also be able to show off now.
If a dog (dragon) didn’t show off in life, what difference did it have with a salted fish?
"Tsk, those trash over there, does anyone dare to battle Grandpa Dog’s lackey?" The large black dog could only find another way to show off.
He placed his arm around Ling Han’s shoulder, "If anyone can take ten moves from Grandpa Dog’s lackey, Grandpa Dog will take him as my grandson."
These words!
Yang Yihuan and the others were all furious.
This dog’s mouth was really too despicable.
How strange.
Being able to become a Saint, how could he not have any bit of culture?
Is it because you are the most despicable character and so became a Saint?
"I’m going to kill this mutt.
We’ll all have a dog meat feast later!" Tong Ming walked over in a dignified manner.
"All right," the Imperial Sons all replied with a smile.
The flesh and blood of Saint-level Demonic Beasts were extremely nutritious, and would also be of some help to them.
"F***, they want to eat Grandpa Dog’s meat?
Little Han, er, Ah Tu, beat them to death for Grandpa Dog!" The large black dog flew into a thunderous rage, and swatted out a paw at Ling Han.
"You won’t do it yourself?" Ling Han turned around and asked.
Furthermore, what exactly should my name be?
"Shouldn’t lackeys be working for their Big Brother at this time?" The large black dog naturally wouldn’t participate in the battle.
Firstly, his cultivation level was lower, and secondly, the opponent was an ancient Imperial Son, whose natural talent in martial arts overwhelmed him.
Thus, it was naturally best to munch on sunflower seeds, clap and watch the show.
Ling Han shook his head, then looked towards Tong Ming, "You are too weak.
Go and call a few more people over."
"Haha, how boastful of you!" Tong Ming sneered.
"Do you think you’re Ling Han?"
Now, Ling Han had already stabilized his position as the strongest Saint in all eternity.
Even the ancient Imperial Sons had to admit that this guy was more freakishly awesome.
Er, should he be happy or displeased now?
Would this become a joke in the future?
Ling Han pinched his nose and said, "Fine, you go ahead then."
"You’re all brimming with confidence!" Tong Ming said as he launched an attack at Ling Han.
Pa!
Ling Han casually delivered a palm strike, and Tong Ming instantly collapsed, his body floating in the pitch-black space.
’F*ck!’
In this instant, all the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters wanted to curse madly.
That was Tong Ming, and he had actually been knocked unconscious with a single palm strike?
Who could believe this?
"You, you are Ling Han!" All the Imperial Sons exclaimed in trembling voices.
Aside from Ling Han, no one else could be so freakish.
Ling Han sighed.
At first, he had wanted to pretend to be a pig to eat a tiger, and pretend for a while longer, but now?
His identity was immediately exposed.
It seemed that no matter how he changed his appearance and identity, his persona would soon collapse.
What was off?
—If those Imperial Sons of the Lands of Death knew what he was thinking, they would definitely complain madly, ’Your battle prowess!
Aside from you, who else would possess this kind of battle prowess?
Don’t you have the slightest idea?’
Ling Han shook his head resolutely, "I am not Ling Han.
You have mistaken me for someone else!"
His alias couldn’t collapse so quickly!
All the Imperial Sons were speechless.
The proof was so obvious, and you actually still want to deny it?
"Ling Han, you have finally returned!" Li Dangping said calmly.
Though Ling Han was indeed very strong, he was still a Two Star Saint, after all.
He seemed to be stuck on this threshold, and had not improved in the slightest.
Thus, if they, the great Imperial Sons, joined forces, it would not be difficult for them to match Ling Han.
"Where did you get this Battle Armor from?"
In comparison, he was even more curious about this.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, "If you defeat me, I’ll tell you."
The Imperial Sons all exchanged a glance before stepping forward.
In a one-on-one battle, any one of them had to admit that they were definitely no match for Ling Han.
Thus, the dignified ancient Imperial Sons actually had to join forces to face the enemy, yet this was a move that they had no choice but to make.

Thus, even against the Skeleton Saint Tool, he could still put up a fight.
Moreover, this was under the condition that he didn’t use the light of the great dao, the Seed of the Holy Flame, or the Destructive Energy.
As for the Imperial Sons?
Heh, they could only be a snack for him.

Only Feng Miaoling showed an expression of admiration.
This was the man that she had her eye on.
He was so dominating.

Hong!

He had absolutely no intention of fighting back or even actually parrying.
This!

chapters.title: Chapter 4722: Ling Han’s Might
paragraphs: With so many Imperial Sons, no matter how weak they were, they still possessed eighteen stars of battle prowess. With their combined attacks, they were actually unable to cause even a slight injury to Ling Han.
F***, what was the point of continuing the battle?
Are you a Skeleton Saint Tool, built from Saintly Material?
Meanwhile, Ling Han looked down and said, "You guys damaged my clothes, so you have to pay compensation."
Compensate your sister!
The Imperial Sons exchanged looks before turning around to flee.
They were no match for him. This guy was too freakish.
Ling Han sighed, stretched out a hand and pressed down, "What I hate the most is when someone owes me something and doesn’t pay me back."
Weng, a terrifying pressure descended, and those dozen over Imperial Sons were actually forcibly trapped.
This was too terrifying.
It should be known that Saints were hard to kill. If he wanted to flee, even if their opponent activated the Imperial Weapon, it would still be very difficult to hit him.
And among these ancient Imperial Sons, which one of them was not one of the strongest Saints of their era?
They fled at the first instant, and were actually still trapped by Ling Han?
’Holy f*ck! Are you really a Saint?’
On the other side, Lu Xun’s face had already turned green from watching. How could he dare to continue fighting? He hurriedly turned around and fled.
Though he was battling fiercely with Brother Monkey, because he was too far away from Ling Han, it was easier for him to escape.
After all, if the Saint wanted to flee, it would be extremely difficult to catch up to him.
He tore a rip into the Void and left, not daring to even turn around.
Ling Han did not take it to heart either. He merely looked smilingly at those Imperial Sons, and asked, "Now, are you guys going to pay or not?"
"We will!" these Imperial Sons said in unison. In comparison, it was naturally their lives that were more important.
"All right, give me a Saint-level Great Herb each," Ling Han said.
’F*ck! Why don’t you go commit robbery instead?’
’We’ve only damaged your clothes, yet you’re actually demanding a Saint-level Great Herb as compensation? And it has to one from each person at that?’
Ling Han smiled again, "So what if I am committing robbery? Do you have the right to resist?"
All the Imperial Sons were instantly rendered speechless. This gap in strength was really too wide.
Though Ling Han was still a Saint, in terms of battle prowess, he was probably a Pseudo-Emperor — even if he was inferior, the gap was not too big.
And this was still a Two Star Saint?
Who was he trying to fool?
Ling Han smiled, "My patience is limited. If you guys don’t hand over the Saint-level Great Herb within a count of ten, I can only blast you guys into dust."

"Even if we promise you, we can’t possibly hand it over in such a short period of time," Tong Ming hurriedly said. Wise men don’t fight when the odds are against them. They were the sons of Great Emperors, and had boundless future prospects. Dying for the sake of a Saint-level Great Herb was really not worth it.
But the problem was, how could they possibly bring such a Great Herb with them?
"It’s fine. I’ll allow you to contact someone. As long as you hand over what I want, I’ll let you live," Ling Han said.
The Imperial Sons were exasperated, and could only start to contact.
The Chang Clan’s Galaxy Network was now serving them.
In a short while, the Void cracked open, and groups of tall warriors walked out, exuding a cold aura.
The Skeleton Saint Tools!
Lu Xun had also appeared. It was he who had called for reinforcements.
This time, he was no longer panicking. Instead, he was filled with confidence.
Ling Han was indeed strong. 200 years ago, he could even match three or four Skeleton Saint Tools, but that was about it.
And now, he had mobilized 50 Skeleton Saint Tools. Just how terrifying was this crushing power?
"Ling Han, hand them over, and I can spare your life," Lu Xun said calmly. This was a calmness that came from having everything under control.
Ling Han looked at the large black dog, and said, "Am I the type to swallow my grievances after suffering a loss?"
"Of course not," the large black dog replied with a smile.
"Then what should be done to those who threaten me?" Ling Han asked again.
"Of course, we have to fight. We have to defeat all of them," the large black dog continued.
Ling Han nodded, and said to Lu Xun, "You heard it, right?"
Even at this point, you still dare to show off?

"Don’t think that I will spare you for fear of harming the hostages!" Lu Xun said balefully, "The priority of killing you has been raised to the highest level, and according to the original words, ’eliminate at all costs’!"
Heh, those Great Emperors in the Lands of Death really had a high opinion of him.
It was no wonder. Previously, two ancient Great Emperors had moved, though there was a boundless distance separating them, and had even caused Old Man Ge to die as a result.
Thinking of this, Ling Han’s eyes involuntarily became cold, and killing intent rose up in him.
"Old Black, kill the hostages for me!" he said.
"Yi, you don’t want the Great Herbs anymore?" The large black dog felt a little heartache.
"I don’t want it anymore!" Ling Han said decisively.
"All right!" The large black dog nodded, and was just about to make a move.
"Stop!" Lu Xun roared. "Go! Go!"
Boom, the 50 Skeleton Saint Tools immediately flew out, blasting towards Ling Han, the large black dog and the others.
Ling Han humphed and stepped forward.
He threw a punch with all his might.

The Skeleton Saint Tools didn’t possess any intelligence, and they only knew how to battle. Moreover, they were incredibly powerful to begin with, so they weren’t afraid of any attack. Thus, how could they dodge a head-on attack?
Of course, it was a battle of strength against strength.
Peng!
The two fists instantly crashed into each other. A frightening power surged, and Regulations flashed madly.
When the light dissipated, everyone shockingly discovered that not only had Ling Han not been sent flying, he was instead standing proudly where he had been.
On the other hand, the Skeleton Saint Tool hadn’t retreated either. However, its right arm had been obliterated all the way to its shoulder!
Heavens!
This was only a single strike.
Just how powerful was Ling Han’s might?
Neither side retreated, which meant that Ling Han and the Skeleton Saint Tool were already on the same level in terms of power, but their destructive power... was on two completely different levels.
This was only natural. Ling Han had used the light of the great dao and the Destructive Energy. The only thing he hadn’t used was the holy flame. Just how powerful was this destructive power?
Capable of destroying the heavens and earth!

However, the Skeleton Saint Tool was also extremely domineering. Though only one side of its body was left, its battle instincts did not decrease in the slightest. It sent out another palm strike, blasting towards Ling Han.
Peng!
Ling Han brandished his fists to parry this attack. In just a short while, this Skeleton Saint Tool had lost another half of its body, leaving behind only its head, broken upper body, and two legs.

However, this wasn’t a living being at all. It didn’t feel any pain, nor did it have any fear of death. It raised a foot and ruthlessly stomped down on Ling Han. Endless saintly might diffused into the surroundings.
"Humph!" Ling Han threw another punch. Peng! The Skeleton Saint Tool completely fell apart.
Hiss!
Seeing this scene, everyone was speechless, their scalps numb.
It was as if they had seen a ghost.
Just how terrifying was the Skeleton Saint Tool?
Even the Imperial Weapon could only force it to retreat, and was unable to shatter it. Now, however, it had been forcefully destroyed by Ling Han.
Didn’t this mean that Ling Han’s battle prowess had actually surpassed the Imperial Weapon?
No, everyone shook their heads again. Ling Han was indeed extraordinary, but he was not as terrifying as this.

In terms of battle prowess, Ling Han was actually more or less the same as the Skeleton Saint Tool. However, this guy had mastered some kind of energy, and its destructive power was too terrifying. It could easily destroy the Saintly Material.
This was natural. At that time, with a punch from Ling Han, a hole had been created in the ground of the Primitive Abyss. What kind of concept was that?
