chapters.title: Chapter 4723: Blasted apart
paragraphs: To say nothing of the Imperial Sons, even the empress and the others were astounded.

They already knew how awesome Ling Han was. After returning from the Primitive Abyss, Ling Han’s abilities had definitely soared. However, he had destroyed a Skeleton Saint Tool with just a few punches?
This still far exceeded their understanding.
They had to be seeing things. How could he possibly be so strong?
Meanwhile, Lu Xun was about to go crazy.
He couldn’t believe his eyes at all. How could a measly Two Star Saint Saint be this powerful?
It should be known that when so many Imperial Clans had attacked it with their Imperial Weapons, the Skeleton Saint Tool had still remained unmoved.
Why?
This was because the Skeleton Saint Tool had used a very unique technique. It could distribute the attacks that it received onto every part of its body.
Thus, with how powerful the Saint Tool was, how could several hundred Saint Tools not be able to share the blow delivered by the equivalent of a Great Emperor?
However, Ling Han destroyed the Skeleton Saint Tool with a single punch.
This guy’s strength was actually stronger than the Imperial Weapon?
No, no, no, that was definitely impossible.
How could a mere Two Star Saint surpass the Imperial Weapon in terms of battle prowess?

If it had been the attack of an Imperial Weapon, the Skeleton Saint Tool would have been sent flying far, far away, and it would not have been like now. With a single punch from Ling Han, the Skeleton Saint Tool did not retreat even half a step.
It could only be said that Ling Han had mastered some kind of secret technique, which endlessly increased his destructive power.
Hiss, was this the reason why this person had disappeared for more than two hundred years?
At this moment, Lu Xun also wished that he had disappeared for 200 years, and had similarly experienced this kind of fortuitous encounter.
Boom!
However, the Skeleton Saint Tools didn’t show any signs of fear. The remaining continued to charge toward Ling Han.
This was their strength, but at the same time, it was also their weakness.
Lu Xun thought for a moment, but did not stop them.
Ling Han’s attacks were powerful, yet this didn’t mean that his defenses were also strong. Perhaps he would be blasted into smithereens by the combined attacks of 10 or 20 Skeleton Saint Tools?
He would only have paid the price of a few Skeleton Saint Tools to kill this greatest freak of all eternity, so it was naturally worth it.

Ling Han released a battle cry, and charged towards the Skeleton Saint Tools. Peng, peng, peng! He brandished his fists repeatedly, and the Destructive Energy fused with the light of the great dao, turning into an incredibly terrifying destructive power.

Peng, peng, peng. He was using the method of trading injury for injury, while he himself was charging around madly, only pursuing the efficiency of slaughter. This naturally caused his defenses to become too horrible to look at, and he was continuously struck by the attacks of the Skeleton Saint Tools.
What kind of concept was this?
Each Skeleton Saint Tool was equivalent to a combination of several hundred Saint Tools. Just how terrifying was it to have so many Saint Tools attacking at the same time?
However, when these attacks landed on Ling Han, they did not even cause the slightest ripple.
It was as if... he was a piece of Origin Gold.
Lu Xun wanted to grab his head and exclaim in shock. How could there be such a freak?
Generally speaking, if one’s attack power was strong, their defense would definitely be weaker. They were human, after all. They would definitely have their strengths and weaknesses.
However, this kind of logic was completely ineffective in front of Ling Han. Both his offensive and defensive abilities were inconceivably strong. What could they do?
"Retreat! Retreat!" Lu Xun hurriedly sent out a signal for the Skeleton Saint Tools to retreat. Otherwise, this would completely be delivering itself up to die.
Could it be that only the Great Emperors would be able to deal with this guy now?
Damn it, the Lords of Death couldn’t make a move so easily. The time wasn’t right yet. Otherwise, to be targeted by a Great Emperor, he would definitely die.
Could it be that they really could only watch helplessly as this guy rose up and became the greatest threat?

Xiu, xiu, xiu! 41 Skeleton Saint Tools flew back, and as for the remaining eight... Ling Han had detained them. With a single punch, they had lost half their bodies, and it was impossible for them to return.
What could they do? What could they do?
Lu Xun felt a chill all over his body. A dozen over Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters had fallen into Ling Han’s hands, and this guy was really going to kill them.

Though the Lords of Death had already prioritized killing Ling Han, those were the sons and daughters of the Great Emperors. If they really died, it was hard to guarantee that the Great Emperors would not go berserk.

Right now, the Living Realm’s transformation into the Netherworld had already reached a critical stage. If something went wrong at this moment... it was possible that millions upon millions of years of preparation would be ruined.
"Ling Han, we can talk things over peacefully!" he hurriedly said.
Ling Han smiled calmly, "You want the lives of these Imperial Sons? Fine, then have those Lords of Death commit suicide, and I will let them go!"
Lu Xun was furious. Wasn’t this making things difficult for him?
To have the Lords of Death commit suicide?
How was this possible!
"Change your request!" he called out loudly.
Ling Han stared fixedly at Lu Xun, "What right do you have to negotiate with me?"
Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was unleashed, and he charged at Lu Xun. In a flash, he had already arrived less than 300 meters away from him.
"Block him!" Lu Xun exclaimed in shock.
The Skeleton Saint Tools all charged toward Ling Han.
"Trash!" Ling Han roared as he unleashed a barrage of attacks. The Skeleton Saint Tools that blocked his path all started to lose limbs. They could only use their bodies to slow him down.
Ling Han penetrated deeply, as if he had entered into an uninhabited land.
It was not that the Skeleton Saint Tools couldn’t withstand a single blow from Ling Han, but they could only slow him down slightly.
In terms of destructive power alone, even a Pseudo-Emperor couldn’t compare to Ling Han.
Lu Xun was so scared that cold sweat was dripping down his forehead. He hurriedly tore a rip into space, wanting to escape from this place.
Weng, right at this moment, a terrifying aura surged over, and a sea of blood suddenly appeared in space.
One of the Twelve Lands of Death!
Hiss, a Lord of Death had arrived.

Ling Han immediately looked solemn. No matter how awesome he was, he could not compare to the Great Emperor. Previously, in the Primitive Abyss, the True Dragon Great Emperor tier had overwhelmed him and Buddha Doga completely.
—According to Buddha Doga, there was still a very big problem with this kind of Great Emperor. His battle prowess was not complete.
"Let them go!" A cold voice rang out, completely emotionless.
This was actually a female Great Emperor!
The ruler of the sea of blood was actually an empress?

In history, there were pitifully few female Ancestral Kings. However, those that could become Great Emperor were even stronger than other Great Emperors, because if the female cultivators wanted to stand out, the price they had to pay would definitely be greater.
Ling Han smiled calmly, "What if I say no?"
Hiss, how dare he!
Seeing this scene, everyone felt rueful. Ling Han had already grown to the point of being able to contend with the Great Emperor?
However, the empress and the others immediately received a message through divine sense from Ling Han, telling them to flee as soon as possible.
F***, this was a Great Emperor, who could easily teach them a lesson.
Everyone tore a rip into the Void and left, and Ling Han did not make a move to kill Di Wuji and the others. His meaning was very clear. It was equivalent to exchanging hostages.
Of course, Ling Han could also use the Clear Bamboo Sword to take a gamble, and see if he could not only escort the empress and the others away, but also kill Di Wuji and the others.
However, those people were all the people he cared about the most, after all. Ling Han wanted stability even more.
Most importantly, he did not take Di Wuji and the others to heart at all.
So what if they were still alive? Could they pose a threat to him?
Right now, only the Great Emperor was worthy of his notice.

How could he possibly be so strong?
Meanwhile, Lu Xun was about to go crazy.

How could a measly Two Star Saint Saint be this powerful?

chapters.title: Chapter 4724: Greatest Crisis?
paragraphs: There were no ripples in the sea of blood, as if it had tacitly approved of Ling Han’s actions.
The Great Emperor would actually compromise?
There was nothing that could be done. The Lords of Death couldn’t make a move easily. Otherwise, with the pride of the Great Emperor, who would they negotiate with?
After everyone had left, Ling Han also released those Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters of the Lands of Death.
Di Wuji and the others all wore dark expressions, their expressions incredibly ugly.
This was a great humiliation!
Which of them was not the son and daughter of a Great Emperor? Who could match them in the same cultivation level?
But now? They had been forcefully conquered by someone whose cultivation level was weaker than theirs, and they were a group of ancient prodigies at that.
How humiliating. With such a defeat, what right did they have to contest for the throne?
At this moment, the sea of blood slowly moved, turning into a human face. However, blood-red seawater dripped endlessly, making this human face appear extremely terrifying.
"If you want, you can become the 13th Lord of Death." The face spoke, and said something that was enough to shake the universe.
The thirteenth Lord of Death!
Wouldn’t that mean that he would be on an equal footing with the Great Emperors?
Lu Xun, Di Wuji and the others were all shocked. They had not thought that the ruler of the sea of blood would actually have such a high opinion of Ling Han.
Ling Han didn’t hesitate at all. He shook his head, and said, "I can’t watch as people die!"
Hiss, this guy actually refused such an invitation!
Even though Di Wuji and the others were furious at Ling Han for not appreciating the show of goodwill, they couldn’t help but admire Ling Han’s courage.
Throughout history, who would dare refuse a Great Emperor directly?
Yet the ruler of the Blood Sea was not angered. Instead, she stated calmly, "You know nothing about this world!"
"Hehe." Ling Han chuckled. When he had been in Genesis World, Extermination had also looked very awesome. In the end, hadn’t it still been beaten up?
"Even if we don’t make a move, this world will ultimately be destroyed, so it would be better to help us," the ruler of the Blood Sea said.
’What do you mean?’
Even without the chaos caused by the Twelve Lands of Death, would the universe still be destroyed?
Ling Han believed her. With the temperament of the Great Emperor, there was no need to trick him. Thus, these words were believable.
However, would the world ultimately walk towards destruction?
Could it be related to the existence of the Primitive Abyss?

It should be known that there were 36 primitive Divine Beasts there, and all of them were Great Emperor-level Divine Beasts. Once they appeared and caused harm, they were even more terrifying than the Twelve Lands of Death.

However, since the birth of heaven and earth, it had already been an era when all the Divine Beasts had gathered together. If it was said that they would destroy the heaven and earth, what need was there for them to drag it out until now?
Moreover, Buddha Doga had also said that the True Dragon Emperor’s strength was clearly inferior to his understanding of Great Emperors.
The little azure dragon concluded that the first generation True Dragon had definitely died.
Thus, at this moment, Ling Han’s mind was in a mess.
Heh, since he couldn’t figure it out, why didn’t he just ask directly?
"Why do you say that?" Ling Han said to the face in the sea of blood. Even though this face was terrifying, upon closer look, it had an indescribably exquisite beauty.
The blood-colored face opened its mouth, and said, "You should know how this world came to be."
"Yes." Ling Han nodded.

In the past, there was no such thing as heaven and earth. There was only a single dot, or rather a sphere. Then, a crack appeared on the sphere, and endless matter gushed out. It was also expanding endlessly, forming the current universe.
This crack was the present Primitive Abyss, and it contained the most fundamental force and secrets of the heaven and earth.
"After the creation of heaven and earth, this universe has continued to expand," the ruler of the Blood Sea continued, "However, this expansion is about to end."
"If it ends, then it ends," Ling Han said. What effect would this have?
With the current size of the universe, it was enough to allow millions and millions of living beings to live.
Even Saints wouldn’t be able to travel from one end of the universe to the other.
Wasn’t it big enough?
"Naive!" the ruler of the Blood Sea stated calmly.
In this world, only a Great Emperor could reprimand Ling Han like this.

Ling Han was not angered. There must be a reason why these Great Emperors lived in such a "sneaky" manner, and did not hesitate to bear such infamy. Now, it was very possible that the ruler of the Blood Sea would reveal the truth for him, so he was willing to listen.
"The end of life is death, and the end of death... is rebirth." The ruler of the Blood Sea said something that seemed completely unrelated.
Yet Ling Han frowned, "What you mean is that after the universe has expanded to its limit, it would shrink next?"
Hiss!
"That’s right." The ruler of the Blood Sea nodded, "It would go back to wherever it came from. What happened in the beginning would also happen in the end."
According to the words of this Empress, the universe would ultimately return to become a point?
Then, millions and millions of living beings would all be exterminated.
It should be known that even in the Primitive Abyss, that terrifying gravity field was enough to make the body of a Saint collapse, not leaving behind even the slightest bit of bone scraps.
Then, what if it was further compressed to a point?
Could a Great Emperor... also withstand it?
At that time, it would be the end of the world.
Thus, the ruler of the sea of blood had said that this world would eventually be destroyed.
If the theory about the universe expanding and shrinking was true, then this day would indeed come.

"Is this the reason why you people are wreaking havoc in the world?" Ling Han raised his voice and said, "From the moment the universe was born until now, it has experienced who knows how many years, and even if there comes a day that it will walk towards death, that would only happen countless years later."
"What right do you have to decide the fate of millions and millions of living beings?"
The ruler of the Blood Sea shook her head, "An ant is an ant, after all. He would only use his own vision to observe."
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head, and he said, "Do you know that in the Primitive Abyss, there are now 36 Divine Beasts that have been revived?"
The ruler of the Blood Sea scoffed, "The Great Emperors have died, and have merged with the heaven and earth, so how could they possibly come back to life!"
In her eyes, Ling Han had just spouted a bunch of bullsh*t.
Yi?
Ling Han was only trying to bluff the ruler of the Blood Sea, wanting to know what relation the Twelve Lands of Death had with the Divine Beasts in the Primitive Abyss, but the result stunned him.
The Twelve Lords of Death actually didn’t know about the True Dragon Emperor and the others?
True, Buddha Doga had also been to the Primitive Abyss, but it was still only when he had gotten the news from Ling Han that he discovered the shocking change in events.
The Primitive Abyss was a forbidden area for Great Emperors. Which Great Emperor would go there for no reason?
Although the Twelve Lands of Death’s leaders obtained secret techniques there and obtained immortality in a strange way, they obviously didn’t go there again in the future.
It could be imagined. Just look at them now, it was not easy for them to make a move at all, which showed just how great a restriction this kind of "immortality" would have.
So, why would they go to the Primitive Abyss?
To die?
Then, the Divine Beasts in the Primitive Abyss had no relation with the Twelve Lands of Death?
Ling Han instantly felt a headache coming on. There were actually two Great Emperor-level forces, and each force had more than ten Great Emperors.
F***, what kind of world was this!

"You can go to the Primitive Abyss and take a look. You’ll naturally know if I’m right or not," Ling Han said calmly. If he could incite these two Great Emperor-level forces to war, that would be great.

chapters.title: Chapter 4725: Returning to the Battle God Palace
paragraphs: The ruler of the Blood Sea humphed, "Looks like you cannot be of any use to us!"
Boom! The sea of blood boiled, and innumerable corpses of Saints instantly rushed out, pouncing towards Ling Han. It was as if a rain of Saints had suddenly fallen, covering heaven and earth.
Was this a fight at the slightest disagreement?
Ling Han was unafraid. As long as the Great Emperor didn’t make a move personally, he wasn’t afraid of anyone.

He casually threw punches and kicks. What Saint corpses? This was completely incomparable to the Skeleton Saint Tool. They were sent flying with a single strike from him, and exploded. They didn’t even have the chance to return.
As the saying went, an abundance of ants could bite an elephant to death, but if this elephant was made from the Origin Gold, then no matter how many ants bit it, what was the use?
His figure was instantly engulfed by the sea of Saint corpses. However, numerous figures were sent flying and blasted into bits. They were completely unable to suppress him.
Ling Han’s strength had already reached a level that numbers could not be depended on to kill him.
The ruler of the Blood Sea didn’t issue any command, and the corpses of the Saints suddenly retreated. Then, the blood sea boiled, and a large hand formed, slapping towards Ling Han.
This time was completely different. Imperial might spread out, so terrifying that it could not be described.
Even Ling Han didn’t dare to face this attack head-on. If the Great Emperor attacked, his only option would be to flee.
He was done playing.
He activated the Clear Bamboo Sword, and slashed out at this giant hand.
Peng!

The sword slashed down, and the large hand was immediately severed into two halves. When the Clear Bamboo Sword revived, it was equivalent to the appearance of a Great Emperor, so how terrifying was its attack power?
Right now, Ling Han’s physique was countless times more powerful than before. Thus, he was able to withstand the shockwaves.
Otherwise, so what if he was protected by the Imperial Weapon? Under the shockwaves of three or two strikes, he could still be killed.
However, monstrous bloody hands stretched out one after another from the sea of blood, striking out at Ling Han.
How was he supposed to block this?
Ling Han gritted his teeth. A Great Emperor was indeed a Great Emperor. She was not something that an Imperial Weapon could compare to at all.
The Imperial Weapon could indeed block the attack of the Great Emperor, but it would only be a matter of one or two moves at most. To face it head-on?
Forget it, he’d better wash up and sleep.

Ling Han hurriedly fled. Phoenix Wings Divine Flightwas unleashed, and his speed was astonishingly fast. Furthermore, with the Imperial Weapon bringing up the rear, even the attack of a Great Emperor could be dispersed.
At least while the Clear Bamboo Sword was revived, Ling Han was unafraid of any life-threatening dangers.
Of course, if he turned around and confronted the ruler of the Blood Sea head-on, it would be a different story.
Thankfully, the ruler of the Blood Sea was unable to use her full strength, or rather, was unwilling to use her full strength. Thus, Ling Han still managed to escape from the siege.
He turned around to look. If he had had that kind of strength in the past, Old Man Ge would not have died in battle.
He then tore a rip into space and returned to the Four Origin Planet.
Seeing Ling Han return, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

Afterward, Ling Han didn’t move again. Instead, he focused on pushing Four Origin Planet toward the edge of the universe.

The Lords of Death were already targeting him, and they were even willing to attack to a certain extent. Thus, he had to be careful. If the Lords of Death attacked him together, even he would be in trouble.
When things calmed down, Ling Han was also pondering over the words of the ruler of the sea of blood.
The expansion of the universe was about to end, and then it would enter into a stage of collapse?
In that case, the Lords of Death had chosen this time to appear, so it was definitely this era that could bring them great fortune.
It must be true immortality.
"In the Living Realm, the truth is hard to find, but if I go to the Netherworld, I might be able to gain something."

Lin Luo, Zhou Heng, Chu Hao and the other elites who had come from Genesis World all broke through to Saint Tier, instilling powerful strength into Four Origin Planet.
Now, in terms of Saint-level power alone, even the Imperial Clans couldn’t compare to Four Origin Planet.
Ling Han was very gratified. The more Saints there were, the safer Four Origin Planet would be.
He set out with a light heart, and began to search for the entrance to the Netherworld.

This was out of character for them.
So be it.
The perverted pig naturally wouldn’t participate in such matters. Instead, he wanted to mingle with the beauties and be as lazy as possible.
However, where was the entrance to the Netherworld?

By now, the layout of the Living Realm had already been disturbed. There were too many areas that had been transformed by the Netherworld, and even Saints were unable to sense the situation there. It was as if they were headless chickens.

Previously, it didn’t matter. In any case, they would be fighting wherever they went, and there was no need for them to choose a location at all. However, it was different now. They needed to locate the entrance to the Netherworld.
Thus, the three of them began their search.

The number one despicable Saint of all eternity, he truly lived up to his name.
"Yi?" Ling Han suddenly faltered. He sensed a fluctuation of life force.
Could it be that he had discovered a dangerous place, or could it be that it was an Imperial Clan that had "rebelled" such as the Chang Clan, the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan, and so on?
If he really encountered it, he would take the chance to make some money.
How well coordinated were the three of them? After exchanging a glance, they didn’t even need to say a word. They all retracted their auras, and then followed the fluctuation of the life force.
A planet appeared ahead of them. It was purple-red in colour.
Ling Han suddenly felt a sense of familiarity. It was as if he had been here before.
They passed through the protective barrier around the planet and arrived on the planet.
"Er!" Ling Han recognized it. This was... the Battle God Palace!
By a freak combination of circumstances, he didn’t find the entrance to the Netherworld. Instead, he found the Battle God Palace.

If this were in the past, the planet where the Battle God Palace was located would be surrounded by fog, and even the Imperial Clans would not be able to find it. However, there was no need for that now.
The Battle God Palace had already made it clear that they belonged to one of the Lands of Death.
Hence, after the universe was transformed into the Netherworld, there was completely no need for them to hide any longer.
—Who would dare charge into an area that had been transformed into the Netherworld, and make things difficult for the Battle God Palace?
Moreover, this was still extremely difficult to find.
"This is heaven’s will!" Ling Han said with a smile.
"Little Han, you failed to show off last time, so you must succeed this time!" the large black dog immediately declared.
"That’s right. Showing off is the most important." The little azure dragon also nodded.
Ling Han’s forehead was covered with cold sweat. Why did these two guys place so much importance on showing off?
Apart from showing off, couldn’t one have some aspirations in life?
Forget it. What life did they have? It was either a dog’s life or a dragon’s life.
Just let them be.
The three of them advanced. Then, their appearances all changed. At least, at a glance, it was impossible to distinguish their identities.
Ling Han walked with ease, bringing the little azure dragon and the large black dog to the Blood Tower.
This was the tower of inheritance of the Battle God Palace.

chapters.title: Chapter 4726: Sweeping aside all opposition
paragraphs: Ling Han and his group walked all the way over, avoiding all the sentry posts, and only then did they appear.
On the one hand, it was also because the Battle God Palace didn’t have any intention to keep a tight guard at all. Was it still possible for foreign enemies to appear here?
Thus, their defenses were naturally relaxed.
"Who are you people?" This Blood Tower naturally had an elite keeping watch, and when he discovered Ling Han and the others, he immediately opened his mouth to question them.

"You murderers, I’ve finally found you today!" The large black dog’s expression was filled with fury, as if he was bearing the responsibility to seek revenge for the death of his father. "You killed the family of us brothers. How pitiful. At that time, our father was only a three-year-old toddler, yet he was killed by you!"
When the elite on the other side heard this, he couldn’t help but feel dumbfounded.
When your entire family was destroyed, your father was only three years old? Then how were you three brothers born?
Your father was too powerful, wasn’t he, to have three children at three years old?
There were so many points that he could criticize about this excuse.
"Don’t spout nonsense. Who exactly are you people?" That elite asked. He was a Venerate.

"I’m Hu Da, this is my Second Brother, Hu Er, and this is my Third Brother, Hu San." The large black dog pointed at Ling Han and the little azure dragon respectively, and said, "You guys killed our entire family, and today, we three brothers are going to slaughter all of you."
Seeing the large black dog repeatedly emphasize this point, that elite was also slightly undecided.
These three people... were they really here to take revenge?
After all, the Battle God Palace had killed countless people before, so it wouldn’t be strange no matter how many enemies they had.
However, the fact that they had come meant that the three of them still had some strength.
Xiu, at this moment, someone just happened to come out of the Blood Tower. It was a middle-aged man in his forties. He looked ordinary, and would not attract the slightest attention.
However, he was a Spirit Transformation True Lord.
"Yang Shisi, kill them," the Venerate commanded.
The middle-aged man couldn’t even be bothered to ask about the origins of Ling Han and the others. His figure immediately flashed, and he hid in the shadows.
Strange Shadow Steps.
Shua, he suddenly appeared behind the large black dog, then delivered a swift slash with his sword.
Sword light flashed, fully displaying its viciousness.
The large black dog pretended to be flustered, and began a fierce battle with the middle-aged man, trying his best to maintain a tie.
If a Saint wanted to disguise himself, so how could a Venerate see through him?
Thus, the Venerate Tier elite guarding the Blood Tower sneered. With such measly strength, he actually dared to come to the Battle God Palace for revenge?
Go accompany your father.
However, when he recalled what the large black dog said about a three-year-old father who had died, he began to grit his teeth again. What kind of people were these three?

The large black dog "expended much effort" before finally defeating the middle-aged man. His face was filled with lofty arrogance as he said, "Anyone else? Anyone else? I want to fight ten of you alone!"
Just look at how smug you are.
At this moment, many assassins from the Battle God Palace had already rushed over. After all, this commotion was not small.

That Venerate Tier originally wanted to make a move and take down Ling Han and the others, but it was rare for a Spiritual Transformation Tier "elite" to appear, so he decided not to make a move first, and nurture the actual combat standards of the disciples.
As long as he was here, it was impossible for anyone to die.
Thus, another assassin immediately stepped out. Though they were both Spiritual Transformation Tier, his abilities were slightly superior than the one from before.
"Let me!" the little azure dragon shouted.
"Don’t fight with me!" The large black dog hurriedly blocked the little azure dragon behind him. There were so few chances to show off now, so he naturally couldn’t let go of every opportunity.
"I’ll go!"
"I’ll go!"
The two of them argued endlessly, which enraged the assassin. ’You guys are looking down on me too much, aren’t you?’
He quietly hid in the shadows, wanting to take advantage of the opening to launch a sneak attack.
Shua, that assassin suddenly appeared, and struck out with his sword.
Though this strike was aimed at the large black dog, it was very powerful. It was clearly meant to cut the large black dog in half, and then kill the little azure dragon as well.
"Get lost!"
The little azure dragon and the large black dog shot out punches at the same time, striking the assassin’s face.
Peng! The assassin immediately stumbled back in retreat. He wavered unsteadily, and it was as if he were drunk.
"You people... are so despicable!" He collapsed loudly, his face filled with grief and indignation.
This was no argument. They were clearly using this as bait.
Too despicable, too shameless.
Meanwhile, the large black dog and little azure dragon giggled, revealing their despicable nature.
Ling Han placed his hand on his forehead. If the old True Dragon revived and saw his only son like this, would he regret having him in the past?
However, their "despicableness" also enraged those assassins.
Xiu, xiu, two people appeared at the same time, sinking into the shadows.
Then, they charged out together, but they actually appeared behind Ling Han.
This was really unexpected.
However, what greeted them was Ling Han’s iron fist.
Peng, this was not aimed directly at them at all, but the wind created by the punch was too terrifying. Instantly, the two of them were sent flying, and then passed out on the ground.
The Venerate Tier elite frowned. Something didn’t seem right.
Just now, when Ling Han had made his move, he actually discovered that he actually did not have the chance to interfere.
With a wave of his hand, the two of them collapsed. The entire process was done in one go, so how could he have the chance to interfere?
Hiss, this was a little strange.
"Attack together!" he commanded.
Immediately, all the assassins fled into the shadows. Only when they were right behind Ling Han and the others did they appear and launch a fatal attack.
But in front of Ling Han and the others, what was this worth?

However, the large black dog was still shouting, "So powerful! You almost injured me severely! Aiyo, this strike was so fierce, and almost sliced off my leg! F*ck, which b@stard actually dared to poke my behind?"
This rendered the assassins speechless. Their attacks were still a million miles away from this guy. Was there any need to be display such shock?
How could there be such a despicable person?
’You clearly have boundless energy, yet you still insist on putting on an act. How unbelievable!’
With a slight exert of force from Ling Han and the others, all the assassins fell to the ground.

"You... where have you come from?" The Venerate Tier assassin couldn’t sit still any longer. He appeared from the Blood Tower, and at the same time, he also sent out a signal to gather the other elites.
In fact, even the Killing Saint had been notified.
He kept feeling that these three people were strange.
"Grandpa is here for revenge!" The large black dog charged out, charging towards that Venerate Tier elite.
"Humph!" That Venerate Tier smirked coldly, and delivered a palm strike at the large black dog.
The large black dog bawled loudly, battling fiercely with that Venerate Tier elite.
The more people there were, the stronger his desire to perform. He could not stop at all.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! More Venerates arrived, and when they discovered that the large black dog was actually capable of matching Venerate Tier, they all looked surprised.
Where had these three elites come from?
The large black dog spent a lot of effort before finally defeating his opponent.
It laughed loudly, proud and insufferably arrogant.
"Battle God Palace, I’m going to destroy all of you today!"

"How arrogant!" One of the Venerates of Slaughter couldn’t help but make a move. He was slightly stronger than the Venerate from before, and he was also using a thick saber. As he slashed out, he was filled with dominance.
"If the tiger doesn’t unleash its might, do you think I’m the Four-Legged Snake?" The large black dog increased its attacks, and soon killed that Venerate of Slaughter.
This!
The members of the Battle God Palace all looked stunned. These three people... did not come with good intentions.

Too strong!

"Who else is there?" the large black dog asked arrogantly. Even if he had taken human form, he still exuded a strong air of vulgarity, and anyone who saw him would want to beat him up.

"Humph, to dare come to our Battle God Palace and act so arrogant, how outrageously bold!" Another Venerate Tier moved, charging towards the large black dog. He delivered a palm strike, and xiu, xiu, xiu, boundless black mist rose up.
Seeing this person move, everyone looked relieved.
This was one of their three Vice Palace Leaders.

The Battle God Palace did not have the a Palace Leader. That old Killing Saint merely considered himself a grand elder, and the position of Palace Leader had always been vacant. It was not just for this term, but rather for all the generations.
Thus, those who could become Vice Palace Leaders were naturally extremely awesome.
The large black dog unleashed a kick. Peng! The Vice Palace Leader exploded into a cloud of blood and flesh.
This!
The members of the Battle God Palace were all astounded. He had destroyed an eight-star Venerate Tier elite with a single kick?
Was this something that a Venerate could do?
"A Saint!" they exclaimed in a trembling voice.

Ling Han pursed his lips. These people were really ignorant and ill-informed. It should be known that when he had been at the Fourth Extreme, he had even actually kicked a Saint to burst. But because they were ignorant, they had actually guessed correctly.
The large black dog laughed loudly, "That’s right, I am a Saint!"
There was actually a Saint with this kind of bearing in this world?
The members of the Battle God Palace exchanged looks, all of them filled with disbelief.
This kind of despicable guy could also become a Saint, so why couldn’t they all become Saints?
The large black dog flew into a thunderous rage, "What kind of expression is that? Grandpa Dog will beat you all to burst!"
The old black dog couldn’t tolerate this. Why did they all look like they had seen a pervert?
Was it that kind of dog?
It cried out loudly, and charged out. Instantly, it was a scene of complete chaos.
The little azure dragon laughed at his misfortune. "Don’t you have any idea just how freakish you are?"
"Grandpa Dog is about to die from fury!" The large black dog was invincible as it unleashed its murderous aura.

This caused the members of the Battle God Palace to feel grief and indignation. It was clear that they were the real victims here. You didn’t experience the slightest loss at all, so why do you still look like you are the victim?
They couldn’t be bullied like this.

They wanted to put their lives on the line, but a head-on confrontation was not their forte. Furthermore, the gap in cultivation level was really too wide. If they rushed forwards, they would only be delivering themselves up to die.
Just as the large black dog was killing to his heart’s content, shua, a majestic light suddenly appeared behind him, slashing down rapidly.
This attack was meant to sever the large black dog’s neck.
"Haha, how mischievous!" The large black dog suddenly spun around, and then shot out a palm strike. The light of Regulations surged.
Peng!
In this exchange of blows, that majestic light immediately crumbled. Then, they saw that this was actually a young man, holding a sword in his hand.
There was a stunned expression on his face, as if he found it strange that his attack had not succeeded.
"Young Master!" When they saw this young man, everyone from the Battle God Palace blurted out, appearing to be very excited.
They knew that the old Killing Saint had appointed a Young Palace Leader, and they had also seen that young man before. However, they had never imagined that this young man was actually a Saint!
No wonder the old Killing Saint favored him and promoted him to become the Young Palace Leader.
Previously, they had indeed been unconvinced. However, because of the authority of the old Killing Saint, they had not dared to object, but now, they were completely convinced.
Furthermore, at this kind of critical moment, the Young Palace Leader stepped out bravely, saving them from the critical situation... f***!
They had not even finished this thought, when they saw that this saviour was being suppressed by the large black dog, completely unable to fight back.
This!
Their Young Palace Leader was indeed strong, but not as strong as that freak.

Weng, a frightening killing intent swept out, and an old man slowly walked out, holding two daggers in his hands. One was black and the other was white, exuding a powerful aura, which was incredibly terrifying.

This was the old Killing Saint of the Battle God Palace, and those two daggers were the Saint Tools of the Battle God Palace, passed down from the primitive times. Under the control of a Saint, this could even unleash might above fifteen stars.
Only at this moment did everyone finally heave a sigh of relief.
The old Killing Saint was their stabilizing force. With his help, there was nothing that could not be resolved.

"Who are you guys?" The old Killing Saint’s eyes roamed over Ling Han and the others, but under the effects of the Soul Forming Technique, he couldn’t see anything off. After all, Ling Han and the others were also Saints.
A Saint’s body accommodated Regulations, and assimilated with the heaven and earth. If he did not want you to see through him, you would definitely not be able to.
...Unless he possessed something like an eye technique.
The large black dog stepped on the head of the Young Palace Leader, and said proudly, "My surname is Gou, and my given name is Daren."
Yi, didn’t you previously say your name was Hu Da? That was practically nonsense!
Also, Gou Daren? Lord Dog?
The members of the Battle God Palace all exchanged looks. They had never seen such self-deprecating behavior, comparing himself to a dog.
Hiss, how shameless would a Saint have to be to bear to lose face like this?
The large black dog’s strength wasn’t astounding to them, but his shamelessness filled them with deep veneration.
The old Killing Saint humphed lightly, and said, "Stop playing the fool. Since you’re a Saint, why don’t you conduct yourself with dignity?"
Saints were invincible no matter where they were. Even if they went to the Imperial Clan, they would still be received with high standards.
But this Saint in front of him was really too unreserved... he was practically shameless!
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, "Haven’t you people from the Battle God Palace been hunting me all this while? Now, I’m here!"
En, what did that mean?
Everyone looked at Ling Han. This guy suddenly stole the limelight, but the words that came out of his mouth stunned everyone.
The large black dog laughed loudly, "Is there anyone that is on the list of people to be killed from your Battle God Palace, but your have never managed to kill him?"
"Ling Han!" Instantly, a great many people exclaimed.
"That’s right, this is our Little Han." The large black dog revealed his true appearance. The iron underwear was still his trademark, shining brightly.
Now, it had already traded this for Saintly Material, and its ultimate goal was Origin Gold!
It would be a pair of underpants that had been forged from Origin Gold. There should only be one pair of such underpants in this world, right?
The mighty name of the large black dog would definitely be known throughout the world because of this.
The Great Emperor could die, but the Imperial Weapon would exist forever!

Of course, the idea had already been outvoted by Ling Han and the little azure dragon. With its despicable ways, it didn’t need any Imperial Weapon-level underpants. Right now, it was already despicable enough to move the world.
The large black dog transformed back into its original form, and so did the little azure dragon. Only Ling Han hadn’t transformed back into his original form yet.
He smiled faintly, his appearance gradually changing.
This time, even that old Killing Saint had become cautious.
According to the information obtained, Ling Han was the greatest prodigy of all eternity. Once this kind of prodigy became a Saint, just how terrifying would his abilities be?

—The level of the Battle God Palace was relatively low, so no one, including the old Killing Saint, knew of Ling Han’s recent outstanding battle merits. He had even managed to escape when the Great Emperor made a move.
If they had known, they would probably be trembling in fear and panic by now.

chapters.title: Chapter 4728: Plunder
paragraphs: As the saying goes, the ignorant have no fear.
Because they didn’t know Ling Han’s terrifying battle merits, the members of the Battle God Palace were all filled with confidence.
With the old Killing Saint standing guard, they were extremely calm.
Hehe, you actually dared to take the initiative to come here to die, then we shall oblige you!

Though the old Killing Saint was only an eight-star Saint, with the addition of two Saint Tools, his battle prowess would reach the height of an eighteen-star Saint. How could it be that he would not be able to deal with a mere three newly advanced Saints?
They must have been newly advanced; just how many years had it been?
These people were all filled with confidence, waiting for the scene of Ling Han and the others being killed to appear.

The old Killing Saint Saint was extremely displeased. This Young Palace Leader was sent over by the Void Imperial Clan, and he was a member of the Wu Clan. Now, however, he was being stepped on by a despicable dog right under his nose. Just how would the Wu Clan view him?

He was still hoping that the Lord of Death would obtain the great heaven-defying opportunity, and then be able to give him a little bit. At the very least, he would be able to break through to become a Nine-Star Saint, and stand at the pinnacle of Saints. He would also be very satisfied.
But now?
"You all deserve to die!" the old Killing Saint said balefully. The two daggers in his hands lit up, one black and one white.
Ling Han crooked a finger at him, "Come!"
Shua, the old Killing Saint suddenly leaped out in a slash, but just as he was about to appear in front of Ling Han, he suddenly disappeared.
Strange Shadow Steps!
"This is the true essence of Strange Shadow Steps!"
"Shadowless and formless."
"Only the grand elder can grasp the Strange Shadow Steps to such a high level!"
Everyone gasped in amazement. Everyone had similarly learnt the Strange Shadow Steps, but the comparison of mastery could infuriate them to death.
Ling Han smiled, took a step, and his figure also disappeared.
"S-Strange Shadow Steps!" Everyone was shocked. How could Ling Han also use the Strange Shadow Steps?
Could it be that they were on the same side?
Peng!
A figure was suddenly beaten out of the shadows, staggering.
Not Ling Han, but the old Killing Saint!
How was this possible!
Everyone was numb with shock. That was the old Killing Saint. How many years had he been immersed in the art of Strange Shadow Steps?
However, in a battle of Strange Shadow Steps, the old Killing Saint was actually no match for Ling Han?
Heavens!
Ling Han also appeared, and shot out a punch at the old Killing Saint.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Under his barrage of attacks, the old Killing Saint was completely unable to fight back, and could only be beaten madly.
Everyone was in despair, but in this kind of desperate situation, not only did they not want to beg for mercy, their killing intent instead surged.
That was because when they had first entered into the Battle God Palace, they had all been brainwashed in the Blood Tower. Aside from slaughter, there was no room for anything else.
Ling Han shook his head. With a thought, peng, peng, peng, everyone’s bodies tilted, and they collapsed to the ground, dead.
Right now, only the old Killing Saint and the Young Palace Leader were still alive.

The old Killing Saint looked at Ling Han, gritted his teeth, and said, "Don’t be too smug. The Battle God Palace has originated from the Void Imperial Clan, and as long as the Imperial Clan is not destroyed, the Battle God Palace will ultimately reappear!"
Ling Han smiled and said, "Then I’ll destroy the Imperial Clan!"

"How boastful!" That Young Palace Leader spoke up, "Do you know what the Imperial Clan signifies? Our Wu Clan is not a low-level Imperial Clan that only has the Imperial Weapon, but rather a real Imperial Clan that has a Great Emperor to oversee things!"
His face was filled with pride. When he spoke of the Wu Clan, that kind of pride was engraved in his bones.
Pa!
The large black dog’s paw stomped down, crushing the head of the Young Palace Leader into the ground.

"You people have gone too far!" That Young Palace Leader pulled his head out of the ground, his hair disheveled. Because the physique of a Saint was strong, this was not the slightest bit harmful to him, but to be treated like this, what face would he have left?
The large black dog snickered, and said to Ling Han, "Looks like this guy has stayed here for quite a number of years, and actually doesn’t know who you are, Little Han."
If this person was well-informed, he would definitely not be so arrogant.
With how freakish Ling Han was, even the Lords of Death didn’t hesitate to make a move, wanting to kill Ling Han before he became Emperor, which showed just how great a threat Ling Han posed.
Ling Han shook his head. Before becoming a Saint, he had always wanted to sweep aside all opposition in the Battle God Palace. However, when he truly succeeded, he felt that it was boring.
This was because he was far too powerful at this moment. It was as if he were a bully.
However, there was no way he would let the Battle God Palace off the hook. After all, this was the most notorious force in history, and everyone had the right to kill them.
Ling Han snapped his fingers. Pa, pa! The heads of the old Killing Saint and the Young Palace Leader exploded at the same time. Their minds were also obliterated. They were as dead as could be.
"Sigh, I haven’t shown off to my heart’s content yet." The large black dog felt dissatisfied.
The invasion of this Netherworld was really too untimely. Otherwise, now that it had become a Saint, it could show off all over the world.
"It’s like wearing embroidered clothes at night," the little azure dragon also sighed.
"Come, let’s go and raid the Battle God Palace," Ling Han said.
Instantly, the large black dog and little azure dragon felt energized. Aside from showing off, this was also one of their hobbies.
However, when they had completely emptied out the reserves of the Battle God Palace, they were all very disappointed.

It should be known that the Battle God Palace had existed for countless billions of years, and what they did was the illegal business of killing people. Merely in terms of accumulating wealth, they should only be inferior to the Chang Clan.
However, the gains of Ling Han and the others were pitifully small.
Even if the Battle God Palace wanted to nurture new disciples and expended some resources, they shouldn’t have expended so much, right?
"It’s probably taken by the Void Imperial Clan," Ling Han deduced.

That Young Palace Leader was obviously a member of the Wu Clan. Since the Wu Clan had already stretched out their hand, it wouldn’t be strange for them to empty the accumulated wealth of the Battle God Palace.
After all, the Battle God Palace existed for the purpose of serving the Wu Clan.
"Sigh, it wasn’t easy for us to conquer a force with deep roots, yet our gains are so little. This is really hard to accept," the large black dog said hatefully.
"Come, let’s go to the Void Imperial Clan!" the little azure dragon howled.
Ling Han and the large black dog did not speak, and merely stared at him.
"Er, why do you guys look at Grandpa Dragon like you’re looking at an idiot?" the little azure dragon said in displeasure.

"Hehe, if you want to go to the Void Imperial Clan, you can do as you like. We won’t be accompanying you. After 80 to 100 years, we’ll collect your corpse. If you still have a corpse by then," the large black dog said.
The little azure dragon wanted to put on a brave front, but if it went to a place guarded by a Great Emperor, would it be able to come back alive?
In the past, Ling Han had managed to charge back from Buddhist Land because Ah Han had only revived the Imperial Weapon.
If the Great Emperor became serious, who would be able to survive?
Probably only a freak like Ling Han could do it, but there was only one such freak in the world.
"Forget it, let’s go to the Netherworld." The little azure dragon found a way out for itself.
They continued to set out, searching all over the world for the entrance to the Netherworld.
Actually, in the Living Realm,, there were a great many entrances into the Netherworld. The only difference was the size of these entrances, as well as the locations they appeared in the Netherworld.
The largest entrance was naturally in the Mountain Sea Heaven. At that time, the Yin souls had invaded from there.

However, it wasn’t an easy task to find the Mountain Sea Heaven. Most of the stars had already been transformed into the Netherworld environment, so they didn’t belong to the Living Realm. Thus, Saints wouldn’t be able to sense them even if they were imbued with Regulations.
That was because the Regulations were different.
After 17 years, Ling Han and the others finally found the Mountain Sea Heaven.

Since the Wu Clan had already stretched out their hand, it wouldn’t be strange for them to empty the accumulated wealth of the Battle God Palace.
After all, the Battle God Palace existed for the purpose of serving the Wu Clan.
"Sigh, it wasn’t easy for us to conquer a force with deep roots, yet our gains are so little.
This is really hard to accept," the large black dog said hatefully.
"Come, let’s go to the Void Imperial Clan!" the little azure dragon howled.
Ling Han and the large black dog did not speak, and merely stared at him.
"Er, why do you guys look at Grandpa Dragon like you’re looking at an idiot?" the little azure dragon said in displeasure.
"Hehe, if you want to go to the Void Imperial Clan, you can do as you like.
We won’t be accompanying you.
After 80 to 100 years, we’ll collect your corpse.
If you still have a corpse by then," the large black dog said.
The little azure dragon wanted to put on a brave front, but if it went to a place guarded by a Great Emperor, would it be able to come back alive?
In the past, Ling Han had managed to charge back from Buddhist Land because Ah Han had only revived the Imperial Weapon.
If the Great Emperor became serious, who would be able to survive?
Probably only a freak like Ling Han could do it, but there was only one such freak in the world.
"Forget it, let’s go to the Netherworld." The little azure dragon found a way out for itself.
They continued to set out, searching all over the world for the entrance to the Netherworld.
Actually, in the Living Realm,, there were a great many entrances into the Netherworld.
The only difference was the size of these entrances, as well as the locations they appeared in the Netherworld.
The largest entrance was naturally in the Mountain Sea Heaven.
At that time, the Yin souls had invaded from there.
However, it wasn’t an easy task to find the Mountain Sea Heaven.
Most of the stars had already been transformed into the Netherworld environment, so they didn’t belong to the Living Realm.
Thus, Saints wouldn’t be able to sense them even if they were imbued with Regulations.
That was because the Regulations were different.
After 17 years, Ling Han and the others finally found the Mountain Sea Heaven.

chapters.title: Chapter 4729: The Great Emperor’s Palace in the Netherworld
paragraphs: At this moment, in the Mountain Sea Heaven, there was still a large number of Yin souls appearing endlessly.

This seemed to be the Netherworld’s base camp here. Countless Yin souls would enter the Living Realm from here onwards, and then head to the front lines, having the effect of assimilating the Living Realm into the Netherworld.
This was also their only use. The true propulsive force was the Skeleton Saint Tool, and even the Yin Saints were only sidekicks.
"Let’s make a big fuss!" Ling Han said with a smile, extremely bold.
"All right!"
The three of them charged out together. The might of a Saint was completely recealed, exuding a majestic light in the darkness. That was the flame of life, and also the holy flame of a Saint.
Boom!
Wherever the three of them went, the Yin souls would evaporate, and instantly disappear without a trace.

They did not encounter any decent resistance at all. All the Skeleton Saint Tools were at the front lines, and even if there was the Yin Saints standing guard here, how could they be a match for Ling Han and the others?
In just half a day, the Mountain Sea Heaven was emptied.
"Sigh, if only we had that kind of strength a few hundred years ago," the large black dog sighed. In that case, the Yin souls would not be able to take the first step of invading.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "If that’s really the case, the Skeleton Saint Tools and the Lords of Death will probably appear in advance as well."
Even if Ling Han could now match, or even destroy, the Skeleton Saint Tool, so what? The Lords of Death were the true root of the issue.
The problem was, those were all Great Emperors, and all of them had suppressed an era. Without becoming the strongest of this era, how could he possibly be a match for them?
"Let’s go."
The three of them entered the Netherworld through the entrance of the Mountain Sea Heaven.
After the Living Realm began transforming into the Netherworld, Ling Han and the others had essentially entered the Netherworld in advance. Thus, they didn’t feel much difference now.
There were still differences. Ling Han discovered that there were also Regulations here, but he could not understand them, nor could he use them.
This was the reverse of the Regulations that he had grasped. If he wanted to grasp the Regulations here, he would first have to give up the Regulations of the Living Realm that he had grasped.
He could only choose one of the two options, and could not possibly take both.
Ling Han could only give up on the idea of cultivating the Regulations of the Netherworld. He, the large black dog, and the little azure dragon began to streak across this vast land.
The Netherworld was different from the Living Realm. It didn’t have any stars, and it was just a vast and boundless continent.
After running for a long time, Ling Han and the others decided to move separately.
The Netherworld was really too big.
How would they contact one another?

Through life tokens. If one discovered anything, he would just kill the mosquitoes and flies. Although there were few Spatial Spirit Tools that could store life, they weren’t rare. However, how much space would one need to store flies and mosquitoes?
The three of them separated, and headed in different directions.
Ling Han used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. In this place, he had no scruples.
’Die!’
As the wings of fire swept past, any Yin soul would immediately turn into ash. However, this was the Netherworld, so killing Yin souls would not be rewarded by heaven and earth.
Ling Han was no longer interested in this little bit of reward. He went straight on ahead. Even if he didn’t discover anything, he still wanted to see if there was an end to this Netherworld.
Would there also be a corresponding Primitive Abyss here?
He also had another motive, and that was to find one or two Saint-level Great Herbs, which could help him rapidly increase his cultivation level. However, after thirty years, he had gained nothing.
Yi?
He was startled. A palace had actually appeared ahead of him!
This, a structure had actually appeared in the Netherworld?
At least, after entering the Netherworld so many times, Ling Han still hadn’t discovered any Yin soul living in the buildings.
—They were all just souls, and did not have a physical body, so what need was there for them to eat, drink, and poop?
A thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind, and he felt that he might have discovered something.
He carefully advanced, fearing that there was another terrifying existence within.
Now that dead Great Emperors would also appear, Saints were really not safe.
He sensed for a while, but did not discover any signs of life in the palace.
Er, were those Lords of Death humans or ghosts?
Ling Han wasn’t sure either. Although he had been hunted down by this kind of existence several times, a real face-to-face situation had never happened before.
Thus, he didn’t know either.
In that case, he could not be careless even if he could not sense any signs of life.

Ling Han arrived before the palace, only to see a stone statue that measured 300 meters in height. Although some forces in the Ling Han would forge statues that measured 3000 meters, 30000 meters, or even higher, this stone statue was completely different.
It was as if it had a life of its own, exuding a terrifying pressure.
Ling Han looked on in astonishment.
He had seen this "person" before.
The ruler of the sea of blood!
Though the ruler of the Blood Sea had only revealed a face that was formed from seawater at the time, there were a lot of similarities with this stone statue.
Moreover, the aura that they exuded was also very similar.
That’s right, this was definitely that fallen Empress.
Ling Han looked up at the stone statue in awe. Even though he knew that this was a Fallen Great Emperor, he still couldn’t help but admire her mighty and sea-like aura.
At the very least, the Great Emperor’s achievements in cultivation were truly admirable.

He couldn’t help but ask himself honestly. If he became a Great Emperor himself, and had the chance to live forever in front of him, would he be unable to withstand the temptation, and turn his back on the whole world?
Ling Han pondered for a moment. This was truly a difficult choice.
However, if he was the only one who could achieve immortality, then he would rather not.
Being alone through the ages, no matter how strong one’s spirit was, he would still collapse.
"However, what if I can grant immortality to those close to me?" Ling Han smiled bitterly. This kind of temptation was really too great. Even he would be tempted, right?
Ling Han sat down in a cross-legged position. Though this was only a mere hypothesis, it was very crucial. It concerned Ling Han’s beliefs, and would shake the foundations of his cultivation.
Without a clear mind, how could he cultivate?
After a while, Ling Han’s expression became determined.
Birth, old age, sickness and death, the laws of heaven and earth.
Just like how he had reprimanded the Lords of Death and the others, who had the right to deprive others of their right to live?
Seeking immortality? Sure, but it couldn’t be built on depriving others of their survival.
Ling Han opened his eyes. At this moment, he no longer hesitated, his heart as firm as iron.
He stood up and headed into the palace.
After arriving at a very spacious plaza, Ling Han entered the palace. However, he immediately discovered that the palace had been severely damaged.
The resting place of a powerful Great Emperor had actually been destroyed?
This was definitely not the corrosion of time, but had rather been damaged by someone.
This was truly inconceivable. Who dared to damage the residence of the Great Emperor?
He touched the broken wall, and squeezed his fingers. To his shock, he discovered that this brick was extremely hard. He actually couldn’t damage it.
Hiss, it should be known, just how strong was his present battle prowess?
Even if he didn’t use Destructive Energy and light of great dao, his battle prowess should still be able to sweep aside all Saints.
Boom, his hand was enshrouded in the light of Destructive Energy and great dao. Then, a crisp sound rang out, and the brick finally shattered.
Ling Han was even more astonished. In terms of destructive power alone, even the revival of the Imperial Weapon couldn’t compare to him.
Then, who had destroyed this place?
Another Great Emperor?

chapters.title: Chapter 4730: The Fall of the Great Emperor
paragraphs: Ling Han walked a few more steps, and suddenly discovered that there were a few lines of words on the ground. At first, they were very neat, but as time went on, they became more and more messy.
These words... were the Imperial Language!

It was said that after breaking through to the level of Great Emperor, comprehending the Dao of Heaven and Earth would form a unique language, and only the Great Emperor would be able to grasp it. Hence, it was called the Imperial Language.

Ling Han didn’t understand the Imperial Language, but he could sense the majestic aura of these words. It was as if they could condense the essence of heaven and earth, and contained a powerful vitality.
This should be very important.
The Great Emperor’s palace had been destroyed, yet there were still a few lines of words left behind. Ling Han refused to believe that this wasn’t left behind by the person who had destroyed it.
Was it another Great Emperor?
Ling Han stretched out a hand and placed it on the words. Instantly, a frightening murderous aura assailed him, as if a Great Emperor was staring at him.
"Humph!" Ling Han focused on guarding his spirit. So what if it was a Great Emperor? In terms of consciousness, he was unafraid of even a Great Emperor.
After enduring this terrifying murderous aura, scenes suddenly appeared in Ling Han’s mind.
This was an Empress, a peerless beauty. It was she who had moved, and destroyed this palace.
Er!
Ling Han was astonished. This was because the Empress was clearly the stone statue that had been erected on the plaza. In other words, the Empress had destroyed this palace herself?
Was she an idiot?
Ling Han saw that this Empress seemed to be hesitating, and made a difficult decision.
It was precisely because this decision was too difficult to make, that this Empress moved in her irritation, and destroyed her own bedroom.
"Since you’ve already made your choice, and have already reached this stage, why are you still hesitating?" the Empress murmured to herself.
Was this a change in the Empress’s mentality that was on the verge of falling?
Being able to become a Great Emperor, his breadth of mind was definitely outstanding. How could she possibly fall so easily?
Thus, they would definitely have to go through a difficult mental journey.
Ling Han very much wanted to know the reason. Immortality?

If she wanted immortality, she could also go to the Primitive Abyss. Although it was extremely dangerous, at least her Dao Heart wouldn’t be tortured. Otherwise, if she massacred the world for her personal gain, her Dao Heart would probably be unstable.
Thus, the pursuit of the Lords of Death should have surpassed the pursuit of immortality.
The scene was still circulating, and the Empress continued to pace around. In the end, her expression became stern, and using her fingers like a pen, she began to write on the ground.
She had not used any Regulations at all, but wherever her fingers touched, the ground was like it was made of tofu, easily leaving marks.
This was the true might of a Great Emperor.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel shocked. In comparison, although a Lord of Death also attacked him previously, its might was completely incomparable.
No wonder Buddha Doga had said that the True Dragon Emperor in the Primitive Abyss was a bit strange, and didn’t match the true strength of the Great Emperor Abyss.
That was indeed the case.
The problem was, he couldn’t understand it.
Though Ling Han had seen the Empress self-destruct her palace, and was making an important decision, he was completely unclear what exactly this was.
In the image, when the empress put away her "pen", her expression had also calmed down. Her expression was filled with determination, and there was no longer the slightest bit of hesitation.
It was as if she had fused all her negative emotions into these words through the method of leaving a letter, completely severing herself from these words.
However, the scene that followed caused Ling Han’s hair to stand on end.

That was because the Empress had sat down in a cross-legged position, and her vitality was continuously seeping out of her body. Not too long after, her stunning beauty had completely disappeared, and she had become a dried corpse.
Had she committed suicide?
However, the following scene stunned Ling Han. The Empress’s corpse was continuously absorbing the Regulations of the Netherworld, and not long after, her corpse became plump.
Hu, her eyes suddenly snapped open. Her gaze actually pierced through time, and landed on Ling Han.
"Hiss!" Ling Han instantly took a few steps back. He felt a sharp pain in his eyes, as if he had gone blind.
This was the power of a Great Emperor. Even after countless years, it could still cause such a blow.
Ling Han composed himself. After a while, his vision finally returned to normal, but he still felt a sharp pain.
He recalled the last scene. The Empress’s eyes were no longer like normal people’s, but as dark as ghost flames.
Was this the secret of "immortality" of the Lords of Death?
In truth... they were all dead!

Originally, when the Great Emperor died, his soul would be assimilated by the heaven and earth. It would be impossible for him to appear in the Netherworld, and he would not have the chance to possess a corpse and be reborn.
However, that Empress had used a secret technique to directly transform herself into a Yin soul. Furthermore, she had also possessed her own body.
Hence, the battle prowess of the present Lords of Death couldn’t compare to their prime, because they were actually all Yin souls?
It shouldn’t be so simple.
Now that they had become the strongest Yin soul, the Lords of Death could naturally command the Netherworld, but what the hell were the sea of Saint corpses?
This should be the "fated opportunity" that the Lords of Death had obtained in the Primitive Abyss, bestowing them with some special abilities.
Ling Han searched again, but this palace was empty, and he did not find anything else.
He left the palace, and continued to search for opportunities.
Unfortunately, the Netherworld really did not produce Celestial medicines, or treasures that could increase one’s cultivation level. It seemed like it was only the place where Yin souls lived.

Ling Han discovered another place that he suspected was the "revival point" of the Lords of Death. There was still Imperial Might permeating from it, yet it was also eerie and menacing, completely different from ordinary Imperial Might.
When he found nothing else, Ling Han sent a signal to the little azure dragon and the large black dog, signaling for them to return.
After they met up, they didn’t take the Mountain Sea Heaven’s exit.
Who knew if there were any Lords of Death standing guard, waiting for them?
In any case, there was more than one exit. They searched for a while, and then exited the Netherworld.
Ling Han talked about his discoveries, and the large black dog and little azure dragon also found similar places, but only the Empress of the sea of blood had left behind a palace.
Perhaps, it had something to do with the fact that this person was a woman.
Clearly, the 12 Lords of Death had all completed their "transformation" in the Netherworld. What Ling Han cared about was why it was 12.

Was it that only the 12 ancient Great Emperors had chosen to walk this path, or could it be that this path could only be walked by the 12 Great Emperors, and every single one of them could obtain a great opportunity?
This... could only be known by the Lords of Death.
"Actually, there’s a way," the large black dog said with a serious expression.
Ling Han sighed, "Every time I see you being so serious, I feel a sense of foreboding. Though I clearly know that there is an 80% chance that your idea is unreliable, I still want to hear it."
"If you manage to court that Empress in the sea of blood, then wouldn’t you know everything!" the large black dog said with a smile.
As expected!
Why did he have fantasies about this despicable dog that he shouldn’t have?
What good ideas could it come up with?
They were definitely all rancid!
"That’s a good idea!" The little azure dragon egged on from the sidelines. "Little Han, go court her!"
"Get lost!" Ling Han sent these two unreliable guys flying with a kick, heading towards Four Origin Planet.
They returned to the Four Origin Planet. They hadn’t even sat down properly, yet they were greeted by a noisy crowd.
"What’s going on?" Ling Han gritted his teeth. It looked like something incredible had happened.
