Hence, the battle prowess of the present Lords of Death couldn’t compare to their prime, because they were actually all Yin souls?
It shouldn’t be so simple.
Now that they had become the strongest Yin soul, the Lords of Death could naturally command the Netherworld, but what the hell were the sea of Saint corpses?
This should be the "fated opportunity" that the Lords of Death had obtained in the Primitive Abyss, bestowing them with some special abilities.
Ling Han searched again, but this palace was empty, and he did not find anything else.
He left the palace, and continued to search for opportunities.
Unfortunately, the Netherworld really did not produce Celestial medicines, or treasures that could increase one’s cultivation level.
It seemed like it was only the place where Yin souls lived.
Ling Han discovered another place that he suspected was the "revival point" of the Lords of Death.
There was still Imperial Might permeating from it, yet it was also eerie and menacing, completely different from ordinary Imperial Might.
When he found nothing else, Ling Han sent a signal to the little azure dragon and the large black dog, signaling for them to return.
After they met up, they didn’t take the Mountain Sea Heaven’s exit.
Who knew if there were any Lords of Death standing guard, waiting for them?
In any case, there was more than one exit.
They searched for a while, and then exited the Netherworld.
Ling Han talked about his discoveries, and the large black dog and little azure dragon also found similar places, but only the Empress of the sea of blood had left behind a palace.
Perhaps, it had something to do with the fact that this person was a woman.
Clearly, the 12 Lords of Death had all completed their "transformation" in the Netherworld.
What Ling Han cared about was why it was 12.

Was it that only the 12 ancient Great Emperors had chosen to walk this path, or could it be that this path could only be walked by the 12 Great Emperors, and every single one of them could obtain a great opportunity?
This... could only be known by the Lords of Death.
"Actually, there’s a way," the large black dog said with a serious expression.
Ling Han sighed, "Every time I see you being so serious, I feel a sense of foreboding.
Though I clearly know that there is an 80% chance that your idea is unreliable, I still want to hear it."
"If you manage to court that Empress in the sea of blood, then wouldn’t you know everything!" the large black dog said with a smile.
As expected!
Why did he have fantasies about this despicable dog that he shouldn’t have?
What good ideas could it come up with?
They were definitely all rancid!
"That’s a good idea!" The little azure dragon egged on from the sidelines.
"Little Han, go court her!"
"Get lost!" Ling Han sent these two unreliable guys flying with a kick, heading towards Four Origin Planet.
They returned to the Four Origin Planet.
They hadn’t even sat down properly, yet they were greeted by a noisy crowd.
"What’s going on?" Ling Han gritted his teeth.
It looked like something incredible had happened.

chapters.title: Chapter 4731: Message from the Pseudo-Emperor
paragraphs: "Three months ago, a streak of golden light suddenly illuminated the galaxy, its speed extraordinarily fast," the empress said. "The three Pseudo-Emperors, Buddha Doga, Qian Yanghao and Xia Houping all moved, wanting to capture it, but none of them succeeded."
What, Pseudo-Emperors actually couldn’t succeed after making a move?
Additionally—
"Xia Houping?" Ling Han was surprised. How had another Pseudo-Emperor appeared?
"Not long ago, the three Pseudo-Emperors had come to visit, but you weren’t present," Chi Menghan said. "And Lord Xia Houping said that he has once met you before."
"Met me before?" Ling Han was stunned. He had actually seen a Pseudo-Emperor without even knowing it?
He immediately searched through his mind to see if any one could match that description.
After a while, he asked, "Is that Lord the woodcutter that I met by chance previously?"

"Haha, Niu’s Ling Han is indeed clever!" Hu Niu suddenly jumped up, and shouted at everyone, "How about it? Niu’s guess is still the most accurate. Niu’s Ling Han will definitely be able to guess, and he succeeded at the first attempt!"

Everyone smiled faintly. Hu Niu was still that Hu Niu. She had been like this when she was young, and she was still like this now that she had grown up. She had been like this when she was a Heavenly Venerate, and she was still like this when she was a Saint.
Though there were times when she was bold and rash, this kind of personality was really something that others could not help but want to dote on her.
Meanwhile, Ling Han smacked his lips. He had never thought that the woodcutter he had met by chance would actually be a Pseudo-Emperor. Before this, he had always thought that the latter was a Saint.
No wonder Buddha Doga had said that he would discuss with "them". If it was only Qian Yanghao, how could it possibly be "them"?
"How is this golden light now?" Ling Han asked.

"It’s still flying in space," the empress continued. "According to the deductions of the three Pseudo-Emperors, this golden light comes from the Primitive Abyss. It has the unique aura of that place."
The unique aura of the Primitive Abyss... Genesis Substance?
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel moved. If he could obtain this golden light, his cultivation level would definitely increase rapidly.
"Do you want to know what that is?" Chi Menghan asked with a smile, a hint of mischief in her voice.
Ling Han’s heart fluttered. This beautiful wife of his had also learnt to tempt him now. This was really too embarrassing. He actually couldn’t control himself.
"What? What?" the large black dog asked greedily.
If he wasn’t greedy, then he wouldn’t be the large black dog.

Chi Menghan didn’t "tease" Ling Han anymore. After all, her husband’s gaze made her a little... uncontrolled, and she hurriedly said, "The three Pseudo-Emperors deduced that is the Natural-born Gold Spirit!"
Natural-born Gold Spirit!
Yi, what did this have to do with Natural-born Stone Spirit?

The Natural-born Stone Spirit could be forged into one’s doppelganger, and its battle prowess could even soar to Pseudo-Emperor-level. Moreover, with the Stone Spirit’s powerful defense, it wouldn’t be killed even by the Imperial Weapon. It could be said that there was no way to break through its defenses.
What the hell was a Natural-born Gold Spirit?

However, when he thought of the Natural-born Stone Spirit, Ling Han couldn’t help but think of Ge Qianqiu. He had met Old Man Ge at the place where the Natural-born Stone Spirit was nurtured. At the time, he had only thought that the latter was a low-key Saint.
His expression turned to grief, and he was no longer in the mood for anything.

"According to Buddha Doga, Natural-born Gold Spirit is the same as Natural-born Stone Spirit. It can be refined to become a Pseudo-Emperor-level doppelganger." Chi Menghan continued, "However, Natural-born Stone Spirit is more inclined towards defense, while Natural-born Gold Spirit is more inclined towards attack."
Among the Five Elements, earth represented thickness and defense, while gold represented sharpness and attack.

"Now, it is not only the three Pseudo-Emperors that are searching for this Natural-born Gold Spirit. Even the various great Imperial Clan and those on the side of the Netherworld are doing the same," the empress continued. "However, the Natural-born Gold Spirit is too fast. As of now, no force has succeeded in capturing it yet."
Ling Han was shocked, and pulled himself out of his grief.

The great Imperial Clans were searching for the Natural-born Gold Spirit. This was understandable, because as long as their Imperial Son refined it into a doppelganger, then not only would it add a being with Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess to their side, they could even use the Natural-born Gold Spirit to appreciate the Great Emperor-level Regulations.
In that way, they would be able to snatch the first opportunity in the competition for the throne.

The Netherworld’s side also had a very good reason for wanting to snatch the Natural-born Gold Spirit. Firstly, they also had Imperial Son-level characters, and secondly, if a Pseudo-Emperor appeared, they would be able to decrease the number of times the Lords of Death would have to make a move personally.
Though there was no direct evidence, everyone could guess by now that the Lords of Death couldn’t make a move casually, or there would definitely be serious future trouble.

Thus, if the Netherworld’s side had a Pseudo-Emperor, and it was forged from the Natural-born Gold Spirit that had incredibly powerful attack at that, it was sure that Buddha Doga and the others would have tremendous headaches.

Thus, even if the Living Realm army obtained the Natural-born Gold Spirit, they wouldn’t be able to change the situation of being beaten. However, they definitely couldn’t allow the Natural-born Gold Spirit to fall into the hands of the Netherworld.
—Even if it meant destroying it.
"Then let’s go and search as well!" Ling Han immediately said.
"The three Pseudo-Emperors have left a message. Once the Natural-born Gold Spirit stops, they will immediately send a message," Chi Menghan said.
Fine then.

Ling Han, the large black dog, and the little azure dragon rested first. After all, they had been in the Netherworld for so many years, and had always been separated from the heaven and earth of the Living Realm. They needed to replenish their power of Regulation.
Boom!
Seven days later, an astonishing aura suddenly exploded from Ling Han’s body. An orange-colored pillar of light shot into the sky, dazzling the universe.
He had broken through!
A Three Star Saint.

Er, in terms of the color of the holy flame, he was indeed a three-star Saint. However, in terms of breaking through, he should be a five-star Saint, but in terms of the number of Regulations, he had far surpassed a nine-star Saint.

"Unfortunately, I am still unable to sense the Nine Star Regulations. Otherwise, even if I could not become the strongest Great Emperor, if I could become a Great Emperor in advance, I would still be able to resist a Lord of Death."
Ling Han shook his head. At this moment, he was no longer purely pursuing his own strength. Instead, he was more concerned about the lives of the people in the world.
Ge Qianqiu’s sacrifice touched him too deeply.
Ling Han familiarized himself with his own power. The number of Regulations he had grasped now had reached as many as 43, but that was still less than half the limit of 99.

"If I cultivate Regulations normally, even if freaks like me can grasp five Regulations every time I break through to the next star-level, at most, I can only grasp 60 Regulations when I reach the level of Nine Star Saint."

"When a Great Emperor was a Saint, there most likely weren’t any Pseudo-Emperors that brought them to the Primitive Abyss, and even if there were, their physique would not be able to withstand the extreme gravity there."
"Hence, even if a Great Emperor is freakish, and every time he advances one star in Saint Tier, even if he can grasp four eight-star Regulations, the limit would only be thirty-six flashes."
"In this sense, I’ve already far surpassed the Great Emperors of the past."

This was also why Ling Han had the confidence to attempt breaking through to Great Emperor-level now. Even if he had not reached his limits yet, as long as he became a Great Emperor, he would definitely be stronger than those Great Emperors of previous eras.
The large black dog and little azure dragon also broke through one after another. Looks like training in the Netherworld would also be of great help in improving their cultivation level.

In the Netherworld, they had to constantly resist the invasion of the Regulations of the Netherworld, and guard against being assimilated by the Regulations of the Netherworld. Under this accumulation, they finally managed to break through smoothly.
Moreover, Ling Han had also immersed himself in the Primitive Abyss for over 200 years.

chapters.title: Chapter 4732: Divine Beast Graveyard
paragraphs: However, this kind of thing could not be repeated. The heaven and earth would not allow a cultivator to cheat like this, and easily break through to Saint Tier consecutively.
Once was already good enough.

If he wanted to become the truly strongest Saint, he would definitely have to go to the Primitive Abyss and continue to obtain Genesis Substance. Without allowing his body to experience Silent Destruction, he would have to grasp even more Regulations.
Otherwise, after Silent Destruction nine times, his body would reach its limit, and then he would directly fuse with heaven and earth, which was equivalent to suicide.

Even someone as strong as Ling Han could not possibly change this kind of fate. Thus, if he wanted to grasp 99 Regulationswhen he was a Saint, he would have to obtain even more Genesis Substance, and could only go to the Primitive Abyss to obtain this.
Ling Han was already prepared. When the matter of the Natural-born Gold Spirit was over, he would ask Buddha Doga to take him to the Primitive Abyss again.
Of course, it was not the kind of trip that would require him to burn the Imperial Source, but rather take two hundred years to make another trip.
In any case, while he was on the road, he could also appreciate the Regulations, and would not waste any time.
After waiting for several days, news came from Buddha Doga that the Natural-born Gold Spirit had stopped. However, it had actually fallen into a land of peril.
It wasn’t like the Twelve Lands of Death, where a Fallen Great Emperor was standing guard. Instead, it was a true land of peril, and it was naturally formed.
This place was called the "Divine Beast Graveyard".

That’s right, it was the Divine Beasts that had appeared in the first batch when the heaven and earth was first created. There were a considerable number of them that had come here in the last moments of their lives, and died.
From then onwards, Imperial Might spread out, turning that place into a land of death. Even Saints would have to be extremely careful when entering, and they could be killed at any time.
And with the suppression of the Imperial Might, there was not much production of treasures there either. Thus, there was naturally even less meaning to venture in.
For a long time, that place was the most dangerous place in the universe, and no one had ever entered.
Only an idiot would go.
But now, the Natural-born Gold Spirit actually chose that place in the end.
It could not be helped. Even if it was dangerous, they had to go.
The most important thing now was definitely not to allow the Netherworld to obtain this Natural-born Gold Spirit.
Ling Han and the others set off.

Now, this was a team that was completely made up of Saints. Aside from the iron trio of Ling Han, the large black dog and the little azure dragon, there was also Brother Monkey, the empress, Hu Niu, Chi Menghan, Lin Luo, Zhou Heng, and so on.
Even someone as powerful as the Imperial Clans could not possibly produce so many Saints in one go.
If Ling Han became Emperor, he would definitely be able to establish the strongest Imperial Clan in history. They would definitely be peerless.

The Divine Beast Graveyard was still within the jurisdiction of the Living Realm. This was a good thing. At least, if they were fighting with the Netherworld, they would have the home ground advantage, and there was no need for them to worry that as they fought, the Regulations in their bodies would all be used up.
Very quickly, they arrived at their destination.
Actually, this was a star. From afar, it looked like a golden orb, and was not dangerous at all. On the contrary, it was quite pleasing to the eye.
However, when they got closer, they discovered that the aura here was too terrifying. It had taken solid form, as if it was a supreme God Tool.
It could be seen that the periphery of this planet was covered with all kinds of shards. They were made out of metal, wood, and even broken corpses.
This was because some warships had accidentally passed by here, and the result was naturally their ship being destroyed and their people dying.
There was no sign of life on the dead planet.
"This star contains a large amount of metal. No wonder the Natural-born Gold Spirit ultimately chose this place."
"Be careful."
They descended towards the planet, not daring to be too fast. The aura here was too chaotic, and the destructive power was too terrifying.
Perhaps, only Ling Han could be unafraid.
His current physique was probably even tougher than a Pseudo-Emperor. If it was just resisting this kind of Great Emperor-level aura, he still had a lot of confidence in doing it.
After a long time, they finally landed on the ground.
This was indeed a star with extremely high metal content. At a glance, it was completely plated with gold. It was dazzling with golden light, practically blinding one’s eyes.
The large black dog lowered his head to look at the iron underwear on his body, then showed a hint of pride.
This planet was not as eye-catching as it was.
Peng!
Everyone sent the large black dog flying with a kick.
F***, this guy was really too vulgar.
"Why are you kicking Grandpa Dog?" The large black dog was still wearing a dumbfounded expression.
The little azure dragon placed a hand on its forehead and said, "Grandpa Dragon is too embarrassed to be with you in the future!"
"Four-Legged Snake, are you looking for a beating?" The large black dog was furious, and immediately charged over.
The two unreliable guys fought fiercely, but they were naturally just playing around. They would not get serious.
However, the battle between the two of them caused quite a commotion. Three people quickly approached from the distance.

A smile spread across Ling Han’s face. These were the three Saints from the Saintly Heaven Imperial Clan. One was Luo Yang, the son of the Great Emperor, the second was an old Nine Star Saint, and the third was also an old Saint, but his cultivation level was slightly weaker, being only a Six Star Saint.
He did not become enemies with the Saintly Heavenly Imperial Clan. On the contrary, they had previously formed an alliance, so his expression was naturally gentle.

"Ling Han, several hundred years have already passed since we last parted," Luo Yang said. Although he was only a Seven Star Saint at this moment, his identity as the son of a Great Emperor was clear for all to see. He was the ancestor of the other two Saints for who knew how many generations.
Moreover, though his cultivation level was slightly inferior, in terms of battle prowess, it was definitely him that was stronger.
Thus, when he spoke on behalf of the Saintly Heavenly Imperial Clan, the other two Saints felt that this was only natural.
Ling Han nodded, "Brother Luo’s improvement is obvious, congratulations."
"It can’t compare to the line of the Nine Suns Saint!" Luo Yang exclaimed ruefully. Just look, just how many Saints were there?
Although the strongest among them, Brother Monkey was only a five-star Saint, it couldn’t hold up to the fact that his power was still astonishing.

—Those that could become Saints in this era basically depended on their own comprehension of Regulations, and could not draw on the power of belief. Thus, those that could become Saints were all prodigies among prodigies. No matter what, they would be able to charge up to five stars in future.
How could such a lineup not be astonishing!
However, it was a shame that the Netherworld had invaded, and the Lords of Death had also appeared out of nowhere. Thus, this dazzling lineup was nothing special in comparison.
Ling Han smiled, and said, "Brother Luo and the others came early. Do you have any clues?"

The two Saints from the Saintly Heaven Imperial Clan hurriedly signalled with their eyes. This meant that they definitely couldn’t say that if they obtained the Natural-born Gold Spirit, they could completely seize the opportunity to become Emperor.
Though Ling Han was the number one Saint of all eternity, who did not hope that it would be their Imperial Son that would become Emperor?
Yet Luo Yang acted as if he had not seen anything, and said, "There are not many clues, and I would not be able to help Brother Ling too much."
Sigh... The two Saints couldn’t help but sigh.
Ling Han thought to himself. After all, he was the son of a Great Emperor, so his vision was different.

However, Luo Yang and the others had only arrived not too long ago, and had only searched a small area. At most, they could only rule out that area, and conclude that it was impossible that the Natural-born Gold Spirit was there.

This planet was filled with Imperial Might, which seriously interfered with divine sense. It was impossible to search with divine sense. Furthermore, no one dared to run around madly here, as they would similarly be pierced into bloody holes by the air formed by Imperial Might.
Ling Han tried to communicate with the ley lines, but discovered that this was a dead star. How could there be any ley lines?
They could only search inch by inch with their naked eyes.

If Ling Han became Emperor, he would definitely be able to establish the strongest Imperial Clan in history.
They would definitely be peerless.
The Divine Beast Graveyard was still within the jurisdiction of the Living Realm.
This was a good thing.

At least, if they were fighting with the Netherworld, they would have the home ground advantage, and there was no need for them to worry that as they fought, the Regulations in their bodies would all be used up.
Very quickly, they arrived at their destination.
Actually, this was a star.
From afar, it looked like a golden orb, and was not dangerous at all.
On the contrary, it was quite pleasing to the eye.
However, when they got closer, they discovered that the aura here was too terrifying.
It had taken solid form, as if it was a supreme God Tool.
It could be seen that the periphery of this planet was covered with all kinds of shards.
They were made out of metal, wood, and even broken corpses.
This was because some warships had accidentally passed by here, and the result was naturally their ship being destroyed and their people dying.
There was no sign of life on the dead planet.
"This star contains a large amount of metal.
No wonder the Natural-born Gold Spirit ultimately chose this place."
"Be careful."
They descended towards the planet, not daring to be too fast.
The aura here was too chaotic, and the destructive power was too terrifying.
Perhaps, only Ling Han could be unafraid.
His current physique was probably even tougher than a Pseudo-Emperor.
If it was just resisting this kind of Great Emperor-level aura, he still had a lot of confidence in doing it.
After a long time, they finally landed on the ground.
This was indeed a star with extremely high metal content.
At a glance, it was completely plated with gold.
It was dazzling with golden light, practically blinding one’s eyes.
The large black dog lowered his head to look at the iron underwear on his body, then showed a hint of pride.
This planet was not as eye-catching as it was.
Peng!
Everyone sent the large black dog flying with a kick.
F***, this guy was really too vulgar.
"Why are you kicking Grandpa Dog?" The large black dog was still wearing a dumbfounded expression.
The little azure dragon placed a hand on its forehead and said, "Grandpa Dragon is too embarrassed to be with you in the future!"
"Four-Legged Snake, are you looking for a beating?" The large black dog was furious, and immediately charged over.
The two unreliable guys fought fiercely, but they were naturally just playing around.
They would not get serious.
However, the battle between the two of them caused quite a commotion.
Three people quickly approached from the distance.
A smile spread across Ling Han’s face.
These were the three Saints from the Saintly Heaven Imperial Clan.
One was Luo Yang, the son of the Great Emperor, the second was an old Nine Star Saint, and the third was also an old Saint, but his cultivation level was slightly weaker, being only a Six Star Saint.
He did not become enemies with the Saintly Heavenly Imperial Clan.
On the contrary, they had previously formed an alliance, so his expression was naturally gentle.
"Ling Han, several hundred years have already passed since we last parted," Luo Yang said.
Although he was only a Seven Star Saint at this moment, his identity as the son of a Great Emperor was clear for all to see.
He was the ancestor of the other two Saints for who knew how many generations.
Moreover, though his cultivation level was slightly inferior, in terms of battle prowess, it was definitely him that was stronger.
Thus, when he spoke on behalf of the Saintly Heavenly Imperial Clan, the other two Saints felt that this was only natural.
Ling Han nodded, "Brother Luo’s improvement is obvious, congratulations."
"It can’t compare to the line of the Nine Suns Saint!" Luo Yang exclaimed ruefully.
Just look, just how many Saints were there?
Although the strongest among them, Brother Monkey was only a five-star Saint, it couldn’t hold up to the fact that his power was still astonishing.
—Those that could become Saints in this era basically depended on their own comprehension of Regulations, and could not draw on the power of belief.
Thus, those that could become Saints were all prodigies among prodigies.
No matter what, they would be able to charge up to five stars in future.
How could such a lineup not be astonishing!
However, it was a shame that the Netherworld had invaded, and the Lords of Death had also appeared out of nowhere.
Thus, this dazzling lineup was nothing special in comparison.
Ling Han smiled, and said, "Brother Luo and the others came early.
Do you have any clues?"
The two Saints from the Saintly Heaven Imperial Clan hurriedly signalled with their eyes.
This meant that they definitely couldn’t say that if they obtained the Natural-born Gold Spirit, they could completely seize the opportunity to become Emperor.
Though Ling Han was the number one Saint of all eternity, who did not hope that it would be their Imperial Son that would become Emperor?
Yet Luo Yang acted as if he had not seen anything, and said, "There are not many clues, and I would not be able to help Brother Ling too much."
Sigh...
The two Saints couldn’t help but sigh.
Ling Han thought to himself.
After all, he was the son of a Great Emperor, so his vision was different.
However, Luo Yang and the others had only arrived not too long ago, and had only searched a small area.
At most, they could only rule out that area, and conclude that it was impossible that the Natural-born Gold Spirit was there.
This planet was filled with Imperial Might, which seriously interfered with divine sense.
It was impossible to search with divine sense.
Furthermore, no one dared to run around madly here, as they would similarly be pierced into bloody holes by the air formed by Imperial Might.
Ling Han tried to communicate with the ley lines, but discovered that this was a dead star.
How could there be any ley lines?
They could only search inch by inch with their naked eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 4733: Killing Lu Xun
paragraphs: The group began a search.
They were all Saints, and searching together would be a waste of manpower. Thus, everyone moved separately.
Of course, they were all extremely careful. If they came across an Imperial Sons of the Land of Death, they would immediately flee if they were no match. They definitely couldn’t linger in battle.
In this place, no matter how strong a Saint was, they would not dare to use movement techniques to run madly. Thus, as long as they did not continue fighting, there would basically be no problems.
Ling Han walked with his hands clasped behind his back, and began to slowly speed up.
He wanted to give it a try and see how fast he could be in this kind of environment.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
As he sped up, the Imperial Might that permeated the air instantly transformed into a sharp blade that stabbed towards him.
However, his tough physique took effect, and the "sharp swords" that attacked him were instantly shattered one after another, and he only felt a slight numbness.
He could go even faster.
He sped up again, and finally, his tolerance had reached its limit. The sharp swords formed by Imperial Might posed a substantial threat to him.
At this kind of speed, he could probably hold on for three to five minutes.
This was equivalent to his speed when he was a Sect Master. In this kind of place... he was already unreasonably fast.
It could be said that even Buddha Doga and the other Pseudo-Emperors could not compare to him.
Ling Han could release his divine sense to a certain extent, covering an area of 0.5 km around him. He could guarantee that in this area, there would be something that slipped through the net.

"Actually, if one were to resist the Imperial Might here, it would be beneficial for one to cultivate the Regulations." Ling Han murmured, "However, there is not just a single Divine Beast’s corpse buried here. The aura is too heterogeneous, and if one stays here for too long, it would definitely be harmful."

He continued to advance. At this moment, he was already the most powerful Saint. Thus, he wouldn’t be afraid even if he came across the Skeleton Saint Tool. The only thing that could suppress him would be a Great Emperor.
’Hmm?’
Where he could see, a person had appeared ahead of him.
Lu Xun!
A fallen Imperial Son.

Ling Han couldn’t help but smile. Very good, very good. Previously, when Old Man Ge had died, it was because of the interference of the Golden Crow Great Emperor. Now that he had encountered the son of this fallen Great Emperor, he could first collect some interest for Old Man Ge.
If he was pleasantly surprised, then for Lu Xun, he was completely shocked.
Without another word, Lu Xun immediately turned around and fled.
In this place, even a Pseudo-Emperor couldn’t unleash his full speed. He was confident that he could escape.
However, he had only run a few steps, when he felt a weight on his shoulder, and his steps were actually forcefully stopped.
He was shocked to see a large hand resting on his shoulder!
It was Ling Han!
F***, when did this guy catch up to him?

It should be known that they had been about 5km away from each other previously. Even if that distance could be covered in the time that would take for a thought to form under normal circumstances, in this place, though it was not like a Divine Abyss, there was indeed a very, very far distance between them.
This was inconceivable. He had actually been caught up to so quickly.
How could Ling Han possibly be so fast?
’You’re only a Saint.’
Ling Han smiled and said, "I’ll send you on your way first. In the future, I will send your father to accompany you in hel."
"Ling Han, you dare to kill me?" Lu Xun exclaimed in shock. "My father is the Golden Crow Great Emperor. Do you want to become deadly enemies with a Great Emperor?"
Ling Han couldn’t help but chuckle, and countered with a question of his own, "Could it be that we are not deadly enemies now?"
If it was just an invasion from the Twelve Lands of Death, then it was only a matter of position on both sides, but added with the death of Old Man Ge, it added another layer of personal enmity.
"With a Great Emperor hunting you down, you will definitely not be able to escape death!" Lu Xun still wanted to threaten him further.
"Oh." Ling Han nodded, "Do you have any other last words?"
Lu Xun gritted his teeth. Boom! Golden flames suddenly exploded from his body, transforming into countless feather arrows that shot rapidly towards Ling Han.

This time, he was really going all out. He burned the holy flame, sparing no expense. Otherwise, his only fate would be death. In fact, the holy flame would still be taken away by Ling Han, and turned into nutrients for his cultivation.
Ling Han did not dodge, nor did he parry. He merely maintained his original posture, and allowed the tens of thousands of feather arrows to shoot towards him.
Peng, peng, peng! The holy flame and Regulations continued to explode on his body. However, he remained unscathed and motionless.
Lu Xun was so shocked that his eyes were about to pop out of his head. What kind of terrifying physique was this?
This was too terrifying. What kind of monster was this?
Ling Han did not speak any nonsense. A sliver of intent rushed out, and entered into Lu Xun’s mind.

What Great Emperor-level trump card? At present, it was completely unable to stop Ling Han. After all, a Great Emperor could not possibly casually create a Great Emperor-level trump card, and in the case of Saint-level, how could it possibly be a match for Ling Han?
Boom, Lu Xun’s mind was instantly shattered, and his eyes immediately lost focus, losing all luster.
His mind had been shattered, so he had naturally died on the spot.
Ling Han drew out Lu Xun’s holy flame, and immediately refined it.
Initially, he disdained from doing this. However, the situation now was too dire. He had to increase his cultivation level as soon as possible.

However, with a wave of the holy flame in his body, it immediately burned this ball of holy flame in Lu Xun’s body into dust, leaving behind only a sliver of essence, causing his holy flame to increase slightly.
This...

Ling Han couldn’t help but smile bitterly. The holy flame that he had ignited was too awesome. It was number one in all of history, but he had to pay a corresponding price for it. It was just that improving it would be too slow.
When other Saints devoured the holy flame, their cultivation level would soar. However, what about him?
Even a "high quality" holy flame like Lu Xun’s was pitifully little help to him.

"If all the Saints in the universe gave me their holy flame, would it be able to help me advance another level?" Ling Han shook his head. This really depressed him. He had one less method to quickly improve himself.

However, this was also good. Refining the holy flame of another would always give Ling Han a feeling of evil. Furthermore, it would definitely cause the holy flame to become heterogeneous, and affect his battle prowess.
Ling Han casually tossed Lu Xun’s corpse aside and continued to advance.
Killing Lu Xun could no longer cause any ripples in his emotions.
Now, he only had the Twelve Lands of Death in his eyes, as well as the thirty-six Divine Beasts of the Primitive Abyss. Their appearance was too strange.
Furthermore, since there was a Divine Beast Graveyard here, then where did the corresponding Divine Beasts from the Primitive Abyss come from?

Walking on this colossal star, since this was the tomb chosen by the Divine Beasts, it was naturally astonishingly huge. If one wanted to search every inch of land, it would take an astonishing amount of time.
What if the Natural-born Gold Spirit hid deep underground?
Then it would be even harder to find.
Ling Han suddenly had an idea. What if he could "revive" this star?
Once the star came back to life, the ley lines would be of use to him, and then it would be easier to search for the location of the Natural-born Gold Spirit.
This was not a bad idea.
Ling Han sat down cross-leggedly, and began to communicate with this star.
Even if reviving a planet would take an extremely long time, compared to walking around aimlessly, this was still more assured and reliable.

Ling Han’s consciousness continuously surged into the depths of the ground. There was also Imperial Might here, but it was not as violent as the surface, allowing his consciousness to penetrate deeper.
However, this still very quickly reached its limit, and was far from reaching the core of the planet.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before diving into the ground and charging toward the core.

However, though this underground layer was slightly weaker, the ground had been heavily tempered by the Imperial Might, so it was incredibly sturdy. Even if it couldn’t compare to the Primitive Abyss, it still had a great restriction on Ling Han.
Ling Han advanced with great difficulty.

chapters.title: Chapter 4734: Reviving a star
paragraphs: Ling Han burrowed into the ground, and slowly ventured deeper.
If it was other people besides him, there was no one else that could do it.
The same was true for the Skeleton Saint Tool. In terms of destructive power alone, Ling Han was definitely the strongest beneath the level of Great Emperor.
The Destructive Energy and the light of great dao unleashed their might together, and he could even easily destroy the Saintly Material. What kind of concept was that?
Of course, this was incomparable to a Great Emperor.
Ling Han could see clearly from the memories of the Blood Sea Empress. She had easily carved words in the imperial palace, but what about him?
But now, Ling Han could guarantee that as long as a Lord of Death didn’t appear, no one could compare to his destructive power.
He cleared a path, and finally arrived at the core of the planet.
All right, let’s begin!
Ling Han sat down on his knees, beginning to revive this planet.
Boom! He unleashed his divine sense, which surged toward the core of the planet like a vast ocean.
This was a dead star. It had died a very, very long time ago.
Was it because of the Imperial Might?
Ling Han carefully sensed for a while, and thought that it was, but also wasn’t.
This star had indeed been killed by Emperor-level power. However, before this, there were a few other powers protecting this star. These were all Emperor-level powers.

One after another, the Divine Beasts that had died here did not destroy this star. On the contrary, before they died, they were still using their own power to protect it, but at some unknown time, another Emperor-level existence had arrived here, causing destruction.
Even after countless years had passed, there was still surplus of this destructive Emperor-level power. Furthermore, it was incredibly powerful.

Ling Han was now qualified to come into contact with the level of Great Emperor. He could say with certainty that this Imperial Might was stronger than the True Dragon Emperor in the Primitive Abyss, and stronger than the Lords of Death that had moved previously.

Of course, there was definitely something wrong with the True Dragon Emperor, and the Lords of Death couldn’t use their full strength either. Thus, Ling Han was still unable to make a direct judgement.
It could only be said that this Emperor-level existence was very strong.
Why did the Divine Beasts want to protect this planet, but why was there a Great Emperor that wanted to destroy it?
Divine Beast?
There were also "revived" Divine Beasts in the Primitive Abyss. What was the connection between them?
Perhaps, after resurrecting this star, he would be able to find out the answer, or a clue, from the memory of the star.
Ling Han dared to give it a try because there were also countless stars in the dimensions inside his body.
The two couldn’t be compared, but Ling Han felt that with his power, he might be able to nurture this star, and then rebuild it from its destroyed state.
He released his own power, and attempted to make the dimensions inside him resonate with this star.
This was a long attempt, but Ling Han didn’t think that it was a waste of time, because in this process, he had also deepened his comprehension of the Power of Dimension.
After coming out of the Genesis World, he rarely paid attention to his dimensions anymore. He only knew that they could help him break through, reaching one limit after another.
But compared with the great universe outside, everything inside him were too weak.
When Heavenly Venerates appeared, they were as powerless as a newborn infant. Any kind of Heavenly Venerable Tier-level Spirit Tool would be worth less than dirt in this great universe outside.
But now, when Ling Han discovered that he could accommodate the stars of the great universe, he had another thought.
Could he take out the dimensions in his body and turn them into a part of this universe?

It should be known that dimensions were actually even stronger than Heavenly Venerable Tier. If dimensions were taken out one after another, wouldn’t they be able to avoid being crushed into dust by the great universe?
Of course, after it was taken out, how the dimensions would develop would be another problem.
Ling Han was instantly distracted, but he quickly pulled himself back together.
This... he would consider it in the future. He had best think about how he was going to revive this planet.
Perhaps, even a Great Emperor would not be able to bring a star back to life, but because of the Genesis World in Ling Han’s body, it was possible for him to do so.

Of course, Ding Shu and the others could do the same. However, their battle prowess was inferior to Ling Han, so it was impossible for them to reach where the core was. Thus, this possibility was also ruled out.
Ling Han extracted the Power of Dimension from within his body and poured it into the core. At the same time, he also released the power of the stars in an attempt to resonate with this core.
Three months passed in a row, and the core was still lifeless, and there was no change at all.

However, Ling Han didn’t turn around and abandon it. Firstly, he believed that this would definitely take a long time, and secondly, this would allow him to have a deeper and deeper understanding of the use of the Power of Dimensions. It would still be greatly beneficial.
Another three months, another half year, and Ling Han continued to inject energy into the core. All of a sudden, he received a feedback signal. Though it was extremely weak, it had indeed happened.
He couldn’t help but feel energized. Was the willpower of the planet about to awaken?
Continue.
Ling Han continued to inject more energy. This time, he was still paying close attention to how the regeneration process of the planet was like.

Another half year passed, and the reaction of the star became more and more intense. However, for the moment, it was impossible for the star to be greatly improved. After all, after being in a state of "death" for such a long time, if it suddenly came back to life, it would still be severely injured, right?
Next, it was time for the planet to slowly awaken.

It didn’t matter. Since the star had been revived, the ley lines could definitely be used, just like the meridians of the human body. No matter how weak they were, they could still allow blood to flow.
He spread his consciousness through the ley lines, thereby allowing him to observe this entire planet.

He first saw Brother Monkey, the empress, and the others. Thankfully, all of them were fine, but now, there were also a great many Imperial Sons from the Lands of Death, and they even brought the Skeleton Saint Tools with them. They were invincible. If they encountered them, Brother Monkey and the others, as well as the great Imperial Clans, could only retreat.
For the moment... it wasn’t a big deal.
Ling Han decided to go out later and ruthlessly deal with those Skeleton Saint Tools. Right now, the most important thing was to find the location of the Natural-born Gold Spirit.
This was too important, and definitely could not fall into the hands of the Lands of Death.
Yi?
Ling Han determined a location. This place was permeated with a powerful imperial might, and where it was the densest on the entire planet.
Was this where the Divine Beasts had died?
Because the Imperial Might here was too strong, Ling Han’s consciousness could only sense this place, but could not glimpse the exact details. Thus, he decided to directly head over to take a look.
Star Steps was not applicable here, because the star had just awakened. The power of the ley lines was too fragile, and he could not arrive instantaneously.
Ling Han exited the core, and went to find the empress and the others first.
He could now contact the ley lines to locate everyone at any time. Thus, he didn’t spend too much time to find everyone.
Of course, he would not inform the other Imperial Clans. Instead of fighting over the Natural-born Gold Spirit, which would be unpleasant, it would be better not to let them know.

"Little Han, hurry up and help Grandpa Dog get back his pride!" When he found the large black dog, the large black dog’s iron underwear actually split open, "There’s a pervert Sketon Saint Tool that actually wants to r@pe Grandpa Dog’s a**!"
Er, you’re overthinking things, aren’t you? How could a Skeleton Saint Tool have this kind of fetish? It just happened to hit that place.
Ling Han shook his head, "Let’s go find the Natural-born Gold Spirit first."
This was the most important thing at present.

But now, Ling Han could guarantee that as long as a Lord of Death didn’t appear, no one could compare to his destructive power.
He cleared a path, and finally arrived at the core of the planet.
All right, let’s begin!
Ling Han sat down on his knees, beginning to revive this planet.
Boom!
He unleashed his divine sense, which surged toward the core of the planet like a vast ocean.
This was a dead star.
It had died a very, very long time ago.
Was it because of the Imperial Might?
Ling Han carefully sensed for a while, and thought that it was, but also wasn’t.
This star had indeed been killed by Emperor-level power.
However, before this, there were a few other powers protecting this star.
These were all Emperor-level powers.
One after another, the Divine Beasts that had died here did not destroy this star.
On the contrary, before they died, they were still using their own power to protect it, but at some unknown time, another Emperor-level existence had arrived here, causing destruction.
Even after countless years had passed, there was still surplus of this destructive Emperor-level power.
Furthermore, it was incredibly powerful.
Ling Han was now qualified to come into contact with the level of Great Emperor.
He could say with certainty that this Imperial Might was stronger than the True Dragon Emperor in the Primitive Abyss, and stronger than the Lords of Death that had moved previously.
Of course, there was definitely something wrong with the True Dragon Emperor, and the Lords of Death couldn’t use their full strength either.
Thus, Ling Han was still unable to make a direct judgement.
It could only be said that this Emperor-level existence was very strong.
Why did the Divine Beasts want to protect this planet, but why was there a Great Emperor that wanted to destroy it?
Divine Beast?
There were also "revived" Divine Beasts in the Primitive Abyss.
What was the connection between them?
Perhaps, after resurrecting this star, he would be able to find out the answer, or a clue, from the memory of the star.
Ling Han dared to give it a try because there were also countless stars in the dimensions inside his body.
The two couldn’t be compared, but Ling Han felt that with his power, he might be able to nurture this star, and then rebuild it from its destroyed state.
He released his own power, and attempted to make the dimensions inside him resonate with this star.
This was a long attempt, but Ling Han didn’t think that it was a waste of time, because in this process, he had also deepened his comprehension of the Power of Dimension.
After coming out of the Genesis World, he rarely paid attention to his dimensions anymore.
He only knew that they could help him break through, reaching one limit after another.
But compared with the great universe outside, everything inside him were too weak.
When Heavenly Venerates appeared, they were as powerless as a newborn infant.
Any kind of Heavenly Venerable Tier-level Spirit Tool would be worth less than dirt in this great universe outside.
But now, when Ling Han discovered that he could accommodate the stars of the great universe, he had another thought.
Could he take out the dimensions in his body and turn them into a part of this universe?
It should be known that dimensions were actually even stronger than Heavenly Venerable Tier.
If dimensions were taken out one after another, wouldn’t they be able to avoid being crushed into dust by the great universe?
Of course, after it was taken out, how the dimensions would develop would be another problem.
Ling Han was instantly distracted, but he quickly pulled himself back together.
This... he would consider it in the future.
He had best think about how he was going to revive this planet.
Perhaps, even a Great Emperor would not be able to bring a star back to life, but because of the Genesis World in Ling Han’s body, it was possible for him to do so.
Of course, Ding Shu and the others could do the same.
However, their battle prowess was inferior to Ling Han, so it was impossible for them to reach where the core was.
Thus, this possibility was also ruled out.
Ling Han extracted the Power of Dimension from within his body and poured it into the core.
At the same time, he also released the power of the stars in an attempt to resonate with this core.
Three months passed in a row, and the core was still lifeless, and there was no change at all.
However, Ling Han didn’t turn around and abandon it.
Firstly, he believed that this would definitely take a long time, and secondly, this would allow him to have a deeper and deeper understanding of the use of the Power of Dimensions.
It would still be greatly beneficial.
Another three months, another half year, and Ling Han continued to inject energy into the core.
All of a sudden, he received a feedback signal.
Though it was extremely weak, it had indeed happened.
He couldn’t help but feel energized.
Was the willpower of the planet about to awaken?
Continue.
Ling Han continued to inject more energy.
This time, he was still paying close attention to how the regeneration process of the planet was like.
Another half year passed, and the reaction of the star became more and more intense.
However, for the moment, it was impossible for the star to be greatly improved.
After all, after being in a state of "death" for such a long time, if it suddenly came back to life, it would still be severely injured, right?
Next, it was time for the planet to slowly awaken.
It didn’t matter.
Since the star had been revived, the ley lines could definitely be used, just like the meridians of the human body.
No matter how weak they were, they could still allow blood to flow.
He spread his consciousness through the ley lines, thereby allowing him to observe this entire planet.
He first saw Brother Monkey, the empress, and the others.
Thankfully, all of them were fine, but now, there were also a great many Imperial Sons from the Lands of Death, and they even brought the Skeleton Saint Tools with them.
They were invincible.
If they encountered them, Brother Monkey and the others, as well as the great Imperial Clans, could only retreat.
For the moment... it wasn’t a big deal.
Ling Han decided to go out later and ruthlessly deal with those Skeleton Saint Tools.
Right now, the most important thing was to find the location of the Natural-born Gold Spirit.
This was too important, and definitely could not fall into the hands of the Lands of Death.
Yi?
Ling Han determined a location.
This place was permeated with a powerful imperial might, and where it was the densest on the entire planet.
Was this where the Divine Beasts had died?
Because the Imperial Might here was too strong, Ling Han’s consciousness could only sense this place, but could not glimpse the exact details.
Thus, he decided to directly head over to take a look.
Star Steps was not applicable here, because the star had just awakened.
The power of the ley lines was too fragile, and he could not arrive instantaneously.
Ling Han exited the core, and went to find the empress and the others first.
He could now contact the ley lines to locate everyone at any time.
Thus, he didn’t spend too much time to find everyone.
Of course, he would not inform the other Imperial Clans.
Instead of fighting over the Natural-born Gold Spirit, which would be unpleasant, it would be better not to let them know.

"Little Han, hurry up and help Grandpa Dog get back his pride!" When he found the large black dog, the large black dog’s iron underwear actually split open, "There’s a pervert Sketon Saint Tool that actually wants to r@pe Grandpa Dog’s a**!"
Er, you’re overthinking things, aren’t you?
How could a Skeleton Saint Tool have this kind of fetish?
It just happened to hit that place.
Ling Han shook his head, "Let’s go find the Natural-born Gold Spirit first."
This was the most important thing at present.

chapters.title: Chapter 4735: Encountering Tong Ming again
paragraphs: Ling Han didn’t find the three Pseudo-Emperors.

It wasn’t that Buddha Doga and the others hadn’t arrived, but rather that Pseudo-Emperors were too strong, and they had their own means to conceal their traces. And Ling Han wanted to use the weak ley lines to locate them?
How was this possible!
However, Ling Han didn’t need to worry about the three of them. As powerful as Pseudo-Emperors were, who could suppress them if a Great Emperor did not appear?
Ling Han led the way, bringing the others with him as they advanced.
Their speed wasn’t fast, but under the premise that they didn’t have to take a detour, it would only be a matter of time before they reached their destination.
When they found out about Ling Han’s grand feat of reviving the star, everyone was stunned.
Something like that was possible?
"Going by that logic, as long as Little Han is still alive, even if the entire Living Realm is controlled by the Yin souls, we can still revive planet after planet, and take back the lost territory!"
This was naturally the last resort, yet it left a path of retreat for the entire universe.
If Ling Han didn’t die, the Living Realm would not be destroyed.
’Hmm?’
Ling Han suddenly stopped in his tracks and looked in another direction.
"What is it?" the empress asked. With Ling Han’s personality, when he decided to do something, it was definitely impossible for him to retreat halfway. Thus, he must have discovered something.
Ling Han smiled, and looked towards the large black dog, "Do you want revenge?"
With how smart the large black dog was, he immediately asked, "You discovered an Imperial Son of the Lands of Death?"
Ling Han nodded in understanding.
"Let’s go, let’s go, let’s f*ck him up!" The large black dog looked at his slightly cracked iron underwear, and his expression immediately became one of grief and indignation.
Want to r@pe Grandpa Dog’s a**?

"Hold on!" The large black dog waved his hand again, "All of you, don’t move. Grandpa Dog will go alone. It would be fine as long as Little Han secretly listens to Grandpa Dog’s commands, and attacks wherever I point and just protect Grandpa Dog."
After suffering such great humiliation, and almost being r@ped, the large black dog naturally wanted to exact revenge.
Was there any meaning to taking revenge and not showing off while he was at it?

Ling Han smiled. Though time was tight, the large black dog had suffered a great loss. If he did not allow it to take revenge, this guy would definitely not be able to think straight, and would continue to cause trouble.
Alright, it shouldn’t waste too much time.
The large black dog dashed out in a flash, running in the direction that Ling Han pointed at. His speed wasn’t fast, and if he was fast, that would be courting death.
It had not walked too far, when two people appeared ahead of it.
To say that there were two, it was actually not very appropriate, because one was indeed human, but in the case of the other, it was a skeletal monster as tall as three hundred meters.
An Imperial Son of the Lands of Death, Tong Ming, and a Skeleton Saint Tool.
After discovering the large black dog, Tong Ming couldn’t help but sneer.
It was this despicable dog.
If Ling Han’s potential threat to the Lands of Death was the greatest, the mouth of the large black dog was truly a magnet for trouble.
The number one despicable Saint of all eternity, he truly lived up to his name.

Tong Ming sneered, and said, "Damn dog, you’re truly unlucky. You actually ran head-first into the hands of this Imperial Son!" Tong Ming sneered. To say nothing of the fact that he still had the Skeleton Saint Tool by his side, even if he were alone, he would still have more than enough power to suppress this despicable dog.
Just how freakish was the son of a Great Emperor? He was only inferior to a freak like Ling Han.
The large black dog was filled with arrogance. He was confident now, so what did he have to fear?
"Little Ming, did you forget to brush your teeth today, or did you eat sh*t? Why is your mouth so smelly?"
Tong Ming was rendered speechless. ’Just how smelly is your own mouth? Don’t you have any estimates?’
He was actually making false accusations. As expected of the Despicable Saint.

He had the intention to kill the large black dog, so that Ling Han’s side would have one less "great weapon". After all, the large black dog’s verbal attacks were still quite threatening, as they could infuriate people and greatly affect their emotions.
Thus, he was in no rush to attack. Instead, he wanted to stabilize the large black dog first, while he had the Skeleton Saint Tool move behind the large black dog, cutting off his path of retreat.
Then, they would pincer attack from both sides, and the large black dog would definitely be killed.

He deliberately chatted idly with the large black dog, and the large black dog was also extremely cooperative, bickering with the latter. In any case, when it came to strength in this area, if it was ranked second, neither the little azure dragon nor Ling Han would dare claim to be first.
Though it had only been a few words, Tong Ming was still so furious that he almost exploded. Who asked him to speak to the large black dog?
However, the Skeleton Saint Tool had already moved into position for a pincer attack.
Very good, there was no need to tolerate this despicable dog any longer.
"From today onwards, you are a dead dog," he announced.

"Pei, Grandpa Dog won’t die today, and won’t die tomorrow either. Even after you die for a million years, Grandpa Dog will still be alive and well. Every year, Grandpa Dog will come to your grave to see you, take a piss, and fertilize the grass on your grave." How could the large black dog show weakness? He immediately returned the favor twice over.
Tong Ming grimaced upon hearing this. ’F*ck! If I speak too much, I’ll definitely suffer internal injuries!’
"Die!" He launched an attack at the large black dog.
Boom, his battle prowess was completely unleashed, turning into a Demonic Sunflower that soared into the skies. It stretched out its vines, and charged towards the large black dog.
The large black dog did not move to parry. Instead, he placed his two front paws behind his back, "Humph, disperse!"
As his words fell, with a bang, the Demonic Sunflower actually exploded.

Tong Ming was slightly depressed. This place was filled with the aura of Great Emperors and it had already solidified. Thus, when he attacked from afar, he would naturally come into contact with this aura of Great Emperors, and directly disintegrate his attack.
However, he was still a little confused. He had clearly tried his best to avoid it.
It was fine. If he missed with a single strike, he would just attack again. At present, he had completely taken the initiative.
Tong Ming unleashed another attack. It was still a Demonic Sunflower, and it shot toward the large black dog.
"Heaven and earth have their own Dao, so how can it be disturbed!" The large black dog was extremely forceful, and stretched out a paw, waving it lightly, "Grandpa Dog commands to disperse!"
Peng, the Demonic Sunflower exploded again.
’F*ck!’
Tong Ming’s eyes widened in shock. How could there be such a coincidence?
Just then, another streak of aura of Great Emperors had slightly veered off course. In the end, his attack had collided into it, and was naturally dispersed again.
But the problem was, why was it so coincidental?

Furthermore, this despicable dog was also taking things a bit too calmly. Could it be that he did not know that his strength was far superior to his? Furthermore, as a Saint, er, even if he was the greatest despicable Saint in history, he should have basic observation skills.
’Aren’t you curious where the Skeleton Saint Tool beside me went?’
He frowned. He couldn’t drag things out for too long.
Tong Ming closed in on him. He was going to close the distance between them before making his move. In that way, the aura of Great Emperors would no longer be a disturbance.
He strode forward, drawing closer and closer to the large black dog.
"Humph, how could a piece of trash like you be able to imagine my might?" The large black dog extended a paw, "Kneel down!"
"Let—" He had not even finished his words, when Tong Ming felt a terrifying power surge towards him, causing his legs to go out of control completely. With a pa, he knelt down.
W-what!
His tongue almost fell out of his mouth. The large black dog had such terrifying abilities?
F***, could it be that you are the true king of concealment?
He hurriedly sent out a signal to summon the Skeleton Saint Tool over. This was a deadly weapon that could sweep aside all the Saints in the world.
Yi?
Where was the Skeleton Saint Tool?
Why was there no response to his summons?

Just how powerful was the large black dog’s ability to read expressions? He immediately sneered, "Still counting on that skeletal monster? Humph, do you think I don’t know that it has circled around to the back? I have dealt with it long ago."

chapters.title: Chapter 4736: Where are the Divine Beast corpses?
paragraphs: Tong Ming definitely didn’t believe the large black dog’s words. However, the problem was that his connection with the Skeleton Saint Tool had indeed been severed.
Hiss, could it be that this despicable dog was really the hidden trump card of Ling Han’s team?
Actually, Ling Han was only a secondary carriage that had been pushed onto the stage to attract attention. The main force was this despicable dog?
No, no, no!
Tong Ming hurriedly said to himself, ’I must be overthinking things.’
With how terrifying Ling Han was, he was already the greatest freak in history. How could this guy be even more freakish?
Could it be?
He was suddenly startled, and looked around.

"Sunflower boy, hurry up and return to your original form. I want to munch on a few sunflower seeds. En, it would be nice if they could be used to produce oil to cook dishes," the large black dog snickered.
’I’m a member of the Demonic Sunflower Race, and my father is a Great Emperor. Yet, you actually dare to tease me like this?’
Tong Ming took a deep breath, then said loudly, "Ling Han, I know you’re here, so why hide?"
After a loud shout, there was no reaction from the surroundings. It was completely silent.
"Sunflower boy, you dare to look down on Grandpa Dog?" The large black dog howled as he strode toward Tong Ming.
However, even if he looked very furious, his expression couldn’t hide its smugness. Just look at how light his four legs were.

Tong Ming wore an expression of grief and indignation. He was the son of a Great Emperor, and he was more so a six-star Saint. Now, however, he was actually kneeling before a despicable dog. If news of this spread, how could he face others?
Furthermore, with this kind of humiliation, he would definitely be left with a knot in his heart, so how was he supposed to break through to attain the imperial throne?

"Who asked you to covet Grandpa Dog’s a**!" The large black dog approached, and delivered a slap. Pa, it was crisp and loud, but it immediately bared its teeth, "F***, is your skin as strong as the city wall? It’s really hard and thick!"
Tong Ming only wanted to vomit blood. As the son of a Great Emperor, the resources he received were naturally incredibly astonishing. His physique was definitely quite awesome.
But the problem was, to cause pain to the hand that had slapped him, was this his f****** original intention when he had tempered his physique?
Furthermore, who would f****** covet your a*s?
Tong Ming believed that he had never cursed as much in the first half of his life as he did at this moment.
The large black dog’s ability to destroy one’s composure was definitely the highest of the highest grade.

"Look, Grandpa Dog’s underpants have all been torn apart by you guys. You’re practically perverts!" The large black dog pointed at his shiny iron underpants, then squirmed again, "Even if Grandpa Dog agrees, you guys have to be gentler, understand!"
Pu!

Tong Ming couldn’t help but throw up blood. He was kneeling in front of the large black dog, and it was already humiliating enough for him to be slapped by the latter. Now, he had to suffer such false accusations, and have such dirty water poured on his reputation?
It was already good enough that he had not died from fury.
The large black dog was extremely smug. His philosophy was to disgust others to death, and now he finally felt like he had gotten his revenge, which was incredibly satisfying.
"Grandpa Dog will send you on your way!" He stretched out a paw, and delivered a palm strike at Tong Ming.
Tong Ming wanted to resist, yet he couldn’t move at all.
So what if he was a six-star Saint? In a situation when he could not resist, how could he match another Saint?
Peng, with this strike, he actually did not die. Only a large bump had appeared on his forehead.
The toughness of his physique was also quite shocking.
After all, he was the son of a Great Emperor.
The large black dog started to pummel Tong Ming again. However, this only caused Tong Ming to suffer a few more bumps.
It bared its teeth, rubbed its paws, and cried out, "Little Han, it’s better that you do it. This guy’s head is like it was made of Saintly Material, and this pounding is hurting Grandpa Dog’s paw."
Xiu, Ling Han’s figure appeared.

Tong Ming’s vision was already blurred, yet he still managed to witness this scene. Sure enough, and this was his last thought in his life. Peng! With a single strike from Ling Han, his spirit was obliterated.
The large black dog hurriedly went to capture Tong Ming’s holy flame. This was an enemy, so he had no scruples.
Ling Han didn’t stop him. He wouldn’t use this method to increase his cultivation level, but he wouldn’t stop the large black dog either.
Now that the whole universe was in great danger, everyone by his side needed to quickly become stronger.
After the large black dog refined Tong Ming’s holy flame, the two of them returned to the team and continued to advance.
However, though the large black dog had refined the holy flame of a six-star Saint, it had not allowed it to advance another step further, and break through to become a five-star Saint.

After all, this wasn’t something that he had cultivated himself. There was the problem of conversion rate, but no matter what, he was still the son of a Great Emperor, so his improvement was still obvious.

Afterwards, they did not encounter any other Imperial Sons from the other Lands of Death. Instead, they discovered a few Imperial Clans, but they circled around them in advance, and did not meet up with them.
Since they were allies, and the Natural-born Gold Spirit was something that could only be obtained by one party, it was best not to move together, to avoid damaging the harmony between them.
After walking for a few more days, they finally arrived at a hidden location.

This entrance really wasn’t too obvious. If Ling Han hadn’t sensed this place through the ley lines, he probably wouldn’t have come straight here. He would have to search the entire planet several times before he could discover this place.
Not long after entering, they immediately sensed that the might of Great Emperors had become stronger.
They were close to the Divine Beast Graveyard.
Everyone was a little excited. After all, not many people had seen a Great Emperor-level corpse before.
Only Hu Niu began to drool. If it was a Divine Beast, its meat should not be too bad, and should taste very delicious.
However, after so many years, would the texture become worse?
This made her feel very conflicted, and her pretty face wrinkled into a frown.
After another while, the great Imperial Might became considerably stronger.
Ling Han frowned, "Something’s not right."
"What’s wrong?" everyone asked.

Ling Han pondered for a moment, "The extent of the increase in pressure from this Imperial Might gives me a feeling of illogicality. Logically speaking, we have already travelled for so long, so the pressure from this Imperial Might should be so strong that a considerable number of people would not be able to advance further."
But in truth, though it was a little difficult for everyone to advance now, it was not too much of a burden.

"Little Han, you’re a well-fed man who doesn’t know how hungry others are. Don’t you know that Grandpa Dog and the others are about to become as tired as pigs?" the large black dog said with his tongue sticking out. This might was extremely terrifying, all right?
Ling Han smiled. He was only relating his own judgement.
"There must be something strange going on here. Everyone, be careful." He led the way ahead.
After another long time, the path ahead of them suddenly opened up.
"This is—"
"Divine Beast Graveyard?"
When everyone saw this, they were all dumbfounded. This was not the Divine Beast Graveyard, but rather an empty plain, all right?
Could it be that this place was just a pretense, and the Divine Beast Graveyard was not here?

Ling Han shook his head, and said, "Here, here, here, and here. There are all clear signs of depression. Moreover, the Imperial Might is permeating into the surroundings, so even I find it extremely difficult to approach."
He paused, then continued, "Thus, I can confirm that those Divine Beasts had indeed died here."
"Then... what about the Divine Beast corpses?" Everyone was completely confused.
Would the Divine Beast corpses disappear into thin air?
Or had the corpses turned into zombies?
Or had they encountered grave robbers?
Er, if they had been stolen, then what cultivation level did this culprit have?
At least, Pseudo-Emperor.

sentences.text: Tong Ming definitely didn’t believe the large black dog’s words.
However, the problem was that his connection with the Skeleton Saint Tool had indeed been severed.
Hiss, could it be that this despicable dog was really the hidden trump card of Ling Han’s team?
Actually, Ling Han was only a secondary carriage that had been pushed onto the stage to attract attention.
The main force was this despicable dog?
No, no, no!
Tong Ming hurriedly said to himself, ’I must be overthinking things.’
With how terrifying Ling Han was, he was already the greatest freak in history.
How could this guy be even more freakish?
Could it be?
He was suddenly startled, and looked around.
"Sunflower boy, hurry up and return to your original form.
I want to munch on a few sunflower seeds.
En, it would be nice if they could be used to produce oil to cook dishes," the large black dog snickered.
’I’m a member of the Demonic Sunflower Race, and my father is a Great Emperor.
Yet, you actually dare to tease me like this?’
Tong Ming took a deep breath, then said loudly, "Ling Han, I know you’re here, so why hide?"
After a loud shout, there was no reaction from the surroundings.
It was completely silent.
"Sunflower boy, you dare to look down on Grandpa Dog?" The large black dog howled as he strode toward Tong Ming.
However, even if he looked very furious, his expression couldn’t hide its smugness.
Just look at how light his four legs were.
Tong Ming wore an expression of grief and indignation.
He was the son of a Great Emperor, and he was more so a six-star Saint.
Now, however, he was actually kneeling before a despicable dog.
If news of this spread, how could he face others?
Furthermore, with this kind of humiliation, he would definitely be left with a knot in his heart, so how was he supposed to break through to attain the imperial throne?
"Who asked you to covet Grandpa Dog’s a**!" The large black dog approached, and delivered a slap.
Pa, it was crisp and loud, but it immediately bared its teeth, "F***, is your skin as strong as the city wall?
It’s really hard and thick!"
Tong Ming only wanted to vomit blood.
As the son of a Great Emperor, the resources he received were naturally incredibly astonishing.
His physique was definitely quite awesome.
But the problem was, to cause pain to the hand that had slapped him, was this his f****** original intention when he had tempered his physique?
Furthermore, who would f****** covet your a*s?
Tong Ming believed that he had never cursed as much in the first half of his life as he did at this moment.
The large black dog’s ability to destroy one’s composure was definitely the highest of the highest grade.
"Look, Grandpa Dog’s underpants have all been torn apart by you guys.
You’re practically perverts!" The large black dog pointed at his shiny iron underpants, then squirmed again, "Even if Grandpa Dog agrees, you guys have to be gentler, understand!"
Pu!
Tong Ming couldn’t help but throw up blood.
He was kneeling in front of the large black dog, and it was already humiliating enough for him to be slapped by the latter.
Now, he had to suffer such false accusations, and have such dirty water poured on his reputation?
It was already good enough that he had not died from fury.
The large black dog was extremely smug.
His philosophy was to disgust others to death, and now he finally felt like he had gotten his revenge, which was incredibly satisfying.
"Grandpa Dog will send you on your way!" He stretched out a paw, and delivered a palm strike at Tong Ming.
Tong Ming wanted to resist, yet he couldn’t move at all.
So what if he was a six-star Saint?
In a situation when he could not resist, how could he match another Saint?
Peng, with this strike, he actually did not die.
Only a large bump had appeared on his forehead.
The toughness of his physique was also quite shocking.
After all, he was the son of a Great Emperor.
The large black dog started to pummel Tong Ming again.
However, this only caused Tong Ming to suffer a few more bumps.
It bared its teeth, rubbed its paws, and cried out, "Little Han, it’s better that you do it.
This guy’s head is like it was made of Saintly Material, and this pounding is hurting Grandpa Dog’s paw."
Xiu, Ling Han’s figure appeared.
Tong Ming’s vision was already blurred, yet he still managed to witness this scene.
Sure enough, and this was his last thought in his life.
Peng!
With a single strike from Ling Han, his spirit was obliterated.
The large black dog hurriedly went to capture Tong Ming’s holy flame.
This was an enemy, so he had no scruples.
Ling Han didn’t stop him.
He wouldn’t use this method to increase his cultivation level, but he wouldn’t stop the large black dog either.
Now that the whole universe was in great danger, everyone by his side needed to quickly become stronger.
