chapters.title: Chapter 4737: Arrival of Netherworld troops
paragraphs: The scene before their eyes rendered them speechless.
They should have found the Divine Beast Graveyard, but where was the main thing?
Hu Niu was even more depressed. Did this mean that she would not be able to eat the Divine Beast meat that was promised? Niu was so disappointed.
Ling Han thought for a long time, then said, "Could it be that this is related to the appearance of new Divine Beasts in the Primitive Abyss?"
These Divine Beasts had come back to life, and had gone to the Primitive Abyss?

But that wasn’t right. The time for those new Divine Beasts from the Primitive Abyss to have appeared definitely wouldn’t have been too long. At least, it would be after the first life of Buddha Doga, and looking at this place, the passing of time left obvious traces. That definitely meant that no one had set foot here for tens of billions of years.
Though he did not know the exact times that changes had occured in this great universe, he was sure that it had far surpassed the first life of Buddha Doga.
Thus, the Divine Beast corses disappeared first, and the Buddha Doga appeared only after that.
This wasn’t right.
Could it be that the Divine Beasts that had previously revived were all focused on recuperating in the Primitive Abyss?
Ling Han felt that this world was becoming more and more confusing. There were too many things that could not be explained.
"Yi, what’s this?" the little azure dragon suddenly called out.

Everyone went over to take a look, and saw that there was a feather on the ground that was exuding a nine-coloured light. However, the light was not very bright, but if one stared closely, they would discover that this feather actually had the dense feeling that a star would have.
However, they couldn’t go too close. This was in a groove that a Divine Beast had left behind.
"Left behind by a Divine Beast?" Everyone guessed.
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower hovered above Ling Han’s head, and he continued forward.

When he entered into that groove, the Imperial Might turned directly into a sharp sword, that slashed out towards Ling Han. However, with the protection of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, the Imperial Might naturally could not pierce through. After all, this was only a remnant aura that had been left behind by a Divine Beast in the past.
Of course, this was also due to Ling Han’s strength. If it were any other Saint, they would definitely be sent flying.
Ling Han stretched out a hand to pick up that feather on the ground.
When the tip of his finger touched that feather, a majestic light flickered, turning into a massive Azure Phoenix that pounced towards Ling Han.
Peng!
This Azure Phoenix crashed into the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, instantly sending Ling Han flying along with the tower.
Ling Han fell heavily onto the ground, and that Azure Phoenix roared at the skies, turning into a soundwave that soared into space/.
At this moment, it was as if this Azure Phoenix had been revived, exuding the terrifying aura of a Great Emperor.
Everyone was stunned. A Great Emperor had come back to life?
Impossible. This was only a sliver of aura left behind on the feather. Perhaps, it had a sliver of the soul imprint of the Azure Phoenix, which allowed it to show its might.
However, this was only short-lived.
The problem was, even if this was only an instant of might, with how strong a Great Emperor was, wasn’t an instant enough to kill all of them?

The Azure Phoenix swept its eyes over the masses, and finally stopped on Ling Han. Xiu, it suddenly flew out, its figure rapidly shrinking, turning into a streak of light that rapidly pounced between Ling Han’s eyes.
This was too fast. Though the Azure Phoenix’s speed could not compare to the Phoenix, as a Divine Beast that was also a bird, it would not be much inferior either.
Thus, Ling Han didn’t even have the chance to block it. The streak of light had already disappeared.
"Ling Han!" Everyone hurriedly gathered around him.
"It’s fine!" Ling Han waved his hand, then an expression of shock appeared on his face, "This is the Azure Phoenix Divine Beast transmitting images to me."
He closed his eyes, and used his heart to memorize.
This was only a feather, and it was left behind by the Azure Phoenix after its death, so its memory was naturally limited.

He had only seen a single scene. The Azure Phoenix Divine Beast, Black Tortoise Divine Beast, the Crimson Ape Divine Beast, and the other Divine Beasts were all resting here, but suddenly, a gigantic Divine Beast whose shape could not be described barged in.
The scene came to an abrupt stop at this point.
Ling Han frowned. He had never seen such a Divine Beast before.

Though after the first-generation Divine Beasts died, their children were no longer able to break through to Great Emperor-level, they would more or less have some descendants. It was just that their bloodline was impure, and their appearance would be slightly different from their ancestors.
However, Ling Han could guarantee that in later generations, there were definitely no ferocious beast or Demonic Beast that looked similar to the Divine Beast that he had just seen.
Putting aside the identity of this Divine Beast, why would the Azure Phoenix remember this scene?
At that time, the Azure Phoenix should have already died. Could it be that she had a premonition, and that was why she had left this backup plan?
Had this unknown Divine Beast barged in here and stolen the Divine Beast corpses?
What was he aiming for?
’Because they were delicious?’
F***, it wasn’t Hu Niu, that little girl.
And was this related to the appearance of the new Divine Beasts at the Primitive Abyss?
Ling Han felt that this was possible. The Primitive Abyss had existed since ancient times. Perhaps, some Divine Beasts had long since gone there to seek immortality.
He related the scene he had seen and his own deductions, which surprised everyone.

Stealing corpses, and stealing the corpses of Divine Beasts at that. This was something that only a Divine Beast that was similarly a Great Emperor-level existence could do. This was practically inconceivable.
Just look, generation after generation of Great Emperors had appeared in history. Who would dig up the graves of the ancestors of those Great Emperors before them?
What kind of Divine Beast was that? It was really too tasteless.
Combined with the Primitive Abyss, the disappearance of the Divine Beast corpses became even stranger.
Everyone was discussing intensely, and Ling Han sat down in a cross-legged position. He thought that the Natural-born Gold Spirit was very likely to be hidden here, so he wanted to try communicating.
He released his divine sense, which transformed into a net.
Ling Han swept it over and over again, yet he didn’t detect any fluctuation from the Natural-born Gold Spirit.
No.
Ling Han suddenly changed his mind. He activated the light of great dao in his mind, sweeping through the ground.
Yi?
He suddenly received a response, but it was very vague. It was like an infant that had just been born. It did not know how to speak at all, and only knew how to bawl.
Was it the Natural-born Gold Spirit?
Ling Han was instantly energized, and hurriedly continued to communicate with it, exuding a kind intent.
His light of great dao and Natural-born Gold Spirit had both originated from the Primitive Abyss, so it was very normal for them to resonate.
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. He was extremely patient.
Time continued to pass. The Natural-born Gold Spirit was like a small dog that had developed a dependence on him.
Boom!
Right at this moment, a terrifying sound rang out, and a large hole actually appeared in the skies, through which a Yin River flowed.
Hiss, the master of the Yin River!

In the Yin River, the Saint corpses were like fishesthat had been caught in a net, flickering and flopping. Meanwhile, Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters like Li Dangping, Feng Miaoling and the others all stepped on the Yin River as they arrived. There were also numerous Skeleton Saint Tools flying down.
The Netherworld army had arrived!
’This... What can I do?’
Though Ling Han alone could defeat the Skeleton Saint Tools and Imperial Sons, Imperial Daughters, wasn’t it obvious that the master of the Yin River was also here?
If the Great Emperor made a move, what else could Ling Han do aside from running?
"Charge!" At this moment, Li Dangping and the others all shouted loudly. They controlled the Skeleton Saint Tools to charge towards Ling Han and the others.
Ling Han humphed. If the Master of the Yin River didn’t make a move, what did he have to fear?
Boom!
He unleashed the Destructive Energy and the light of great dao. Now that a powerful enemy was bearing down on him, he had to give it his all.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
He alone could hold his own against an army of ten thousand.

chapters.title: Chapter 4738: Great Emperors battle
paragraphs: Ling Han was like a pillar of support. No matter who attacked him, he would remain unmoved.
Brother Monkey and the others also pounced out one after another, battling fiercely with those Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters.
Both sides were going all out. Sooner or later, they would battle.
However, the side of the Netherworld was brimming with confidence. This was because they had a Great Emperor on standby.

However, this couldn’t change Ling Han’s domineering nature. He continued to push forward, and not only did he force the Skeleton Saint Tools to retreat, but he even destroyed many of them. Not only that, but he even ensured the safety of the empress and the others.
Boom!
Right at this moment, the skies shattered once more, and a massive claw stretched out, landing directly on the ground.
A terrifying Imperial Might spread out, boundlessly terrifying.
Hiss, a Great Emperor had moved!
Hold on.
Ling Han was surprised. This claw looked very familiar. ’F*ck, it’s that guy from the Primitive Abyss.’
The True Dragon Emperor!
F***, this guy actually chased after him?
That’s not right. If this Great Emperor wanted to pursue him, shouldn’t he have chased out after him long ago? Why would he be so late?
Moreover, this attack clearly wasn’t aimed at him, but... where the Natural-born Gold Spirit was located.
Not good, the True Dragon Emperor wasn’t here to hunt him down. Instead, he was targeting the Natural-born Gold Spirit.

However... the Great Emperor was invincible in the world, and it was obvious that the True Dragon Emperor wasn’t like the Lord of Death, who would have reservations when attacking. Thus, did this Great Emperor need a manifestation that was Pseudo-Emperor-level?
All of a sudden, Ling Han’s mind was filled with a myriad of thoughts. He had never thought that even an existence from the Primitive Abyss would interfere.

Yi, this might not be a bad thing. The Master of Yin River was also here for the Natural-born Gold Spirit. so he obviously couldn’t just stand by and watch as the Natural-born Gold Spirit was snatched away. He would definitely move to stop it.

It should be known that no matter which Great Emperor made a move, others would not have the right to interfere, but the clash between the two Great Emperors gave Ling Han a chance to pluck chestnuts out of the <anno data-annotation-id="f40bb8e3-59aa-4ac3-8b2c-975232794174" data-title="fire">fire1</anno>.
"Humph!" A cold humph rang out from the Yin River. Then, a large hand formed from the river water stretched out, and struck out at the True Dragon’s claw.
Boom!
The two Great Emperors exchanged blows through the air, and a terrifying imperial might instantly surged. No one could withstand it, and they hurriedly retreated.
Ling Han also drew the Clear Bamboo Sword, covering everyone’s retreat.
Of course, they couldn’t fight now. F*ck! Two Great Emperors were attacking, so who wanted to die so badly?
"Impossible!" the little azure dragon murmured. He sensed a powerful dragon’s presence, similar to his bloodline.
This was his father?
But the old True Dragon had clearly died!
"No!" The little azure dragon immediately revealed a fierce expression. "This aura isn’t right. It’s obviously very similar to my father, but it’s definitely not my father!"
He raised his voice, and shouted at the skies, "You are definitely not the first generation True Dragon. Who exactly are you, and why are you impersonating my father!"
Boom!
In the skies, a giant green dragon appeared, baring its fangs and brandishing its claws, exuding an incredibly powerful aura.
"True Dragon!"
"How is this possible?!"
Ling Han and the others weren’t the only ones who were stunned. The side of the Lands of Death were also stunned.
The True Dragon had long since died, so how could it possibly still be alive now?

chapters.title: Chapter 4739: Repeated appearance of Great Emperors
paragraphs: In the end, the Natural-born Gold Spirit was still snatched away by the Lands of Death.
The large black dog and the others all wore expressions of regret. Now, the life of the Living Realm was going to be even more difficult.
Only Ling Han was an exception, because in the instant the Natural-born Gold Spirit was taken away, a thought or matter flew out of the Natural-born Gold Spirit and fused into his body.
For the moment, he hadn’t investigated it yet, because he was afraid that it would cause too much commotion and cause the Master of the Yin River to snatch it from him.
Now, it was time to flee.
"Retreat!" he commanded.
"Humph!" However, right at this moment, the Master of the Yin River moved, and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han.
Boom! The might of this strike soared sky-high, and Imperial Might blazed.
How was he supposed to block this?
The current battle prowess of the Master of the Yin River was probably already in its prime. Just now, he had easily defeated even the True Dragon Emperor. Just how strong was this battle prowess?
Ling Han hurriedly activated the Clear Bamboo Sword, and charged forward.
However, with this strike, the Clear Bamboo Sword was sent flying to the side. The attack of the Great Emperor was unstoppable, and was still descending down on Ling Han.
Was he done for?
Peng!
Three giant hands struck out at the same time, heading towards the master of the Yin River.
Boom, a terrifying shockwave reverberated, and the three giant hands immediately crumbled, but the attack of the Master of the Yin River was finally dispersed.
In the distance, three figures strode over.
Buddha Doga, Qian Yanghao, and... the old woodcutter, Xia Houping!

The Clear Bamboo Sword was still in the hands of Buddha Doga. It was clear that he had retrieved it when the Clear Bamboo Sword had been sent flying. This was because he knew the secret technique that controlled the Clear Bamboo Sword.
Hiss, the revival of the Imperial Weapon, along with the combined efforts of three Pseudo-Emperors only managed to block a single blow from the Master of the Yin River.
Impressive, this was really impressive. This was the true might of a Great Emperor!
Even if they were standing on opposing sides, everyone could not help but be impressed by the strength of the Master of the Yin River.

Now, the Master of the Yin River had obtained the Natural-born Gold Spirit, and as long as he refined it, he would be able to obtain another Pseudo-Emperor-level doppelganger. This was something that even Buddha Doga and the others would probably be extremely wary of.
"Great Emperor Senluo!" Xia Houping roared.
"Xia Hou, you’re not dead yet?" the Master of the Yin River asked calmly. He didn’t deny the name that Xia Houping had called him.
Alright, now they had found out the origins of a Lord of Death.
Great Emperor Senluo!
"The three of you want to protect this brat?" Great Emperor Senluo’s voice was still calm. That was the confidence of invincibility. Everything in this world was within his grasp.
"That’s right," Buddha Doga said as he brandished the Clear Bamboo Sword.
Great Emperor Senluo laughed loudly, "Since I have completely awakened, even if all of you join forces, how many moves can you block from me?"
"Enough to wear you down," Buddha Doga also said calmly.

Great Emperor Senluo was rendered speechless. He had destroyed his own life force, and his soul had transformed. In truth, he was no longer the invincible Great Emperor he had once been. Though he could awaken again, the time was extremely short.
Buddha Doga was right. If he made another move, though he could kill Buddha Doga and the other Pseudo-Emperors and Ling Han, he himself would have to pay a price that he couldn’t bear.
Having schemed for so long, yet all his efforts had come to nothing at this moment?
Of course not.
He only had to refine the Natural-born Gold Spirit into a doppelganger, and he would still be able to hunt down Ling Han.

"Humph!" With a wave of his hand, the Yin River surged, instantly sending Feng Miaoling and the other Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters away. Then, he took a deep breath, and instantly, the black mist that enshrouded him was sucked in, revealing a dried corpse.
This caused everyone to exclaim in shock. This was really too different from the image of the Great Emperor that they had in mind.
Only Ling Han was unmoved, because he had once witnessed the process of that Empress falling.
Great Emperor Senluo took another deep breath. This time, it was terrifying. A boundless suction force was generated.
Ling Han and the others could all feel their vitality draining away. In fact, even their souls were vibrating, as if they were about to be sucked out of their minds.

"Go!" Buddha Doga shouted loudly. He activated the Clear Bamboo Sword, severing the suction force of the oncoming attack. The other two Pseudo-Emperors tore a rip into the Void and pushed everyone inside.
In just an instant, Ling Han saw an endless stream of life essence surging towards Great Emperor Senluo, causing his shriveled body to immediately become enriched. A stalwart man appeared.
That aura was indescribably powerful!
Shua, the spatial fissure closed, and this Lord of Death could no longer be seen.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! On the other side, everyone came out of the Void one after another. They stood in space, and shockingly discovered that the surrounding stars had all become lifeless.
This wasn’t the territory of the Netherworld.
Great Emperor Senluo only took a deep breath. Even in such a far place, all life was still exterminated?
This was far too terrifying. This was the aura of a Great Emperor!
Everyone’s expressions were incredibly solemn. The Natural-born Gold Spirit had been obtained by a Lord of Death, which meant that the strength of the Netherworld would be greatly increased.
Though Ling Han had almost destroyed all the Skeleton Saint Tools, a Natural-born Gold Spirit could completely replace them. In fact, it would make the Netherworld even stronger.
It could be said that their trip had ended in a complete failure.
"Don’t be in a rush," Ling Han said. He had also obtained something from the Natural-born Gold Spirit. This was perhaps the most important thing.
Everyone was confused. Things had already come to this, so how could they not be anxious?
However, because Ling Han didn’t tell them the truth, they could only think that Ling Han was comforting them.
There was still hope for them, and that was for Ling Han to become a Great Emperor!
As long as Ling Han could become a Great Emperor, he would be able to conquer the world, and become the Number One Emperor of All Eternity.
Ling Han merely smiled. After they returned to Four Origin Planet, Ling Han immediately went into seclusion to figure out what he had obtained.
This was a ball of light, but it was tightly sealed. He had not been able to open it previously.
On the way, he was unable to concentrate fully.
Now, he finally had enough time and absolute silence.
He activated his divine sense and observed the orb of light in his mind. He then started to analyze it carefully.
The progress was very slow. Though the thing wrapped around this ball of light did not have strong destructive power, it was extremely tough, and Ling Han had to expend a lot of effort.
However, no matter how slow the progress was, as long as there was improvement, it was a good thing.
After about half a month, Ling Han finally succeeded.
Instantly, a consciousness emerged from the ball of light, turning into a heavy voice.
"If my deduction is correct, you must be the person who obtained the Origin Gold that I left behind."
Ling Han was instantly rendered speechless. This person was... the Great Emperor Wu Ya!
In history, it was not every Great Emperor that possessed an Imperial Weapon.

Some Great Emperors might have been unlucky, not being able to find the Origin Gold during their reign, but there were also some Great Emperors that had absolutely no intention of forging the Imperial Weapon. In fact, they didn’t even leave behind their inheritance.
However, only one Great Emperor obtained two pieces of Origin Gold.
This was none other than the Great Emperor Wu Ya.

However, the Great Emperor Wu Ya didn’t forge two Imperial Weapons, leaving behind an indestructible legend. Instead, he preserved the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning, and only then did it become the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower in Ling Han’s hands.
However, this was actually a scheme that the Great Emperor Wu Ya had laid out for millions and millions of years?
"The world that we are in is presently facing a great danger of destruction. I am fighting bravely in the Primitive Abyss, and desperately need help. Hopefully, you will arrive very soon."
"There’s also a piece of Metal of Creation sealed in your mind. It can help you forge the strongest Imperial Weapon!"

However, this was actually a scheme that the Great Emperor Wu Ya had laid out for millions and millions of years?
"The world that we are in is presently facing a great danger of destruction.
I am fighting bravely in the Primitive Abyss, and desperately need help.
Hopefully, you will arrive very soon."
"There’s also a piece of Metal of Creation sealed in your mind.
It can help you forge the strongest Imperial Weapon!"

chapters.title: Chapter 4740: Netherworld attacks
paragraphs: Ling Han swept an eye over his body, and sure enough, after the ball of light disappeared, a piece of light golden metal was revealed. It didn’t look anything special, but gave Ling Han a feeling that it could create infinite possibilities.
This was the Metal of Creation?
What kind of strange name was that!
Ling Han couldn’t help but grumble. ’You’re a dignified Great Emperor, and it’s not like you’re incompetent in naming. Why didn’t you give it a nicer and simpler name?’

However, he immediately turned his attention back to the message that the Great Emperor Wu Ya had left behind. According to this Lord, the Primitive Abyss was presently experiencing an extremely urgent situation, which concerned the survival of the entire universe.
The problem was that it wasn’t peaceful outside either. The main goal of the Twelve Lands of Death was to destroy the Living Realm, which could similarly cause great loss of life.

Previously, he had still been hoping that the Great Emperors that had gone to the Primitive Abyss to search for an opportunity for immortality had not died, and would come out to help pacify the chaos caused by the Twelve Lands of Death. Now, it was obvious that they could not be counted on.
Hold on, he had to sort out this matter.

After entering the Primitive Abyss, the Great Emperor Wu Ya, the Battle Saint Emperor and the others had all obtained the fortune of immortality. This was a definite fact. Otherwise, after so many years, they would definitely have all died.
However, this kind of immortality should also have its limits, causing them to be unable to leave the Primitive Abyss.
—Perhaps, once they left, they would age rapidly, and then die.
Of course, there was also a second possibility, and that was there were terrifying enemies within the Primitive Abyss, forcing these Great Emperors to stay behind to fight.
If it was the latter, hiss, just how strong would their opponents have to be?
No wonder the Great Emperor Wu Ya’s tone was so solemn.
Additionally, the Great Emperor Wu Ya had already used the Natural-born Gold Spirit to summon reinforcements, which showed just how terrible the situation was in the Primitive Abyss.
It was not just Empress Qingzhu. The Great Emperor Wu Ya had also laid out his plans. Of course, it was even more so for the Twelve Lands of Death. They had all survived until this era.

Wasn’t it just the universe expanding to the extreme? Even if it immediately began to shrink, there would still be endless years until it returned to its original size. Why did the Great Emperors insist on contending in this era?
Ling Han sighed upon hearing this. Could it be that this Great Emperor Wu Ya couldn’t speak a little more?
What the hell were those thirty-six Divine Beasts?
They were definitely all Great Emperor-level, and were weaker than ordinary Great Emperor-level, so why was that?
Ling Han’s mind was a mess right now. The more he knew, the more confused he became.
"Forget it!"

"I’ll go to the Primitive Abyss to increase my strength first, and just in time. I’ll see if I can go deep inside and meet with the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others. That way, I can get some answers."

They had no choice but to leave. The side of the Lands of Death had already obtained the Natural-born Gold Spirit, which could be refined into a Pseudo-Emperor doppelganger. How powerful would this be under the control of a Great Emperor?
Powerful to sweep aside all other Pseudo-Emperors?
In short, this was too terrifying.

Because the situation with the Primitive Abyss was also extremely tense, Ling Han didn’t spread the news about the Great Emperor Wu Ya. Instead, he only told Buddha Doga, Qian Yanghao, and Xia Houping.
After listening to Ling Han’s words, the three Pseudo-Emperors all wore grave expressions.
Even the side of the Primitive Abyss was screwed over?
With chaos both inside and outside, how could Pseudo-Emperors like them hold up?
"In short, let’s go to Primitive Abyss first."
The three Pseudo-Emperors had also made up their minds, and formed a unified understanding.
After obtaining the Natural-born Gold Spirit, the Netherworld completely compensated for the inadequacy of the Skeleton Saint Tools being suppressed by Ling Han. It became unstoppable again.
"I have to bring those Imperial Clans with me," Ling Han said.
Buddha Doga frowned and said, "Although there are three Pseudo-Emperors now, it’s impossible to bring too many people."
"What if I absorb all of those stars into my body?" Ling Han asked with a smile.
This?
The three Pseudo-Emperors were all looking at Ling Han with strange expressions. This was really a monster.
"Alright, we can give it a try," Qian Yanghao said with a nod. The more people they could bring with them, the more sparks of hope there would be.
However, before Ling Han could make a move, terrible news immediately came.

—The Natural-born Gold Spirit brought the Imperial Weapon and attacked, easily breaking through Thousand Bird Imperial Clan’s imperial formation, destroying the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan and Origin had died in battle!
Origin had died!
One of the rulers of Genesis World.
Ling Han immediately became suspicious. It was extremely likely that the Netherworld’s target wasn’t the Thousand Bird Imperial Clan, but rather Origin.

The Genesis World originated from the Divine Stone, and he was 99% sure that the Divine Stone came from the Primitive Abyss. In the era of Xuan Taiyu, this had once attracted the emergence of the Twelve Lords of Death, who combined forces to fight against Xuan Taiyu.

In the end, though Xuan Taiyu calmed the darkness, the Twelve Lords of Death also devoured a large amount of life essence in order to extend their lifespans, causing the entire North Heavenly Realm’s fortune to decline. After so many years, it still hadn’t recovered.

With how freakish he was, he would definitely arouse the suspicion of the Lords of Death. Perhaps the Lords of Death didn’t know what the Divine Stone represented, but with the sudden appearance of a supreme prodigy that surpassed the sons of the Great Emperors, it would be strange if he didn’t arouse suspicion.
Previously, he had been standing in front of them, concealing Ding Shu and the others, but now... the Lords of Death and the others might have discovered something.
Ling Han immediately set out to find Ding Shu and the others, wanting to pack them up and take them away.
He would definitely first go to the nearest place to him, which was the Ten Thousand Flower Imperial Clan Clan. This was where Ding Shu was staying.
Thankfully, the Ten Thousand Flower Imperial Clan was still very calm.
When Ling Han related the purpose of his visit, it caused the Ten Thousand Flower Imperial Clan to hesitate. To move their ancestral planet into Ling Han’s body?
That meant that with a single thought, Ling Han would be able to control the life and death of all of them.
However, did they have any other choice?
Ling Han started to contain the Ten Thousand Flower Planet. However, he immediately discovered that the Great Emperor Formation was releasing a powerful resistance, preventing him from doing so.
They had to shut down the Great Emperor Formation first.

This caused the Ten Thousand Flower Imperial Clan to feel conflicted for a very long time, right until news spread out that the Nine Purple Imperial Clan was also finished. Only then did they make up their minds and close the imperial formation.
The Nine Purple Imperial Clan... Heaven Crushing!
As expected, the eyes of the Lords of Death were set on Ding Shu and the others. They must have discovered that they had also come out of the Divine Stone.
Hold on, would these Lords of Death have even greater schemes, targeting the Genesis Worlds inside Origin and the others?

The fact that Ling Han had been able to grow to become as powerful as he was now was naturally thanks to his hard work, effort, and great opportunities. However, it could not be denied that the Genesis World had also played a very important role.
What if this was obtained by the Lords of Death?
Hiss!

Ling Han hurriedly stored the Ten Thousand Flower Planet into his body. Sure enough, without the imperial formation’s resistance, he could do it. However, as long as one carried the Imperial Weapon, Ling Han wouldn’t be able to store this person into his body.
In other words, the limit of what he could accommodate was below Great Emperor-level.
This was already astonishing enough.
This time, it was clear that the Ten Thousand Flower Planet was larger and had more living creatures, but Ling Han felt that it was easier than when he had taken in the Four Origin Planet.
It must be because his strength had increased.
Ling Han continued to search for the other Genesis World rulers.

At the next stop, he found Jing Haoran, which corresponded to the Flawless Imperial Clan. This time, it was much smoother for him. The bloody truth was there, and the son of the Great Emperor of the Flawless Imperial Clan immediately agreed to Ling Han’s suggestion.

However, when Ling Han headed to the next stop, he had just walked out of the Void, when he saw a golden human figure controlling a blood-coloured large umbrella, which wrapped around him, and he forcibly penetrated into a star.
Natural-born Gold Spirit!
Not good, he had come too late.

chapters.title: Chapter 4741: Escape
paragraphs: Boom!

Under the attack of the Natural-born Gold Spirit, even the imperial formation couldn’t block it. He directly detonated the core of this planet, forming a terrifying shockwave. Under this attack, all beings below the level of Saint were naturally killed.

This was the might of a Pseudo-Emperor. So what if it was an Imperial Weapon? He could use the Imperial Weapon to resist the Imperial Formation, and directly blast apart the core of the planet himself.
The Natural-born Gold Spirit was extremely skilled in attack.
Right now, there were still some Saints who had managed to escape. Their eyes were wide with rage and grief.
Ling Han’s eyes swept over, and already located Shui Qingchang.
Shua, the Natural-born Gold Spirit attacked, aiming right for Shui Qingchang.
Shui Qingchang was indeed a ruler of the Genesis World. Although she was anxious, she didn’t panic, and she immediately raised her hands to counterattack.
However, no matter how strong she was, she was only a Five Star Saint, so how could she possibly be a match for a Pseudo-Emperor?
Even the present Ling Han was no match!
Just when she was about to be killed, weng, the Imperial Son of the Big Dipper Imperial Clan revived the Imperial Weapon and rushed over in time, blocking this fatal blow for her.
The Natural-born Gold Spirit as expressionless as it continued to attack with its Blood Parasol.
This was the Imperial Weapon that belonged to the Master of the Blood Sea.
In the hands of a Pseudo-Emperor, how long could the might of an Imperial Weapon last?
It would definitely last longer than in the hands of a Saint.
"I’ll hold them back, you guys retreat first!" Ling Han attacked, and the Clear Bamboo Sword appeared, greeting the Natural-born Gold Spirit.
The members of the Big Dipper Imperial Clan were overjoyed, and they hurriedly retreated to the back. After tearing a rip into the Void, they hurriedly retreated.
The killing intent of the Natural-born Gold Spirit instantly soared, and it ferociously charged at Ling Han.
Weng!
The two Imperial Weapons flew out of their hands and started to attack each other through the air.
F***, Ling Han had to face the Natural-born Gold Spirit, a Pseudo-Emperor, on his own?
Ling Han gritted his teeth. This was truly a difficult challenge.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Blinding golden light suddenly burst from Natural-born Gold Spirit’s body, transforming into a sky full of golden swords that shot towards Ling Han.
Hiss, within every streak of golden light, there was actually a sliver of Nine Star Regulations!

Even as strong as Ling Han was, he was presently unable to weave the eight-star Regulations together to match the nine-star Regulations. Otherwise, he would have long since been able to thrash a Pseudo-Emperor.
Thus, faced with the attack of the Nine Star Regulations, how was he supposed to block?
Taking it head-on?
He would definitely be blasted into smithereens.
Dodging?
The sky was filled with golden swords, so where could he dodge?
Boom, the golden swords shot down, releasing a terrifying sound that shook the universe.
However, after the golden light dispersed, a precious tower appeared where Ling Han was standing. It was exuding Primal Chaos Qi, with lightning flashing around it.
Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower!

"Haha, you wouldn’t have thought, would you? I am a man who has two Imperial Weapons at the same time!" Ling Han laughed loudly. Though the Pseudo-Emperor’s attack had not hit him directly, the terrifying shockwave of power still made him feel so bad that he wanted to throw up blood.
The Natural-born Gold Spirit didn’t speak, but xiu, xiu, xiu! Numerous weapons materialized around him... some weren’t even weapons, but rather jade vials, sunflowers, and the like.
’Holy f*ck!’
Ling Han gritted his teeth. These were all Imperial Weapons!
Gods, the Lords of Death actually gave their Imperial Weapons to this Natural-born Gold Spirit.

He understood now. This Natural-born Gold Spirit was definitely refined by the combined forces of the 12 Lords of Death. Thus, even though there was only one, it represented the willpower of the 12 Lords of Death.
Boom, aside from the Heavenly Net Blood Parasol that was battling fiercely with the Clear Bamboo Sword, the other 11 Imperial Weapons also came to life, exuding a terrifying imperial might.
For other Pseudo-Emperors, this was impossible.
There was no Pseudo-Emperor that could awaken more than one Imperial Weapon. However, the Natural-born Gold Spirit was different.
Firstly, he came from the Primitive Abyss and possessed unlimited possibilities. Secondly, the 12 Lords of Death had refined it so it possessed a sliver of their divine sense.
Thus, how much power would a Great Emperor have to expend if he wanted to revive his own Imperial Weapon?
It was practically zero, all right?
Thus, Ling Han saw such a terrifying scene. A mere Pseudo-Emperor was controlling twelve Imperial Weapons at the same time!

He cursed internally. How was he supposed to match this? Though the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower could be ranked among the top in terms of Origin Gold, it could not possibly exchange blows with eleven Imperial Weapons.
Moreover, wasn’t the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower only a Pseudo-Imperial Weapon?
Run!
Ling Han used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight and fled.
Behind him, the Natural-born Gold Spirit was hot on his heels. Its speed was actually not inferior to Ling Han at all.
Pseudo-Emperor!
And this was still because it had not burnt the Imperial Source. Otherwise, it would be even faster.
Hold on, did the Natural-born Gold Spirit have the Imperial Source? After all, he hadn’t truly cultivated.

Ling Han believed that the Natural-born Gold Spirit should not have the Imperial Source. Otherwise, for the sake of killing him, the greatest threat, it would be completely worth it even if the Natural-born Gold Spirit had to be expended.

One fled, while the other pursued. Ling Han used all his tricks, and fled for a whole three years’ time. Only then did he manage to throw off the Natural-born Gold Spirit and return to Four Origin Planet.
"Let’s leave quickly!"
Ling Han didn’t even bother to rest as he absorbed Four Origin Planet into his body. Then, he had Buddha Dog and the other Pseudo-Emperors bring them towards the Primitive Abyss.
Those who possessed Imperial Weapons couldn’t enter Ling Han’s body, but Buddha Doga and the others also had three Imperial Weapons, so bringing a few more people wouldn’t be a problem.
—Myriad Dao had also died; the Natural-born Gold Spirit was really too fast.
However, Ling Han also managed to save Ding Shu, Jing Haoran, and Shui Qingchang, even though the ancestral grounds of the Big Dipper Imperial Clan had been destroyed.
In this battle, it could be considered a tie. Ling Han did not lose to the Lords of Death.
On this trip to the Primitive Abyss, the Pseudo-Emperors naturally could not possibly burn their Imperial Source. Instead, they used their normal speed.
In this way, Ling Han wouldn’t need a Pseudo-Emperor to bring him along. His current speed was actually not inferior to a Pseudo-Emperor.
200 or so years later, they arrived at the Primitive Abyss.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then circled to the back of the Primitive Abyss. It was very, very far away, and only then did he release the three stars.

There was nothing else that could be done. Accommodating three planets at once, and having to experience a journey as long as two hundred years, this was also his limit. Otherwise, Ling Han could still bring other Imperial Clans.

Ding Shu, Jing Haoran and Shui Qingchang all volunteered. They too wanted to try to do the same as Ling Han, and see if they could absorb the stars into their bodies. If they succeeded, they would be able to act as vessels, and transport planets, with Buddha Doga and the others bringing them along.
Meanwhile, Ling Han drew out the Metal of Creation, planning to increase the might of the Imperial Weapon.
The logical choice was naturally to use it on the Clear Bamboo Sword.
In the first place, this was an Imperial Weapon. If he further upgraded it with the Metal of Creation, it was very likely that it would be able to suppress other Imperial Weapons.
However, Ling Han still felt that strengthening the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was better.
The Imperial Weapon alone couldn’t suppress the Lord of Death. After all, it wasn’t a true Great Emperor.
Thus, Ling Han was more accustomed to using his own Spirit Tool.

Moreover, hundreds of millions of years ago, the Great Emperor Wu Ya had left behind the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning, and now he had delivered the Metal of Creation to his hands. Wasn’t this a hint?
He decided to use it on the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.

Ling Han pressed the Metal of Creation onto the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Then, following the method taught to him by the Great Emperor Wu Ya, he had the Origin Gold absorb the Metal of Creation.
Yi, Ling Han discovered that rather than saying that the Origin Gold was absorbing it, it would be better to say that the Metal of Creation was actively channeling, tempering the Origin Gold.
In a short while, the Metal of Creation had completely assimilated into the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.

Firstly, he came from the Primitive Abyss and possessed unlimited possibilities.
Secondly, the 12 Lords of Death had refined it so it possessed a sliver of their divine sense.
Thus, how much power would a Great Emperor have to expend if he wanted to revive his own Imperial Weapon?
It was practically zero, all right?
Thus, Ling Han saw such a terrifying scene.
A mere Pseudo-Emperor was controlling twelve Imperial Weapons at the same time!
He cursed internally.
How was he supposed to match this?
Though the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower could be ranked among the top in terms of Origin Gold, it could not possibly exchange blows with eleven Imperial Weapons.
Moreover, wasn’t the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower only a Pseudo-Imperial Weapon?
Run!
Ling Han used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight and fled.
Behind him, the Natural-born Gold Spirit was hot on his heels.
Its speed was actually not inferior to Ling Han at all.
Pseudo-Emperor!
And this was still because it had not burnt the Imperial Source.
Otherwise, it would be even faster.
Hold on, did the Natural-born Gold Spirit have the Imperial Source?
After all, he hadn’t truly cultivated.
Ling Han believed that the Natural-born Gold Spirit should not have the Imperial Source.
Otherwise, for the sake of killing him, the greatest threat, it would be completely worth it even if the Natural-born Gold Spirit had to be expended.
One fled, while the other pursued.
Ling Han used all his tricks, and fled for a whole three years’ time.
Only then did he manage to throw off the Natural-born Gold Spirit and return to Four Origin Planet.
"Let’s leave quickly!"
Ling Han didn’t even bother to rest as he absorbed Four Origin Planet into his body.
Then, he had Buddha Dog and the other Pseudo-Emperors bring them towards the Primitive Abyss.
Those who possessed Imperial Weapons couldn’t enter Ling Han’s body, but Buddha Doga and the others also had three Imperial Weapons, so bringing a few more people wouldn’t be a problem.
—Myriad Dao had also died; the Natural-born Gold Spirit was really too fast.
However, Ling Han also managed to save Ding Shu, Jing Haoran, and Shui Qingchang, even though the ancestral grounds of the Big Dipper Imperial Clan had been destroyed.
In this battle, it could be considered a tie.
Ling Han did not lose to the Lords of Death.
On this trip to the Primitive Abyss, the Pseudo-Emperors naturally could not possibly burn their Imperial Source.
Instead, they used their normal speed.
In this way, Ling Han wouldn’t need a Pseudo-Emperor to bring him along.
His current speed was actually not inferior to a Pseudo-Emperor.
200 or so years later, they arrived at the Primitive Abyss.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then circled to the back of the Primitive Abyss.
It was very, very far away, and only then did he release the three stars.
There was nothing else that could be done.
Accommodating three planets at once, and having to experience a journey as long as two hundred years, this was also his limit.
Otherwise, Ling Han could still bring other Imperial Clans.
Ding Shu, Jing Haoran and Shui Qingchang all volunteered.
They too wanted to try to do the same as Ling Han, and see if they could absorb the stars into their bodies.
If they succeeded, they would be able to act as vessels, and transport planets, with Buddha Doga and the others bringing them along.
Meanwhile, Ling Han drew out the Metal of Creation, planning to increase the might of the Imperial Weapon.
The logical choice was naturally to use it on the Clear Bamboo Sword.
In the first place, this was an Imperial Weapon.
If he further upgraded it with the Metal of Creation, it was very likely that it would be able to suppress other Imperial Weapons.
However, Ling Han still felt that strengthening the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was better.
The Imperial Weapon alone couldn’t suppress the Lord of Death.
After all, it wasn’t a true Great Emperor.
Thus, Ling Han was more accustomed to using his own Spirit Tool.
Moreover, hundreds of millions of years ago, the Great Emperor Wu Ya had left behind the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning, and now he had delivered the Metal of Creation to his hands.
Wasn’t this a hint?
He decided to use it on the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Ling Han pressed the Metal of Creation onto the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Then, following the method taught to him by the Great Emperor Wu Ya, he had the Origin Gold absorb the Metal of Creation.
Yi, Ling Han discovered that rather than saying that the Origin Gold was absorbing it, it would be better to say that the Metal of Creation was actively channeling, tempering the Origin Gold.
In a short while, the Metal of Creation had completely assimilated into the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 4742: Entering the city
paragraphs: Origin Gold was the sturdiest thing in the world, and even the Great Emperor couldn’t damage it.
Thus, the Origin Gold could only be burned in the strongest flames in the world. After burning to a certain extent, it could be molded into any form.
But it should be known that adamantine and the like had to be hammered over and over again to be able to reach the requirements of hardness and sharpness.
The Origin Gold was naturally different. It itself was the strongest material in the world, so it was definitely pure.
However, no matter how pure it was, there would still be a trace of impurity, which would affect its might.
Now, the Metal of Creation’s effect was to expel these impurities. Although it didn’t completely transform the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, its might definitely increased a bit.
"I have a feeling that as long as I have enough Metal of Creation, I can completely increase the quality of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower!"
However, even the Great Emperor Wu Ya could only give out this little bit. Furthermore, it was only this little bit, but its value was even higher than the Natural-born Gold Spirit!
Which was more important was actually dependent on the individual.
For Saints, it would definitely be the Natural-born Gold Spirit that was better. That represented creating a Pseudo-Emperor-level doppelganger.
But for a Great Emperor, they themselves were already strong enough, and no longer needed a Pseudo-Emperor-level doppelganger. Then, it would definitely be the Metal of Creation that was even better.
"Inside the Primitive Abyss, there must be more Metal of Creation."
"Great Emperor Wu Ya is reminding me that I can continue to strengthen the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower in the Primitive Abyss."

"In the outside world, it would really be very difficult for me to further improve my cultivation level. Furthermore, after nine times of Silent Destruction, even if I have cultivated to the pinnacle of Saint Tier, I would not be able to reach the height of 99 eight-star Regulations."
Ling Han went to discuss the details of entering the Primitive Abyss with Buddha Doga and the others.
Now that they had two Bronze Battle Armors, they could both increase their safety and conceal their identities, giving them the chance to sneak in.

In the end, it was still decided that Ling Han and Buddha Doga would enter and seize the opportunity to obtain more Bronze Battle Armors. This way, the others would also be able to withstand the gravity inside the Primitive Abyss.
Since they had already made their decision, there was no need for any further delays. Ling Han and Buddha Doga immediately set out.
They entered the Primitive Abyss and remained silent all the way.
More than a month later, they entered the core area that was enshrouded by the Primal Chaos.
They had already come here once, so they were naturally familiar with this place.
However, the harsh environment here would not change just because they had come more often. Things like monstrous flames, meteorite showers, super waves really came in one wave after another.
So what if one as strong as a Pseudo-Emperor? Faced with such a situation, even they could only wait.
To say nothing of them, even the True Dragon Emperor from before had been stopped by the natural disasters. Otherwise, Ling Han and Buddha Doga might not have been able to come out.
This dawdling took more than twenty years.
Thankfully, time passed quickly here. In the outside world, not even a year had passed.
Finally, Dragon Head City appeared ahead of them.
This time, neither Ling Han nor Buddha Doga sent out their divine sense as a probe. Instead, they directly approached.
Of course, they had also changed their appearance.
It wasn’t long before they arrived before the city gates. The city gates were open, and the people inside didn’t even ask.
"Chu Tang, where have you all been all these years?" After entering the city, someone finally asked.
Ling Han shockingly discovered that in this city, the gravity was surprisingly small, reaching the conditions for habitation.
He coughed, and said, "I was unlucky. In order to avoid the storms of heaven and earth, I was forced to hide in a dead end valley. It wasn’t easy for me to escape."
"All right, hurry up and go back — oh, your wives seem to have all died, so go and collect another."
Er, what was going on here?
Ling Han and Buddha Doga didn’t ask any more questions, fearing that they would arouse suspicion. The two of them walked on the streets of the city and carefully observed the surroundings.
If they hadn’t come in from the Primitive Abyss, they would really find it hard to believe that such an ordinary-looking city would actually be located in the most dangerous place in the universe.
All the buildings here were very simple and crude. It could be imagined. After all, this was the Primitive Abyss, which was too barren.
What Ling Han was curious about was how did the people here cultivate?
They couldn’t all hope for Genesis Substance, right?
There was definitely pitifully little Genesis Substance. Otherwise, there was no way that even the disciples of a Great Emperor would come out to search for it.
Speaking of the disciples of a Great Emperor, Wang Zhe was most likely not the only one in this Dragon Head City. This was because Chu Tang called them the Ninth King.
Then, going upwards, there should still be First King all the way to Eighth King.
Strange.
Ling Han and Buddha Doga started to investigate separately. They would meet at the promised location every three days to exchange information.
The aura of the True Dragon Emperor had not appeared all this while. He had probably been crippled by Great Emperor Senluo, and needed a long time to recover and recuperate.
Thus, this was a good opportunity for Ling Han and Buddha Doga to become active.
After three days, Ling Han also gained some understanding of this city.
There was actually a medicinal field planted in this city, and it was precisely this medicinal field that ensured the supply of cultivation resources in the city.

Ling Han took a look. Though the Celestial medicines in the medicinal field were not top grade, they were still six or seven stars, at least. Thus, they could completely satisfy the cultivation needs of the few people in the city.
Suspicions also appeared. Going by his deductions, the population in the city should be far from reaching the number that it should have. Then, where had these people gone?
He met up with Buddha Doga, then discussed for a while, and decided to focus the investigation on the missing population.
The two of them passed their days. In this city, those who could obtain Battle Armors were all mighty figures. Even if it was Bronze Battle Armor-level, it was still incredible.
True, Saints were all mighty figures. Wherever they went, wouldn’t they be a mighty figure?

The True Dragon Emperor didn’t appear, and neither did those disciples of the True Dragon Emperor. After waiting for seven days, Ling Han and Buddha Doga finally saw a large number of people enter the city.
These people were all dressed in ragged clothing, as if they were refugees.
Ling Han and Buddha Doga were just wondering what these people had gone out of the city for, when they were quickly notified to escort the miners into the mountains on the second day.
Yi, miners?
Then, what were they mining?
Genesis Substance? Metal of Creation?
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel his heart palpitate. No matter what it was, it would be of great help to him.
Furthermore, this was such a good opportunity, and it had taken the initiative to deliver itself to their doorstep.
On the second day, Ling Han and Buddha Doga went over to the gathering location. They didn’t know what to do next, so they would see what others did, and follow suit.

A person who looked like the leader appeared. Of course, he was also wearing a Bronze Battle Armor, and led Ling Han and Buddha Doga out. The miners that looked like refugees that they had seen yesterday had already gathered here.
"Let’s go!" The leader gave a command, and they headed towards the city gates.

After arriving at the city gates, the leader took out a small boat, but it immediately enlarged. Those miners climbed aboard one after another. All of them were very proficient, and by the looks of it, they had already done it countless times.

Realization dawned on Ling Han. The gravity fields outside were so strong, and he was still wondering how these people who were merely in the Core Formation Tier and True Self Tier managed to leave the city. As it turned out, they had a vehicle.

chapters.title: Chapter 4743: Mineshaft
paragraphs: "Hey, what are you guys doing?" The leader suddenly called out.
Ling Han and Buddha Doga exchanged looks. They had also jumped onto the ship. However, looking at the leader’s expression, it was clear that this was a mistake.
"I know you guys are lazy, but you guys can’t be so lazy!" The leader shook his head, "Hurry up and get down, pull the ship with me!"
Fine.
Ling Han and Buddha Doga jumped off the ship. As expected, there were three ropes at the bow of the ship. It was unclear what material they were made of, but they should be extremely tough.
Thankfully, that person had not become suspicious. Otherwise, Ling Han and his companion’s identities would have been exposed.
Ling Han even sighed. Why was it that every time he hid his identity, it was very easy for his persona to collapse?
The three bronze warriors grabbed the ropes, then walked forwards.

After leaving the city, the terrifying gravity fields immediately took effect. Thankfully, the Bronze Battle Armor canceled out a large portion of the gravity fields, and that ship was made of some unknown material that could actually withstand the extreme weight of the gravity fields.
But for the people towing the ship, this was still considerably unfriendly.
That was because the ship was too heavy.

Even if the ship was made of a special material that could cancel out a portion of the gravity fields, it was still extraordinarily heavy as a whole. Otherwise, why would it be accompanied by three Saints to pull the ship?
Ling Han and Buddha Doga didn’t dare to exert too much force, fearing that their power would exceed the level that they should have.

"Yi, what’s going on today? It’s much more relaxed," the leader said in surprise. Then, he glanced at Ling Han and Buddha Doga, "Yo, you guys still know how to be apologetic. You’ve just been scolded by me, so you know how to work hard now?"
This... Ling Han and Buddha Doga both laughed drily.
What kind of attributes did the other have?
After discovering the suspicious points, he would provide an explanation for it himself. There was no need for Ling Han and Buddha Doga to try to fool him.
Yes, this kind of person would definitely be able to live for a very long time. There was definitely no need to worry that he would be silenced.
With this in mind, Ling Han and Buddha Doga both smiled at the person in a friendly manner.
"F***!" The leader got a scare, "What bad things have you guys done now? And you want me to clean up your mess?"
"Of course not." Ling Han and Buddha Doga both shook their heads. The favorable impression that they had just formed had already disappeared without a trace.
The three of them dragged the ship along at a slow speed. After a whole seven days of travelling, they finally arrived at a mountainous area.
Ling Han had initially thought that they had reached their destination, but in the end, they were only resting here for a while.
—He and Buddha Doga could withstand it, but how could the leader have such a physique and stamina?
That’s right, this person’s name was Tang Sishui.

"Chu Tang and Luo Qi, how come your stamina is so much stronger than mine?" Tang Sishui asked curiously. Without waiting for Ling Han and Buddha Doga to speak, he slapped his thigh and said, "That’s right. Previously, you were trapped outside, which is equivalent to cultivating diligently every day. It’s only right that your physiques and stamina have been greatly improved."
As expected, his method of explaining away his own suspicions activated, and there was completely no fear that he would be killed to keep a secret.
Ling Han and Buddha Doga both smiled in unison, thinking that this person definitely wouldn’t be lonely. When he was bored, he could completely talk to himself.
After resting here for three days, they set out again. This journey took another five days.
The ship stopped again. This time, there was no need for Tang Sishui to speak. The miners all jumped down, and walked forwards.
Yi, there was actually no super gravity here again.

Ling Han was surprised. This Primitive Abyss was really strange. Sometimes, it would be incredibly dangerous. Merely the extreme weight of the Primitive Abyss could insta-kill a Saint, and there were some places that were completely harmless.

"Today, the Fifth King is keeping watch. You two idiots have to be smarter — forget it, forget it. You guys just have to stop talking." Tang Sishui wanted to exhort Ling Han and Buddha Doga, but after some thought, he decided to forget it.
The Fifth King?
Was he the fifth disciple of the True Dragon Emperor?
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t take it to heart. What he was more curious about was why there was no extreme gravity here.
The smaller the matter was compressed, the greater the gravity field would be created. This was an objective fact. Then, what was here that cancelled out the extreme gravity?
What were the miners digging?
The two were definitely related, right? Otherwise, why didn’t they dig elsewhere, but rather here?
In this little bit of time, Ling Han’s thoughts flew.
"The Fifth King is here!" Tang Sishui suddenly exclaimed, then suddenly stood up.
Ling Han and Buddha Doga’s movements were slow as they looked into the distance.

A young man wearing a Silver Battle Armor walked over in large strides. He was extremely tall, and was even half a head taller than Ling Han. His long crimson hair couldn’t be concealed, even with a helmet, and danced wildly behind him.
"Greetings, Fifth King!" Tang Sishui hurriedly clasped his hands in greeting.
Ling Han and Buddha Doga followed suit. Fortunately, Tang Sishui didn’t kneel. Otherwise, Ling Han and Buddha Doga would definitely turn hostile immediately.

The Fifth King swept an eye over the three of them, and said calmly, "The three of you have worked hard. In the next few days, the three of you should have a good rest, and I would have to trouble the three of you to send them back."
"Fifth King, that is being too polite. It is our honor to be working for His Majesty, the True Dragon Emperor!" Tang Sishui hurriedly said.
The Fifth King nodded, turned and left.

"Amongst the nine disciples of the Great Emperor, the Fifth King is indeed the kindest," Tang Sishui said quietly, "If it was the other disciples, they would definitely disdain from coming over to take a look at us."
Hey, you are a Saint, after all. Why are you so lacking in confidence?

True, these people should have been living here since birth. Even if they had occasionally gone out, all they could see was boundless darkness. How could they not know that there were other living beings in the universe?
Thus, they naturally didn’t have the arrogance of elites.
Ling Han and Buddha Doga excused themselves to rest, and began to move quietly.
The Fifth King was standing guard here, so they would just ignore him for the moment.
Ling Han and Buddha Doga were even more curious about what those miners were digging, that it actually needed a Great Emperor to personally create a city and oversee a region.
As for the Fifth King? When they returned from the mine area, they would knock him out and take him away.
The two of them entered the mineshaft and found the stones that the miners had dug out.
Ling Han immediately looked surprised. This actually contained Genesis Substance!
Though it was pitifully little, after some refinement, it was not difficult to forge a Battle Armor like the one he was wearing.
As it turned out, this was how the Battle Armor came about.
However, the Silver Battle Armor was clearly a level higher, and it was truly forged from metal. How could this kind of Stone Battle Armor compare?
Ling Han and Buddha Doga both released their divine sense to explore this area. However, their divine sense was quickly bounced back.
The two of them exchanged a look, shaking their heads and smiling bitterly.
Outside, they were practically omnipotent, but after entering into the Primitive Abyss, it was as if they had become weak cultivators that had just begun cultivating.
"Let’s go into the mine and take a look."
They entered the mine and ventured deeper.
With their strength, as long as they did not want to be discovered, there was naturally no one that could see them.
Very soon, they arrived at the innermost depths of the mine.

Previously, you were trapped outside, which is equivalent to cultivating diligently every day.
It’s only right that your physiques and stamina have been greatly improved."
As expected, his method of explaining away his own suspicions activated, and there was completely no fear that he would be killed to keep a secret.
Ling Han and Buddha Doga both smiled in unison, thinking that this person definitely wouldn’t be lonely.
When he was bored, he could completely talk to himself.
After resting here for three days, they set out again.
This journey took another five days.
The ship stopped again.
This time, there was no need for Tang Sishui to speak.
The miners all jumped down, and walked forwards.
Yi, there was actually no super gravity here again.
Ling Han was surprised.
This Primitive Abyss was really strange.
Sometimes, it would be incredibly dangerous.
Merely the extreme weight of the Primitive Abyss could insta-kill a Saint, and there were some places that were completely harmless.
"Today, the Fifth King is keeping watch.
You two idiots have to be smarter — forget it, forget it.
You guys just have to stop talking." Tang Sishui wanted to exhort Ling Han and Buddha Doga, but after some thought, he decided to forget it.
The Fifth King?
Was he the fifth disciple of the True Dragon Emperor?
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t take it to heart.
What he was more curious about was why there was no extreme gravity here.
The smaller the matter was compressed, the greater the gravity field would be created.
This was an objective fact.
Then, what was here that cancelled out the extreme gravity?
What were the miners digging?
The two were definitely related, right?
Otherwise, why didn’t they dig elsewhere, but rather here?
In this little bit of time, Ling Han’s thoughts flew.
"The Fifth King is here!" Tang Sishui suddenly exclaimed, then suddenly stood up.
Ling Han and Buddha Doga’s movements were slow as they looked into the distance.
A young man wearing a Silver Battle Armor walked over in large strides.
He was extremely tall, and was even half a head taller than Ling Han.
His long crimson hair couldn’t be concealed, even with a helmet, and danced wildly behind him.
"Greetings, Fifth King!" Tang Sishui hurriedly clasped his hands in greeting.
Ling Han and Buddha Doga followed suit.
Fortunately, Tang Sishui didn’t kneel.
Otherwise, Ling Han and Buddha Doga would definitely turn hostile immediately.
The Fifth King swept an eye over the three of them, and said calmly, "The three of you have worked hard.
In the next few days, the three of you should have a good rest, and I would have to trouble the three of you to send them back."
"Fifth King, that is being too polite.
It is our honor to be working for His Majesty, the True Dragon Emperor!" Tang Sishui hurriedly said.
The Fifth King nodded, turned and left.

"Amongst the nine disciples of the Great Emperor, the Fifth King is indeed the kindest," Tang Sishui said quietly, "If it was the other disciples, they would definitely disdain from coming over to take a look at us."
Hey, you are a Saint, after all.
Why are you so lacking in confidence?
True, these people should have been living here since birth.
Even if they had occasionally gone out, all they could see was boundless darkness.
How could they not know that there were other living beings in the universe?
Thus, they naturally didn’t have the arrogance of elites.
Ling Han and Buddha Doga excused themselves to rest, and began to move quietly.
The Fifth King was standing guard here, so they would just ignore him for the moment.
Ling Han and Buddha Doga were even more curious about what those miners were digging, that it actually needed a Great Emperor to personally create a city and oversee a region.
As for the Fifth King?
When they returned from the mine area, they would knock him out and take him away.
The two of them entered the mineshaft and found the stones that the miners had dug out.
Ling Han immediately looked surprised.
This actually contained Genesis Substance!
Though it was pitifully little, after some refinement, it was not difficult to forge a Battle Armor like the one he was wearing.
As it turned out, this was how the Battle Armor came about.
However, the Silver Battle Armor was clearly a level higher, and it was truly forged from metal.
How could this kind of Stone Battle Armor compare?
Ling Han and Buddha Doga both released their divine sense to explore this area.
However, their divine sense was quickly bounced back.
The two of them exchanged a look, shaking their heads and smiling bitterly.
Outside, they were practically omnipotent, but after entering into the Primitive Abyss, it was as if they had become weak cultivators that had just begun cultivating.
"Let’s go into the mine and take a look."
They entered the mine and ventured deeper.
With their strength, as long as they did not want to be discovered, there was naturally no one that could see them.
Very soon, they arrived at the innermost depths of the mine.

chapters.title: Chapter 4744: Interrogation
paragraphs: This place was completely dark.
There were miners working, but after being attacked by Ling Han’s divine sense, they immediately lost consciousness and fainted on the ground.
Ling Han walked over and picked up the hoe on the ground, appearing slightly surprised.
This hoe was very powerful, to actually be able to dig up that hard ore.
Though the soil structure of this mine was relatively loose, and was far from being as firm as the ground outside, even if Saints came here, their excavation efficiency would only be so.
In other words, this hoe could allow the wielder to possess Saint-level destructive power.
Of course it was awesome.

"Yi!" Ling Han sensed for a while, and discovered that there was a sliver of something similar to the Metal of Creation in this hoe. However, the difference in quality was too great, like a drop of water compared to an ocean.
But it was precisely because of the existence of this thing that this ordinary-looking hoe possessed the might of a Saint.
Anything from the Primitive Abyss was indeed amazing.
Ling Han held the hoe in his hand, and tried to dig a few times. Instantly, he saw the rocks on the cave wall fall down, piece by piece. It was extremely easy.
"Tsk, tsk, tsk. Instead of resting well, the two of you actually came here to do physical labour. I am really touched!" Behind the two of them, a voice suddenly rang out.
The Fifth King!
However, Ling Han and Buddha Doga weren’t surprised at all. After all, with their powerful divine sense, they had definitely noticed the other’s arrival long ago.
Ling Han turned around, and smiled slightly, "Then shouldn’t the Fifth King bestow a good reward on us?"
"Reward, of course." The Fifth King also smiled, then his expression suddenly turned cold, "I will reward the two of you with mining here for eternity!"
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "I don’t like this reward."
"This is my reward. If you like it, you can accept it, but if you don’t... you still have to accept it!" the Fifth Kingsaid balefully.
"Heh, isn’t this just forceful compulsion?" Ling Han wagged his finger, and said, "I’m telling you very responsibly that this is wrong."
The corners of the Five King’s mouth twitched slightly. What kind of character was this?
He had clearly grasped the rhythm of the exchange, and molded his image as an overlord that could give and take, but why had he been instantly led astray by Ling Han?
"The two of you... who exactly are you!" he asked. This was a very serious question.
Ling Han smiled and said, "You came alone, so why don’t you think and wonder? What if you’re no match for us?"

"Humph!" The Fifth King showed an expression of pride. In the first place, he was an eight-star Saint, and added with the Silver Battle Armor, aside from the Great Emperor, only the other disciples of the Great Emperor could compare.
Deal with the two of you who are wearing Bronze Battle Armors?
Easily.
"Since you people are so stubborn and uncooperative I will have no option but to capture you first and interrogate you," the Fifth King said as he reached over to grab Ling Han and the Buddha Doga.
Ling Han pointed a finger at the Fifth King.
"Where did you get such courage from?" The Fifth King was proud. Ling Han actually dared to clash with him.
Peng!
With a single strike, the large hand that the Fifth King had shot out immediately crumbled.
"What?!" The Fifth King was stunned. Ling Han had actually blocked his attack with such ease?
This kind of battle prowess was too terrifying, wasn’t it?
How many disciples of the Great Emperor could accomplish this?
Unless it was those few trump cards.
But if he was such a trump card, how could he have appeared in the mine?
Which Great Emperor didn’t occupy territory?
’Oh, you’re not going to your own territory, but instead come to the True Dragon City to play. Are you bored out of your mind?’
All of a sudden, the heart of the Fifth King was filled with complaints, but for the moment, he did not know where to begin complaining.
"Who exactly are you people?" he finally asked again.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and stretched out a hand to grab the Fifth King, "Let us exchange roles. I will ask, and you answer!"
"Impudence!" The Fifth King humphed, and the Battle Armor on his body immediately glowed, injecting a powerful battle prowess into him.
He threw a punch, and the light was so dazzling that one couldn’t see anything else except for a place of white.
However, as an iron fist swung over, peng, the light was immediately extinguished.
Peng, the Fifth King was sent flying, and crashed into the cave wall. Then, he bounced back, causing a great many rocks to fall, burying him completely.
In only an instant, he broke out of the ground, yet did not linger in battle at all. Hurriedly, he turned around and fled.
This was truly a trump card. He was completely outmatched.

"Hey, what are you running for!" Ling Han said with a smile. Murderous aura shot out, turning into an iron fist. Its speed was astonishingly fast, and instantly sank into the back of the Fifth King’s head.
Peng! The Fifth King instantly collapsed to the ground, unconscious.
In the face of this kind of battle, Buddha Doga naturally disdained from interfering.

Ling Han first removed the Silver Battle Armor from the Fifth King’s body. This was really a good thing. It could greatly cancel out the extreme weight of gravity outside, allowing any Saint to come and go as they pleased.
Then, he jolted the Fifth King awake.
"You guys—"
"If you speak another word of nonsense, I’ll stuff a rock into your a**."
The Fifth King had just spoken, when he was so shocked by Ling Han that he swallowed his words.
Was this guy a pervert? He had actually thought of such a malicious idea.
When Ling Han saw that this guy had shut up, he did not pay any heed to his silent complaints. He asked, "What is the purpose of you guys mining these ores?"
"Refine the particles of the Metal of Creation, and think of a way to forge the Metal of Creation," the Fifth King answered honestly.
The Metal of Creation!
Ling Han and Buddha Doga exchanged looks. How could it be that the 36 Divine Beasts were all digging up the Metal of Creation here?
But the dignified Great Emperor actually transformed into the leader of miners. This was slightly unacceptable to the two of them.
This was too damaging to the image.
A Great Emperor, invincible in the world, ruling an era on his own, was the leader of miners?
How humiliating.

"Looks like the 36 Divine Beasts are all conspiring to create the Metal of Creation. Thus, when the Natural-born Gold Spirit was discovered to fly out of the Primitive Abyss, the True Dragon Emperor chased out, following its tracks," Buddha Doga said.
Meanwhile, Ling Han looked towards the Fifth King, "How much Metal of Creation have you guys gotten now?"
He didn’t mind snatching all of it.

The Fifth King immediately cast him a disdainful look, but when he discovered that Ling Han’s expression had become fierce, he couldn’t help but tremble. He had almost forgotten that this guy was a freak that could not be trifled with!

He shook his head, and said, "Do you think that it’s so easy to obtain the Metal of Creation? First of all, it needs a huge amount of Metal of Creation particles to be forged, but the success rate is too low. In so many years, there hasn’t been a single time that has succeeded."
Ling Han and Buddha Doga both breathed a sigh of relief. No matter what the True Dragon wanted to do, it definitely wasn’t a good thing. Thus, the fact that it hadn’t succeeded was good news.
"This city... How long has it existed?" Ling Han changed the topic.

"I don’t know either." The Fifth King shook his head, and when he saw Ling Han pick up a rock, put it in his hand, weighed it in his hand, and when he turned his gaze to his behind, he broke out in a cold sweat, and hurriedly continued, "I really don’t know. I have been in this city since birth."
"All right, I’ll take that as the truth." Ling Han nodded, "Then do you know that aside from the 36 Divine Beasts, there are other Great Emperors here?"
