chapters.title: Chapter 4745: Young man
paragraphs: The Fifth King immediately revealed an expression of disdain, but then awkwardly withdrew his expression.
He said, "Do you think that Great Emperors are as common as cabbages?"
Because he felt too much disdain in his heart, there was quite a lot of disdain in his words.
Ling Han chuckled, and delivered a slap. ’Just see how smug you are.’
How could it be that he did not know?

In the outside world, it was said that Great Emperors would never see another. Only one Great Emperor could appear in a single era, and even if the masters of the Twelve Lands of Death had once been Great Emperors, and that was because they had destroyed their own life force, turning themselves into Yin souls.
But here, the 36 Divine Beasts were alive and kicking, completely breaking the tradition of a Great Emperor never seeing another.
Yi, was this a time that had returned to the Primitive Age?
"Don’t you know how to speak properly?" Ling Han glared at him.
Only then did the Fifth King nod obediently, feeling very depressed. He was the Fifth King, so why had he encountered such a freak?
"No, there are only 36 Lord Divine Beasts here!"
Ling Han looked at Buddha Doga, and Buddha Doga also frowned.
Looking at the expression of the Fifth King, the other party was not lying.
Then here was the problem.
The Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others were definitely still alive. Otherwise, the Natural-born Gold Spirit couldn’t possibly have contained a message from that Great Emperor.
But the Fifth King had completely no idea.
Could it be that their only purpose was to mine?
The effect of the Metal of Creation was to forge the strongest Imperial Weapon.

However, if the 36 Divine Beasts teamed up, even if their individual abilities were inferior to that of ordinary Great Emperors, they would still be able to sweep aside all opposition with their advantage in numbers.
Why did they have to expend so much effort to obtain the Metal of Creation?
Hold on!
Was it because the Great Emperor Wu Ya was currently battling fiercely with the 36 Divine Beasts, so the Divine Beasts wanted to forge the strongest Imperial Weapon to kill these Great Emperors?
Er, was there any need to go to so much trouble?
Moreover, could the strongest Imperial Weapon kill a Great Emperor?
In comparison, the person was the main force, while the Tool was only a supportive tool.
The only thing that made the Imperial Weapon stronger than the Great Emperor was that it could last for eternity and never be destroyed.
F***, he had clearly obtained even more information, but not only had he not solved the mystery, it was becoming more and more chaotic instead?
Pa, he slapped the head of the Fifth King again.
The Fifth King was a little confused. This time, he did not speak carelessly, nor did he show any disdain.
"I’m not in a good mood," Ling Han explained very considerately.
’You’re in a bad mood, so you want to vent your anger on me?’
The Fifth King wanted to beat him up. He was the disciple of the Great Emperor, not your punching bag!
However, he wisely chose to keep his mouth shut.
Ling Han asked again, about anything the Fifth King knew about the Primitive Abyss.
However, there was really not much useful information.

The Fifth King basically mingled around in Dragon Head City, or stayed here to keep watch. Occasionally, he would also leave the Primitive Abyss and appreciate the Regulations in the outside world. This was also the main method for people like him to increase their cultivation level.
After all, there was too little Genesis Substance. It was too dangerous to venture too deep, so they could only try their luck in the outer regions.
However, in the misfortunate case of the Ninth King, he was accidentally killed by Ling Han.
Because this guy didn’t have any obvious evil deeds, Ling Han didn’t kill him. He only erased his recent memories.
"Should we continue to venture deeper, or return?" Ling Han asked Buddha Doga.
There was no longer any need to investigate this Dragon Head City.
Buddha Doga pondered for a moment before saying, "We’ll rob the treasure storage before returning."
"All right."
The two of them moved. With their strength, if the Great Emperor did not appear, who would be able to stop them?
It wasn’t long before they returned with a full load.

In truth, there really wasn’t much in the treasury, because once it had accumulated enough, the True Dragon Emperor would personally move to extract the essence within, attempting to forge the Metal of Creation.
However, so far, he had not succeeded even once.
Thus, although this mine had been dug for many, many years, it had basically been wasted. There were only a few Silver Battle Armors and a great many Bronze Battle Armors left behind.
Ling Han and Buddha Doga did all they could, directly robbing anyone they saw. They ransacked all the Saints who were wearing Bronze Battle Armors.
Then, they returned with a large number of Battle Armors.

Those Saints were all dumbfounded. Two extremely ruthless characters had come, and as soon as they came face-to-face, they directly knocked them unconscious and stripped them of their Battle Armor without saying a word, scaring them so much that they thought that they were going to "lose their chastity".
This caused a great commotion, drawing out the True Dragon Emperor who was recuperating from his injuries, but by this time, Ling Han and Buddha Doga had long since fled.
After exiting the Primitive Abyss, although they had stayed inside for several dozen years, not even a year had passed in the outside world.

Ling Han distributed the Battle Armors, arming them as much as possible. In this way, as long as one became a Saint, they could enter into the Primitive Abyss to find Genesis Substance. This could rapidly increase one’s cultivation level.

He had never denied that he was a selfish person. The distribution of these Battle Armors naturally prioritized his own people. However, in the case of Ding Shu, Jing Haoran, and Shui Qingchang, each of them had obtained a Battle Armor.

Ling Han hoped that they could go to the Primitive Abyss to comprehend the inner world inside their bodies. The flow of time there would be 100 times faster, so that they could cultivate to host stars as soon as possible, and move more forces here.
The large black dog, the little azure dragon and the others all moved out, entering into the Primitive Abyss. However, they all stayed in the outer circle, and did not go to Dragon Head City.
It was too dangerous there, and the True Dragon Emperor had also been alerted. It would be difficult to sneak in again. It was more likely that they would be directly blasted into smithereens.
Every few months, there would be people returning one after another.
Even though they had only been away for a few months, it had actually been as long as a few dozen years, and not one of them had obtained Genesis Substance.
This was actually normal. That kind of rare treasure was really too rare, and only Ling Han, with his nature-defying luck, could obtain such treasures two times in a row.
In the Primitive Abyss, there were actually some benefits, such as concocting alchemical pills and cultivating formations.
This did not involve Regulations. The only expense was time, so if it was carried out there, it would "save" a lot of time.

Several years had passed, yet they hadn’t made any progress. Instead, two Saints had been killed by the energy storms. Even the Bronze Battle Armor hadn’t been able to withstand the energy storms. They had been blasted into a sieve, and not even a corpse had been found.
After reaching Saint Tier, it was really no ordinary difficulty to advance another level.

Ling Han would also occasionally venture into the Primitive Abyss to try his luck. With his strength, he no longer needed the Battle Armor. If it was left to others, at least one more person would be able to enter the Primitive Abyss.
All of a sudden, they had already been here for seventeen years.

On this day, Ling Han was drinking tea with the empress, Hu Niu, Chi Menghan, Song Lan, and the others. Meanwhile, his little female attendant was still the same as before, serving him from the sidelines.
It was she who had insisted on becoming Ling Han’s maid, because once she lost this identity, how could she continue to stay by Ling Han’s side?
"Hmm?"
Ling Han frowned upon hearing this.
"What is it?" the empress asked.
"We have a visitor." Ling Han stood up and looked into the distance.
A small figure walked over from the sky, and in the blink of an eye, he had appeared in front of everyone.
This was really a child. He was only eleven or twelve years old, his black locks fluttering, his feet bare. Dressed in snow-white coarse clothes, he looked delicate and refined.

F***, he had clearly obtained even more information, but not only had he not solved the mystery, it was becoming more and more chaotic instead?
Pa, he slapped the head of the Fifth King again.
The Fifth King was a little confused.
This time, he did not speak carelessly, nor did he show any disdain.
"I’m not in a good mood," Ling Han explained very considerately.
’You’re in a bad mood, so you want to vent your anger on me?’
The Fifth King wanted to beat him up.
He was the disciple of the Great Emperor, not your punching bag!
However, he wisely chose to keep his mouth shut.
Ling Han asked again, about anything the Fifth King knew about the Primitive Abyss.
However, there was really not much useful information.
The Fifth King basically mingled around in Dragon Head City, or stayed here to keep watch.
Occasionally, he would also leave the Primitive Abyss and appreciate the Regulations in the outside world.
This was also the main method for people like him to increase their cultivation level.
After all, there was too little Genesis Substance.
It was too dangerous to venture too deep, so they could only try their luck in the outer regions.
However, in the misfortunate case of the Ninth King, he was accidentally killed by Ling Han.
Because this guy didn’t have any obvious evil deeds, Ling Han didn’t kill him.
He only erased his recent memories.
"Should we continue to venture deeper, or return?" Ling Han asked Buddha Doga.
There was no longer any need to investigate this Dragon Head City.
Buddha Doga pondered for a moment before saying, "We’ll rob the treasure storage before returning."
"All right."
The two of them moved.
With their strength, if the Great Emperor did not appear, who would be able to stop them?
It wasn’t long before they returned with a full load.

In truth, there really wasn’t much in the treasury, because once it had accumulated enough, the True Dragon Emperor would personally move to extract the essence within, attempting to forge the Metal of Creation.
However, so far, he had not succeeded even once.
Thus, although this mine had been dug for many, many years, it had basically been wasted.
There were only a few Silver Battle Armors and a great many Bronze Battle Armors left behind.
Ling Han and Buddha Doga did all they could, directly robbing anyone they saw.
They ransacked all the Saints who were wearing Bronze Battle Armors.
Then, they returned with a large number of Battle Armors.
Those Saints were all dumbfounded.

Two extremely ruthless characters had come, and as soon as they came face-to-face, they directly knocked them unconscious and stripped them of their Battle Armor without saying a word, scaring them so much that they thought that they were going to "lose their chastity".
This caused a great commotion, drawing out the True Dragon Emperor who was recuperating from his injuries, but by this time, Ling Han and Buddha Doga had long since fled.
After exiting the Primitive Abyss, although they had stayed inside for several dozen years, not even a year had passed in the outside world.
Ling Han distributed the Battle Armors, arming them as much as possible.
In this way, as long as one became a Saint, they could enter into the Primitive Abyss to find Genesis Substance.
This could rapidly increase one’s cultivation level.
He had never denied that he was a selfish person.
The distribution of these Battle Armors naturally prioritized his own people.
However, in the case of Ding Shu, Jing Haoran, and Shui Qingchang, each of them had obtained a Battle Armor.
Ling Han hoped that they could go to the Primitive Abyss to comprehend the inner world inside their bodies.
The flow of time there would be 100 times faster, so that they could cultivate to host stars as soon as possible, and move more forces here.
The large black dog, the little azure dragon and the others all moved out, entering into the Primitive Abyss.
However, they all stayed in the outer circle, and did not go to Dragon Head City.
It was too dangerous there, and the True Dragon Emperor had also been alerted.
It would be difficult to sneak in again.
It was more likely that they would be directly blasted into smithereens.
Every few months, there would be people returning one after another.
Even though they had only been away for a few months, it had actually been as long as a few dozen years, and not one of them had obtained Genesis Substance.
This was actually normal.
That kind of rare treasure was really too rare, and only Ling Han, with his nature-defying luck, could obtain such treasures two times in a row.
In the Primitive Abyss, there were actually some benefits, such as concocting alchemical pills and cultivating formations.
This did not involve Regulations.
The only expense was time, so if it was carried out there, it would "save" a lot of time.
Several years had passed, yet they hadn’t made any progress.
Instead, two Saints had been killed by the energy storms.
Even the Bronze Battle Armor hadn’t been able to withstand the energy storms.
They had been blasted into a sieve, and not even a corpse had been found.
After reaching Saint Tier, it was really no ordinary difficulty to advance another level.
Ling Han would also occasionally venture into the Primitive Abyss to try his luck.
With his strength, he no longer needed the Battle Armor.
If it was left to others, at least one more person would be able to enter the Primitive Abyss.
All of a sudden, they had already been here for seventeen years.
On this day, Ling Han was drinking tea with the empress, Hu Niu, Chi Menghan, Song Lan, and the others.
Meanwhile, his little female attendant was still the same as before, serving him from the sidelines.
It was she who had insisted on becoming Ling Han’s maid, because once she lost this identity, how could she continue to stay by Ling Han’s side?
"Hmm?"
Ling Han frowned upon hearing this.
"What is it?" the empress asked.
"We have a visitor." Ling Han stood up and looked into the distance.
A small figure walked over from the sky, and in the blink of an eye, he had appeared in front of everyone.
This was really a child.
He was only eleven or twelve years old, his black locks fluttering, his feet bare.
Dressed in snow-white coarse clothes, he looked delicate and refined.

chapters.title: Chapter 4746: Manipulating Time
paragraphs: Seeing this pleasing-looking boy, both Chi Menghan and Song Lan were greatly moved by maternal tenderness, and began to imagine just how adorable the baby that they would have with Ling Han would be.

However, the empress was proud and haughty. In her eyes, everyone was inferior, so how could she give them a second look? And Hu Niu was more interested in food, and similarly couldn’t even be bothered to give him a second look.
Ling Han looked at the boy, and couldn’t help but feel surprised, because this boy was really young. At most, he had only lived for eleven or twelve years.
However, he actually couldn’t see through such a child!
He activated his eye technique, yet he could only see a stretch of emptiness.
Could it be that... the other party was Pseudo-Emperor, or even a Great Emperor?
If he was a Saint, Ling Han didn’t believe that there was any Saint that could block his eye technique.
Moreover, the appearance of this boy was far too bizarre.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Brother Monkey, the large black dog, the little azure dragon and the others all appeared. After all, it was too strange for a little boy to suddenly appear out of nowhere.
"Huh? Which family are you from?" the large black dog immediately asked.
"My name is Little Ye," the boy said. "I have come today to see just how powerful the so-called greatest prodigy of all eternity is."
Ling Han frowned. At first, he had thought that this little boy had come from the Primitive Abyss. After all, it was only there that such a strange young elite could be nurtured.
But now, judging from the other’s tone, he clearly came from the same place as them.
Furthermore, he did not come with good intentions. Was he from the Lands of Death?
"Where’s your parents?" the large black dog asked boldly. How could he be cautious about such a young child?
Furthermore, he still had Ling Han and the three Pseudo-Emperors behind him!
"I don’t have parents." Little Ye giggled, "Big doggy, you are fun. Why don’t you become my steed!"
"What, you wet-behind-the-ears brat actually want to ride on Grandpa Dog’s back?" The large black dog said angrily, "Come over here, and see if Grandpa Dog won’t beat your behind to mush!"
Little Ye pouted, and shook his head at the large black dog, "Come on then!"
The large black dog howled, and immediately pounced towards Little Ye, "Damn brat, Grandpa Dog will teach you the proper behaviour of a dog."

Though Ling Han felt that this Little Ye was a little strange, the large black dog was a Saint, and now, he was a Five Star Saint at that. He was still wearing the Bronze Battle Armor, and no matter how bad he was, there was no way he could be insta-killed by the other party.
Thus, he did not interfere.
The others were also observing. This little boy was too strange. He had charged over all by himself.
The large black dog didn’t unleash his full power. Instead, he launched a palm strike at Little Ye.

This child giggled, and stretched out a hand to press down on empty air. The large black dog’s movements suddenly slowed, and then became slower and slower. In fact, it was as if his movements were about to stop.
This!
Everyone was stunned. To be able to play around with a Saint like the large black dog in the palm of his hand, just how terrifying was this guy’s strength?
He could probably compete with Ling Han.
Little Ye moved calmly, and then it was seen that the large black dog’s speed suddenly recover. Boom, its attack landed, and naturally missed its target.
"Yi, you can teleport, brat?" The large black dog seemed to be completely unaware of what had just happened, his face filled with surprise.
Hearing the large black dog’s words, everyone was even more surprised. He actually didn’t know that he had been frozen in place by Little Ye?
It was as if it had not been frozen, but rather... time had slowed down and stopped.
Hiss!
The large black dog roared, and pounced towards Little Ye again.
This time, it was not slowed down again. This attack instantly landed solidly on Little Ye.
But a strange scene appeared. Little Ye’s body was flowing with light. Not only had this attack failed to wound him, it had not even managed to force him to take a step back.
How was this possible?
Even if the large black dog’s attack hadn’t succeeded, it shouldn’t have been so weak, right?
Little Ye stretched out his right hand, and then began to turn counter-clockwise. Instantly, the large black dog was rapidly shrinking in size, turning into a small puppy.
"Woof! Woof!" The large black dog didn’t even know how to speak anymore, and could only bark weakly.
However, Little Ye rapidly grew taller, turning into a tall and slender young man, captivating and enchanting.
Everyone was shocked by this scene. F*ck, he could actually turn his opponent back into a child?
How were they supposed to fight?
Directly turning you into an infant, what was left of your battle prowess?
"Regulations of Time?" Ling Han asked darkly. No wonder the large black dog didn’t react at all when Little Ye froze it in place. If this was Regulations of Time, then it could be explained.
Little Ye giggled, stuck out his tongue, and wore a dazzling smile, "Ya, I’ve been seen through!"
If this was a child, he would appear innocent and naive, but if it was an adult man, it would seem out of place.
Strange, the large black dog had shrunk, while he had matured. Was there a connection between these?
"Recover him," Ling Han said calmly.
"There’s no need to go to so much trouble." Little Ye shrugged, "Controlling time is something heaven-defying. Thus, in half a day, at most, this stupid dog would return to its original state."
Was that really the case?
Ling Han was skeptical, but internally, he believed this.
Controlling time was too terrifying. It should be an ability unique to heaven and earth. Thus, there was a time limiting how long it could last, so this was still reasonable.

Ling Han waved a hand, and the large black dog, er, no, the small black dog was grabbed by him. Now, Old Black was just a puppy, and had no abilities at all. If it was not for the fact that he still had a pair of shining golden iron underwear on him, who would be able to connect the two?
Sigh, this despicable dog would also have a day like this.
Brother Monkey leaped out, waved the staff, and said, "Old Sun will battle you!"
Little Ye giggled again, "Do you all want to bully me?"
Brother Monkey did not waste any more words. He directly leaped out, and struck with his staff.
Little Ye raised his hand and pressed down on Brother Monkey. Brother Monkey aged rapidly at a visible rate, and in an instant, he had become an old monkey covered in white fur.
On the other hand, Little Ye had transformed from a young man to a two to three year old child. He was as fair as jade, and extremely adorable.
Hiss, he had only made two moves, and he had directly crippled the battle prowess of Brother Monkey and the large black dog.
Though the large black dog was slightly weaker, Brother Monkey was extremely, extremely strong.
This guy... was a strong opponent!
Ling Han stretched out a hand, and grabbed Brother Monkey as well. Though Brother Monkey was aged now, he still wanted to raise his staff to continue the battle.
However, he was only one step away from dying of old age, and it was already difficult for him to hold a staff, so how could he still make a move?
"Who else is there?" Little Ye asked in a childish voice. Though he was naive and cute, no one dared to look down on him.
Ling Han took a step forward, his fighting spirit blazing.
He had yet to encounter such an opponent, which made him excited.

For example, though a Saint had absorbed Regulations, it could only strengthen the destructive power. For example, if you had grasped Regulations of Metal, that could only strengthen the destructive power of your attack, and in the case of Regulations of Earth, that could strengthen your defense.
However, it was definitely impossible to conjure a piece of Divine Metal out of thin air just because one had grasped Regulations of Metal.

chapters.title: Chapter 4747: Limits
paragraphs: However, in the hands of Little Ye, he could allow the Regulations of Time to unleash a completely different effect.
How was this done?

Ling Han had also thought about this before. If he could grasp the Regulations of Time, would he be able to age the Great Emperor in an instant? However, he was told by Buddha Doga that the Great Emperor was self-contained, and this would be ineffective.
He was already invincible against all opponents below the level of Great Emperor, so he naturally couldn’t be bothered to waste this time. He focused on cultivating the Regulations of Time.

Furthermore, it was highly possible that this would not succeed. After all, if Time was disturbed, that would be equivalent to disturbing the great dao, which would lead to extremely serious consequences.
Hence, he was very curious now, and his fighting spirit blazed.
"Come fight me!" Ling Han shouted. He wouldn’t treat this "person" in front of him like a child.
The other party could control time, so perhaps he himself was an old geezer.

Little Ye bared his teeth in a grin, "The greatest prodigy of all eternity, I am really curious. To become a toothless old geezer, or a little brat wrapped in a diaper, how interesting would that be."
Ling Han also smiled, "That would have to depend on your abilities."
"En, let me think, should I turn you into an infant, or an old geezer?" Little Ye said, biting on his finger. Because he now looked like a child, no one felt discomforted by his display.
However, everyone had seen how he looked like as an adult before, and when this scene flashed past in their minds, it naturally gave rise to a strong feeling of dissonance.
"Better turn into a child first!" Little Ye stretched out a hand, and pressed it down on Ling Han. Then, he began to spin counter-clockwise.
Ling Han suddenly felt an indescribable feeling assault him, causing him to undergo some kind of change.
Young age!
He could feel it, but right at this moment, with the light of great dao lightly flickering in his mind, this feeling instantly disappeared.
He stood there like a god.
"Yi?" Little Ye looked extremely surprised.
How was this possible?
Why had it not taken effect?
"Strange!" He once again turned his hand clockwise.
Weng, Ling Han had a strange feeling again. This time, he felt like time was urging him to age.
However, in his mind, the light of great dao trembled slightly, and this feeling instantly disappeared without a trace.
"Hehe, hehe!" Little Ye retracted his hand, and stopped trying, "As expected of the number one prodigy of all eternity. You are indeed powerful, capable of resisting even my Mystical Power of Time."
Ling Han’s expression remained calm, yet a sliver of hope flashed through his mind.

If it was not for the fact that he had previously entered into the Primitive Abyss and refined the Genesis Substance, and thus cultivated the light of great dao, it was very possible that he would have already become an infant or an old geezer.
Just look at the large black dog and Brother Monkey. They have completely lost their battle prowess now, and was at the mercy of others.
In an instant, Ling Han’s killing intent blazed. This kind of opponent was too terrifying, and could cause a massive blow to his own side.
He had to deal with him as soon as possible.

Sensing Ling Han’s killing intent, Little Ye giggled, "Yo, yo, yo, why are you suddenly filled with killing intent? However, Ling Han, even if you are the greatest prodigy of all eternity, you are still far from being able to kill me."
After saying this, his body suddenly enlarged, turning into a man in his early twenties. He stood tall, his aura filled with might.
"Then let’s battle!" Ling Han charged over. As he shot out a punch, he went all out, and all 43 flashes of Regulations were shot out.
Little Ye greeted the incoming attack, and confronted Ling Han head-on.

When their fists collided, Little Ye’s body suddenly trembled for a moment, and actually became two people. Then, they continuously overlapped into one, and then split into two again, repeating the same process.
Peng, the attack landed, and Little Ye suddenly stumbled backwards.
His face was a little pale, but he did not spurt out blood. Instead, he nodded, "How impressive. I have underestimated you."

Meanwhile, Ling Han was astonished. This was because he had seen Ling Han continuously splitting into two before combining into one again. This wasn’t a shadow image after rapid movement. Instead, he had genuinely transformed into two people.
Was this another application of the Regulations of Time?
Meanwhile, everyone was astounded. Someone had actually survived a clash with Ling Han? This was far too terrifying.
Where had this monster come from?
"Again!" Ling Han let out a battle cry, raised his fist, and waved it again.
Peng!
In this exchange of blows, Little Ye’s body trembled, and manifested into three figures, but very soon, he became four, five, and only when there were seven, did he finally stabilize.
"Impressive, truly impressive!" he said sincerely, "You almost pushed me to my limits. I have to admit, you are really strong, qualified to be called number one in all eternity."
What was the meaning of this?
If Ling Han was number one in history, then wouldn’t you be even stronger if you "were almost pushed to your limits"?
"You still haven’t reached your limit?" Ling Han smiled faintly, and charged out again. "Then I’ll help you fight it out!"
Hong! Hong! Hong!
He threw punch after punch, but Little Ye’s body split into seven, and each of his seven bodies took on the attacks respectively, but he was very calm and relaxed.
However, Ling Han was completely unconcerned, and his attacks became faster and faster.
This time, Little Ye’s expression finally changed.
Though he was still continuously splitting into seven to disperse the might of Ling Han’s attacks, his seven bodies were continuously trembling, as if they were about to shatter.
Finally, when Ling Han threw another punch, Little Ye didn’t dare to take it head-on anymore. Instead, he turned into a streak of light, and xiu, he appeared extremely far away.
He was no longer calm, but rather looked at Ling Han with a dark expression.
This was a slap to the face.

Just now, he had still been boasting, saying that Ling Han hadn’t made him hit his limit yet. In the end, however, he was being punched again and again by Ling Han. There was nothing fancy about it, and there was no variation at all as Ling Han hit him until he couldn’t bear it anymore.
His summoning doppelgangers were actually neutralized by Ling Han in such a violent manner.
Previously, he had continuously split into seven. It was he who had summoned the six versions of himself of the past and future at the same time, so that they could share Ling Han’s attack.

However, Ling Han’s attacks were too fast and too heavy. Even if there were seven "selves" to share the burden, under the continuous and endless attacks, the "selves" in the entire chain of time still sustained extremely heavy blows, and could no longer be summoned.
Otherwise, no matter which "selves" in the chain of time was injured, it would affect the current "self".
How could there be such a terrifying guy?
It should be known that he did not have a mortal body!

Seeing that Ling Han was finally on the upper hand, everyone breathed a sigh of relief. However, Little Ye was actually strong to this extent, and was finally outmatched after exchanging so many blows with Ling Han. This still made everyone dumbfounded.
"Humph!" With a wave of his hand, weng, space was torn apart, and a human figure that was completely enshrouded in golden light appeared.
Natural-born Gold Spirit!
Hiss, this Little Ye was indeed from the Lands of Death!
Which Great Emperor’s son was this? To actually possess such astonishing battle prowess?

After the Natural-born Gold Spirit it was another sixteen Skeleton Saint Tools. Though more than half of them had been destroyed by Ling Han, it was still no problem for them to take out sixteen of them.
Finally, it was the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters, one after another.

Ling Han suddenly felt an indescribable feeling assault him, causing him to undergo some kind of change.
Young age!
He could feel it, but right at this moment, with the light of great dao lightly flickering in his mind, this feeling instantly disappeared.
He stood there like a god.
"Yi?" Little Ye looked extremely surprised.
How was this possible?
Why had it not taken effect?
"Strange!" He once again turned his hand clockwise.
Weng, Ling Han had a strange feeling again.
This time, he felt like time was urging him to age.
However, in his mind, the light of great dao trembled slightly, and this feeling instantly disappeared without a trace.
"Hehe, hehe!" Little Ye retracted his hand, and stopped trying, "As expected of the number one prodigy of all eternity.
You are indeed powerful, capable of resisting even my Mystical Power of Time."
Ling Han’s expression remained calm, yet a sliver of hope flashed through his mind.

If it was not for the fact that he had previously entered into the Primitive Abyss and refined the Genesis Substance, and thus cultivated the light of great dao, it was very possible that he would have already become an infant or an old geezer.
Just look at the large black dog and Brother Monkey.
They have completely lost their battle prowess now, and was at the mercy of others.
In an instant, Ling Han’s killing intent blazed.
This kind of opponent was too terrifying, and could cause a massive blow to his own side.
He had to deal with him as soon as possible.
Sensing Ling Han’s killing intent, Little Ye giggled, "Yo, yo, yo, why are you suddenly filled with killing intent?
However, Ling Han, even if you are the greatest prodigy of all eternity, you are still far from being able to kill me."
After saying this, his body suddenly enlarged, turning into a man in his early twenties.
He stood tall, his aura filled with might.
"Then let’s battle!" Ling Han charged over.
As he shot out a punch, he went all out, and all 43 flashes of Regulations were shot out.
Little Ye greeted the incoming attack, and confronted Ling Han head-on.
When their fists collided, Little Ye’s body suddenly trembled for a moment, and actually became two people.
Then, they continuously overlapped into one, and then split into two again, repeating the same process.
Peng, the attack landed, and Little Ye suddenly stumbled backwards.
His face was a little pale, but he did not spurt out blood.
Instead, he nodded, "How impressive.
I have underestimated you."
Meanwhile, Ling Han was astonished.
This was because he had seen Ling Han continuously splitting into two before combining into one again.
This wasn’t a shadow image after rapid movement.
Instead, he had genuinely transformed into two people.
Was this another application of the Regulations of Time?
Meanwhile, everyone was astounded.
Someone had actually survived a clash with Ling Han?
This was far too terrifying.
Where had this monster come from?
"Again!" Ling Han let out a battle cry, raised his fist, and waved it again.
Peng!
In this exchange of blows, Little Ye’s body trembled, and manifested into three figures, but very soon, he became four, five, and only when there were seven, did he finally stabilize.
"Impressive, truly impressive!" he said sincerely, "You almost pushed me to my limits.
I have to admit, you are really strong, qualified to be called number one in all eternity."
What was the meaning of this?
If Ling Han was number one in history, then wouldn’t you be even stronger if you "were almost pushed to your limits"?
"You still haven’t reached your limit?" Ling Han smiled faintly, and charged out again.
"Then I’ll help you fight it out!"
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
He threw punch after punch, but Little Ye’s body split into seven, and each of his seven bodies took on the attacks respectively, but he was very calm and relaxed.
However, Ling Han was completely unconcerned, and his attacks became faster and faster.
This time, Little Ye’s expression finally changed.
Though he was still continuously splitting into seven to disperse the might of Ling Han’s attacks, his seven bodies were continuously trembling, as if they were about to shatter.
Finally, when Ling Han threw another punch, Little Ye didn’t dare to take it head-on anymore.
Instead, he turned into a streak of light, and xiu, he appeared extremely far away.
He was no longer calm, but rather looked at Ling Han with a dark expression.
This was a slap to the face.
Just now, he had still been boasting, saying that Ling Han hadn’t made him hit his limit yet.
In the end, however, he was being punched again and again by Ling Han.
There was nothing fancy about it, and there was no variation at all as Ling Han hit him until he couldn’t bear it anymore.
His summoning doppelgangers were actually neutralized by Ling Han in such a violent manner.
Previously, he had continuously split into seven.
It was he who had summoned the six versions of himself of the past and future at the same time, so that they could share Ling Han’s attack.
However, Ling Han’s attacks were too fast and too heavy.

Even if there were seven "selves" to share the burden, under the continuous and endless attacks, the "selves" in the entire chain of time still sustained extremely heavy blows, and could no longer be summoned.
Otherwise, no matter which "selves" in the chain of time was injured, it would affect the current "self".
How could there be such a terrifying guy?
It should be known that he did not have a mortal body!
Seeing that Ling Han was finally on the upper hand, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
However, Little Ye was actually strong to this extent, and was finally outmatched after exchanging so many blows with Ling Han.
This still made everyone dumbfounded.
"Humph!" With a wave of his hand, weng, space was torn apart, and a human figure that was completely enshrouded in golden light appeared.
Natural-born Gold Spirit!
Hiss, this Little Ye was indeed from the Lands of Death!
Which Great Emperor’s son was this?
To actually possess such astonishing battle prowess?
After the Natural-born Gold Spirit it was another sixteen Skeleton Saint Tools.
Though more than half of them had been destroyed by Ling Han, it was still no problem for them to take out sixteen of them.
Finally, it was the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters, one after another.

chapters.title: Chapter 4748: Mass Arrival
paragraphs: The Lands of Death have charged over again.
How had they found this place?
Ling Han didn’t ask. This was already meaningless. The enemy had already reached the door, so their only option was to face them head-on.
Weng, the Natural-born Gold Spirit’s eyes immediately lit up, and a terrifying aura surged, as if he was a Great Emperor.
Xiu, he charged out.
Buddha Doga approached. Boom, the two Pseudo-Emperor-level beings started fighting, but in just a few moves, Buddha Doga was already at a disadvantage.

As long as the Natural-born Gold Spirit was refined, it could become a Pseudo-Emperor-level doppelganger. And now, it was controlled by the all twelve of the Lords of Death at the same time, so just how strong would it be?
Strength upon strength, it was naturally freakishly terrifying.
Qian Yanghao and Xia Houping exchanged a glance before immediately charging over to join forces with Buddha Doga to battle against the Natural-born Gold Spirit.
In this way, both sides were finally on the same level.
After all, they were Pseudo-Emperors. How many people had been able to cultivate to this kind of height in history?

Every Pseudo-Emperor was naturally inconceivably strong. However, whether it was the Natural-born Gold Spirit itself or the divine sense that controlled it, it had surpassed the level of Pseudo-Emperor, which allowed him to have the strength to fight three people on his own.
In this way, the threat posed by the Natural-born Gold Spirit temporarily disappeared. However, Ling Han’s side also lost three Pseudo-Emperors.
With just one enemy, this had weakened their forces by three people, which showed how terrifying the Natural-born Gold Spirit was!
"Ling Han, no matter where you flee to, how can you escape from the prediction of the Great Emperor?" Wu Xingtong said proudly.

Ling Han merely smiled faintly. He couldn’t be predicted, but the others could. Thus, as long as they could predict the whereabouts of Brother Monkey and the others, it was equivalent to knowing where Ling Han was.
"Just the few of you?" He shook his head, his disdain clear in his words.
"Wouldn’t it be more than enough to sweep all of you aside?" Wu Xingtong said with a smile.
Ling Han pointed at Little Ye, "Who is this guy?"
Wu Xingtong also showed a hint of surprise, but immediately said, "That’s none of your business!"
"Yi, you probably don’t know either," Ling Han said with a smile. "As I see it, he’s the one who’s been focused on and nurtured. None of you can dream of contesting for the throne with him."
When these words fell, the expressions of those Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters all darkened, as if their sore spot had been poked.

Peng! Right at this moment, Brother Monkey and the large black dog suddenly underwent a transformation. One of them became radiant and full of vitality, while the other transformed from a puppy into a large black dog.
—The effects of the flow of time on them had already passed, and they had returned to their original state.
The large black dog immediately snickered, and said impatiently, "Are you really blood-related? The good thing of becoming Emperor doesn’t fall on you, but instead benefits an outsider!"
As expected of Old Black. He had just recovered from that state, and was not rejoicing first, but was directly attacking.
Thus, the title of the greatest despicable Saint in the world was justified.
These words were annoying.
Wu Xingtong stared at the large black dog and said, "Shut up, you despicable dog!"

"Just because you told Grandpa Dog to shut up, Grandpa Dog shut up? Grandpa Dog doesn’t want face?" the large black dog howled. Then, he turned around, and shook his behind. His iron underwear was still very conspicuous, "If you can, come and fight Grandpa Dog!"
"Die!" Wu Xingtong couldn’t help but charge toward the large black dog.
"Do you think I’m afraid of you?!" The large black dog’s bearing immediately transformed, and it was as if he had become some powerful elite. He charged toward Wu Xingtong.
Boom!
Human and dog exchanged a blow, and it could be seen that the large black dog was not much at a disadvantage.
It wore a Bronze Battle Armor, greatly boosting its battle prowess.
And this was still a battle in the outside world. If it was in the Primitive Abyss, then Wu Xingtong would not be able to fight back at all, and could only be thrashed madly by the large black dog.
Seeing that Wu Xingtong and the large black dog were already locked in battle, Yang Yihuan, He Luo, and the others also pounced towards them.
A battle royale was thus drawn out.
If this were in the past, Ling Han’s side would definitely be at a disadvantage.
These were the sons and daughters of Great Emperors! Just how freakish were they?
However, many people now had Bronze Battle Armors in their hands, which greatly increased their power and defense. Thus, they could completely put up a fight.
It was also because of this that Ling Han didn’t interfere.
He simply stared at Little Ye. This was the strongest and most troublesome enemy.
This person... who exactly was he? Why was he able to use the Regulations of Time?
"Ling Han, don’t even think of stalling for time. The Great Emperor is about to arrive personally. This is completely meaningless!" Feng Miaoling suddenly shouted.
Yi?
Ling Han faltered upon hearing this. ’Are you trying to remind me?’
Meanwhile, Little Ye looked at Feng Miaoling with a playful gaze, but didn’t say anything.
"Then let’s battle!" Ling Han charged over. As Phoenix Wings Divine Flight unleashed, he charged towards Little Ye.
Even Little Ye did not dare to underestimate his opponent. Ling Han’s freakishness caused even him to feel wary.
He greeted the incoming attack, and shot out a kick. Colorful light shone from his leg, possessing the charm of great dao.
Peng!
Ling Han threw a punch, a faint smile curling up the corners of his lips.
Boom, he suddenly stimulated Destructive Energy.
Little Ye was immediately sent flying. However, what surprised Ling Han was that his leg was still there!
And what was even stranger was that there was actually black-coloured energy entwined around this guy’s legs as well.
Destructive Energy!
How was this possible?

Destructive Energy belonged to Xuan Taiyu in the last era, while in this era, it was grasped by Ling Han, Ding Shu and the other Genesis World rulers. As for the others, even if they were given the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram, they would not be able to learn it.
And now... it had appeared on the ninth person.

Ling Han couldn’t help but think. Heaven Crushing, Myriad Dao and Origin had all been killed. Those were the targets of accurate assaults from the Lords of Death. Previously, he had only thought that the Lords of Death had thought that the three of them were also great threats that needed to be eliminated.
However, after seeing Destructive Energy, he had another guess.
"What did you do to Origin and the others!" Ling Han shouted harshly.

Meanwhile, Little Ye was very regretful. At first, he had wanted to catch Ling Han off guard, and use Destructive Energy to kill Ling Han in one go. At the very least, he would have to cause him serious injury.
Unexpectedly, the two of them unanimously unleashed Destructive Energy, and neither of them had the upper hand.
He snickered, "I didn’t do much. I just recycled and reused, and took something from them into my body."
Was it the Genesis World?
Ling Han only knew that grasping Destructive Energy was inextricably linked to the Genesis World, but he didn’t know the exact details.
"You’re really disgusting!" Ling Han shook his head. Wasn’t it disgusting to have something of a dead person planted into one’s body?
"Winner takes all," Little Ye said calmly.
Xiu, with a flash, he once again charged towards Ling Han.
Ling Han’s eyes focused, and a powerful killing intent rose up in him.
He charged towards Little Ye, and as he swung his fist, not only did he use the Destructive Energy, it also came with the light of great dao.
This was his strongest trump card.
—If it was the holy flame, it would only be used as a last resort. After all, the more it was used, the less there would be left.
Weng, a mysterious light suddenly surged from Little Ye’s body, as if time had passed, which was extremely strange.
However, he forcefully stopped in his tracks.
"Light of great dao!" he exclaimed in shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 4749: Time Crystal
paragraphs: Ling Han was astonished. The other party actually recognized the light of great dao. Moreover, he had forcefully halted his advance. This was like reining in his horse at the brink of a cliff, not daring to face him head-on.
He naturally would not give up, and set off in pursuit of Little Ye.
This time, Little Ye was no longer arrogant. Instead, he did not dare to take it head-on at all. He turned around and fled.
His speed was also abnormally fast, and he was teleporting in a flash.
Was this another application of the Regulations of Time?
Even if Ling Han possessed the world’s fastest movement technique, Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he actually couldn’t catch up to him. He could only maintain a stalemate.
This caused Ling Han to have even stronger desire of killing him. However, what could he do if he couldn’t catch up to him?
Just now, Little Ye had been so arrogant, but when he saw the light of great dao, he was so scared that he fled in a panic.
Could it be that it was light of great dao could naturally restrain him?
With a thought from Ling Han, he threw a punch through the air. Instantly, the power of his fist surged violently, enveloping Destructive Energy and light of great dao.
How fast was this kind of attack?
That was because Ling Han himself was in an extremely high speed. This punch shot out explosively, turning into a brilliant ball of light that rapidly chased after Little Ye.
In a mere instant, the fist light had caught up to Little Ye.
Little Ye had no choice but to turn around to parry. Otherwise, it would definitely be a situation of death.
Peng!
He split into seven, and used the Doppelgangers Summoning Technique again, extracting six "selves" at different times to face the attack together.
The fist light exploded, and when the light dissipated, Little Ye was still standing there unscathed. However, the six doppelgangers trembled at the same time, and then quickly disappeared.
"Wa!" Little Ye threw up blood, but the expression on his face was much more relaxed.
"Scared me to death. I had thought that you had really grasped the light of great dao, but as it turned out, it was just a little bit," he said thankfully.
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, "Even if it’s just a little bit, it’s enough to beat the crap out of you!"
This!

Little Ye’s expression turned dark. Previously, he had been scared out of his wits. When he sensed the aura of the light of great dao, he immediately fled. He had not thought that Ling Han had only grasped a little bit of it.

But even if it was just a little bit, it had still shattered his doppelgangers of time with a single strike, causing them to completely dissipate, and he would not be able to summon them out again for the moment.
Merely from this aspect, he was no match for Ling Han.
He looked at Ling Han, and there was actually the passing of time in his eyes. However, after only a while, his figure trembled, and blood seeped out from the corner of his mouth.

He wanted to use the Regulations of Time to predict Ling Han’s past and future, but all he saw was Primal Chaos. He wanted to forcibly erase the Primal Chaos, but when he looked closely, he suffered a backlash.
"Hehe, Ling Han, you can restrict me, but if I make a move on others, will they be able to resist my Mystical Power of Time?" Little Ye suddenly smiled, as if he had regained his confidence.
Ling Han looked at him coldly, "You can give it a try!"
A powerful killing intent radiated from his body as he said this.
Little Ye’s eyes darted around, and took out a crystal from his robes. It was transparent, but there was light circulating on its surface.
He played around with it for a while, and muttered, "I can’t bear to part with this. After all, this is the only thing that accompanied my birth."
Then, he looked at Ling Han, and lit up the crystal, "This thing is called the Time Crystal. When it is used in a certain area, it can decrease the flow of time in this area by a few hundred times."
"Thus, as long as I trap you within, you can only watch helplessly as I commit murder. Hehe!"

Ling Han’s expression changed drastically. He had seen the extreme changes in the flow of time in the Primitive Abyss. That was truly a hopeless situation. Even a Pseudo-Emperor would instantly become a skeleton in the Primitive Abyss. After all, a Pseudo-Emperor would only have a lifespan of a few million years, which was negligible before the passage of time in the universe.

Little Ye’s ability was definitely not comparable to heaven and earth, but if it was really as he had said, and he trapped him, then he could only sit by and watch as the other party reaped the heads of those in his party.
Aside from Ling Han, no one was a match for Little Ye. That Mystical Power of Time was too terrifying.

"Hehe, go!" Little Ye immediately threw out the Time Crystal. Ling Han hurriedly dodged, but the Time Crystal had already exploded. Weng, it turned into a massive screen of light that instantly caught up to Ling Han, enveloping him within.
Ling Han immediately discovered that his movements had slowed down.
No, no, no. He was not slow. It was just that others had become faster, at least a few hundred times faster.
He was affected by the Time Crystal, and the flow of time in his body was several hundred times slower than outside.
What could he do?

Ling Han immediately thought of this. Previously, Little Ye had also wanted to use the Mystical Power of Time to age him or turn him younger. However, the light of great dao had taken effect, and blocked this Mystical Power of Time.
Now... was this possible?
Ling Han actively channeled the light of great dao. Weng, his whole body glowed, exuding the Qi of great dao.
Xiu, his speed instantly sped up.
Two times, three times, five times, ten times... Though he had not recovered to the normal flow of time, compared to before, it was already much, much faster.
When Little Ye saw this, he couldn’t help but frown, "What a freakish guy, to actually have mastered the light of great dao!"
He no longer hesitated, and charged towards the empress and the others.
"Hehe, age!" He rotated his right hand clockwise.

However, before the Mystical Power of Time could be unleashed, the wings of fire flickered, and Ling Han had already stepped in front of the empress. Then, the Mystical Power of Time became completely ineffective.
Little Ye frowned. He had already taken out his trump card, and it was still unable to trap Ling Han?
"Let’s go!" Ling Han transmitted a message through his divine sense. He didn’t know when some Great Emperor would charge over, and it would be too unwise to continue fighting here.
He directly collected the stars, one, two, three, then led everyone to charge towards the Primitive Abyss.
He took the lead, and the three Pseudo-Emperors retreated as they fought, bringing up the rear.

The people from the Lands of Death pursued one after another. Even if there was the Primitive Abyss in front of them, they were unafraid, because very soon, a Great Emperor would appear, and suppress everything.
In the Primitive Abyss, specks of light rained down.
Boom!
A spot of light exploded, instantly emitting a terrifying wave of energy that spread out in all directions.
Everyone hurriedly dodged. This was something that could kill a nine-star Saint.
Yet Ling Han was completely unconcerned. He stood in front of them, protecting them.
This time, no one dared to give chase. Only the Natural-born Gold Spirit and Little Ye were unafraid of this kind of energy wave.
The two of them were still in pursuit, looking like they would not give up.
And right at this moment, outside of the Primitive Abyss, a Yin River pierced down from the skies.
Lord of Death, Great Emperor Senluo had arrived.
Without hesitation, this Yin River flowed into the Primitive Abyss, setting off in rapid pursuit.

Ling Han hurriedly drew everyone into his body. For those who held Imperial Weapons, whom he could not absorb into his body, he would grab them physically. He and the three Pseudo-Emperors brought them with them, running quickly.

Thankfully, they had entered into the Primitive Abyss first, and the flow of time here was much faster. With a head start, even the Great Emperor would not be able to catch up to them in a short amount of time.
Moreover, Great Emperor Senluo couldn’t unleash his full strength at this moment.
"Let’s go to Dragon Head City!"
Ling Han and the three Pseudo-Emperors did not hesitate at all, and headed towards the area of Primal Chaos.

In the outside world, no matter how fast they ran, they could not possibly be faster than a Great Emperor, and would always be caught up. Thus, they could only bring Great Emperor Senluo with them to Dragon Head City, and use another Great Emperor to restrain him.

sentences.text: Ling Han was astonished.
The other party actually recognized the light of great dao.
Moreover, he had forcefully halted his advance.
This was like reining in his horse at the brink of a cliff, not daring to face him head-on.
He naturally would not give up, and set off in pursuit of Little Ye.
This time, Little Ye was no longer arrogant.
Instead, he did not dare to take it head-on at all.
He turned around and fled.
His speed was also abnormally fast, and he was teleporting in a flash.
Was this another application of the Regulations of Time?
Even if Ling Han possessed the world’s fastest movement technique, Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he actually couldn’t catch up to him.
He could only maintain a stalemate.
This caused Ling Han to have even stronger desire of killing him.
However, what could he do if he couldn’t catch up to him?
Just now, Little Ye had been so arrogant, but when he saw the light of great dao, he was so scared that he fled in a panic.
Could it be that it was light of great dao could naturally restrain him?
With a thought from Ling Han, he threw a punch through the air.
Instantly, the power of his fist surged violently, enveloping Destructive Energy and light of great dao.
How fast was this kind of attack?
That was because Ling Han himself was in an extremely high speed.
This punch shot out explosively, turning into a brilliant ball of light that rapidly chased after Little Ye.
In a mere instant, the fist light had caught up to Little Ye.
Little Ye had no choice but to turn around to parry.
Otherwise, it would definitely be a situation of death.
Peng!
He split into seven, and used the Doppelgangers Summoning Technique again, extracting six "selves" at different times to face the attack together.
The fist light exploded, and when the light dissipated, Little Ye was still standing there unscathed.
However, the six doppelgangers trembled at the same time, and then quickly disappeared.
"Wa!" Little Ye threw up blood, but the expression on his face was much more relaxed.
"Scared me to death.
I had thought that you had really grasped the light of great dao, but as it turned out, it was just a little bit," he said thankfully.
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, "Even if it’s just a little bit, it’s enough to beat the crap out of you!"
This!
Little Ye’s expression turned dark.
Previously, he had been scared out of his wits.
When he sensed the aura of the light of great dao, he immediately fled.
He had not thought that Ling Han had only grasped a little bit of it.

But even if it was just a little bit, it had still shattered his doppelgangers of time with a single strike, causing them to completely dissipate, and he would not be able to summon them out again for the moment.
Merely from this aspect, he was no match for Ling Han.
He looked at Ling Han, and there was actually the passing of time in his eyes.
However, after only a while, his figure trembled, and blood seeped out from the corner of his mouth.
He wanted to use the Regulations of Time to predict Ling Han’s past and future, but all he saw was Primal Chaos.
He wanted to forcibly erase the Primal Chaos, but when he looked closely, he suffered a backlash.
"Hehe, Ling Han, you can restrict me, but if I make a move on others, will they be able to resist my Mystical Power of Time?" Little Ye suddenly smiled, as if he had regained his confidence.
Ling Han looked at him coldly, "You can give it a try!"
A powerful killing intent radiated from his body as he said this.
Little Ye’s eyes darted around, and took out a crystal from his robes.
It was transparent, but there was light circulating on its surface.
He played around with it for a while, and muttered, "I can’t bear to part with this.
After all, this is the only thing that accompanied my birth."
Then, he looked at Ling Han, and lit up the crystal, "This thing is called the Time Crystal.
When it is used in a certain area, it can decrease the flow of time in this area by a few hundred times."
"Thus, as long as I trap you within, you can only watch helplessly as I commit murder.
Hehe!"
Ling Han’s expression changed drastically.
He had seen the extreme changes in the flow of time in the Primitive Abyss.
That was truly a hopeless situation.
Even a Pseudo-Emperor would instantly become a skeleton in the Primitive Abyss.
After all, a Pseudo-Emperor would only have a lifespan of a few million years, which was negligible before the passage of time in the universe.

Little Ye’s ability was definitely not comparable to heaven and earth, but if it was really as he had said, and he trapped him, then he could only sit by and watch as the other party reaped the heads of those in his party.
Aside from Ling Han, no one was a match for Little Ye.
That Mystical Power of Time was too terrifying.
"Hehe, go!" Little Ye immediately threw out the Time Crystal.
Ling Han hurriedly dodged, but the Time Crystal had already exploded.
Weng, it turned into a massive screen of light that instantly caught up to Ling Han, enveloping him within.
Ling Han immediately discovered that his movements had slowed down.
No, no, no.
He was not slow.
It was just that others had become faster, at least a few hundred times faster.
He was affected by the Time Crystal, and the flow of time in his body was several hundred times slower than outside.
What could he do?
Ling Han immediately thought of this.
Previously, Little Ye had also wanted to use the Mystical Power of Time to age him or turn him younger.
However, the light of great dao had taken effect, and blocked this Mystical Power of Time.
Now... was this possible?
Ling Han actively channeled the light of great dao.
Weng, his whole body glowed, exuding the Qi of great dao.
Xiu, his speed instantly sped up.
Two times, three times, five times, ten times...
Though he had not recovered to the normal flow of time, compared to before, it was already much, much faster.
When Little Ye saw this, he couldn’t help but frown, "What a freakish guy, to actually have mastered the light of great dao!"
He no longer hesitated, and charged towards the empress and the others.
"Hehe, age!" He rotated his right hand clockwise.
However, before the Mystical Power of Time could be unleashed, the wings of fire flickered, and Ling Han had already stepped in front of the empress.
Then, the Mystical Power of Time became completely ineffective.
Little Ye frowned.
He had already taken out his trump card, and it was still unable to trap Ling Han?
"Let’s go!" Ling Han transmitted a message through his divine sense.
He didn’t know when some Great Emperor would charge over, and it would be too unwise to continue fighting here.
He directly collected the stars, one, two, three, then led everyone to charge towards the Primitive Abyss.
He took the lead, and the three Pseudo-Emperors retreated as they fought, bringing up the rear.
The people from the Lands of Death pursued one after another.
Even if there was the Primitive Abyss in front of them, they were unafraid, because very soon, a Great Emperor would appear, and suppress everything.
In the Primitive Abyss, specks of light rained down.
Boom!
A spot of light exploded, instantly emitting a terrifying wave of energy that spread out in all directions.
Everyone hurriedly dodged.
This was something that could kill a nine-star Saint.
Yet Ling Han was completely unconcerned.
He stood in front of them, protecting them.
This time, no one dared to give chase.
Only the Natural-born Gold Spirit and Little Ye were unafraid of this kind of energy wave.
The two of them were still in pursuit, looking like they would not give up.
And right at this moment, outside of the Primitive Abyss, a Yin River pierced down from the skies.
Lord of Death, Great Emperor Senluo had arrived.
Without hesitation, this Yin River flowed into the Primitive Abyss, setting off in rapid pursuit.
Ling Han hurriedly drew everyone into his body.
For those who held Imperial Weapons, whom he could not absorb into his body, he would grab them physically.
He and the three Pseudo-Emperors brought them with them, running quickly.
Thankfully, they had entered into the Primitive Abyss first, and the flow of time here was much faster.
With a head start, even the Great Emperor would not be able to catch up to them in a short amount of time.
Moreover, Great Emperor Senluo couldn’t unleash his full strength at this moment.
"Let’s go to Dragon Head City!"
Ling Han and the three Pseudo-Emperors did not hesitate at all, and headed towards the area of Primal Chaos.
In the outside world, no matter how fast they ran, they could not possibly be faster than a Great Emperor, and would always be caught up.
Thus, they could only bring Great Emperor Senluo with them to Dragon Head City, and use another Great Emperor to restrain him.

chapters.title: Chapter 4750: Great Emperor restraining Great Emperor
paragraphs: Previously, the True Dragon Emperor had suffered a great loss, and if he saw the Great Emperor Senluo now, he would definitely be furious.
This was the only way out for Ling Han and the others.

Furthermore, allowing the Lords of Death and the 36 Divine Beasts to fight was also in line with Ling Han’s plans, because no matter how he looked at it, both sides were aiming to destroy the universe.
Just let these dogs fight... Uh, these words couldn’t be heard by the large black dog.
This time, their luck was especially good. On the way, they did not encounter any energy storm. Though it took them a few months, they still successfully arrived outside Dragon Head City.
Behind them, the Yin River was already closing in.
Boom!
A terrifying aura surged out of the city, and then an Azure Dragon soared into the skies.
However... the Azure Dragon’s eyes were focused on Ling Han and the others.
Ling Han suddenly had an idea, and immediately called out loudly, "Great Emperor Senluo, we have already reached our destination!"
Instantly, the True Dragon Emperor shifted his gaze, landing on the Yin River that was rapidly chasing after them, his eyes bursting with hatred.
He was a Great Emperor, yet he had actually been forced to flee in a panic. This was a great humiliation!
Thus, he didn’t care about Ling Han and the other ants as he attacked Yin River.
When this Great Emperor made a move, even if Great Emperor Senluo felt disdain for the True Dragon Emperor, he could not possibly take it lightly.
Thus, he could only temporarily set Ling Han and the others aside to face the True Dragon Emperor.
"Humph, nothing but a defeated opponent!" he said disdainfully.

"You’re neither a human nor a ghost, yet you still dare to boast shamelessly?" the True Dragon Emperor said with a cold chuckle. He controlled his supreme Regulations and attacked the Yin River madly.
Without unleashing his full power, Great Emperor Senluo was no match for the True Dragon Emperor.
Ling Han and the others didn’t dare to watch the show from the sidelines. No matter which Great Emperor won, they would definitely be the next target.
They hurriedly passed through the Dragon Head City, then continued onwards.

Meanwhile, the Natural-born Gold Spirit and Little Ye continued their pursuit. One of them was a Pseudo-Empero, while the other was a supreme Saint that had grasped the Mystical Power of Time. They were qualified to act with no qualms like this.
Moreover, there were still twelve Great Emperors behind them, so they were even more unafraid.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The True Dragon Emperor bombarded him madly, blasting Yin River to the point that liquid was splashing everywhere. At this moment, he was extremely domineering, and had a great advantage.
"Fake True Dragon, are you courting death?" the Great Emperor Senluo humphed. He was already infuriated.
He was the overlord that was invincible in his era, so how high and noble was he?

And even if it was the True Dragon, there were still Divine Beasts in the past, so it could not be said that it was the sole ruler of an era, what more when this True Dragon in front of him had many problems, and was definitely not the same one as the one from all those years ago.

"Humph, you’ve cultivated evil arts, and that’s why you were able to survive the passage of time. I don’t believe that you won’t need to pay a price for recovering to your prime, and that can continue endlessly!" the True Dragon Emperor said balefully.
"It’s more than enough to kill you!" the Great Emperor Senluo said coldly.
The True Dragon Emperor took a step back, and said, "This is my territory. If you step back, I don’t want to fight you to the point of mutual destruction either."
"Are you even worthy of negotiating with me?" the Great Emperor Senluo said, appearing extremely proud.
After all, he had once been invincible for an era.
"You’ve gone too far!" The True Dragon Emperor was also angered, and he didn’t say anything else. Instead, he intensified his attacks.

"I really want to see what the hell is going on with your coming back to life!" Great Emperor Senluo suddenly charged out of the Yin River. At this moment, he finally unleashed the true strength of the Great Emperor.
The situation was completely different. He attacked aggressively, and instantly gained the upper hand, beating down on the True Dragon Emperor.
This was the battle prowess that a Great Emperor should possess!
The situation was the same as the last time. The True Dragon Emperor was outmatched after battling for a long time, and didn’t dare to continue fighting. He hurriedly turned around and fled.
Thankfully, he did not die. He had not run too far, when he encountered an energy storm.
Even if they were Great Emperors, they still didn’t dare to face this storm of energy head-on. They had no choice but to stop in their tracks.

"Fake True Dragon, let me see your true appearance!" Great Emperor Senluo was also greatly interested in this being that looked to be a True Dragon, but should not be a True Dragon at all. His offensive was like a tide, fully showing the invincibility of the Great Emperor.
The True Dragon Emperor had nowhere to retreat, and could only battle to the death.
An expression of terror appeared on his face. If they continued to battle, so what if he was a Great Emperor? He would still be killed.
"Ang!" He released a dragon’s roar that shook the heavens.
"Yi, summoning help?" The Great Emperor Senluo looked surprised. No wonder; there was something similar to the True Dragon Emperor in the Primitive Abyss?
—Previously, though Ling Han had revealed the news of the 36 Divine Beasts to the ruler of the Blood Sea, the ruler of the Blood Sea did not believe it at all.
Thus, since she didn’t believe him, why would she tell the Great Emperor Senluo and the others?
"All the more reason to kill you!" Great Emperor Senluo’s killing intent surged like a flood.
Even as powerful as he was, he would still frown deeply when he was besieged by two "True Dragon Emperors". If there were three or even four of them, he would have to consider retreating.
Thus, he had to make the most of his time.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The might of the Great Emperor was fully unleashed. The True Dragon Emperor, on the other hand, was lacking in ability, and his performance was becoming worse and worse.
This was also in line with the deductions of Buddha Doga, Great Emperor Senluo and so on. There was a huge problem with this True Dragon, and it was definitely not like the real Great Emperor.
Though the True Dragon Emperor tried his best to resist, in a situation where there was no way out and he could only fight to the death, how could he last long?
Peng!

The Great Emperor Senluo unleashed a furious punch, and the True Dragon Emperor’s chest was forcefully pierced through. The Great Emperor Senluo then reached over with both hands and ripped the True Dragon Emperor into two.

"Humph, with such a physique, are you worthy of being called the True Dragon?" the Great Emperor Senluo said coldly. He took a deep breath, and instantly, whether it was the True Dragon Emperor that was still breathing, or the Dragon Head City in front of them, all of their life essence was sucked away by him.
In an instant, this had become a land of death.
His shrivelled body was slightly plumper, but he was still far from his complete state.
After all, there were far too few living beings in this place. If it weren’t for the fact that he had a Great Emperor, he wouldn’t have even recovered one-ten-thousandth of his power.
"Strange, when did such a city appear inside the Primitive Abyss?" The Great Emperor Senluo frowned, "And it has to be at such a time! Could it be a coincidence?"
"Impossible, how could there be such a coincidence in this world!"
He looked ahead, and could clearly sense that a frightening aura was presently rapidly approaching.
This was an existence that was not inferior to him.
Great Emperor-level!
In just a short while, a green divine bird flew over.
"Azure Phoenix?" The Great Emperor Senluo sneered. "This is getting more and more fun. Even the Azure Phoenix has come back to life!"
The Azure Phoenix was in the air, and Imperial Might permeated through the air.
"You killed the True Dragon?" The Azure Phoenix’s voice boomed, but if Ling Han was here, he would definitely discover that this Azure Phoenix was actually a male!
"Do you also want to die?" the Great Emperor Senluo asked calmly.
The Azure Phoenix Emperor gazed at Great Emperor Senluo and said, "You’ve already entered a state of exhaustion. Can you still fight?"
The Great Emperor Senluo smiled faintly, and said, "I’m powerful enough to kill you!"
Even if he was a Lord of Death, this kind of invincible confidence was still breathtaking.
